Revenue Cycle Operations Manager

AdvantixxRCM is seeking a hands-on operations leader to build and manage compliant, scalable revenue-cycle workflows across billing, claims, A/R, denials, payment posting, eligibility, prior authorization, credentialing, reporting, and client service.   • Demonstrated ability to manage distributed teams and improve measurable outcomes.

Privacy, Security, and Ethical Billing

The manager must model HIPAA, minimum-necessary access, data-security, payer, client, and company requirements. jobs.excerpt: Company Overview:Our client is a publicly traded cloud storage company with two flagship products: a personal computer backup solution and a cloud object storage platform often compared to Amazon S3 — but chosen for its pricing and a no-egress-fees policy that has made it a go-to for cost-conscious builders.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a publicly traded cloud storage company with two flagship products: a personal computer backup solution and a cloud object storage platform often compared to Amazon S3 — but chosen for its pricing and a no-egress-fees policy that has made it a go-to for cost-conscious builders. They run their own physical data centers (4 in the U.S., plus Netherlands and Canada), and their engineering culture is unusually transparent — they publish deep technical blog posts and hardware reliability reports that the industry actually reads. They're expanding globally, with active hiring across LATAM, India, and the Philippines. This isn't a company that abstracts away the hard parts; they own the stack, and it shows.

Your Role:

The Storage Platform team owns the foundational durable storage layer that every product is built on top of. Their job — and yours — is to make sure data doesn't get lost, performance holds at scale, and the architecture is ready for the next decade of growth. This is an open-ended, ambiguous, systems-close-to-the-metal role: you'll be investigating unclear symptoms, optimizing for specific hardware behaviors, improving throughput, and helping redesign components that general-purpose tools can no longer handle well. You'll be fully embedded with the U.S. team — not a satellite — which means deep collaboration, clear communication, and real ownership.

You'll:

  • Build and evolve a storage platform operating at cloud scale — we're talking exabyte-level storage with real durability constraints

  • Optimize for different hard drive and hardware characteristics, improving throughput and reducing error rates across hardware failure modes

  • Troubleshoot ambiguous, symptom-driven problems where the signal is limited and the root cause isn't obvious

  • Contribute to major architectural upgrades that will support the platform for the next 5–10 years — including support for emerging storage technologies

  • Take ownership of parts of the stack where general-purpose components stop being the right fit

  • Improve hardware utilization and efficiency as the business grows upmarket and scale increases

  • Collaborate closely with a distributed team — coordinating, problem-solving, and communicating across time zones daily

You Bring:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with comfort operating lower in the stack

  • Experience with complex systems where performance, reliability, and cost actually matter

  • A genuine ability to work through ambiguity — you can navigate limited signal and multiple possible causes without getting stuck

  • Solid collaboration and communication skills in English (strong enough for deep technical conversations)

  • Proficiency in Java, or meaningful experience in adjacent languages (C, C++, C#, Rust) — fundamentals matter more than the specific language

  • A track record of shipping in environments where engineering decisions have real downstream consequences

Bonus points:

  • Experience working with hardware or systems tightly coupled to hardware behavior

  • Exposure to Rustor interest in growing into it

  • Breadth across different systems and types of projects over time

What They Offer:

  • Fully remote contractor role based in LATAM (currently focused on Costa Rica, Mexico, Chile, and Colombia)

  • Competitive USD compensation: $50K–$90K base (location/market-adjusted) plus ~10% bonus

  • Full integration with the U.S. engineering team — real ownership, not a satellite setup

  • A chance to work on infrastructure that underpins real customer data at meaningful scale

  • A company with an unusually transparent engineering culture and a strong technical reputation

Interview Process:

1️⃣ Recruiter Screen — behavioral alignment, comp, logistics, and a few targeted questions
2️⃣ Technical Phone Screen — with a lead engineer from the Storage Platform team
3️⃣ Panel Interviews (×3) — ranging from lower-level coding to higher-level system design topics

Our team has fully embraced AI-assisted, agentic development, guided by a core principle: agentic workflows scale execution, but they don’t always scale judgment. Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention

Experience & Skills

  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)

  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening

  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

jobs.excerpt: About Rimini Street, Inc. Rimini Street, Inc. jobs.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a global leader in end-to-end third-party enterprise software support, managed services and Agentic AI ERP innovation solutions, dedicated to helping clients realize extraordinary business outcomes.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.


Position Summary


We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Demand Marketing, EMEA to lead the planning, localisation and execution of integrated demand marketing programmes across EMEA.


This role sits at the intersection of global campaigns, regional marketing, digital execution, client marketing and sales. The successful candidate will take global priorities and propositions and turn them into high-performing, locally relevant programmes that create engagement, generate qualified demand, accelerate opportunities and expand relationships with existing clients.


This is a highly collaborative and execution-focused role. You will work across country and field marketing, digital, content, product marketing, client marketing, SDR and sales teams to ensure campaigns are coordinated across channels, adapted appropriately for EMEA markets and measured against commercial outcomes.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation

  • Lead the development and execution of integrated demand generation programmes across EMEA.
  • Translate global campaign strategies into effective regional programmes aligned to EMEA priorities and sales needs.
  • Build multi-channel campaigns across paid and owned channels, including email, digital advertising, content syndication, and SDR activation.
  • Develop campaign journeys that move audiences from awareness and engagement through to qualified demand and pipeline.
  • Coordinate campaign activity across countries and segments to maximise impact while avoiding fragmented or duplicated execution.
  • Partner with sales and SDR teams to ensure appropriate follow-up and progression of campaign-generated demand.

Localisation & Regional Activation

  • Own the localisation and regionalisation of global campaigns for EMEA.
  • Determine where campaigns require simple translation versus deeper localisation of messaging, creative, offers and channel mix.
  • Work closely with country marketing teams to adapt programmes for different markets, buyer behaviours and sales priorities.
  • Manage localisation of campaign assets including landing pages, email, advertising, content, webinars and sales enablement.
  • Ensure regional execution maintains global brand and messaging consistency while remaining locally relevant.
  • Identify opportunities to develop EMEA-specific campaigns where global programmes do not sufficiently address regional market needs.

Digital Execution

  • Drive digital activation of EMEA campaigns across email, paid media, web, social, content syndication and other appropriate channels.
  • Partner with digital and marketing operations teams on audience segmentation, targeting, campaign builds, testing and optimisation.
  • Use performance data to continuously optimise targeting, messaging, creative, channel mix and investment.
  • Champion test-and-learn approaches across campaigns, including audience, creative and conversion testing.

Client Marketing

  • Develop demand and engagement programmes for the existing EMEA client base, not just net-new prospects.
  • Partner with client-facing teams to build campaigns supporting cross-sell, upsell, advocacy, retention and deeper engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate customer stories, references and proof points into demand programmes.
  • Build targeted client campaigns based on relevant solutions, customer needs and account opportunities.
  • Ensure client marketing is integrated into the broader EMEA campaign calendar rather than operating as a separate activity.

Sales & SDR Alignment

  • Partner closely with regional sales and SDR leadership to align demand programmes with pipeline priorities.
  • Ensure campaign audiences, target accounts and propositions reflect current sales priorities.
  • Create clear campaign briefs so sales and SDR teams understand the target audience, value proposition, follow-up approach and desired outcome.
  • Develop appropriate sales enablement and follow-up assets to support campaign conversion.
  • Establish feedback loops with sales and SDR teams to understand lead quality and optimise future campaigns.

Performance & Optimisation

  • Measure campaign performance through the funnel, with a strong focus on quality and commercial impact rather than activity volume alone.
  • Track engagement, conversions, MQLs, SALs, opportunities, pipeline contribution and progression as appropriate.
  • Analyse campaign and channel performance to understand what is driving meaningful demand.
  • Identify conversion gaps and recommend actions to improve programme effectiveness.
  • Build clear reporting that communicates results, insights and recommended actions to EMEA marketing and sales leadership.
  • Apply campaign learnings systematically rather than treating each programme as a standalone activity.

Planning & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain an integrated EMEA demand and campaign calendar across global, regional and country activities.
  • Manage campaign priorities, timelines, dependencies and budgets.
  • Work with marketing operations to ensure campaigns are correctly structured, tracked and measured.
  • Establish repeatable campaign frameworks and processes that enable the EMEA team to execute faster without sacrificing local relevance.
  • Manage external agencies and partners where required.

Experience & Skills


Essential

  • Significant B2B marketing experience, ideally within enterprise technology, SaaS, IT services or a similarly complex B2B environment.
  • Strong experience developing and executing integrated demand generation campaigns.
  • Demonstrated experience managing campaigns across multiple countries or markets.
  • Proven ability to take global campaign strategies and translate them into effective regional and local execution.
  • Strong understanding of digital demand generation, including email, paid media, web, nurture and content-led campaigns.
  • Experience working with marketing automation and CRM platforms.
  • Strong understanding of the B2B buyer journey and lead management process.
  • Comfortable analysing funnel and campaign performance and translating data into decisions and actions.
  • Experience partnering closely with sales and SDR organisations.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programmes simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience marketing enterprise technology solutions to CIO, IT, finance or other senior enterprise audiences.
  • Experience with account-based marketing and named-account programmes.
  • Experience developing client or customer marketing programmes.
  • Experience operating across diverse EMEA markets and languages.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo or comparable CRM and marketing automation technology.

Location

Remote, UK


Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company: We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues: We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients: We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community: We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,700+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 23 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and Wirecutter). Calendar 2 launched earlier this year to rave reviews, and our newest product, Skylight Buddy, was just named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

About the Role:

The Retail Operations Manager will own the day to day execution & scale of our global retail operations for our big box, specialty, and international accounts: Target, Best Buy, BJ’s, and the new retailers we are onboarding. You will work side by side with a peer who runs our club channels, and you will cover for each other. You will be responsible for tracking and maintaining high wholesale customer satisfaction by delivering products accurately and on time. You will proactively manage 3PL warehouses, freight carriers, and the relationships with our wholesale retailers’ operations teams. It is also imperative you work closely with our sales teams. This role requires building and maintaining scalable processes, tools, and reporting while ensuring consistent delivery experiences across multiple markets globally. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute global fulfillment for your retail accounts to optimize delivery performance, cost efficiency, and customer satisfaction across US & international markets (OTIF).
  • Develop and monitor KPIs for your accounts, including on-time delivery, fill rate, lead time, chargeback %, and cost.
  • Track incoming shipments and quantities, and run analysis on inventory levels against Retailer on-hand quantities, sell-through, planned orders, and incoming shipments to find gaps and surplus.
  • Communicate with Retailer partners / inventory teams on planned future orders and open shipments. Partner with Sales and Planning on forecast changes.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with 3PLs, outbound transportation brokers, and outbound carriers (FTL, LTL, parcel).
  • Manage 3PL fulfillment for your wholesale accounts, including creating and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for each retailer.
  • Own each retailer’s routing guide and compliance requirements: labels, ASN accuracy, packaging, and appointment rules. Keep the 3PL current on changes.
  • Monitor and report order processing lead times, troubleshoot, and escalate issues (missed appointments, missed ship dates, late deliveries, etc.) ensuring all Retailer criteria are met for each order.
  • Execute EDI documents (850-Purchase Order, 856-Advanced Ship Notice, 810-Invoice) to ensure accurate and timely systematic communication with our wholesale retail customers.
  • Maintain order management system of record - NetSuite - moving orders through standard fulfillment phases: intake & validation, 3PL warehouse allocation, and customer delivery.
  • Lead dispute resolution for shipment penalties, order errors, or other fees assigned by the retailer, including documentation from the 3PL and carrier to submit through the retailer portal.
  • Lead onboarding of new retail partners and new product launches into retail, with Sales, Planning, and the 3PL.
  • Document your processes so your peer can cover your accounts, and cover theirs in return.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across global fulfillment operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in retail fulfillment operations, or supply chain management
  • Demonstrated experience managing fulfillment and delivery operations with 3PLs to retailers
  • Proven experience managing fulfillment for the following retail accounts (Target, Best Buy)
  • Experience with outbound transportation management and broker/carrier negotiations
  • Experience with EDI order flow (850 / 856 / 810) and retailer portals
  • Proficiency as a user of warehouse management systems
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with data-driven decision-making ability
  • Excellent project management skills with experience leading cross-cultural teams

Bonus Points for:

  • Proven experience managing fulfillment for the following retail accounts (Costco, Walmart, Sam’s Club, BJ’s)
  • Experience onboarding new retailers or running a distributor program
  • Experience with international retail shipments (ocean, forwarders, direct-to-retailer)
  • MBA or MS in Supply Chain Management, International Business, or related field
  • Experience with major ERP systems (NetSuite) and fulfillment automation platforms
  • Six Sigma certification or similar process improvement qualifications
  • Multi-lingual capabilities
  • Track record of successful change management in complex organizations

Our Commitment:

We value diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—and we hire kind, thoughtful people who care deeply about their work. If you're reading this and think, “I don’t check every box,” but still feel excited about the role: Apply. We want to hear from you.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120k-$135k per year. This range reflects the compensation Skylight reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, which may include experience, qualifications, skills, education, geographic location, and internal equity. Skylight also offers benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Skylight is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Skylight will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Job Description

Job Purpose

Here at Kraft Heinz, our US Sales team aspires to be an Indispensable Partner with a Growth and Winning Mindset, acutely focused on Superior Execution every day. This is our guiding compass to grow something great and make life delicious!

This Customer Sales Manager (CSM) position perfectly embodies that ambition, as you will own & be responsible for Taste Elevation category selling execution of $40M+ revenue with two (3) customers [Giant Carlisle/Giant Company and Giant Landover/Giant Foods] as a vital member of the Ahold Delhaize Customer Business Team (CBT). The CSM serves as the liaison between Kraft Heinz and the Customer, leading all selling activities & driving efforts tied to improving our net sales (NSV) and profit (CMA), along with building a strategic partnership with our customers. The CSM should exemplify best in class customer service while navigating through internal and external opportunities—leveraging rituals & routines, and organization to ensure optimal results and timely follow up with stakeholders.

jobs.description:
At ICF Next, we are fearless in finding new ways to solve problems, relentless in making sure it pays off for our clients and committed to making a positive change in the world.

Join our community of mission-driven creatives, communicators, strategists, and technologists to challenge the status quo.


The Team

You'll work as part of a cross-functional team of software engineers, solution and cloud architects, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, quality assurance specialists, user experience professionals, business analysts, product managers, data analysts, accessibility and security specialists, and behavioral health subject matter experts. We partner with federal stakeholders to operate and modernize a mission-critical data collection and performance reporting platform used by grantees and program staff. The team balances reliable production operations with incremental modernization in a secure federal cloud environment.


The Work

In this individual contributor role, you will design, build, test, and support secure, accessible web applications that enable data entry, batch ingestion, validation, workflow, role-based access, reporting, and data exchange. You will contribute across the application stack, including C# and .NET services, web interfaces, APIs, SQL Server data stores, automated tests, and release pipelines.

A key part of the work is strengthening the platform while it remains in active use. You will help modernize legacy components incrementally, improve performance and reliability, raise data quality, expand automated testing and deployment practices, and make production behavior easier to observe and troubleshoot. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who values maintainable systems, practical collaboration, and technology that supports public health programs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain production web applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core or MVC, and modern JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs, web services, and system integrations that support secure and reliable data exchange.
  • Implement data entry, batch upload, validation, duplicate detection, workflow, notification, and data download capabilities.
  • Design and optimize SQL Server data models, queries, and stored procedures, and support data migration, reconciliation, and historical data needs.
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests; contribute to automated build, test, and deployment pipelines.
  • Support production operations by investigating defects, analyzing application logs and monitoring data, identifying root causes, and delivering tested fixes.
  • Apply secure coding, least-privilege access, role-based authorization, privacy, Section 508, and WCAG requirements throughout delivery.
  • Participate in Agile planning, estimation, daily coordination, code reviews, demonstrations, release activities, and user acceptance testing support.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, cloud, database, security, quality assurance, accessibility, product, and client stakeholders.
  • Maintain technical documentation for application behavior, interfaces, data flows, deployment procedures, and operational support.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years developing and supporting production web applications, including 2+ years using C#, .NET or .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC or Web API with object-oriented design.
  • 2+ years working with SQL Server or another relational database, including data modeling, query development, and performance troubleshooting.
  • 1+ year developing browser-based interfaces and integrating REST APIs using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and JSON.
  • 1+ year writing automated tests and collaborating through Git-based source control, pull requests, and code reviews.
  • 1+ year implementing authentication, authorization, role-based access, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot application issues, document technical solutions, and communicate effectively within a collaborative delivery team.
  • Authorization to work in the United States, ability to perform all work within the United States, and ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and complete required background screening.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience contributing to incremental modernization of legacy .NET applications while maintaining reliable production service.
  • Experience supporting applications in AWS or AWS GovCloud and troubleshooting issues using monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch or Splunk.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or infrastructure as code, including command-line tools for automation and deployment support.
  • Experience building interfaces with React, Angular, or another modern frontend framework and using reusable components or established design systems.
  • Experience integrating Okta or another federated identity platform for single sign-on and multifactor authentication.
  • Experience implementing batch data ingestion, ETL, data quality rules, or business intelligence integrations such as Tableau.
  • Experience supporting federal government or public health applications, or familiarity with federal security, privacy, and accessibility requirements, such as NIST Moderate controls, FedRAMP, ATO processes, or Section 508/WCAG.

Autodesk’s M&A Finance team is a highly visible and impactful group that plays a key role in shaping the company’s inorganic growth and strategic evolution. Reporting to the Director, M&A Finance, the Senior Program Manager, M&A Finance will be a critical leader within the M&A Finance team, supporting the full M&A lifecycle from diligence and transaction planning through close, integration, and post-close value realization.


This role will partner closely with FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, Corporate Development, Legal, HR, IT, business teams, and more Finance and cross-functional teams to assess transactions, support decision-making, and execute finance workstreams across acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic initiatives. Reporting to the Director of M&A Finance, the Senior Program Manager, will lead and support finance activities across the full M&A lifecycle, from diligence through sign, close, and integration. This role partners across FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, Corporate Development, Legal, HR, IT, business teams, and more to deliver transaction support, finance readiness, and integration execution for Autodesk’s strategic initiatives.


Responsibilities

  • Lead finance workstreams across the full M&A lifecycle, including diligence, deal planning, close readiness, Day 1 execution, and post-close integration
  • Partner with finance sub-functions and cross-functional M&A stakeholders to assess risks and opportunities, support transaction recommendations, and drive execution planning
  • Lead finance diligence activities, including analysis of historical and projected financial performance, operating metrics, cash flow, working capital, and key transaction assumptions
  • Review transaction materials and agreements to provide finance input on deal structure, financial risks, and key provisions
  • Synthesize diligence findings, financial risks, and integration considerations into clear recommendations and decision-ready materials for leadership
  • Analyze and negotiate key transaction and closing considerations, including minimum cash requirements, net working capital, funds flow, purchase price adjustments, escrows, holdbacks, and related closing mechanics
  • Coordinate pre-close planning across core finance functions, including Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, FP&A, Treasury, Payroll, Tax, etc. to support Day 1 readiness and continuity of operations
  • Develop and execute finance integration plans, including governance, milestone tracking, executive updates, risk management, issue resolution, and decision-making processes
  • Partner with acquired company finance teams and Autodesk stakeholders to transition processes, systems, controls, vendors, bank accounts, and reporting into Autodesk’s operating model
  • Support closing and post-close execution activities, including review of seller deliverables, finance approvals, onboarding and transition planning, and transaction-related settlements in partnership with cross-functional teams
  • Track integration progress, critical dependencies, and blockers against transaction objectives, escalating issues and driving timely resolution as needed
  • Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and scale M&A finance processes, tools, templates, and governance, while building strong relationships and influencing effectively across a matrixed organization

  • Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations
  • Experience leading across cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, FP&A, Treasury, Payroll, and Tax
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior leaders and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive alignment, manage ambiguity, drive accountability, and deliver results in a matrixed organization
  • Strong program and project management skills, including planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and issue resolution
  • High degree of business judgment, attention to detail, and ownership

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced finance or accounting credentials
  • Experience in the technology or SaaS industry
  • Experience supporting software, cloud, or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with valuation concepts and transaction metrics, including synergy analysis, cash flow assessment, and key deal performance indicators

jobs.title: AI Field Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.excerpt: Location: New York, NY / San Mateo, CA / Remote, USA Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 3–10 years Compensation: $176K–$228K base | $220K–$285K OTE + meaningful equity Visa: H-1B transfers and TN visas sponsored; O-1 considered case-by-case About the RoleWe’re hiring an AI Field Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our AI’s high-velocity team You’ll work directly with ambitious AI-native companies to turn complex AI challenges into production-ready systems.
jobs.description:
Location: New York, NY / San Mateo, CA / Remote, USA
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 3–10 years
Compensation: $176K–$228K base | $220K–$285K OTE + meaningful equity
Visa: H-1B transfers and TN visas sponsored; O-1 considered case-by-case


About the Role

We’re hiring an AI Field Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our AI’s high-velocity team

You’ll work directly with ambitious AI-native companies to turn complex AI challenges into production-ready systems. This is a highly hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI engineering, product, and customer delivery.

You’ll build POCs, MVPs, and production integrations while working directly with customers, account executives, and engineering teams. You’ll also engage with technical and executive stakeholders to discuss architecture, strategy, and business outcomes.

This is not a traditional consulting or solutions role you’ll be hands-on-keyboard, writing code, deploying systems, solving technical problems, and contributing directly to our products and platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their technical and business challenges.

  • Design and build POCs, MVPs, and production AI applications.

  • Deploy and optimize LLM and generative AI workloads in production.

  • Work with open-source models, inference infrastructure, and AI/ML platforms.

  • Collaborate with customer engineering teams, account executives, and Fireworks product/engineering teams.

  • Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Troubleshoot complex AI, infrastructure, and deployment challenges.

  • Communicate technical architecture and tradeoffs to both engineers and executive stakeholders.

  • Contribute code and product improvements directly to the codebase.

  • Turn customer learnings into product feedback and help shape our roadmap.

  • Take ownership of projects from initial discovery through production deployment.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong technical depth with excellent customer-facing skills.

You may come from backgrounds such as:

  • Forward Deployed Engineer

  • AI/ML Engineer

  • Applied AI Engineer

  • AI Solutions Engineer

  • Solutions Architect

  • Sales Engineer

  • Customer Engineer

  • ML/AI Infrastructure Engineer

  • Customer Success Engineer with strong technical depth


Required

  • 3–10 years of experience in a client-facing technical or AI/ML engineering role.

  • Strong Python programming skills.

  • Experience building and deploying AI/ML or generative AI applications.

  • Experience working with LLMs and/or open-source AI models.

  • Ability to work directly with customers and communicate technical concepts clearly.

  • Experience building POCs and taking solutions toward production.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

  • Willingness to work hands-on across engineering, customer delivery, and product.


Technical Experience

Experience with some of the following is highly relevant:

  • Python

  • vLLM

  • SGLang

  • TensorRT-LLM

  • Kubernetes

  • AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • AWS Bedrock / SageMaker

  • Azure AI Foundry

  • GCP Vertex AI

  • LLM fine-tuning, including SFT, DPO, or RFT

  • GPU infrastructure

  • Model inference and optimization

You do not need experience with every technology listed, but you should have strong fundamentals in AI/ML engineering and be comfortable learning quickly.


Why Join?

  • Work directly with cutting-edge AI companies.

  • Build real AI systems that move from prototype to production.

  • Work across engineering, product, and customer delivery.

  • Contribute directly to an AI infrastructure platform.

  • Join a highly technical, builder-first team.

  • Competitive compensation of $220K–$285K OTE + meaningful equity.

  • US visa support including H-1B transfers and TN visas.

jobs.excerpt: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health.
jobs.companyName: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
jobs.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The role is a technical lead that requires deep knowledge, skills, and experience in designing and carrying out quality analytics. The incumbent for this position will design and implement a structured approach to data quality, ensuring our HEDIS data accurately reflects the health status of our members. The position is a key team member collaborating in a multi-disciplinary business environment with colleagues across the enterprise to lead quality performance analytics, development, and reporting that deliver actionable insights. As a subject matter expert, the role collects business requirements as per State, CMS, and NCQA specifications, translates business requirements into analytics design, define data & analytics specifications, manipulates and analyze large healthcare data from various data sources, and interpret the findings to inform opportunities and solutions that improve clinical quality and increase cost efficiency and health care affordability. This position requires advanced data analytic programming and coding skills with robust knowledge and understanding of the healthcare business and data.

What You'll Do

  • Functions as the implementation lead for projects designed to improve HEDIS, Stars, accreditation and State performance.
  • Functions as the vendor relationship owner (VRO) to vendors utilized intended to improve quality performance.
  • Builds robust quality assurance criteria and processes to ensure regulatory reporting data is complete and accurate.
  • Acts as the analytic liaison for complex clinical analytics projects involving multiple data resources and teams to inform business decisions in clinical, network, and value-based performance models.
  • Understands the strategic direction of the organization and the analytic and reporting requirements to meet departmental needs. Translates business questions and needs into analytics technical requirements including data analytics design, clinical and data.
  • Creates integrated analytic datasets and summarizes findings to inform business opportunities and address business questions. Provides insight and guidance into analytic findings (including root causes and contributing factors – both actionable and not) through clear, professional, succinct written and oral summaries, tables, charts, reports, or presentations.
  • Navigates across multiple analytical and business units to socialize analytics design, results and interpretation, including making recommendations on how to use the results to inform business decisions.
  • Documents methods, specifications and findings clearly. Collaborate with team members to document work appropriately, including SAS coding comments and use of analytic plan/timeline where needed for analytic projects.
  • Presents analytics findings to internal leadership teams to inform actionable opportunities and solutions.
  • Provides technical trainings (analytics design, data, programming, QA, statistics, documentation, etc.) to junior analysts.

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Bachelor degree in Math, Statistics, Data Science, or Public Health preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree.
  • Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in data analytics, HEDIS, SAS or related field.
  • Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience performing analysis on healthcare data, HEDIS data or relational health care databases with significant experience analyzing medical, pharmacy and behavioral data.

Knowledge:

  • Requires extensive knowledge of US healthcare industry, health plan business, claims data, clinical data, and coding practices.​
  • Prefers knowledge and working experience of visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau) with preference given to Tableau experience.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Strongly Prefers SAS, SQL and Python experience
  • Requires proficiency with MS Excel for data analysis and reporting.
  • Requires solid organizational skills and attention to details.
  • Requires strong ability to work in a fast-paced team-oriented environment and strong ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Must be highly motivated and able to work independently.

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

$109,600 - $149,625

This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Global Supply Sourcing Coordinator to join our team working remotely.

As a Global Supply Sourcing Coordinator, you will provide tactical sourcing solutions for depots, investigational medicinal products, couriers, and ancillary supplies. You will analyze complex study requirements, advise internal customers, and coordinate sourcing activities that help ensure compliant products and services are available when clinical studies need them.

You will join a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your work will support clinical study execution through supplier selection, sourcing, contracting, problem resolution, and supply planning. By building effective supplier relationships and offering out of the box solutions, you will help teams respond to urgent study needs while maintaining quality, compliance, and service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain close working relationships with internal and external customers and provide professional sourcing advice and assistance at all levels.
  • Monitor the quality, pricing accuracy, purchase requests, approvals, and purchase orders.
  • Conduct commodity research, regulatory requirements, supplier selection, and requests for information, quotation, and proposals.
  • Ensure products and services are obtained at budgeted prices and that ancillary materials and investigational products meet local requirements.
  • Coordinate the return of rental equipment and medical devices.
  • Own and action sourcing help desk tickets, create and execute Statements of Work, and complete on-demand sourcing activities that support study needs.
  • Anticipate sourcing challenges, take ownership through resolution, and work with suppliers to identify comparable compliant ancillary supplies.
  • Obtain required supplier and manufacturer documentation for import and export activities.
  • Take action on quality issues involving third-party suppliers and manage risk mitigation through resolution.
  • Assist internal customers with sourcing questions and system challenges and mentor junior team members.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in sourcing, supplier coordination, analytical problem-solving, and project management
  • An operational understanding of clinical studies, clinical supply chains, and sourcing and contracting principles
  • A client-focused approach with the ability to work with urgency and accountability in a changing environment
  • The ability to collaborate across functions, work effectively in a matrix environment, and communicate across cultures
  • Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail when managing multiple priorities and tight timelines
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn new systems and processes
  • A flexible, self-motivated, and professional approach to assignments and continued learning

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, or equivalent in biology, pharmacy, another health-related discipline, international trade, business administration, or logistics, or relevant work experience
  • Operational understanding of clinical studies, related supply chain activities, sourcing, and contracting principles
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice, Good Distribution Practice, and Good Practice requirements
  • Strong Microsoft Office knowledge
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to changing study needs
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize work with tight timelines and significant urgency while maintaining attention to detail and first-time quality

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of sourcing or procurement experience in a contract research organization or pharmaceutical environment
  • Knowledge of sourcing operations and supplier management
  • Cross-functional business team experience
  • Process and project management capabilities

Benefits and Compensation

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match
  • Pet Insurance

For a complete list of benefits, please visit .

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes paid time off, a 401(k) match, life insurance, health insurance, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Summary

A Coordinator serves as a Medicare Secondary Payer Compliance liaison between insurers, third-party administrators, attorneys, and various departments within the company. The role involves managing and maintaining an active caseload containing confidential information. The Coordinator is responsible for both written and verbal communication with teammates and customers to ensure the completion of requested services. The ability to collaborate with all teams to meet internal and client-specific service expectations is essential. Role Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Cyber Security team and play a key role in strengthening and continuously improving our security infrastructure. The role will focus on network security, security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and the continuous improvement of our security controls and architecture.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Cyber Security, Infrastructure, IT and Technology teams to protect our systems and services against evolving cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the cybersecurity architecture.

  • Manage and improve the integration of network security and protection infrastructures.

  • Perform L2/L3-level incident response for critical security incidents.

  • Analyse cyber attacks, identify and extract IOCs and TTPs, and carry out the necessary containment and remediation actions.

  • Continuously improve security controls and evolve the security architecture in response to emerging threats and vulnerabilities.

  • Contribute to the hardening of Linux and Windows systems.

  • Support vulnerability management, remediation, and security improvement activities.

  • Contribute to information security processes and compliance activities.

  • Support security automation initiatives and identify opportunities to improve security operations through automation.

  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, incident reports, and security-related assessments.Prepare technical documentation, incident reports and security-related assessments.

  • Contribute to information security processes and ISO 27001 compliance activities.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Cyber Security or a similar role.

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in Network Security and Cyber Security.

  • Experience with IAM and PAM concepts, including privileged account governance, credential vaulting, session monitoring, and least-privilege access controls.

  • Deep expertise in WAF systems, proxy management, and Layer 7 (L7) DDoS protection.

  • Experience managing DDoS protection appliances.

  • Experience with SIEM solutions, including log analysis, event correlation, alert investigation, and incident tracking.

  • Experience with EDR/XDR solutions, such as SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, or Microsoft Defender.

  • Experience in triage, investigation, and incident response for cybersecurity incidents.

  • Good knowledge of IOCs, TTPs, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Strong experience with firewall technologies, including firewall policy management, routing, and security policies.

  • Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS).

  • Ability to perform basic to intermediate-level security analysis and auditing on Windows and Linux systems.

  • Experience with vulnerability assessment, system hardening, and remediation, including the ability to produce technical reports.

  • Proficiency with vulnerability management tools and processes.

  • Ability to contribute to Red Team activities and security assessments.

  • Experience supporting and implementing security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other relevant compliance requirements.

  • Ability to document cybersecurity incidents and produce clear and detailed technical reports.

  • Knowledge of ISO 27001 and information security practices.

  • Experience with security automation processes.

  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or similar tools.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

  • Good command of English.

jobs.description:
Adventus is an Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Solutions and Services Provider with a wide footprint across the globe.

We help organizations bring about positive transformation to their businesses by leveraging intelligent applications of innovative solutions and pertinent services to remain winners in today's ultra-competitive marketplace.

With our strong network of technology partners, excellent domain expertise and differentiated value proposition, we are able to go above and beyond for our customers, far exceeding expectations.

Role Overview

We are seeking SOC Analysts to join our Managed Security Operations Center (SOC), supporting customers across ASEAN. You will monitor security alerts, investigate potential threats, manage incidents, and coordinate with customers and internal technical teams to ensure timely incident resolution.

This role follows a fixed day shift schedule 3 and a half day work week, 1 weekend off.

Working hours:

Full day: 13 hours shift (9am – 10pm)

Half day: 6.5 hours shift (9am - 3.30pm / 3pm – 9.30pm)

Job Responsibilities

  • Monitor security alerts across multiple security platforms and identify potential threats.

  • Triage and investigate alerts, analyse security logs, and distinguish true positives from false positives.

  • Assess incident severity, gather indicators of compromise (IOCs), and document investigation findings.

  • Manage and track security incidents in ServiceNow, ensuring compliance with SLAs.

  • Communicate incident updates and recommendations to customers professionally.

  • Escalate complex incidents to L3 analysts and the SOC Manager, and support containment and remediation activities.

  • Maintain accurate incident records, shift handovers, and operational documentation.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, SIEM monitoring, incident management, identity security, endpoint protection, and email security.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft security technologies, preferably Microsoft Defender.

  • Basic knowledge of security log analysis, KQL, or PowerShell is an advantage.

  • 1–2 years of experience in SOC operations, cybersecurity, or IT operations.

  • Experience in a Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP) environment is an advantage.

  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, SC-900, CompTIA Security+, or ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity are preferred.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

  • Attention to detail and accurate documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and remain effective under pressure.

  • Willingness to work rotating shifts, if required.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive (Platform)
jobs.excerpt: We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix.
jobs.description:
We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good. We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.

Role Overview:

Nuix builds software that finds the truth in complex, voluminous data. Our platform is used by governments, corporations and law enforcement agencies to investigate, analyse and understand digital information at a scale and speed that no other technology can match. As a Sales Executive at Nuix, you will be responsible for growing a significant book of enterprise business across your assigned territory, working with organisations that face the most demanding data intelligence, investigative analytics and eDiscovery challenges in the world. This is a full-cycle, platform-focused sales role requiring deep commercial acumen, patience through extended procurement processes and the credibility to engage with technical users and executive decision-makers in the same conversation.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor, owning your territory with a high degree of autonomy. You will be expected to build and sustain a healthy pipeline, orchestrate internal resources across pre-sales, legal and customer success, and close complex, high-value software and SaaS agreements. Success in this role demands a sophisticated understanding of enterprise buying behaviour, a consultative approach to uncovering and solving multi-layered business problems, and the discipline to manage long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles through to a consistent and growing outcome.

Location:

This role is 100% remote unless you are within commuting distance to one of our offices in Reston, VA or Pittsburgh, PA. If you are within commuting distance the role would be hybrid.

*We're excited to be hiring multiple team members for this role, creating several opportunities for qualified candidates to join our growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

•Own and grow a defined territory of enterprise accounts across government, corporate and commercial sectors. Develop and execute an annual territory plan that targets net-new logos and expansion within existing accounts to deliver sustained revenue growth year on year.

•Drive the full sales cycle from initial qualification through to contract execution and handover. Apply a structured qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC to assess opportunity quality, manage stakeholder consensus and advance complex deals through procurement with discipline and accuracy.

•Build and maintain executive-level relationships across each target account. Engage decision-makers at every level of the buying organisation, from operational users to C-suite, ensuring Nuix is positioned as a strategic platform partner rather than a point solution.

•Develop and maintain a pipeline that is sufficient in volume and quality to meet and exceed quota. Maintain accurate opportunity data and forecast commitments in the CRM at all times, giving the business reliable visibility of expected revenue across short and long-horizon deals.

•Lead the commercial and contractual negotiation on all opportunities within your territory. Construct commercial proposals that reflect the full value of the Nuix platform, then negotiate terms that protect margin and establish the foundation for a long-term customer relationship.

•Coordinate internal resources to deliver a compelling and consistent buyer experience throughout each sales engagement. Direct pre-sales engineers, product specialists and executive sponsors at the right moments in the cycle to strengthen the business case and address technical or commercial objections.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

  • Demonstrated success selling complex enterprise software or SaaS platforms on extended sales cycles. A consistent track record of closing high-value, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements, ideally in data intelligence, investigative analytics, legal technology, eDiscovery or an adjacent regulated technology sector.

  • Proven ability to sell a platform rather than individual products or modules. Experience positioning an integrated software platform as a strategic investment rather than a tactical purchase, with the commercial and conversational skills to align a buying committee around that narrative

  • Fluency in a structured sales qualification methodology applied to long and complex cycles. Practical experience applying MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger or an equivalent framework to qualify, advance and close enterprise opportunities that span multiple quarters or financial years.

  • The range and confidence to sell credibly to practitioners, technical evaluators and senior executives. Demonstrable experience navigating large organisations and adapting your approach, language and value proposition to meet the needs of diverse stakeholders at every level of authority.

Desired Expertise:

  • Prior sales experience in government, law enforcement, regulatory or national security sectors. Familiarity with public sector procurement frameworks, security clearance environments and the unique buying dynamics of government agencies is a meaningful advantage in a significant portion of the Nuix customer base.

  • Working knowledge of eDiscovery, digital forensics, compliance or investigative workflows. Candidates who can hold a credible technical conversation about how data is collected, processed, reviewed and produced in legal or investigative contexts will build customer confidence more quickly and shorten the trust-building phase of each engagement.

About Nuix:

Nuix is on an incredible journey of transformation, aligning our strengths with our ambitions to pursue greater opportunities. As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values.

Vision:Finding Truth in a Digital World.

Mission:Nuix creates innovative software that empowers organisations to simply and quickly find the truth from any data in a digital world. We are a passionate and talented team, delighting our customers with software that transforms data into actionable intelligence.

Values

•Take ownership and follow up

•Resilient - we learn from the past and are optimistic about tomorrow

•Unafraid to do the right thing, quickly

•Team Nuix - first and foremost

•Hero our customers and innovate for them

Position:

Field Sales Manager


Job Description:

Why You'll Love This Role

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.


Lead a Team That Shapes Microsoft's Partner Ecosystem

We're looking for an exceptional leader to build, inspire, and develop a team of Channel Managers who help Microsoft partners accelerate growth.


This isn't a traditional people management role. It's an opportunity for a coach, strategist, and builder to lead one of Microsoft's most impactful partner-facing organizations.


You'll lead a team of seven Channel Managers to help partners build differentiated go-to-market strategies, generate pipeline, and accelerate customer success.


Success isn't measured by activity—it's measured by the growth of your people, the success of our partners, and the business impact your team creates.


What You'll Be Doing

Develop Exceptional Talent

  • Your first priority is building a high-performing team.
  • You'll coach, mentor, and inspire experienced Channel Managers, helping them expand their business acumen, technical credibility, and leadership skills. You'll foster a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning while creating meaningful career growth opportunities for every team member.

Drive Partner Success

  • You'll guide your team in helping partners build successful Microsoft cloud businesses through technical readiness, solution positioning, joint business planning, go-to-market strategy, and pipeline development.
  • You'll encourage new ideas, scalable engagement models, and AI-enabled ways of working that increase the impact of both your team and our partners.

Lead Through Influence

  • This role succeeds through relationships, not hierarchy.
  • You'll work across Microsoft Sales, Partner Development, Channel Management, Solution Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, and executive partner stakeholders to align priorities, remove obstacles, and accelerate partner outcomes.
  • You'll also be a visible advocate for your team, ensuring Channel Managers have the support, relationships, and opportunities needed to maximize their impact.

Build a High-Performing Organization

  • You'll define success through measurable business outcomes, use data to guide decisions, simplify processes, and continuously improve how the organization operates.
  • You'll constantly ask how to make the team more effective, more innovative, and more valuable to partners.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience leading high-performing customer-facing, partner-facing, technical sales, solution consulting, partner success, or similar organizations.
  • Strong business acumen with experience driving go-to-market strategy, partner growth, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Success influencing leaders and collaborating across multiple organizations without relying on formal authority.
  • Detail-oriented operator with strong organizational skills and consistent follow-through.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply a robust sales cadence and business rigor, including pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and execution against targets.
  • People-oriented “servant leader” who focuses on results while prioritizing coaching, employee development, and team growth.
  • Open, direct, and honest communicator who builds trust through transparency and clear expectations.
  • Proven sales acumen and experience leading a sales team, with a track record of driving performance and accountability.
  • Prior experience with cloud and subscription services.
  • Channel experience required, including managing and growing performance through partner ecosystems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the Microsoft partner ecosystem.
  • Experience with the Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) channel.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft partner programs, incentives, co-sell, and marketplace-led growth.
  • A proven track record of coaching experienced professionals and building inclusive, high-performing teams.

Work Arrangement

Fully Remote: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.


What's In It For You

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans and a solid benefits package.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k, With Matching Contributions
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better. At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges. Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.


Life at Arrow

At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day. From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future. Head of Strategic Partnerships
Location: Remote
Compensation Range: $165,000-$200,000 OTE
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Chief of Staff

Position Overview
Transparent Energy is seeking a Head of Strategic Partnerships to build and lead a high-impact channel strategy focused on generating new business through enterprise strategic partners serving large commercial and industrial energy users.

This individual will be responsible for identifying, developing, and managing strategic relationships with organizations where Transparent Energy’s capabilities can complement or extend an existing client offering. The objective is straightforward: build a scalable network of partners that consistently generates qualified opportunities and revenue for Transparent Energy.

The ideal candidate is a senior commercial professional who combines exceptional relationship-management skills with executive presence, enterprise sales discipline, and the ability to identify mutually beneficial business models. This person must be equally comfortable developing relationships with senior executives, navigating complex organizations, structuring commercial partnerships, and working directly with partners to convert relationships into active client opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Partnership Development
  • Develop and execute Transparent Energy’s strategy for originating new business through strategic partners.
  • Identify and prioritize energy brokers, consultants, advisory firms, professional services organizations, and other potential partners whose client relationships and capabilities are complementary to Transparent Energy.
  • Build relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers within target partner organizations.
  • Develop compelling partnership models that enable partners to incorporate Transparent Energy’s energy procurement capabilities into their existing client relationships and service offerings.
  • Negotiate and structure partnership arrangements that create sustainable value for Transparent Energy, its partners, and their clients.
Partner-Driven Business Development
  • Own revenue generation and qualified pipeline originating from the strategic partnerships channel.
  • Work with partners to identify opportunities within their existing client bases where Transparent Energy can provide procurement, technology, market expertise, or other complementary capabilities.
  • Develop account strategies for high-value partner relationships and translate those relationships into specific client opportunities.
  • Collaborate with partners throughout the sales process, including prospect identification, introductions, discovery, solution development, executive engagement, and closing.
  • Maintain a disciplined pipeline of partner-generated opportunities and consistently advance opportunities toward revenue.
Relationship Management
  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for Transparent Energy’s most important strategic partners.
  • Establish trusted, long-term relationships with executives and commercial leaders across partner organizations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each partner’s business model, client base, commercial priorities, capabilities, and competitive positioning.
  • Create regular engagement with partners to identify new opportunities, resolve barriers, and expand the scope and productivity of the relationship.
  • Represent Transparent Energy as a credible, sophisticated, and highly responsive partner to senior external stakeholders.
Partnership Strategy & Market Development
  • Identify new categories of potential partners and routes to market where Transparent Energy’s capabilities can create differentiated value.
  • Evaluate prospective partnerships based on strategic fit, revenue potential, client overlap, ease of execution, and long-term scalability.
  • Develop partnership value propositions, commercial structures, sales materials, and go-to-market strategies tailored to different partner types.
  • Monitor market developments and competitive dynamics to identify emerging partnership opportunities.
  • Provide leadership with visibility into partnership pipeline, performance, market feedback, and opportunities for investment or expansion.
Internal Collaboration
  • Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Operations, Marketing, and executive leadership to ensure partner-generated opportunities receive appropriate support and follow-through.
  • Coordinate internal resources to develop solutions that meet the needs of partners and their clients.
  • Establish clear processes for partner referrals, opportunity ownership, pipeline tracking, commercial arrangements, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Serve as the internal advocate for strategic partners while ensuring partnerships remain aligned with Transparent Energy’s commercial objectives.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, business development, professional services, energy, or a related commercial field.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing senior-level relationships that resulted in meaningful revenue generation.
  • Experience selling complex B2B services or solutions to large commercial and institutional organizations.
  • Experience developing business through intermediaries, channel partners, referral relationships, consultants, or professional-services organizations strongly preferred.
  • Ability to independently originate relationships and opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads or established accounts.
  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience within energy, energy procurement, sustainability, consulting, commercial real estate, private equity, insurance, financial services, or other relationship-driven professional-services markets is advantageous.
