That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Diferenciais

Informações adicionais

Nossa cultura

Nos importamos (we care):assumimos responsabilidade antes de sermos cobrados e agimos pelo impacto real no cliente, no colega e no produto, sem esperar o problema virar incidente.

Somos auto-motivados (self driven): assumimos o ownership, identificamos o problema, resolvemos e fechamos o loop por iniciativa própria, porque é isso que faz a empresa crescer e gera confiança com o cliente.

Dominamos nosso ofício (we master the craft): entregamos com profundidade real, orgulho pelo resultado e inconformismo com soluções superficiais. Quem domina o ofício busca aprendizado e nunca se acomoda.

Ganhamos como time (we win as a team): removemos bloqueios e compartilhamos contexto, porque o resultado coletivo vale mais do que qualquer destaque individual. Quem ganha como time não guarda conhecimento, distribui.

jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Role Overview

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will operate at the front lines of innovation — embedded directly with multiple cross-functional teams to rapidly design, architect, prototype, and deploy solutions that solve their highest-priority problems. This is not a traditional engineering role with long delivery cycles: you will be expected to go from concept to working prototype in days, not months, while maintaining enterprise-grade standards for quality, security, and scalability.

You will act as the embedded technical owner across several teams simultaneously — diagnosing their workflow and data problems, then architecting and building the fix yourself. You will use modern AI coding assistants day-to-day to design and implement solutions, and you're expected to be fluent extending that toolset — building custom plugins/skills, redesigning data pipelines and data flows, and deploying agents to production via AWS Bedrock AgentCore. At the Staff level, your impact extends beyond any single team: you define the patterns and playbooks other engineers use to deliver, and you act as the escalation point for the hardest technical and stakeholder problems across the portfolio.

You bring an exceptional combination of skills: deep hands-on engineering experience across AI agents, data architecture, and full-stack development, and the interpersonal skills to earn trust, drive alignment, and influence without authority across multiple teams at once. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding a system architecture with senior stakeholders and shipping production code the same afternoon.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Lead solution design for complex, cross-functional data and AI problems — from initial discovery through to technical blueprint
  • Evaluate and select the right tools and architecture for each problem — no single stack applies across every team you support, so you must be able to reason across different platforms, data sources, and integration patterns
  • Define and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and delivery approaches to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Design scalable, modular systems that balance speed with enterprise standards for reliability, security, and maintainability
  • Create clear technical documentation: architecture diagrams, data flow maps, API contracts, and solution briefs
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns and reference designs that other engineers adopt across engagements

AI-Assisted Solution Delivery

  • Use AI coding assistants as your primary development environment for day-to-day solution building — from prototyping through production implementation
  • Build and maintain custom plugins/skills for your AI coding assistant that package reusable capabilities for recurring problems across teams
  • Redesign and rebuild data pipelines and data flows to unblock use cases — including source integration, transformation logic, and downstream delivery
  • Deploy and operate AI agents in production via AWS Bedrock AgentCore
  • Translate ambiguous business requirements from stakeholders into concrete technical solutions with minimal hand-holding
  • Balance speed of delivery with enterprise standards — your prototypes are production-ready, not throwaway
  • Develop intuitive front-end interfaces and dashboards that bring data and AI outputs to life for business users

AI Agent Development

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi-agent systems that automate complex workflows end-to-end
  • Develop and maintain agent skills and plugins — discrete, reusable capabilities that compose into larger agentic pipelines
  • Implement and extend Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients to connect agents with enterprise tools, APIs, and data sources
  • Design evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and monitoring pipelines to ensure agent reliability and safety in production on AgentCore
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape (AI coding assistants, AgentCore, MCP ecosystem) and proactively bring new techniques to the practice

Practice Leadership & Technical Strategy

  • Define and evolve delivery practices and playbooks used across multiple cross-functional teams
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for the most ambiguous or high-stakes problems across the portfolio
  • Provide direct input to the hiring manager on recurring patterns and roadmap priorities based on field signal
  • Mentor and elevate other engineers on AI-assisted agentic development, plugin design, and rapid delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Embed directly with multiple cross-functional teams simultaneously to co-define problems and co-deliver solutions
  • Influence technical direction and build alignment across teams without relying on formal authority
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical business stakeholders — in writing, in meetings, and in presentations
  • Foster a collaborative, low-ego culture where speed and quality go hand in hand

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8–12+ years of software engineering experience, with substantial time in customer-facing or embedded technical delivery roles
  • Strong software architecture background — able to independently design and defend system architecture across varied tools and platforms, not tied to one stack
  • Direct hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a primary development workflow; experience building custom plugins/skills for these tools is a strong plus
  • Direct, hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents on AWS Bedrock AgentCore — required
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server/client implementation — required
  • Data engineering experience — building and redesigning data pipelines and data flows across varied sources
  • Full-stack development proficiency — backend services, APIs, and front-end interfaces/dashboards
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and defining technical standards adopted beyond your own work
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to manage multiple concurrent internal stakeholder relationships

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.


Expected compensation for this position:

150,000.00 – 280,000.00 USD per year

Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

This position requires someone who can run the operation—not simply supervise employees.

Operations & Leadership

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology. This individual will analyze itemized hospital bills and claims data to identify billing errors, coding discrepancies, DRG misassignments, and other overpayment opportunities, then work directly with claims administrators on behalf of our ASO clients to secure claim adjustments, recoveries, and repricing.

This is a highly analytical, client-facing role requiring both technical claims expertise and strong negotiation/communication skills.

This is a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Analysis & Review

  • Perform detailed audits of hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing accuracy.

  • Analyze DRG assignments and coding to identify DRG upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other irregularities that affect reimbursement.

  • Review high-cost and catastrophic claims (typically $100K+) to identify overpayments, contract misapplication, and opportunities for negotiated adjustments.

  • Evaluate claims against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and CMS guidelines to determine appropriate reimbursement.

Stop Loss & High-Cost Claims Expertise

  • Understand and apply stop loss (specific and aggregate) provisions, laser terms, and reporting requirements as they relate to claim adjustments and client financial exposure.

  • Coordinate with stop loss carriers and reinsurers as needed to ensure adjustments and recoveries are properly reflected in stop loss reimbursement calculations.

  • Identify claims nearing or exceeding specific deductible thresholds and prioritize review accordingly.

Client Advocacy & Claims Administrator Negotiation

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and advocate on behalf of ASO clients in disputes with claims administrators (TPAs) and carriers regarding claim payment accuracy.

  • Prepare clear, well-documented findings packages (clinical, contractual, and coding rationale) to support requested claim adjustments and appeals.

  • Lead or support negotiations with claims administrators to reach adjusted payment resolutions.

  • Track disputes through resolution, escalating unresolved cases appropriately and maintaining strong working relationships with TPA claims and provider relations teams.

Data & Reporting

  • Analyze large claims data sets to identify trends, outlier claims, and systemic overpayment patterns across client populations.

  • Build and maintain claim tracking logs, savings reports, and client-facing summaries of identified and recovered savings.

jobs.description:
About Wherobots

Wherobots is the AI Context Engine for the Physical World: the missing infrastructure layer for AI that needs to reason about our physical reality. Existing AI context infrastructure was built for text, code, documents, databases, and the internet. The most consequential enterprise decisions also depend on the physical world: supply chains, climate exposure, geopolitics, infrastructure, and more.

Our two products let teams use familiar SQL and Python to analyze physical-world data and give AI agents persistent context about their organization’s assets and operations:

  • WherobotsDB is a fully distributed spatial analytics engine with a Rust-native execution layer. It processes vector and raster data in the same engine at scale, enabling precise spatial joins across billions of geometries and analysis that connects imagery with business data.
  • RasterFlow is a fully distributed, serverless engine for raster preparation and computer vision. It processes satellite imagery at planetary scale, runs built-in or custom PyTorch models, and turns imagery into predictions and spatial features that teams can analyze with WherobotsDB.

Wherobots was founded by the original creators of Apache Sedona, the open-source spatial computing platform with more than 80 million downloads. Apache Sedona is used in production by tens of thousands of organizations, including many Fortune 500 companies.

About the role

Wherobots is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to help enterprise customers design and adopt geospatial data solutions. You will partner with sales throughout technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, then help customers move into production and expand their use of Wherobots.

This is a customer-facing role with hands-on technical work. You will help customers connect raster ETL, spatial analytics, and computer vision or machine learning use cases to their business needs. You will also create reusable technical resources and bring customer feedback to product and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Pre-sales: Lead technical discovery. Partner with sales and marketing to understand customer business challenges, data infrastructure, and analytics needs. Translate those requirements into proposed solutions and clear success criteria.
  • Pre-sales: Design solution architectures. Develop architecture diagrams, integration flows, and deployment plans tailored to customer environments, including platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, and Google Earth Engine.
  • Pre-sales: Deliver demonstrations and proofs of concept. Build customer-specific demonstrations, notebooks, and benchmarks that show how Wherobots supports raster ETL, spatial analytics, and ML workflows. Help customers evaluate technical fit and business value.
  • Post-sales: Lead architectural onboarding. Guide new customers from evaluation into production, working with their engineering and analytics teams to establish implementation plans and operational best practices.
  • Post-sales: Support customer implementations. Help customers design data ingestion and transformation pipelines, spatial analysis workflows, and model inference integrations, including storage, querying, visualization, and governance.

  • Create reusable technical resources. Develop reference architectures, implementation guides, Jupyter notebooks, tutorials, and technical blog posts. Share practical examples through workshops, webinars, technical events, and community engagement.
  • Inform product direction. Collect customer requirements and implementation feedback to help prioritize improvements to Wherobots capabilities, APIs, and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role covering pre-sales and post-sales activities, such as solution architecture, sales engineering, or technical consulting.
  • Experience with spatial data and spatial analysis, including raster processing using tools such as GDAL and Rasterio.
  • Hands-on Python and SQL skills for building customer examples, analyzing data, and troubleshooting workflows.
  • Strong understanding of the data analytics lifecycle, from extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipelines through data platform design to business intelligence and analytics tools.
  • Strong skills in databases, data warehouses, and data processing, with familiarity with technologies such as PostgreSQL, Apache Iceberg, and AWS Glue.
  • Experience working with cloud object storage such as Amazon S3 and geospatial data formats such as GeoTIFF, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), or Zarr.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a customer-focused approach and the ability to collaborate across sales, engineering, and product teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, geography, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have (Optional)

  • Experience with Apache Spark and Apache Sedona.
  • Experience with PyTorch, computer vision, or machine learning workflows, including model inference on satellite imagery or other raster data.
  • Familiarity with Xarray for working with multidimensional raster and scientific datasets.
  • A track record of supporting enterprise data or analytics software sales, including identifying key stakeholders, establishing value propositions, and delivering successful proofs of concept.
  • Experience designing solutions around large-scale databases and enterprise data platforms.
  • Familiarity with downstream data consumption patterns, including BI tools, dashboards, and application integrations.
  • Experience working at an enterprise software startup.

Compensation and benefits

Wherobots offers competitive compensation, equity, and benefits, with flexible working arrangements for most roles, including remote and in-office options. Base pay varies based on work location, seniority, skills, and experience.

Our benefits package for full-time employees includes:

  • 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Access to a 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Unlimited paid time off.

SUMMARY

The Carrier Representative is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with transportation providers to ensure timely, cost-effective, and reliable freight solutions. This role involves negotiating rates, securing carrier capacity, and coordinating shipments to meet customer requirements. Success in this position requires excellent communication, problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume logistics environment. The intent of this role is to deliver exceptional service while optimizing operational efficiency, operating proactively and with attention to detail.

  • Negotiate competitive rates with carriers while maintaining profitability and service standards.
  • Secure carrier capacity for transactional and spot market loads.
  • Monitor market trends and adjust buy strategies accordingly.
  • Assign loads to carriers and provide detailed route and delivery instructions.
  • Ensure carriers have all necessary documentation and compliance requirements.
  • Perform real-time track and trace to monitor shipment progress and proactively address delays.
  • Respond promptly to carrier and shipment-related issues, including delays, equipment failures, and compliance concerns.
  • Manage the carrier onboarding process.
  • Utilize TMS and other tools to manage workload, update shipment statuses, and maintain accurate records.
  • Analyze carrier performance metrics and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Work closely with internal teams (Customer Service, Account Management, Accounting) to ensure seamless operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.

Demonstrated excellence in customer service and client support.

Skilled in prioritizing, organizing, and managing multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

Capable of identifying complex problems, analyzing relevant information, and implementing effective solutions.

Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy in task execution.

Proficient in gathering, interpreting, and utilizing data to support operational activities.

Data Solutions Architects work alongside our Principal Consultants to ensure our project deliverables meet stakeholders' needs while upholding OpsGuru's quality and operational maturity standards.

What you'll be doing:

  • Provide deep technical expertise and leadership across a range of cloud data technologies. You will be the go-to person for driving tool selection, resolving complex engineering issues, and guiding best practices during engagements.

  • Identify and communicate technical risks as they emerge over the course of a project.

  • Maintain a close working relationship with the customer, as a "Trusted Advisor". Set clear expectations, challenge assumptions, solicit feedback, and take ownership of project deliverables.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Operations Specialist, Contracts & Vendor Management Location: Anywhere in the continental US, with the ability to travel up to monthly (quarterly for company summits plus periodic in-person sessions and school visits) Join our mission to transform elementary math!
jobs.description:
Senior Operations Specialist, Contracts & Vendor Management

Location: Anywhere in the continental US, with the ability to travel up to monthly (quarterly for company summits plus periodic in-person sessions and school visits)

Join our mission to transform elementary math! We’re looking for a Senior Operations Specialist who is passionate about the details that keep a growing organization running smoothly. You’ll own our contract lifecycle - tracking every agreement from draft to signature to renewal, and digging into redlines with a sharp eye - while also managing the vendor relationships behind our printing and physical material operations. Both sides of this role draw on the same core strengths: attention to detail and the ability to represent Inflection Point Learning well to the schools, districts, and vendors we work with. We need someone who reads the fine print for fun, who finds satisfaction in a well-organized system, who uses AI to increase efficiency and transparency, and who builds the kind of trusted relationships with vendors and internal partners that make hard problems easier to solve.

Our vision

Welcome to Beast Classroom, where students delight in mathematical challenge - playing games, solving puzzles, and exploring rigorous content that demands flexible, creative thinking; where teachers are energized and empowered to teach math; where principals stop by and smile at the signs of a budding math culture; and where there is no ceiling for math excellence.

Our mission

At Beast, we’re on a mission to bring this experience to teachers in elementary schools everywhere. We’re building Beast Classroom, a K-5 math curriculum based on the beloved Beast Academy comic universe and the rigorous Art of Problem Solving pedagogy that has trained the world’s top math students for a generation.

Why we need you

We have the foundational pieces in place: a pedagogy rooted in deep problem-solving, a growing community of early-adopter educators, and mission-aligned backers. We’ve built a talented team on a foundation of transparency, trust, and deep care.

As we grow, our contract and physical material operations are growing more complex right alongside us: more agreements to track and negotiate, more print runs and shipments to coordinate, more vendors to manage. And as schools rethink how much screen time belongs in the classroom, our physical materials have never been more important. We need a Senior Operations Specialist who can bring order and rigor to both areas: someone who can read a contract closely enough to catch what matters, keep every agreement moving without anything slipping through the cracks, and partner closely with our printing and fulfillment vendors so all of our materials reliably show up where they need to be, on time and at quality. As we scale, we expect this role to evolve, taking on more responsibility in these and potentially new areas as needs arise.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will:

  • Own contract lifecycle management: Track contracts, vendor forms, and procurement processes from intake through negotiation, redlining, execution, and renewal. Build and maintain the systems that make sure nothing falls through the cracks - key dates, obligations and related timeframes, renewal windows, and approvals.
  • Redline with precision: Review incoming contracts and agreements closely, flag risk and non-standard terms, and coordinate redlines with internal stakeholders. Bring a genuine appetite for reading dense documents carefully.
  • Be the face of our vendor relationships: Serve as the primary point of contact for our print and fulfillment vendors - from quoting and scoping print runs to troubleshooting quality or delivery issues as they come up. Build the kind of relationships where problems get solved before they become crises.
  • Drive process and system improvement: Identify gaps or inefficiencies in how we track contracts and manage vendors, and build and refine tools that scale as we grow.

Who you are

  • You’re detail-oriented almost to a fault. You catch the clause others skimmed past and take real satisfaction in getting the details right.
  • You’re organized, proactive, and systems-minded. You build (or find) tools and processes that hold up as volume grows, not just for today’s workload.
  • You’re genuinely excited by vendor relationships and logistics - you like figuring out how products move from a vendor’s print floor to a classroom and you enjoy being the person who makes that handoff smooth.
  • You build trusting relationships easily and use them well. You’re personable, responsive, and straightforward, and you represent us well to the outside world.
  • You communicate clearly and directly, whether you’re redlining a clause or taking a vendor through a missed deadline.

All candidates must have

  • Education: A bachelor’s degree. We care more about how you think and communicate than your specific major.
  • Experience: 3+ years in a role involving contract administration, vendor management, procurement, supply chain, or operations - ideally with exposure to more than one of these areas.
  • Technical skills: Proficiency with office productivity tools (we use Google Workspace); comfort with contract tracking or project management tools; experience with logistics/supply chain workflows/tools is a plus.

Exceptional candidates may have

  • Legal or contracts background: Direct experience negotiating and redlining commercial agreements.
  • Vendor management experience: Direct experience managing print or physical goods supply chains, ideally in education or a similarly deadline-driven industry.
  • Operational scaling experience: You’ve lived in the fluid world of a small company and brought order to it, including building tools and processes using AI.
  • Product experience: You’ve worked closely with internal stakeholders to balance product and customer experience goals with feasibility and cost-effectiveness.

Additional information about the position

  • Work authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
  • Salary range: $95,000 – $110,000 + equity
  • Key benefits: Private health, dental, vision, and life insurance; paid time off, including a winter holiday shutdown; 401K plan; flexibility-first culture.
Salary: $95,000 – $110,000 / year

Senior Manager, Operational Excellence

Remote Position

About the Role

Intellivo is seeking a Senior Manager of Operational Excellence with direct experience in healthcare billing, subrogation, or health insurance operations. This experience is required.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Operational Excellence, this role helps ensure that the processes supporting healthcare claim identification, case development, and recovery are followed consistently and working as intended.

You will use established KPIs and operational reviews to identify breakdowns in performance or process adherence, diagnose the root cause, and coordinate process and technology issues through resolution. You will also perform UAT for system defects, bug fixes, and workflow changes affecting Intellivo’s recovery operations.

This is a hands-on player-coach role requiring healthcare operational knowledge, analytical thinking, process discipline, technology fluency, strong follow-through, and the ability to lead and develop a small team of 5–7 employees.

What You’ll Do

Monitor Operational Adherence

  • Evaluate whether established case workflows, processes, and operating standards are followed consistently.
  • Use established KPIs and performance signals to identify areas requiring investigation.
  • Review operational activity across the healthcare claims and recovery lifecycle to identify breakdowns, inconsistencies, rework, delays, or unintended outcomes.
  • Partner and provide Recovery Operations leadership with clear, evidence-based findings when issues involve employee adherence, knowledge, training, or performance.
  • Drive employee adoption of new processes and procedures and monitor adherence following implementation.

Diagnose Root Cause

  • Investigate operational and performance issues to determine the underlying cause.
  • Determine whether issues stem from process adherence, process design, workflow, technology, automation, data, capacity, or another operational factor.
  • Analyze case activity, operational data, and workflow behavior to validate findings.
  • Distinguish between issues requiring process or technology remediation and those requiring intervention by Recovery Operations leadership.
  • Translate findings into clear recommendations and required outcomes.

Manage Process & Technology Resolution

  • Coordinate process, workflow, system, or automation changes needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Define business requirements, ownership, expected outcomes, and measures of successful resolution.
  • Work across Recovery Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, Legal, and Client Services to move issues through resolution.
  • Track issues, dependencies, and solutions through completion.
  • Validate results after implementation to confirm the underlying issue has been resolved.

Perform UAT & Validate Fixes

  • Coordinate and perform UAT for bug fixes, system changes, automation, and operational workflow improvements.
  • Develop test scenarios based on healthcare claims, case management, and recovery workflows.
  • Validate that system changes address the original operational issue without creating unintended downstream impacts.
  • Document testing results, defects, and unresolved issues.
  • Maintain follow-through from issue identification through testing, deployment, and post-implementation validation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of direct professional experience in healthcare billing or health insurance operations is required. Candidates without this experience will not be considered.
  • 3+ years people management
  • Experience working with healthcare claims, billing, reimbursement, revenue cycle, payment integrity, subrogation, coordination of benefits, recovery, or related insurance workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate healthcare operational issues and identify root causes across people adherence, process, workflow, technology, and data.
  • Experience performing UAT for system defects, bug fixes, workflow changes, and technology implementations.
  • Experience translating operational issues into clear business requirements and test scenarios.
  • Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of AI prompting, Power BI and Excel.

Who is Intellivo?

As an industry market leader in subrogation, Intellivo empowers health plans and insurers to maximize financial outcomes by identifying and pursuing more reimbursement opportunities from alternative third-party liability (TPL) payers. Through innovative technology, Intellivo accelerates the identification of reimbursement opportunities while eliminating burdensome outreach to plan members. With a 26-year history of excellence, Intellivo proudly represents more than 200 of the country's largest health plans.

We denken mee, zeggen waar het op staat en doen wat werkt.

Functieomschrijving

Als SAP Supply Chain Consultant maak je deel uit van ons SAP Core-team. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende specialismen en voert opdrachten uit bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Je taken omvatten onder andere:

  • Het leiden van workshops om logistieke processen helder in kaart te brengen.

  • Adviseren over technische oplossingen, architectuur en innovatie.

  • Realiseren van end-to-end oplossingen voor uitdagingen zoals S/4HANA (RISE of GROW) transities, cloudmigraties en procesoptimalisatie.

Dankzij onze brede expertise vertrouwen klanten op SUPERP voor oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen jouw eigen domein. Dit betekent dat je meedenkt op strategisch niveau en écht impact maakt.

Requirements

Wat breng je mee?

  • Gedegen kennis van SAP SCM (Sourcing & Procurement, Inventory Management & Warehouse Management, Transportation Management).

  • De drive om niet alleen hands-on te werken, maar ook workshops te leiden en klanten te adviseren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij SUPERP geef jij richting aan je eigen carrière. Wij ondersteunen, stimuleren en faciliteren jouw ontwikkeling, zonder vastomlijnde functiehuizen. Wat je verder kunt verwachten:

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 dagen per jaar.

  • Persoonlijke groei: toegang tot de nieuwste technologieën en trainingen.

In twee gesprekken maak je kennis met je toekomstige teamleider, een salescollega en een teamgenoot. Heb je specifieke wensen over wie je wilt spreken? Laat het ons weten, dan maken we dat mogelijk!

Texas

AI ENGINEERING & AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT

PRODUCTION OPERATIONS & RELIABILITY

jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

DataForce by TransPerfect is seeking experienced Legal Subject Matter Experts (SME) with sharp analytical skills and a deep understanding of legal frameworks to join our AI training and model development team. The ideal candidate will bring broad expertise in the legal sector, including litigation, corporate law, regulatory compliance, contract management, and intellectual property, to help train, evaluate, and fine-tune AI models. Your goal is to ensure the highest levels of accuracy, jurisdictional relevance, and logical reasoning within the AI’s output.

You will work with cross-functional teams of data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams to build intelligent legal solutions such as automated contract review tools, legal research assistants, and compliance monitoring engines.   • Prompt Engineering & Strategy: Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to design training data strategies and prompt engineering techniques specifically tailored for legal reasoning and drafting.

  • Model Audit: Provide expert feedback on model outputs, identifying "hallucinations," legal inaccuracies, or ambiguities to improve the model’s reliability in high-stakes environments.

  • Business Alignment: Partner with product teams to align AI capabilities with legal objectives, such as reducing discovery timelines or automating risk assessment.

  • Regulatory Watch: Stay current with emerging trends in LegalTech and AI-related regulations to ensure ethical and compliant model implementation.

  • Education: Juris Doctor (JD) or Master of Laws (LLM) from an accredited law school. Active bar membership is a plus.

  • Experience: 5 years of experience in the legal sector (e.g., private practice, in-house counsel, or legal research).

  • Analytical Precision: Proven ability to translate complex legal processes into structured logic and data requirements.

  • Communication: Exceptional writing and verbal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical AI teams and legal stakeholders.

  • Able to operate in messy, evolving requirements — you design systems that scale while staying pragmatic.

  • Clear communicator (C1+ English). You can collaborate with banks, customers, and teammates across time zones without things slipping.

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Bonus: you’ve built bank integrations using H2H, SFTP or ISO 20022

Why you’ll thrive here

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

📍 Location:Remote - this role is available across all countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

Benefits & Perks

DebtHammer is a dynamic technology startup located in the USA, founded by individuals with experience in working with international remote teams. Our mission is to assist millions of families in breaking free from the payday loan cycle. Each year, 12 million individuals resort to high-interest loans, often becoming trapped in a cycle of perpetual debt. We aim to put an end to this cycle and revolutionize the personal finance industry.

Joining us now presents an exceptional opportunity to play a pivotal role in DebtHammer's growth journey, working closely with the company's founder. Although our team is currently small, we are rapidly expanding.

We are seeking individuals to join our operations team—individuals who are enthusiastic about building a long-term career with us. If you are sales-oriented, possess a customer-first mindset, and aspire to elevate your customer service and sales skills by joining our remote operations team, we encourage you to apply!

Overview

As a Consumer Sales Representative at DebtHammer, your mission is to drive revenue for the company. Your primary responsibility will be engaging with potential customers actively seeking loan relief. We utilize three modes of communication to reach our customers: phone, text, and email. Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

Requirements

  • Must have a minimum of 3 years of solid SALES experience in a call center setting (Non-negotiable requirement).

  • We are seeking candidates with highly effective English communication skills, both written and verbal, to ensure successful collaboration with our diverse team and stakeholders. Fluency close to native-level proficiency is preferred.

  • Must have your own laptop or PC, a high-quality headset, high-speed internet, and a backup connection

  • Must be amenable to working night shifts and overtime

*Kindly send us a copy of your resume in English

jobs.description:
Confirmo is a global stablecoin-first payment platform trusted by market leaders. Originally founded in Prague in 2014, we now run one of the most established infrastructures in the industry. We’re a 60-person global team (with 3 hires already in the US) and this is a rare opportunity to join a proven, profitable business on the ground floor of our US expansion.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Pioneer Confirmo's US market presence — serve as the company's first US-based AE, owning end-to-end pipeline generation through self-sourced outreach, industry conferences, and events.

  • Drive the full sales cycle — manage every stage of the sales process from initial outreach and discovery through to close, ensuring a consultative, high-quality buyer experience that reflects Confirmo's values and product positioning.

  • Build and own your pipeline — proactively identify and engage new business opportunities across key US verticals, developing a robust, self-generated pipeline without reliance on inbound leads.

  • Represent Confirmo on the ground — attend and actively contribute to US-based industry events, conferences, and networking forums, acting as the face of the brand and converting presence into qualified opportunities.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally — partner closely with marketing, product, and leadership to feed market intelligence back into the business, helping shape messaging, positioning, and go-to-market strategy for the US region.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience — proven track record of owning the entire sales process from discovery and qualification through negotiation and close, with consistent quota attainment.

  • Payments or FinTech background required — demonstrated experience selling into or working within the payments, financial services, or broader FinTech ecosystem; crypto or digital assets experience a strong plus.

  • Self-sufficient pipeline builder — history of operating as a hunter in a true outbound capacity, generating the majority of your own pipeline without reliance on inbound leads or BDR support.

  • Comfortable with complexity and longer sales cycles — experience navigating multi-stakeholder deals and technical buyers, with the ability to align business value to diverse decision-makers across compliance, finance, and product teams.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset — prior experience as an early or first sales hire at a startup or scale-up is highly desirable; comfortable building process and playbooks from scratch in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Location: This role requires you to be based in the EST or CST time zone to ensure alignment with both our US customers and our global team.

If you are interested in learning more, please submit your CV, and our recruiter will get back to you promptly.

jobs.description:
About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

Where you'll create impact

  • You’ll own end-to-end ERP implementations and long-term customer relationships

  • You’ll deliver best-in-class onboarding, go-live execution, and ongoing CX excellence

  • You’ll collaborate with founders, product, and engineering to shape the roadmap based on real customer feedback

  • You’ll establish and evolve implementation methodologies, processes, and operational standards

  • You’ll challenge the status quo of what world-class ERP customer success looks like

  • You’ll drive outcomes that meaningfully accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction

What sets you up for success

  • 3–6+ years of experience in ERP implementations, ERP functional consulting, or accounting/advisory

  • Strong preference for an accounting or audit background (CPA or Big 4 is a major plus)

  • Deep understanding of ERP systems, finance workflows, and implementation best practices

  • You’re a customer-service extraordinaire who loves solving complex problems

  • You thrive in fast-moving, early-stage environments with high ownership

  • Expertise in Accounting, audit, ERP systems, CPA

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

Benefits & Compensation

  • Equity: $60,000+ USD

  • Base Salary: $75,000 – $150,000 USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2 years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer,and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

Work Location: Remote in Colombia

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor/Freelance

Estimated Workload: 28 hours

Estimated Project Duration: 2 weeks, with the possibility of extension

Estimated Start Date: Immediate

Language Needed: Spanish (Colombia), English

DataForce by TransPerfect is seeking a Voice Director with native fluency in Spanish (Colombia) to support an upcoming Text-to-Speech (TTS) development project. We are looking for professionals who can remotely direct voice talents during recording sessions, ensuring natural delivery and adherence to project guidelines.

Role Summary

In this role, you will oversee remote recording sessions through our proprietary platform, providing real-time guidance to voice talents to ensure accurate pronunciation, natural delivery, consistency across recording sessions, and adherence to project guidelines.

Role Responsibilities

  • Monitor remote recording sessions

  • Provide real-time coaching on pronunciation, tone, pacing, prosody, enunciation, and natural speech delivery

  • Verify compliance with project guidelines and recording standards

  • Ensure recordings accurately follow the provided scripts

  • Verify that recordings reflect authentic contemporary Spanish (Colombia)

  • Identify and report technical or environmental issues that may affect recording quality, including background noise, distortion, clipping, microphone artifacts, or other recording defects

Role Requirements

  • Native fluency in Spanish (Colombia)

  • Good English communication skills

  • Professional experience directing voice talents or demonstrable expertise in spoken Spanish (Colombia)

  • Strong listening, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • Professional experience in at least one of the following areas:

-Voice direction or voice acting

-Linguistics (preferably with a focus on phonetics, phonology, or sociolinguistics)

-Speech technology

-Voice coaching

Preferred Role Requirements

  • Previous experience directing Text-to-Speech (TTS) projects

  • Knowledge of phonetics and speech production

  • Experience working on speech, voice, or language-related projects

  • Familiarity with remote recording platforms or digital audio production workflows

  • Up to 25 hours availability per week

DataForce by TransPerfect is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide.

We offer high-quality data for Human-Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. Our department focuses on gathering, enriching and processing data for Machine Learning in different AI domains.

jobs.excerpt: Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director) Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast) Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it?
jobs.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. The Senior Director, Medical & Scientific Affairs – Specialty Testing is responsible for setting the vision and strategic direction for the Specialty Testing business area and leading daily business operations support related to product development and clinical research, product quality, compliance, commercial/marketing activities and customer interactions. This senior role assists the Chief Medical Officer as the medical representative of Beckman to external partners and professional societies. This disease area is a key focus area for Beckman Coulter, providing the successful candidate an exciting opportunity to build and grow the Specialty Testing business area leadership, ultimately impacting patient outcomes. The Senior Director will partner as a thought leader and Beckman Coulter representative with senior external customers, bringing our technology, patient focus, and commitment message to the market.

Specialty Testing consists of Urinalysis, Hematology, Bone Health and Anemia, and some of the rare diseases not captured in the other Medical and Scientific Affairs Chapters. The role will support the business team leaders in driving forward key strategic projects. This candidate will drive the scientific and clinical positioning of the products for the respective area(s) pre and post-launch to ensure optimal clinical utility globally.

This position reports to the Chief Medical Officer and is part of the Medical & Scientific Affairs organization, a team of medical specialists dedicated to all medical aspects of safe and effective therapeutic areas. The Beckman specialty testing test portfolio enables better patient outcomes for those afflicted with hematological diseases, among others.

This role may be fully remote, working remotely to cover a global business area. Beckman Coulter has a major site presence in South Florida, Southern California, Hebron Kentucky, and Minneapolis Minnesota, as well as major hubs in Europe and Asia.

  • Demonstrated record of strong collaboration with internal stakeholders across matrix organizations, sharing information, active collective goal achievement, open risk / reward / resource discussions, and developing talent within and outside of the MedSci function

  • Lead and own the global strategies for health economics, policy, and reimbursement (HEPR) for Beckman solutions

  • Build, sustain and serve as the leader for influential relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to drive scientific exchange and shape the future of hematology/urinalysis (and potentially coagulation) technologies

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Doctorate level requirement (M.D., Ph.D, Pharm.D, DNP) with a minimum of 20 years of medical & clinical affairs experience

  • Board-certified hematologist

  • Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to communicate clinical and business issues to audiences of diverse backgrounds

  • Strong leadership skills, able to create a dynamic environment that fosters transparency, collaboration, and innovative thinking

  • Strong problem solving and negotiation skills; ability to influence and make recommendations at multiple levels of the company

  • Minimum of 5 years of project management skills to establish strategic goals and to prioritize, plan, delegate and evaluate deliverables – with a continuous improvement mindset

  • Has extensive clinical experience and a knowledge base beyond hematology that extends to complementary areas such as bone health and anemia and immunology

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - Malware Detection (remote work)
jobs.excerpt: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company.  We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations.
jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information:

Imunify360 is CloudLinux's security suite for Linux web servers: real-time and background malware scanning, automated cleanup, a WAF, runtime PHP protection (Proactive Defense), a database malware scanner, and IP reputation. It runs on hosting providers' shared, VPS, and dedicated servers, so new web-malware campaigns land on our fleet early.

We sit on one of the largest labeled corpora of live web-server malware in the industry: files, verdicts, cleanup outcomes, and analyst decisions collected from production hosting servers every day. It already drives our signatures, heuristics, and ML models, and there is far more to get out of it. We are looking for a Senior ML Engineer who will turn that data into detection that ships — classifiers, LLM-assisted triage and generated signatures — and keep exploring new ML/LLM methods against it, measured by the product's false-negative and false-positive rates, not by notebook accuracy.

Our dataset focuses on web malware — PHP, JavaScript, HTML phishing kits, infected WordPress and Joomla plugins and themes, database injections — with the context around each file.

What you'll work with:

  • Malware samples from production servers, with verdicts and analyst decisions
  • Years of signatures and detection rules
  • Customer-reported false negatives and false positives
  • Runtime behavior of code on live sites
  • Web-attack traffic
  • File metadata and how files spread across servers
  • Cleanup outcomes, including what came back

What you will do:

The goal is 10x more malware detected at the same or lower false-positive rate. Hand-written rules and faster pipelines will not get there; models trained on our data might.

  • Decide which files on a server deserve a closer look, within tight CPU and memory budgets
  • Tell malicious code from benign at fleet scale and a sensible cost per file
  • Generate detection signatures automatically from new campaigns
  • Catch malware that only looks malicious in context, such as phishing pages and script injections
  • Route each file to the right detection engine
  • Make cleanup precise so sites stay clean afterwards
  • Prove each model improves detection before it ships

How we work:

You get an experimentation track, GPUs, and a direct line to leadership; in return, you bring numbers, not opinions.

  • Remote-first, async across UTC−5 to UTC+8. Decisions are written down (ADR-Lite) and public by default.
  • Hardware follows evidence: Each training direction starts with dedicated GPUs on our own bare metal; leadership has committed to fund more when the case is made with data.
  • Agentic engineering: Claude and Codex are the default tools, wired to GitLab, Jenkins, Redash, Jira, and Slite through MCP servers. We look at how engineers work with agents — context, specificity, review quality — not only at output.
  • Close to ground truth: You work daily with malware analysts, detection and infrastructure engineers, and the rest of our ML team.
  • Ship gates: No model or build goes out if it raises false positives or false negatives on our past-error sets. Blameless post-mortems within 24 hours.

What you'll deliver:

You own the path from raw samples to a model in production, and the numbers that prove it helped.

  • First month: A first model trained on production data and measured against today's engines — suspicious-file triage or a metadata model. The evaluation harness in place: splits by time and campaign so families don't leak, and a regression set from past FPs and FNs.
  • By month 3: Several models in production: some in shadow mode building evidence, some live and producing real detections, all gated on the past-error regression set. A training setup that keeps its GPUs busy. A written proposal (ADR) for the detection cascade, with cost per file and hardware needs.
  • By month 12: Models are a main source of new detections, reported as share of new detections and FN-rate trend. Retraining on fresh analyst and FN labels on a fixed cadence. Generated signatures inside the analyst workflow. Two or three parallel training directions that other engineers can run with your tooling.

Requirements

What you bring:

  • 5+ years building ML systems that ran in production, including 2+ in an adversarial domain: security, abuse, fraud, or spam.
  • You have trained and fine-tuned transformer models yourself — data preparation, tokenizing code, LoRA/QLoRA or full fine-tunes, distillation, quantization — not only called hosted APIs.
  • Classic ML depth: gradient boosting, linear models on sparse features, calibration, class imbalance, and judgement on when these beat an LLM.
  • Evaluation discipline: leakage-free splits by time and family, precision at a fixed false-positive budget, regression sets, and an honest account of why production will differ from offline.
  • Inference cost engineering: you have measured throughput and latency and made a model fit a CPU or memory budget (ONNX, llama.cpp, vLLM, int8/int4).
  • Strong Python, PyTorch and the Hugging Face stack; SQL on large analytical tables (ClickHouse or similar).
  • Familiarity with PHP or JavaScript, or willingness to pick it up working with our malware analysts.
  • You use AI coding agents daily and can show how.
  • English at upper-Intermediate (B2) level or higher, with particularly strong written communication for async work.

It is a strong plus if you have:

  • Web malware, webshells, phishing kits or WordPress security experience.
  • Models over code: AST or token features, code LLMs, graph models on program structure.
  • Malware clustering and similarity analysis.
  • Multi-GPU training on your own bare metal; MLflow or Weights & Biases; dataset versioning.
  • Go or Rust, for on-server inference.
  • Published work or talks on ML for security.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer

About us

We're creating the foundational backend systems that power private market access, from secure authentication and transaction processing to portfolio management and regulatory compliance.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own the systems where money moves and balances have to be correct — the ledger, transaction processing, and the settlement and reconciliation workflows behind our platform. This is the correctness core of what we build. If a balance is wrong, a transaction double-processes, or a reconciliation silently drifts, nothing else we build matters.

You'll design the double-entry ledger, the money-movement engine, and the long-running state machines that carry complex financial workflows to completion reliably over hours, days, or weeks. You'll reason about idempotency, concurrency, partial failure, and replay as a matter of habit, not as an afterthought.

You'll own core infrastructure decisions and set the standard for how we build financial systems.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Design and build the double-entry ledger and money-movement engine that all transactions reconcile against
  • Model complex financial workflows as robust, observable state machines that run reliably over long periods
  • Guarantee financial correctness under concurrency: idempotent operations, transactional integrity, and reconciliation that ties out to the cent
  • Handle partial-failure and replay cases so no event is lost, duplicated, or applied twice
  • Build secure, well-versioned APIs
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and data models
  • Debug production issues and own the reliability of mission-critical financial workflows

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of backend development on production systems
  • Demonstrated money-movement correctness experience: you've built a ledger, settlement system, payments core, or transaction-processing system and can talk in detail about how you kept it correct
  • Concurrency and idempotency depth: you can explain, from experience, how you handled double-processing, race conditions on balances, and replay
  • Reconciliation experience: you've built or owned systems that had to tie out exactly, and you know what happens when they don't
  • Strong TDD practices: you write tests first and maintain comprehensive coverage
  • Domain-Driven Design expertise: you model complex financial domains accurately
  • Deep PostgreSQL knowledge: schema design, transactions, isolation levels, optimization
  • Strong in a modern backend stack: we work in TypeScript/Node.js, Go and on the JVM ecosystem; we value real depth in either and the range to pick up the other

• Cloud deployment experience

  • Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, high autonomy, driving solutions without detailed specs

Nice to Have

  • Payments, banking, brokerage, or investment-platform systems experience
  • Securities, custody, or portfolio/NAV domain knowledge
  • Event-driven architectures and message queues
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Understanding of KYC/AML or compliance frameworks
  • Accounting principles or financial modeling
