jobs.description:
We’re UserTesting—the leader in human insight. Our mission is to help organizations craft exceptional customer experiences through fast, actionable feedback.

We empower teams to build the best products and experiences by embedding real human perspectives into every stage of the development process—from ideation to launch. With the world’s strongest participant network, AI-powered analysis, expert services, and seamless integrations, we help companies eliminate guesswork, align stakeholders, and bring customer needs into sharp focus.

Trusted by more than 3,000 organizations worldwide—including 75 of the Fortune 100—UserTesting delivers measurable business outcomes, reduces risk, and helps teams deliver with confidence. Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.

Let’s build experiences people love—together.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive IT Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in cloud and DevOps practices and a strong working knowledge of AI tooling and infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of modern cloud infrastructure engineering and the rapidly evolving AI enablement space. You will play a hands-on IC role in deploying and maintaining the AI tools, agents, hosting environments, and cloud infrastructure that support UserTesting’s broader AI initiatives, along with other infrastructure and IT responsibilities. Target ratio is an 80/20 split of AI “building” vs traditional cloud infrastructure/IT work.

Key Responsibilities

AI Enablement & Infrastructure

  • Set up, configure, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect AI systems to internal tools and data sources, including scoping access, managing credentials, and troubleshooting integrations.

  • Design, provision, and support hosting environments for internally built AI applications ranging from lightweight PaaS deployments to full cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP (VPCs, compute, containers, load balancing) depending on the app’s complexity and scale requirements.

  • Familiarity with AI features within existing SaaS platforms (e.g., Atlassian Rovo, Slack AI, Okta AI, ChatGPT, Google Gemini)

  • Provision and support AI agent / application infrastructure: service accounts, API key management, permissions scoping, rate limit monitoring, and access auditing for agents operating across internal systems and cloud environments.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to support repeatable, secure deployment of AI-hosted applications and supporting services.

  • Maintain documentation for all AI integrations and hosted environments, including architecture diagrams, access maps, runbooks, cost/usage tracking, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Stay current on the AI tooling and cloud ecosystem and proactively identify tools, platforms, or integrations that could benefit the IT team or the broader organization.

Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Support the administration of UserTesting’s IT cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) and DevOps toolset across the organization as it relates to IT’s AI Infrastructure.

  • Become a subject matter expert for AI-hosted platforms, cloud integrations, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Monitor uptime, performance, and cost of hosted AI applications; implement alerting and observability (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, GCO) to catch issues before they affect users.

  • Identify, prioritize, and address technical debt across cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and integrations.

  • Partner with other IT System Admins and Engineering/ Security teams to improve reliability, automation, documentation, and supportability of hosted environments.

Support & Collaboration

  • Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure and hosting issues for the IT support team.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security, Engineering, People Ops, etc.) to improve cloud governance, security posture, and AI tool/app hosting adoption.

  • Stakeholder management, this role will act (at times) as a project lead in some capacity. The ability to interact, demo and collaborate with non technical counterparts is critical.

  • Document procedures, system changes, and troubleshooting workflows.

Job Description

The IT team at UserTesting manages company-wide systems and serves as an integration, automation, and support layer for the company’s many technology initiatives. This role extends that mission into the AI space, with a particular focus on cloud infrastructure. An ideal candidate is someone who can transition between managing our cloud infrastructure and configuring AI tools and systems like custom MCPs, complex agent-based solutions, and hosting environments for internally built AI applications.

The person in this role won't operate like a traditional software developer (In house IT focus vs public app focus), but must be comfortable working in technical, cloud-native environments with all that entails from an infrastructure and connectivity standpoint and thinking critically about how IT, AI tools, and hosted applications interact with the rest of the company’s tech stack. This role also has the need for communication skills and doing project and stake holder management work for AI Build / support work with non technical / non IT stakeholders and business owners.

Role Requirements

  • Able to work Monday through Friday in the UK / Spain (Barcelona) timezones

  • 5+ years of experience with cloud infrastructure and/or DevOps engineering, ideally with direct AWS and/or GCP experience (compute, networking/VPCs, IAM, storage).

  • Practical experience deploying and hosting applications across cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)

  • Hands-on experience with AI Concepts like MCP, AI Agents, and other AI related technologies

  • Strong scripting & automation skills in Python and/or Bash, working knowledge of Git for version control, and comfort with JSON/YAML for config and API work.

  • Experience with containerization (Docker / Podman) and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, ECS, or Cloud Run), including running and troubleshooting containerized services experience with MCP servers or similar tooling a plus.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

  • Familiarity with API-based integrations managing keys, scoping permissions, reading docs, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.

  • Ability to train and mentor IT staff on infrastructure and DevOps practices as they apply to your role and function.

  • Familiarity with IDP tools like Okta, as well as the concepts of OAuth and SSO from an infrastructure/security perspective.

  • Certifications in cloud or AI platforms are a plus (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Anthropic), but demonstrated hands-on experience is valued more highly and be prepared to explain this experience with real world examples.

  • Ability to learn in a constantly shifting environment. We will do our best to manage processes, but the field of AI (and its infrastructure demands) is new and growing. Change is unavoidable.

Don’t meet every single requirement but excited about the role? We encourage you to apply. Research shows that some candidates are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications—but you may be exactly who we’re looking for. Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we’re committed to building a team with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

🔐 Director of Platform Security Engineering | Remote, United States | Pax8

Join Pax8 as our Director of Platform Security Engineering and lead the strategy, innovation, and execution of platform security across one of the world's fastest-growing cloud technology marketplaces.


Shape the Future of Secure Innovation

This is a rare opportunity to build and evolve security at scale while influencing how modern cloud platforms are developed, protected, and operated. You'll lead a high-impact function at the intersection of cloud security, engineering excellence, artificial intelligence, and product innovation.

As Pax8 continues its evolution toward an AI-enabled future, you'll help ensure security remains embedded into every stage of the development lifecycle, empowering teams to move quickly, confidently, and securely. You'll work alongside exceptional engineers, security specialists, and technology leaders while building the foundations that protect our partners, customers, and business.


Why Pax8?

Pax8 is transforming the way technology is bought, sold, and managed. Through our cloud marketplace, we connect managed service providers with world-class technology vendors, helping small and medium-sized businesses unlock the power of modern technology.

As part of our continued growth, we're investing heavily in platform innovation, automation, and AI-driven capabilities. That means security leadership has never been more important. Here, you'll have the opportunity to influence strategy, shape engineering culture, and drive measurable business outcomes while working remotely from anywhere in the United States.


What You'll Be Doing

🚀 Lead Security Strategy

  • Establish and execute a comprehensive platform security vision aligned with business objectives and risk management priorities.
  • Define long-term security roadmaps that support product innovation and scalable growth.
  • Champion a culture where security is viewed as an accelerator rather than a blocker.

☁️ Strengthen Cloud Platform Security

  • Own the security posture of cloud-native platforms, services, data, and infrastructure.
  • Drive continuous improvements to security architecture, controls, and operational resilience.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and adopt practices that improve security effectiveness.

🔍 Embed Security into Engineering

  • Integrate security practices seamlessly throughout software delivery processes.
  • Guide engineering teams through secure design, threat assessment, testing, validation, and deployment activities.
  • Ensure secure coding principles and security standards are consistently applied across development initiatives.

🛡️ Advance Secure Services Delivery

  • Partner with professional services and engineering teams to ensure secure software development and maintenance practices.
  • Establish repeatable security frameworks that support both internal and customer-facing solutions.

📊 Measure and Improve

  • Use data-driven insights to continually assess risk, improve controls, and demonstrate program effectiveness.

⚡ Respond and Adapt

  • Drive continuous learning and readiness through proactive risk identification and mitigation.

🌟 Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Recruit, mentor, and empower security and engineering professionals.

What Success Looks Like

You'll create lasting impact by enabling secure innovation across Pax8's technology ecosystem. Success in this role means building security capabilities that scale alongside our ambitious growth plans while empowering teams to do their best work.

  • Demonstrated expertise leading platform, application, or product security programs within complex technology environments.
  • Extensive experience embedding security practices into modern software delivery and engineering workflows.

  • Strong knowledge of threat modeling, vulnerability management, security testing, and secure software engineering principles.
  • Experience leveraging security analytics, operational metrics, and risk-based decision-making to drive improvements.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence technical and executive audiences alike.

Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. The Opportunity:

The Contract Analyst – Government Contracts is responsible for administering, coordinating, and supporting VWR’s government contract programs, with a focus on contract administrative efforts for major federal and state contract vehicles, including NASPO and DLA eCAT. This role ensures contractual requirements are monitored, reported, and executed in alignment with customer obligations, internal policies, and compliance expectations. The Contract Analyst partners closely with Sales, Bids/Quotes, Pricing, Legal, Government Contracts leadership, and external customers to support contract performance, issue resolution, reporting accuracy, and continuous process improvement.


The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing time-sensitive contract administration activities in a fast-paced environment. This individual must be able to operate independently within defined business objectives while maintaining strong communication with internal stakeholders and government customers.

How you will thrive and create an impact


  • Manage contract administrative efforts for assigned government contracts, including NASPO and DLA eCAT, ensuring contract requirements are executed accurately, timely, and in compliance with customer obligations.
  • Take ownership of contract compliance issues by performing and communicating root-cause analysis to management and successfully implementing corrective action plans in collaboration with internal and external partners and customers.
  • Perform analysis and complete reporting functions for assigned government customers, including customer-specific reporting, fee requirements, and contract performance tracking.
  • Perform contract modifications and administrative actions on assigned government contracts, including completion and maintenance of customer pricing files.
  • Proactively recommend tools, policies, and processes that enhance government customer performance, contract compliance, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency; assist in developing, auditing, and implementing such functionality.
  • Provide supporting analytics to Sales leadership and the Government Contracts Manager to improve government customer growth, profitability, and performance across major federal and state contracts.
  • Partner with Sales and Bids/Quotes teams to implement new agreements and ensure all aspects of contractual requirements are delivered to the customer.
  • Train and assist internal partners to ensure customer reporting, administrative fee requirements, and other contract obligations are maintained and executed in compliance with VWR’s contracts.
  • Proactively manage and measure assigned accounts against departmental metrics to drive business support, process improvement, and accountability.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders and external government customers regarding contract requirements, reporting obligations, pricing files, timelines, and administrative actions.
  • Support audit readiness, documentation accuracy, and contract file maintenance to ensure clear records of contract activity, decisions, actions, and customer communications.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of Government Contracts administration and operational excellence.

What we're looking for


  • College degree or equivalent applicable experience required.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of applicable experience in contracts, government procurement, pricing, customer contract operations, reporting, or a related business support function.
  • Government procurement and contract administration background preferred.
  • Knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations preferred, but not required.
  • Strong Excel capabilities
  • Experience supporting federal, state, or cooperative purchasing contract vehicles such as NASPO, DLA eCAT, GSA, or similar programs preferred.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with broad general guidance against a framework of defined business objectives.
  • Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, maintain pricing files, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to navigate and effectively communicate with internal partners and external customers, including government customer contacts.
  • Ability to prioritize work and manage extremely time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Ability to understand and comply with internal policies, contract terms, customer requirements, and reporting obligations.
  • Ability to travel approximately 5% as business needs require.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • High level of accountability, ownership, and follow-through on assigned contract administration activities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, recommend corrective actions, and support implementation.
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to balance service, compliance, risk management, and business needs.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Bids/Quotes, Pricing, Legal, Operations, Customer Service, and external customer contacts.
  • Ability to identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to increase efficiency, compliance, and customer performance.

Implements tactical and operational data engineering goals, contributing to the design, development, and optimization of data pipelines, ETL processes, and enterprise-wide data accessibility. Enhances data infrastructure, standards, and workflows, supporting analytics, regulatory compliance, and supply chain efficiency. Manages data engineering projects and operational processes, overseeing integration, migration, and performance improvements. Works on problems with a diverse scope, requiring evaluation of structured and unstructured data, storage methodologies, and security considerations. Develops solutions based on limited historical data, evolving technologies, and business needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including business analytics, data management, IT, and cloud architecture, to align data strategies with organizational goals. Engages external stakeholders such as vendors, cloud providers, and compliance entities to ensure seamless data operations and scalability.

The Customer Data Platform (CDP) Developer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining customer data solutions that enable a unified customer view across digital and offline channels. This role works closely with Marketing, Analytics, IT, Data Engineering, and Business stakeholders to integrate customer data sources, build audience segmentation, support activation use cases, and ensure data quality, governance, and compliance.


The ideal candidate has experience with customer data platforms, data integration technologies,

identity resolution, marketing technologies, and cloud-based data architectures.


What we're looking for

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics,
  • Marketing Technology, or related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer data management, marketing technology,
  • data engineering, or CDP development.
  • Experience with one or more CDP platforms such as Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Tealium, Segment, mParticle, Treasure Data, or similar.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling.
  • Experience with APIs, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration technologies.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Understanding of customer identity resolution and master data management concepts.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Marketo, HubSpot, etc.).
  • Experience with data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or other scripting languages.
  • Experience with customer journey orchestration and personalization tools.
  • CDP, cloud, or data platform certifications.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Customer data architecture
  • Data integration and transformation
  • Audience segmentation
  • Identity resolution
  • Marketing technology ecosystem
  • Data governance and compliance
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Stakeholder communication and collaboration

Success Metrics

  • Accuracy and completeness of unified customer profiles
  • Data ingestion and processing reliability
  • Audience activation effectiveness
  • Data quality improvement metrics
  • Platform performance and uptime
  • Compliance with privacy and governance standards
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and adoption

How you will thrive and create an impact


  • CDP Development & Administration
    • Design, configure, and maintain Customer Data Platform environments.
    • Develop and manage customer data models, schemas, and profile structures.
    • Configure identity resolution and customer profile unification processes.
    • Build and maintain audience segments, calculated insights, and activation workflows.
    • Support real-time and batch data ingestion processes.

  • Data Integration
    • Develop and maintain integrations between the CDP and source systems, including:
      • CRM platforms
      • Marketing automation platforms
      • Web and mobile applications
      • ERP systems
      • Data warehouses and data lakes
      • Third-party data providers
    • Create and optimize ETL/ELT processes for customer data ingestion and transformation.
    • Implement APIs, connectors, and event-streaming solutions.

  • Data Quality & Governance
    • Monitor and maintain data quality, accuracy, and completeness.
    • Implement data validation, cleansing, and enrichment processes.
    • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable standards.
    • Support data governance initiatives, documentation, and metadata management.

  • Analytics & Audience Activation
    • Partner with marketing and analytics teams to define customer segments and activation strategies.
    • Enable audience delivery to marketing, advertising, and personalization platforms.
    • Support campaign measurement, attribution, and customer journey analysis.
    • Develop dashboards and reporting solutions related to customer data performance.

  • Technical Support & Optimization
    • Troubleshoot CDP platform issues and integration failures.
    • Monitor system performance and optimize data processing workflows.
    • Collaborate with vendors and internal technology teams on platform enhancements.
    • Stay current with CDP capabilities, industry trends, and best practices.

jobs.description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visitwww.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

Perks of working with us!

  • Competitive health + wellness benefit plan

  • Continuous professional development with many opportunities for growth!

  • Recharge with 15 days of paid time off

  • Competitive Salary and Bonuses

  • 401k Plan

  • Ability to work remotely and travel

Summary

We are excited to announce an opportunity for a Process Automation and Control Engineer to join our North American Engineering Hub. In this role, you will play an integral part in leading automation projects, implementing cyber security and providing operational support around the globe. This position is crucial for advancing our automation journey and delivering exceptional automation services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all phases of automation portion of capital projects including initial design, detailed engineering, implementation, and commissioning phases.

  • Championing safety by ensuring adherence to process safety work processes and life critical work processes when in the field.

  • Serve as the technical authority on all aspects of the projects, ensuring that all technical deliverables adhere to industry standards and best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with site leadership, engineering teams, and vendors to ensure seamless project execution and to foster strong, productive relationships.

  • Monitor project milestones and deliverables, ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulatory requirements, and maintaining the highest quality of work.

  • Deliver control system configuration services for the NA sites.

  • Provide Automation support to Operational sites for life cycle management, cybersecurity services, and other automation needs.

  • Occasional travel for commissioning or other project related activities may be required. This includes North America, South America, and Asia Pacific Regions

What you will need to apply:

  • Ability to travel ~25% domestically and some international

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Controls Engineering.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Chemical / Petrochemical / Pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

  • Proven track record of leading control-focused engineering projects.

  • Understanding of Distributed Control Systems (DCS) such as Emerson DeltaV, ABB 800xA, Foxboro, or Rockwell.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage teams at all levels.

  • Expertise in control philosophy for modern process plants and a strong understanding of production manufacturing processes and instrumentation.

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you.

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits which include medical, dental, vision & 401K, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or the field, consider joining our team.

jobs.excerpt: This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline.
jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a SailPoint Support Engineer with a Secret Security clearance to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced ICAM SailPoint Support Engineer to join a team supporting Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) solutions for our government customers. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled professional with a strong background in identity and access management technologies, particularly within the SailPoint platform, and is passionate about delivering secure and reliable solutions in a federal environment.

The ICAM SailPoint Support Engineer will provide technical support, configuration, administration, and maintenance of SailPoint-based Identity, Credential, and Access Management solutions in a federal government environment. The engineer will work closely with security teams, system administrators, and government stakeholders to ensure the integrity, availability, and security of identity governance and access management systems.

Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Provide day-to-day administration, configuration, and support of the SailPoint platform, including identity lifecycle management, role management, access certifications, and provisioning workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve ICAM-related incidents, service requests, and problems in a timely manner, adhering to established SLAs.
  • Configure and maintain SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) or IdentityIQ (IIQ) features including access certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), separation of duties (SoD) policies, and automated provisioning/deprovisioning.
  • Integrate SailPoint with enterprise applications, directories, and third-party services using REST APIs, SCIM, and connector frameworks.
  • Support the onboarding and offboarding of users, roles, and applications within the SailPoint environment.
  • Monitor system health, review logs, and proactively identify and address potential issues within the ICAM ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure IAM configurations meet federal security standards and frameworks, including NIST guidelines and Zero Trust principles.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and runbooks related to ICAM and SailPoint operations.
  • Participate in change management processes, including planning, testing, and implementing changes to the SailPoint environment.
  • Support audits and compliance reviews by generating access reports, certification campaigns, and configuration documentation.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to evaluate and implement new SailPoint features and capabilities that align with mission requirements.
  • Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for escalated identity governance and access management issues.

Education and Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field from an accredited college or university; equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), or a comparable Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform.
  • Active Secret Clearance required.
  • Relevant SailPoint certification(s) required (e.g., SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Engineer, or SailPoint Certified Administrator).

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience administering the SailPoint platform, including identity lifecycle management, access certifications, role management, provisioning workflows, and SoD policy enforcement.
  • Strong understanding of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) concepts including joiner/mover/leaver processes, RBAC, and entitlement management.
  • Experience integrating SailPoint with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, and enterprise applications via native connectors or REST/SCIM APIs.
  • Familiarity with ICAM frameworks, principles, and federal identity management standards (e.g., NIST SP 800-63, FICAM).
  • Experience supporting users and applications in a ticketing/ITSM environment (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Ability to analyze and interpret system logs to diagnose and resolve identity governance and provisioning issues.
  • Knowledge of role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC) models and their implementation within SailPoint.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and their application to identity governance and access management.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation, SOPs, and runbooks.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Clearance Requirement:

  • Active Secret Clearance

Desired Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience working in a federal government IT environment supporting ICAM programs.
  • SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Architect or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Architect certification.
  • Experience with SailPoint BeanShell/Java scripting for custom rule development and workflow configuration.
  • Familiarity with Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions and concepts, such as CyberArk or BeyondTrust.
  • Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipeline integrations involving identity services.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and their native IAM services.
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of identity management and provisioning tasks.
  • Familiarity with additional IAM/ICAM platforms such as Okta, Ping Identity, or ForgeRock.
  • Understanding of PIV/CAC authentication and its integration within federal environments.
  • Experience supporting ATO (Authority to Operate) processes and contributing to security documentation such as System Security Plans (SSPs).
  • CISSP, Security+, or other relevant cybersecurity certifications.

This position reports to:

Product Marketing Manager, Distribution Solutions, Grid Components

__

Position Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and technically proficient Senior Technical Business Developer to lead the expansion of our Grid Automation portfolio in the U.S. market. This role bridges advanced grid technologies and a focused market penetration strategy, driving growth through utility customer and key partner engagement, stakeholder intelligence, and solution development. This position reports directly to the Product Marketing Director and functionally to the Global Portfolio Management of Grid Components.

This is a remote position. Candidates can be located anywhere in the US, with preference for Cary, NC or Houston, TX.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Market strategy leadership — Drive U.S. growth by identifying new utility/industrial automation opportunities, shaping market penetration strategy, and securing product homologation with key utilities.

  • Technical engagement — Act as a grid‑automation SME, lead pre‑sales technical activities, and support solution design across architectures, protection systems, and integration workflows.

  • Standards influence — Contribute to vPAC and IEEE working groups, representing the company to help shape emerging grid automation standards and interoperability frameworks.

  • Ecosystem & innovation Build strategic partnerships, represent the company at industry forums, and channel field insights to evolve offerings like SSC600, SMU600, and CogniEN.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in technical business development, preferably in grid automation or power systems.

  • Deep understanding of U.S. utility market dynamics, standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC 61850), and digital substation architectures.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with SaaS or subscription-based business models in the energy sector.

  • Familiarity with DERMS, DLR, and network state estimation technologies.

  • Ability to travel up to 30% - domestic and international - may be required.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Type: Permanent

Reports to: CEO

About the role

The Director, Growth and External Relations is responsible for leading Digital Moment’s growth strategy across fundraising, government funding, strategic partnerships, and external relations.

Reporting directly to the CEO, this role drives a diversified revenue strategy that supports both program delivery and organizational sustainability. The Director builds and manages long-term relationships with government funders, corporate partners, philanthropic supporters, and other strategic stakeholders, while also strengthening Digital Moment’s external positioning, visibility, and stewardship practices.

This leader works closely with the CEO, Finance, Program, Project Management, and Communications functions to ensure funding strategies are aligned with organizational priorities, partner commitments are well-supported, and Digital Moment is positioned for long-term impact and growth.

What you'll do

1. Revenue Strategy and Growth

  • Develop and lead a diversified funding strategy that supports both program initiatives and organizational sustainability.
  • Oversee Digital Moment’s revenue streams across government funding, philanthropy, sponsorship, and strategic partnerships.
  • Build and monitor annual funding targets, revenue pipeline health, and growth plans.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance to support revenue forecasting, budget planning, and funding pipeline visibility.

2. Government Funding and Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop strong relationships, concept notes, and proposals to secure provincial and federal government funding.
  • Stay informed on funding trends, public priorities, and budget developments to identify opportunities aligned with Digital Moment’s mission.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with funders, partners, and supporters that contribute to both program impact and operational sustainability.
  • Leverage partnerships that offer value beyond funding, including visibility, volunteer engagement, strategic collaboration, and market credibility.
  • Build strong relationships with key government stakeholders and external decision-makers that support long-term sustainability.

3. Stewardship and Funder Relations

  • Ensure Digital Moment has a strong stewardship approach that deepens relationships with current funders and partners while generating new opportunities.
  • Oversee funder and partner communications related to renewals, updates, reporting inputs, and relationship development.
  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure commitments made to funders and partners are well coordinated and supported.
  • Partner with program and project management teams to help translate results, deliverables, and impact into strong funder-facing narratives and reports.

4. External Relations, Positioning and Communications

  • Oversee or guide external-facing initiatives that position Digital Moment as a leader in digital education and AI literacy.
  • Support marketing and communications efforts that strengthen visibility, generate partnership opportunities, and reinforce organizational credibility.
  • Help shape external messaging and partner-facing materials to ensure they are aligned with Digital Moment’s mission, impact, and growth priorities.
  • Represent Digital Moment effectively with funders, government stakeholders, strategic partners, and other external audiences.

5. CRM, Performance and Organizational Contribution

  • Build, implement, and oversee strong CRM practices that support relationship management, data quality, reporting, and impact storytelling.
  • Monitor and evaluate fundraising and growth activities to improve strategy through data-informed decision-making.
  • Work closely with the CEO to provide regular updates on fundraising progress, pipeline health, and financial outlook to the Board.
  • Contribute to cross-functional planning and organizational effectiveness by ensuring growth priorities are well integrated with program, finance, and operational realities.

Who you are

  • Significant experience in fundraising, partnerships, external relations, business development, or growth leadership in a nonprofit, education, youth-serving, or mission-driven organization.
  • Strong experience securing and managing government funding, philanthropic support, corporate sponsorships, or strategic partnerships.
  • Demonstrated success building long-term stakeholder relationships and converting them into sustainable revenue or strategic value.
  • Strong strategic, written, and verbal communication skills, including proposal development, concept notes, and executive-level relationship management.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with finance, programs, project management, and communications teams.
  • Strong data and systems orientation, including CRM discipline, pipeline management, and revenue tracking.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Strong commitment to Digital Moment’s mission and to expanding equitable access to digital and AI literacy.

Why join us

  • Mission with scale. Your work directly expands how many young people — especially those from underserved communities — get the digital and AI skills to shape their future. Operations here isn't back-office; it's the engine of the mission.
  • Practice what we teach. Help a leading AI-education charity become the proof point for how nonprofits can responsibly harness AI — a story you'll help write, not just support.
  • A true thought partnership with the CEO, with real access, real trust, and a seat at the leadership table.
  • Rare scope. Orgsnization-wide influence from day one, at the intersection of education, technology, and social impact — alongside global partners and a community of educators and youth across Canada and beyond.
  • 20 days of annual vacation (including 5 days in December during office closure).
  • Group benefits including RRSP, parental top-up, medical and dental.
  • Working from home, and a flexible 35 hour work week.
  • 10 annual wellness days.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

Digital Moment is proud to be an equal opportunity employer who champions collaboration, innovation, and diversity of thought.

We pride ourselves on being a truly collaborative, innovative and diverse team. We celebrate the big - and small - wins. We laugh often and love to build connections. We support and help each other learn and grow. We are really good at what we do and we care a lot about doing it. Apply if you belong!

Application process:

  • Apply through our job posting link. Applications must include a resume, and candidates will be asked to answer a few questions about their professional experience.
  • Selected candidates will have a 30-min video screening call with our People & Culture Specialist.
  • Following the screening call, selected candidates will have a 60-min video call with our Director of Programs & Operations and a member of our Programs team.
  • We make sure to contact every applicant by email in a timely manner.

******************************************************************************

Type d’emploi: Poste à temps plein, 35 heures par semaine

Lieu de travail: Québec ou Ontario, Canada (à distance)

Relève de : le PDG

À propos du poste

La directrice ou le directeur, croissance et relations externes est responsable de diriger la stratégie de croissance de Moment Numérique en matière de collecte de fonds, de financement gouvernemental, de partenariats stratégiques et de relations externes.

Relevant directement de la ou du PDG, cette personne pilote une stratégie de revenus diversifiée qui soutient à la fois la prestation des programmes et la pérennité organisationnelle. Elle établit et entretient des relations à long terme avec les bailleurs de fonds gouvernementaux, les partenaires corporatifs, les donatrices et donateurs philanthropiques ainsi que d'autres parties prenantes stratégiques, tout en renforçant le positionnement externe, la visibilité et les pratiques d'intendance de Moment Numérique.

Cette personne travaille en étroite collaboration avec la ou le PDG et avec les fonctions Finances, Programmes, Gestion de projet et Communications afin de veiller à ce que les stratégies de financement soient alignées sur les priorités organisationnelles, à ce que les engagements pris envers les partenaires soient bien soutenus et à ce que Moment Numérique soit bien positionné pour générer un impact et une croissance durables.

Vos responsabilités

1. Stratégie de revenus et croissance

  • Élaborer et diriger une stratégie de financement diversifiée qui soutient à la fois les initiatives de programmes et la pérennité organisationnelle.
  • Superviser les sources de revenus de Moment Numérique : financement gouvernemental, philanthropie, commandites et partenariats stratégiques.
  • Établir et suivre les cibles annuelles de financement, la santé du pipeline de revenus et les plans de croissance.
  • Collaborer avec la direction des Finances pour appuyer les prévisions de revenus, la planification budgétaire et la visibilité du pipeline de financement.

2. Financement gouvernemental et partenariats stratégiques

  • Développer des relations solides, des notes conceptuelles et des demandes de financement en vue d'obtenir du financement des gouvernements provincial et fédéral.
  • Se tenir informée ou informé des tendances en matière de financement, des priorités publiques et des développements budgétaires afin de repérer les occasions alignées sur la mission de Moment Numérique.
  • Établir et cultiver des relations durables avec les bailleurs de fonds, les partenaires et les personnes qui soutiennent l'organisation, et qui contribuent tant à l'impact des programmes qu'à la pérennité opérationnelle.
  • Mettre à profit des partenariats qui offrent une valeur au-delà du financement, notamment sur les plans de la visibilité, de l'engagement bénévole, de la collaboration stratégique et de la crédibilité sur le marché.
  • Développer des relations solides avec les principales parties prenantes gouvernementales et les décideuses et décideurs externes qui contribuent à la pérennité à long terme.

3. Intendance et relations avec les bailleurs de fonds

  • Veiller à ce que Moment Numérique dispose d'une approche d'intendance solide, qui approfondit les relations avec les bailleurs de fonds et partenaires actuels tout en générant de nouvelles occasions.
  • Superviser les communications avec les bailleurs de fonds et les partenaires en ce qui a trait aux renouvellements, aux mises à jour, aux intrants pour la reddition de comptes et au développement des relations.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes afin que les engagements pris envers les bailleurs de fonds et les partenaires soient bien coordonnés et soutenus.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des programmes et de la gestion de projet pour traduire les résultats, les livrables et les retombées en récits et en rapports convaincants destinés aux bailleurs de fonds.

4. Relations externes, positionnement et communications

  • Superviser ou orienter les initiatives externes qui positionnent Moment Numérique comme chef de file en éducation au numérique et en littératie de l'IA.
  • Appuyer les efforts de marketing et de communication qui renforcent la visibilité, génèrent des occasions de partenariat et consolident la crédibilité de l'organisation.
  • Contribuer à façonner les messages externes et le matériel destiné aux partenaires afin qu'ils soient alignés sur la mission, l'impact et les priorités de croissance de Moment Numérique.
  • Représenter efficacement Moment Numérique auprès des bailleurs de fonds, des parties prenantes gouvernementales, des partenaires stratégiques et d'autres publics externes.

5. CRM, performance et contribution organisationnelle

  • Mettre en place, déployer et superviser des pratiques CRM rigoureuses qui soutiennent la gestion des relations, la qualité des données, la reddition de comptes et la mise en récit de l'impact.
  • Suivre et évaluer les activités de collecte de fonds et de croissance afin d'améliorer la stratégie grâce à une prise de décision fondée sur les données.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la ou le PDG pour transmettre régulièrement au conseil d'administration des mises à jour sur les progrès en collecte de fonds, la santé du pipeline et les perspectives financières.
  • Contribuer à la planification interfonctionnelle et à l'efficacité organisationnelle en veillant à ce que les priorités de croissance soient bien intégrées aux réalités des programmes, des finances et des opérations.

Votre profil

  • Expérience significative en collecte de fonds, en partenariats, en relations externes, en développement des affaires ou en leadership de la croissance au sein d'un organisme sans but lucratif, d'une organisation en éducation, d'un organisme jeunesse ou d'une organisation à vocation sociale.
  • Solide expérience de l'obtention et de la gestion de financement gouvernemental, de soutien philanthropique, de commandites corporatives ou de partenariats stratégiques.
  • Succès démontré dans l'établissement de relations durables avec les parties prenantes et dans leur conversion en revenus durables ou en valeur stratégique.
  • Fortes compétences en communication stratégique, écrite et verbale, incluant l'élaboration de demandes de financement et de notes conceptuelles ainsi que la gestion de relations de haut niveau.
  • Expérience de travail interfonctionnel avec les équipes des finances, des programmes, de la gestion de projet et des communications.
  • Solide orientation vers les données et les systèmes, incluant la rigueur en matière de CRM, la gestion du pipeline et le suivi des revenus.
  • Capacité à conjuguer réflexion stratégique et exécution concrète.
  • Fort engagement envers la mission de Moment Numérique et envers l'élargissement de l'accès équitable à la littératie numérique et à l'IA.

Travailler chez Moment numérique inclut:

  • Des avantages sociaux collectifs, notamment une assurance médicale, une assurance de congés parentaux, une assurance dentaire, et un complément de REER ;
  • Travailler à domicile et un horaire flexible de 35 heures par semaine ;
  • 10 jours personnels/bien-être par année ;
  • Des opportunités de développement et de formation continue.

Moment Numérique est fier d'être un employeur qui défend l'égalité des chances, la collaboration, l'innovation et la diversité de pensée.

Nous sommes fiers d'être une équipe véritablement collaborative, innovante et diversifiée. Nous célébrons les grandes - et les petites - victoires. Nous rions souvent et aimons tisser des liens. Nous nous soutenons et nous nous aidons mutuellement à apprendre et à progresser. Nous sommes vraiment bons dans ce que nous faisons et nous y tenons beaucoup. Posez votre candidature si cette opportunité vous intéresse!

Processus de candidature:

  1. Postulez en cliquant sur le lien de notre offre d'emploi. Les candidatures doivent être accompagnées d'un curriculum vitae et les candidats seront invités à répondre à quelques questions concernant leur expérience professionnelle ;
  2. Les candidats sélectionnés passeront un appel vidéo de 30 minutes avec notre coordonnateur talents et culture ;
  3. Après l'appel de présélection, les candidats sélectionnés auront un appel vidéo de 45 minutes avec le directeur des programmes et des opérations.

Nous veillons à contacter chaque candidat(e) par courriel dans un délai raisonnable.

jobs.excerpt: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen.
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Technical Consulting Manager II

__

Your role and responsibilities:

As a Protection & Control Engineer, you will have the opportunity to act as the technical lead for all engineering activities in assignments. Each day, you will ensure the activities related to all engineering disciplines within the project are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by acting as a design authority for a particular engineering discipline and completing the corresponding engineering assignments.

While this is a full remote position, there is preference for candidates located in the Northern California area.

Main Accountabilities:

  • Lead and support engineering design activities for new and existing utility, industrial, and commercial substation protection & control/automation systems, including planning, coordination, and execution of new and retrofit designs.

  • Develop engineering documentation and perform analyses—such as schematics, logic diagrams, layouts, bills of materials, reports, and calculations—to support accurate, standards‑compliant system designs.

  • Manage project materials, construction design packages, and technical issue resolution while providing ongoing communication, status updates, and support to project teams, management, partners, and customers.

  • Ensure adherence to safety practices, industry standards, and company/customer requirements while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and participating in training to maintain technical proficiency.

Requirements:

  • Bachelors Degree in Electrical Engineering required. Masters Degree Preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in protection & control projects for utility customers.

  • Ability to read, correctly interpret, and apply electrical one-lines, schematics, and instruction manuals.

  • Proficient software experience should include Easy Power, SKM Powertools, ETAP, Aspen, and EMTP.

  • PE License in California required

  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US

More about us:

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

What's in it for you:

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Executive Assistant to Business Unit Head

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

Role Summary

The Executive Assistant (EA) to the Business Unit Head (BUH) is a trusted executive partner who provides comprehensive, high-level administrative and operational support in a fast-paced, complex, and highly visible environment. This role requires exceptional organizational capability, discretion, and judgment, combined with strong executive presence and a service-oriented mindset.

The EA acts as a central point of coordination for the BUH, enabling focus on strategic priorities by anticipating needs, resolving issues independently, and ensuring seamless execution of day-to-day and long-range activities. The role includes responsibility for executive administration, global meeting and event management, stakeholder coordination, and preparation of high-quality business materials.

The role is ideally UK-based to ensure maximum time-zone overlap and effective collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Support

  • Provide comprehensive executive administrative support to the BUH and their direct reports, as needed.

  • Proactively manage a complex and dynamic calendar, prioritizing meetings and ensuring optimal use of executive time.

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, including itineraries, logistics, and contingency planning.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, managing communications and meeting logistics as required.

  • Manage delegation of approvals for timesheets, expenses, and other administrative workflows.

  • Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

Meetings & Event Management

  • Arrange, coordinate, and host large-scale global virtual meetings, including:

  • Driving Microsoft Teams meetings

  • Opening and closing calls

  • Managing attendance records

  • Fielding and coordinating Q&A

  • Plan, coordinate, and deliver in-person meetings and events end-to-end, including logistics, venues, agendas, materials, and on-site coordination.

  • Ensure meetings are well structured, professionally delivered, and aligned with executive objectives.

Business & Presentation Support

  • Translates the BUH’s high-level direction, notes, and concepts into clear, concise, and executive-ready PowerPoint presentations aligned to standard formats and messaging.

  • Synthesizes complex or unstructured input into well-organized, visually polished presentations suitable for senior leadership and external audiences.

  • Collate updates and inputs from Therapeutic Area Heads (TAHs) and direct reports to support key business deliverables and status updates.

  • Track and organize action items, follow-ups, and key outputs from leadership meetings.

Stakeholder & External Engagement

  • Act as point of contact for external meeting attendance and coordination, representing leadership with professionalism and credibility.

  • Build effective working relationships across senior leadership, direct reports, and global stakeholders.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Proactive, solutions-oriented, and able to anticipate executive needs.

  • Strong judgment, discretion, and ability to manage confidential information.

  • Confident communicator with polished executive presence.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate calmly and effectively in high-pressure, fast-paced environments.

  • Strong planning and coordination skills, particularly for complex global meetings and events.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, and other standard business tools.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience supporting senior leaders (Business Unit Head, SVP, EVP, or equivalent) in a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Demonstrated experience managing executive calendars, travel, and high-profile meetings.

  • Strong background in preparing executive-level presentations and business materials.

  • Experience working in global organizations and across multiple time zones preferred.

Personal Attributes

  • Trusted executive partner with a strong sense of accountability.

  • Service-oriented mindset with a commitment to excellence.

  • Professional, discreet, and credible ambassador for senior leadership.

  • Able to work independently while maintaining close alignment with executive priorities.

Location

  • UK-based preferred to ensure maximum time-zone overlap and effective collaboration.

  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA are responsible for overseeing and ensuring the integrity of clinical research studies by monitoring data and processes from a centralized location. This includes conducting remote monitoring of trial sites to verify compliance with regulatory requirements and clinical protocols. Utilizes data analytics and risk-based monitoring techniques to identify potential issues and trends, ensuring that trials are conducted in accordance with established clinical practices. Collaborates with site teams to develop and implement tools, procedures, and processes that enhance quality monitoring and support the overall success of clinical trials.

Impact and Contribution

Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Established and productive individual contributor. May manage defined components of projects or processes within area of responsibility. Requires practical knowledge of a professional area, typically obtained through education combined with experience.

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.

  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.

  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.

  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.

  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.

  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.

  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.

  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements

  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.

  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.

  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies

  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Who We Are

At SweetRush, we believe that when you put people at the center of business, magic happens. As a global leader in learning and development, we blend high-end storytelling, emerging tech like AI and VR, and deep psychological insights to help organizations—from iconic global brands to essential nonprofits—flourish. Our work isn’t just about the awards we win with incredible partners such as Hilton, Google, Bridgestone, Adidas, SHRM, and numerous others; it’s about balancing profit with a genuine desire to spread good in the world. If you are a caring innovator who believes work should be life-centered and impactful, then this is where you come in…

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a mid-to-senior level Performance Marketing, Paid Social, or Growth Marketing Practitioner to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for an upcoming curriculum development project. In this freelance role, you will lead the rigorous quality, accuracy, and fidelity review of a five-course Coursera specialization titled Accelerate Business Growth & Performance with Meta Ads.

The course content is adapted from existing Meta webinars covering performance best practices, Ads Manager vs. boosted posts, partnership ads, cross-border sales strategy, and business ecosystem security. This is an active editing and validation role where you will review, refine, correct, and augment AI-drafted course content generated by Coursera's tools to ensure absolute platform currency, tactical growth accuracy, and learner engagement.

  • Location: Remote (Global / US Preferred)
  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Project Duration: Estimated execution across the development cycle
  • Project Capacity: Total of ~60–80 hours allocated across the full 5-course specialization program
  • System Requirements: SweetRush is a remote organization; all resources must be technically savvy, have a strong internet connection, be comfortable with virtual collaboration tools (Google Drive, Slack, Airtable), and be available for scheduled live alignment syncs.

Salary/Hourly Range (US Only)

$65.00 per hour (Dependent on depth of technical performance marketing experience; salary is negotiable)

Your Impact and Responsibilities

As the primary technical authority for this specialization, you will ensure the curriculum accurately represents how marketers leverage Meta technologies to drive revenue growth, expand into international markets, collaborate with creators, and secure business assets. Your day-to-day responsibilities will be structured around three continuous review checkpoints per course:

  • Checkpoint 1: Program Outline Review

    • Attend live alignment calls with the Coursera and Learning Design teams to validate content at the structural level.
  • Checkpoint 2: Full Course Atlas (Script) Review
    • Conduct a deep-dive review of a Proof-of-Concept (POC) course to establish the standard for tone, depth, accuracy, and structure.
    • Review remaining course atlases (.doc format via Google Drive) to ensure they mirror the POC standards and flag course-specific errors.
  • Checkpoint 3: On-Platform Final Review
    • Access the live Coursera staging environment to end-to-end test all interactive components, dialogues, and logic triggers.
    • Validate final uploads against source webinars for absolute factual accuracy, brand alignment, and completeness.
  • Continuous Quality Assurance & Content Creation
    • Source-Fidelity Checking: Scrutinize all elements to ensure absolutely zero hallucinated or drifted Meta product claims.
    • Growth & Optimization Workflows: Verify that setup steps for Ads Manager campaigns, partnership ads, cross-border parameters, and security configurations reflect the current live UI.
    • Copywriting: Draft and refine XDP copy for product accuracy; review Donobu QA reports as required.
    • Screencasting: Record high-quality technical screencasts following provided audio/room setup guidelines if needed to complement written text.

Core Capabilities to Validate

  • Account simplification, creative diversification, and automated direct response performance frameworks.
  • Partnership ad creation workflows, partner permissions infrastructure, and branded content advertising guidelines.
  • International campaign planning factors, cross-border targeting mechanics, and market comparison variables.
  • Meta business asset security features, administrative permission management, and fraud prevention/brand misuse concepts.

Bonus Skills

  • Holding an active Meta Certified Media Buying Professional or Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate credential.
  • Hands-on or live environment familiarity with cross-border setups or creator collaboration tools within Meta.
  • Familiarity with broader analytics ecosystems such as GA4 or corporate revenue reporting tools that connect ad performance directly to downstream business outcomes.
  • Prior experience working within the Meta Blueprint or Meta partner ecosystem.
  • Familiarity working with Google Drive (.doc) editing workflows and Airtable/Donobu QA feedback tracking.

Description

About Factify

AI agents are starting to make decisions in regulated enterprises, including US banks and insurers. Factify turns an organization's policies, documents and real-world practice into a sealed, executable rulebook that governs how those agents decide. Every decision is traceable, auditable and ratified by the people who own the process.

The role

You will be our US banking expert. You will map how critical decisions are actually made inside US banks, starting with credit decisions from application intake to final approval. You will find where policy and practice diverge, and encode that into rules that an AI agent can execute and a credit committee or examiner can defend. As our work expands, you will cover more of the bank's critical processes.

What you'll do

  • Map end-to-end loan origination flows for consumer, small business and commercial lending: intake, KYC/BSA/AML, income and collateral verification, credit analysis, underwriting, approval and exceptions.
  • Map other critical bank processes as customer needs arise, using your own experience of how they run in practice.
  • Analyze credit policies, underwriting guidelines and regulatory requirements. Surface conflicts, gaps and ambiguous thresholds.
  • Define and validate decision rules (eligibility, DTI/DSCR/LTV limits, covenants, pricing and escalation criteria) with bank process owners.
  • Build realistic test cases and golden-label datasets (approve / decline / refer) with documented supporting evidence.
  • Review agent decisions against real banking practice and flag where the rulebook or the agent is wrong.
  • Advise product and engineering on what US banking teams need, and what breaks in production.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in banking at a US bank, credit union or lender, with deep expertise in credit, underwriting, loan operations or credit risk. Commercial lending experience is valuable.
  • Working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervision: ECOA/Reg B, fair lending, HMDA, TILA/RESPA, BSA/AML, OCC/FDIC/Fed model risk and credit risk guidance, and CECL.
  • Experience documenting or redesigning bank processes (SOPs, BPMN, audit or model-governance work).
  • The ability to turn "it depends" into explicit conditions, thresholds and exceptions.
  • Availability for regular overlap with our Tel Aviv team.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with bank leaders, executives and engineers.
  • Location: Remote (US), with regular overlap with our Tel Aviv team (US Eastern morning hours).

﻿Strong advantage

Hands-on experience in any core banking process is a major asset. Knowing additional processes from the inside broadens the range of business problems you can solve, for example:

  • Customer onboarding, KYC, and CDD/EDD.
  • AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and SAR filing.
  • Payments, cash management, and liquidity operations.
  • Fraud detection and dispute handling.
  • Collections, debt restructuring, and loan workouts.
  • Deposit operations and account servicing.
  • Trade finance and commercial banking operations.
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance testing.
  • Credit risk, model risk, and third-party risk management.
  • Complaint handling and exam readiness.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a fintech, a digital lender or a Big 4 financial-services practice.
  • Exposure to decision engines, core banking and loan origination systems, or AI governance.
  • FRM, CFA, CAMS or equivalent credentials.

Company Benefits

Responsibilities

GPDQ are working in partnership with a client to support and deliver GP and ANP consultations to private and insurance patients, we are looking for dynamic and motivated ANPs who are able to see a wide range of general acute conditions. You will be expected to carry out 15-minute consultations, with a maximum of 4 patients per hour.
As a ANP working for GPDQ, you will have access to a multi-tude of workstreams enabling you to develop a portfolio career including face to face corporate and private GP consultations, health assessments as well as a variety of NHS clinics.

Essential requirements

❖Registered with the NMC
❖Must have a Right to Work in the UK
❖Msc in advanced practice
❖2 years’ experience within Primary Care as a Prescriber
❖Must be IT literate
❖Must be able to commit to a minimum of 10 hours per week

About us

GPDQ provides nationwide healthcare services for individuals, businesses, and the NHS. Led by NHS GP, Founder and Chief Medical Officer, Dr Anshu Bhagat, with services delivered by a multidisciplinary team, we harness the benefits of technology to deliver better local access to healthcare. Our services include GP consultations, physiotherapy, mental health, audiology, health checks, blood tests, vaccinations and more. Consultations take place online, at home or in a clinic with a GPDQ vetted GMC-registered NHS GP or highly skilled multidisciplinary team member.

Our reason for being

We help people to stay healthy by revolutionising access to primary healthcare in the home, workplace and community.

Our Core values

❖Care: we make people feel genuinely cared for
❖Efficiency: we seek out efficiencies to improve healthcare
❖Innovation: we relentlessly innovate and adapt to meet patient/ customer needs
❖Collaboration: we work with partners to enhance healthcare delivery
❖Dedication: we use our professional skills to help others live their best lives

Equality & Diversity

GPDQ is an equal opportunities employer. We understand that not all people are the same and it is our mission to help support people in their journey. We pride ourselves on our diverse workforce and we have a commitment to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants; we ensure that all applicants are treated fairly throughout our recruitment and selection process.
