Every large company now runs critical parts of its business on Salesforce: sales, service, financial data, patient records, citizen services. When a release breaks something or data goes missing, revenue stops and regulators call. Flosum is the platform these companies trust to ship changes safely, protect their data, and recover fast.
We are in the middle of the most exciting chapter in our history. Our customers have relied on our Salesforce-native platform for years. Now we are bringing them a new cloud-native platform they can run on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or on-premises. We have also launched sandbox management built for the AI era, so teams can test AI agents such as Agentforce on production-ready environments in minutes instead of days.
Our customers include some of the most demanding enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, the public sector, and technology. They don’t buy us casually, and they don’t leave us casually. Your job is to make sure they never want to.

The role
You will own a book of enterprise accounts and one number: retained revenue. You decide which accounts need you most this week, and you go there. This is a commercial role. You will spend your time with executives, not running support tickets.

What you will do

  • Own renewals across your book, from strategic accounts to smaller ones, and protect every dollar of recurring revenue.
  • Build relationships with the executives who decide: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and heads of Salesforce platforms. Reach past your champion when the account needs it.
  • Turn red accounts green. Spot risk early, build a save plan, and run it with urgency.
  • Move customers from our Salesforce-native products to our cloud-native platform, and make the business case for why it matters to them.
  • Defend your accounts against competitors, in-house builds, and new enterprise architectures.
  • Pull the right people in. Hold product, support, engineering, and customer success accountable for what your customers need.
  • Find expansion opportunities and hand them to our sales team with a clear plan.
  • Run your book with discipline: accurate forecasts, clean renewal pipeline in Salesforce, no surprises.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 7+ years in enterprise account management, renewals, or customer-facing sales at a B2B software company.
  • You have carried a significant book of business (ideally $5M+ in annual recurring revenue) with individual accounts above $250K.
  • You have sold or renewed complex IT solutions: DevOps, data protection, security, infrastructure, or developer platforms. Technical buyers trust you.
  • A track record of saving at-risk renewals by going to the executive level, with the numbers to prove it.
  • Commercial intensity. You negotiate well, you push for multi-year terms, and you are comfortable with hard conversations about price and value.
  • You know how NRR and GRR are calculated and how your work moves them.
  • Clear, concise writing and speaking. You can brief a CIO in five minutes.
  • Experience in the Salesforce ecosystem is a strong plus.

Benefits

Why join now

    • You will work with customers at the moment they move to the cloud. Few account managers get to shape a transition this large.
    • Our products sit in the path of AI adoption. Every company deploying AI agents on Salesforce needs to test, release, and protect them safely.
    • You will have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to build how account management works here.
    • Competitive base plus variable compensation tied to retention.

Interested? Click here to apply now!

 

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we are advancing the future of Artificial Intelligence by helping AI systems understand, process, and generate human speech with greater accuracy and naturalness.

As an AI Speech & Audio Specialist in our AI Community, you will contribute to the development and improvement of next-generation speech AI technologies, including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Voice AI, and audio machine learning systems.

We rely on our global community of specialists to evaluate, create, refine, and improve high-quality speech and audio datasets. Your expertise in audio production, speech analysis, linguistics, or voice technology will help ensure AI models deliver natural, accurate, culturally relevant, and human-like voice experiences.

At TELUS Digital, you will play a key role in shaping how AI listens, understands, and communicates with people around the world.

 

Key Responsibilities:

·         Evaluate AI-generated speech (TTS) for naturalness, pronunciation accuracy, rhythm, tone, emotion, and overall voice quality.

·         Review and improve speech recognition outputs (ASR) by identifying transcription errors, pronunciation issues, accents, and linguistic nuances.

·         Perform professional audio editing tasks including segmentation, trimming, noise reduction, silence adjustment, and quality enhancement.

·         Analyze audio recordings using waveform and spectrogram-based tools to identify quality issues.

·         Support the creation and validation of high-quality speech datasets used for AI model training and evaluation.

·         Review voice recordings for clarity, consistency, articulation, and technical quality.

·         Perform audio quality checks including loudness levels, background noise detection, clipping, distortion, and export specifications.

·         Support voice AI projects including TTS, ASR, voice generation, voice similarity, voice mimicry, and conversational AI evaluation.

·         Apply expertise in phonetics, linguistics, audio engineering, or speech technology to improve AI-generated voice experiences.

 

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

Education / Professional Background:

Minimum of one of the following:

·         Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in:

·         Audio Engineering

·         Sound Engineering

·         Music Technology

·         Linguistics

·         Phonetics

·         Speech-Language Pathology

·         Computational Linguistics

·         Computer Science (Speech/AI focus)

·         Related audio or speech fields

 

OR

Professional experience in:

 

·         Audio production

·         Sound design

·         Dialogue editing

·         Voice recording

·         Podcast/audio post-production

·         Speech data creation

·         AI speech projects

·         Technical Experience:

·         Experience with at least one professional audio tool:

·         Adobe Audition

·         iZotope RX

·         Pro Tools

·         Reaper

·         Audacity

·         Logic Pro

·         Cubase

·         Other Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs)

 

Knowledge of:

·         Audio editing and restoration

·         Noise reduction

·         Speech segmentation

·         Spectrogram analysis

·         Audio quality assessment

·         Voice/audio processing workflows

Language Requirements:

·         Native-level proficiency (C1/C2+) in the required language is preferred for language-specific projects.

·         Ability to identify pronunciation, accent, and linguistic nuances.

·         English proficiency sufficient to understand technical instructions and project guidelines.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with:

·         Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)

·         Text-to-Speech (TTS)

·         Voice AI

·         Speech datasets

·         Audio annotation

·         Voice cloning or voice mimicry projects

·         ADR / dubbing

·         Localization audio

·         Broadcast or media production

·         AI model evaluation

 

Assessment:

·         To join the TELUS Digital AI Community, candidates will complete:

·         Subject-specific qualification assessment

·         Practical audio/speech evaluation (where applicable)

·         Identity verification process

 

The assessment may include:

 

·         Audio quality evaluation

·         Speech recognition review

·         Audio editing tasks

·         Voice quality analysis

·         Linguistic accuracy evaluation

 

Payment:

Currently, pay rates for specialists range from $6 - $40 USD per hour depending on expertise, project complexity, and market requirements. *Location and language is directly dependent.

Payment terms and rates are defined separately for each project engagement.

Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:

·         Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

·         Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

·         Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

·         Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

·         Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship:

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian IT services provider that helps businesses keep their technology secure, reliable, and ready to grow. They support clients across IT infrastructure, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and ongoing technical support, while also helping them plan and deliver technology projects. With a focus on proactive IT management rather than simply fixing problems when they arise, they work closely with businesses to improve their systems, reduce risks, and make technology work better for the organisation.

Role Overview: We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Technical Lead to become the most senior technical resource within an established Australian IT services business.

This is a broad, hands-on leadership role combining technical account management, infrastructure design, cybersecurity, project delivery, service escalation and internal technical leadership.

The successful candidate will take ownership of complex technical matters across multiple client environments while managing competing priorities and ensuring clients receive clear, proactive communication throughout the process.

This is not a role for someone who prefers to focus on a single technical problem at a time. The successful candidate will need to comfortably move between client requirements, technical escalations, projects, team support and internal initiatives, while knowing when to resolve an issue personally and when to escalate or delegate.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Account Management

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point across client environments.
  • Work directly with clients to understand requirements, explain technical issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Provide clear, proactive communication to clients throughout technical issues and projects.
  • Lead the technical team on complex issues and provide guidance, mentoring and direction.
  • Help manage technical relationships across multiple client accounts.

Infrastructure Design & Implementation

  • Design and implement infrastructure and systems solutions based on client requirements.
  • Develop technical solutions across cloud, networking, Microsoft environments, security and core IT infrastructure.
  • Lead technical implementations from planning through deployment, testing and handover.
  • Review existing environments and identify opportunities for improvement, resilience and efficiency.

Cybersecurity & Risk

  • Assess client environments for security risks and recommend appropriate controls.

Project Delivery

  • Lead and contribute to multiple concurrent technical projects.

  • Manage competing priorities, dependencies and deadlines.
  • Communicate project progress, risks and issues clearly to stakeholders.
  • Ensure projects are properly documented and handed over.

Service Escalation & Operational Support

  • Take ownership of complex technical escalations that cannot be resolved at lower levels.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, systems, networking, cloud and security issues.
  • Determine the appropriate level of urgency and business impact.
  • Escalate or delegate issues appropriately rather than allowing individual tasks to consume disproportionate time.
  • Identify recurring technical issues and recommend longer-term solutions.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive technical and service processes.
  • Contribute to improvements in internal systems, workflows and documentation.
  • Assist with evaluating and implementing new technologies that improve service delivery and efficiency.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant IT experience, ideally across infrastructure, systems engineering, technical consulting or MSP environments.

  • Strong technical background across infrastructure, Microsoft/cloud environments, networking and cybersecurity.

jobs.title: Tax Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.excerpt: About Valsoft Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Montreal, Valsoft acquires and grows vertical market software businesses across North America, Europe and beyond.
jobs.description:
About Valsoft
Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Montreal, Valsoft acquires and grows vertical market software businesses across North America, Europe and beyond. Unlike traditional private equity, Valsoft acquires companies with a long-term, buy-and-hold approach. Our portfolio businesses keep their identity, brand and teams, and we give them the resources, expertise and stability they need to grow. Today, Valsoft supports a large and growing portfolio of software companies, organized in regional portfolios with a decentralized operating model.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Tax Manager to lead tax matters for the Helios / Tessera portfolio, covering businesses in the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium, Italy and Switzerland. The role reports directly to the Head of Finance and works closely with the finance managers and CEOs of the portfolio businesses. It is responsible for European tax compliance, tax provision work, transfer pricing, and European due diligence and M&A tax matters, and acts as the key link between the portfolio businesses and the HQ corporate tax team, including the VP, Tax. The ideal candidate brings strong European and international tax expertise, solid technical skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization; exposure to U.S. and Canadian tax is a plus.

Travel Requirements:

Occasionally, approx. once per quarter intercontinental, once every two months international within Europe

Key Responsibilities

Tax Provision & Accounting for Income Taxes

  • Lead the preparation and review of quarterly (when required) and annual tax provisions for the European entities, delivering inputs to HQ’s group tax provision on time and in line with group policies.
  • Prepare supporting schedules for current and deferred tax calculations, including effective tax rate reconciliations.
  • Assess the impact of tax law changes, particularly European, UK and Swiss tax reforms, on the financial statements, and flag group-level implications to HQ.
  • Lead Pillar Two work for the European jurisdictions, including local QDMTT, IIR and UTPR implementation, and provide HQ with the European data needed for U.S. international tax calculations (e.g. GILTI, Subpart F, foreign tax credits).
  • Act as the main point of contact between the HQ corporate tax team and the European finance teams to ensure timely and accurate tax accruals and disclosures.
  • Assist in the automation and implementation of tax provision software solution to improve efficiency and accuracy.
  • Maintain organized documentation of provision workpapers, assumptions, and key judgments to support audit and compliance reviews.

European Tax Compliance Management (UK, NL, DE, FR, BE, IT, CH)

  • Oversee corporate income tax and trade/local tax compliance for portfolio entities in the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium, Italy and Switzerland, coordinating local advisors to ensure timely and accurate filings and tax payments.
  • Oversee VAT and indirect tax compliance, including cross-border SaaS and digital services, intra-EU reporting, and readiness for e-invoicing and e-reporting mandates (e.g. Belgium, France, Germany, Italy).
  • Manage withholding tax on intercompany dividends, interest and royalties, including treaty relief, EU directive exemptions and refund claims (e.g. Swiss withholding tax).
  • Ensure tax reporting is aligned with local statutory accounts (e.g. HGB, Dutch GAAP, French GAAP, Swiss CO) and support local statutory audits.
  • Identify and secure R&D and IP-related tax incentives available to software businesses (e.g. UK R&D relief, Dutch WBSO and innovation box, French CIR/CII, German Forschungszulage, Belgian innovation income deduction, Italian patent box, Swiss patent box and R&D super-deduction).
  • Manage EU and local reporting obligations, including DAC6 mandatory disclosure, Pillar Two GloBE information returns and UK Senior Accounting Officer requirements.

HQ Coordination & U.S./Canadian Tax

  • Coordinate with HQ on group tax reporting, policies, calendars and deadlines, ensuring the European businesses deliver complete and accurate tax inputs.
  • Work with the Head of Finance, HQ tax, the M&A team and external advisors on tax elections and research projects related to the businesses.
  • Where U.S. or Canadian tax touches the European businesses (e.g. intercompany flows, repatriation, U.S. entities in the portfolio), support HQ and external providers on the related compliance.
  • Maintain tax and audit records and ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Coordinate with HQ, group auditors and external advisors to ensure consistent tax filings and documentation across the group.

Transfer Pricing

  • Manage documentation of intercompany arrangements and ensure transfer pricing compliance under OECD guidelines and local European requirements (master file / local file, CbCR) in the UK, NL, DE, FR, BE, IT and CH, coordinating with HQ on CRA and IRS requirements.
  • Assist in compiling financial data for transfer pricing reports and internal benchmarking.
  • Help coordinate with external advisors and internal stakeholders to assess new intercompany transactions.
  • Support transfer pricing audits and assist with dispute resolution strategies as needed.
  • Monitor evolving international tax regulations, including OECD BEPS Pillar One and Pillar Two, and assess their impact on the portfolio’s transfer pricing strategy.

International Due Diligence & Tax M&A Assistance

  • Assist with tax due diligence for acquisitions within the portfolio, including European targets, covering identification of tax exposures (incl. VAT, wage taxes and social security), review of historical tax filings, and analysis of tax attributes such as loss carry-forwards and their usability after a change of control.
  • Support onboarding of newly acquired entities by coordinating with local finance teams to gather tax information, confirm tax registrations, and align compliance processes with group policies.
  • Provide strategic tax planning recommendations for international expansion and entity restructuring, including intra-European mergers, legal entity simplification and the use of tax groups (e.g. German Organschaft, Dutch fiscal unity, French and Italian tax consolidation).
  • Work closely with the VP of Tax and legal team to model tax implications of proposed transactions, assist in documentation of structuring steps, and coordinate external advisor input where needed.
  • Maintain transaction files, structure memos, and support documentation for internal reporting and audit readiness.

Ad Hoc Research & Tax Structuring

  • Monitor and conduct research and analysis of tax issues, including new tax legislation and regulatory changes and summarize implications for the portfolio.
  • Provide tax input on operational matters and respond to queries from portfolio finance teams.
  • Provide guidance on European tax implications of business transactions and restructurings, coordinating with HQ on U.S. and Canadian implications.
  • Assist with tax modeling and scenario planning for potential legislative changes and corporate tax strategies as needed.
  • Support the VP of Tax, Legal, and Finance teams in evaluating and implementing tax-efficient structures for investments and repatriation strategies specific to the portfolio and its cross-border operations.
  • Support operating businesses on tax audit defense strategies and responses to European tax authority inquiries and field audits, liaising with HQ where IRS or CRA matters arise.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Professional tax or accounting qualification, e.g. CTA/ACA (UK), Steuerberater (DE), Belastingadviseur (NL), Expert-comptable (FR), dipl. Steuerexperte (CH), or CPA/CA.
  • 4+ years of post-qualification tax experience in public accounting or corporate tax environments, with hands-on experience across several of the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium, Italy and Switzerland; exposure to U.S. and Canadian tax is a plus.
  • Strong technical knowledge of European taxation (incl. EU directives such as ATAD, Parent-Subsidiary, Interest & Royalties and DAC6, and VAT), tax accounting, transfer pricing, and international tax rules.
  • Experience managing tax compliance and provision processes.
  • Experience working with a group or HQ tax function in a multinational, including providing reporting inputs and aligning local practice with group policies.
  • Familiarity with M&A tax due diligence, tax structuring, and cross-border tax planning.
  • Strong research, analytical, and organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective communicator who can collaborate with non-tax stakeholders and external advisors.
  • Ability to work independently and balance multiple priorities in a decentralized environment.
  • Fluent English required; working knowledge of German, French, Dutch or Italian is a strong advantage.

About The Role

﻿Clarico is a fully remote accounting firm based in Adelaide, Australia. Our Philippines team deals with clients directly. They aren't a back office.

﻿We're hiring a Senior Client Concierge. The firm has grown and there's more client contact and coordination than there used to be. We want someone senior in this part of the business.

﻿Two things about this job you should know before you apply.

The first few months are about learning. How we work, how our systems fit together, and how Australian tax administration actually runs — company and trust structures, ATO and ASIC deadlines, what business owners are dealing with and when.

﻿

﻿You'll learn it through the work: client follow-ups, correspondence, preparing documents, chasing signatures, keeping things moving. Some of it is repetitive. That's how you learn a system properly.

While you're doing it, we want you finding ways to make it faster.

﻿

﻿That's not a side project we'll get to later — it's the main reason this role exists at a senior level.
﻿
﻿We want someone who looks at a task they've done fifteen times and works out how to stop doing it. Using AI tools where they help, changing the process where they don't.

﻿If that sounds like the boring part of the job rather than the interesting part, this isn't the right role for you.﻿

Where the role goes from there depends on what you show us. We have a written progression path from Senior Client Concierge to Executive Assistant, and we'll walk you through it in the interview.

﻿You don't need an accounting background. Most of our team learned it here. But if you already have one — particularly with an Australian firm — you'll move through the early stages faster, and we'll pay for that.

Want to find out more about us? Check out our Mission, Vision and ﻿Values Page here.

What You'll ﻿Do

Think of a hotel concierge. They don't cook your dinner and they don't clean your room. But they know who does, they know how to get it done, and they make sure you're looked after. That's this job. You're not the accountant. You don't do the tax work and nobody expects you to. Your job is making sure the client is looked after and the outcome happens.

Our clients are business owners. Most of them find tax stressful and confusing. When they hear from us they want to know where things stand, what they need to do, and by when — in plain English, not accountant language. A lot of the value in this job is removing that stress: answering before they have to chase, explaining things simply, and making sure nobody is left wondering.

Day to day:

  • Handling client, ATO and ASIC correspondence and follow-up. Resolving things, not passing messages along.
  • Answering the questions you can answer, clearly, without needing someone to check your wording first — and knowing which questions belong with the accountant.
  • Noticing when a client is confused or worried and dealing with it, rather than answering only the question they asked.
  • Explaining what we need from them and by when, in plain English.
  • Preparing client documents and communications.
  • Managing signing workflows, lodgement support and onboarding admin.
  • Finding the parts of our processes that are slow, duplicated or unclear, and fixing them.
  • Testing and building AI-assisted ways of doing this work.

We need someone who moves without being asked. If something is sitting, chase it. If a client hasn't replied, follow up. If something looks wrong, say so. We're not handing you a task list every morning.

And we need someone who's switched on. You have your own life in order — you deal with your own money, your own obligations, your own problems, and you don't need supervising. That's what lets you understand a business owner. They're adults running something real, and they can tell immediately whether the person on the other end of the email gets that or not.

Tools: Karbon, Xero, Notion, Google Workspace, ATO and ASIC portals, Ignition, and whatever AI tools prove useful.

Who we're looking for

Your English has to be exceptional. Spoken and written. You'll be talking and writing to Australian business owners directly. You need to be able to explain something complicated to someone who doesn't understand it, clearly and without sounding like a template.

You have to care how the client feels. Not just whether the task got done. This is a service job for people who find tax stressful. If you can put yourself in their position and think about what would give them peace of mind, you'll do well here.

You have to want to understand why things work the way they do, not just what the steps are. When something doesn't make sense to you, you go and find out. When a client's situation doesn't match anything you've seen before, you work out what's actually going on and what would help. When you're shown how to do something, you want to know why it's done that way — not to argue, but because knowing why is what lets you handle the next thing nobody prepared you for.

Australian tax admin has a logic to it. The ATO, ASIC, company structures, deadlines — they connect to each other in ways that make sense once you see them. Understand the logic and most situations become obvious. If that sounds like something you'd enjoy working out, you'll like it here.

And you have to act on it. Work out what the sensible answer is, do it, and tell us. When you do need to escalate, bring a suggestion with it rather than just the problem.

You have to already use AI. Not "open to learning it." Using it now, for real work, with views on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Experience:

  • 3+ years in admin, client service, executive assistance or operations
  • Able to work Australian business hours
  • You've carried real responsibility somewhere — decisions with consequences, obligations that mattered, dealing with institutions and bureaucracy. This counts for more with us than years on a CV.

Helpful but not required: experience with an Australian accounting or professional services firm; familiarity with Karbon, Xero, or ATO and ASIC processes.

We've hired well from professional services, legal, medical practice management and government backgrounds. We can teach you tax. We can't teach you how to think or how to communicate

﻿The upper end of the range is for someone arriving with Australian accounting firm experience. If you're exceptional but coming from another industry, apply anyway — we'd rather find the right person and work out the number.

How to apply — please read carefully

We don't review applications without a video. This matters more than your CV.

Record an unlisted YouTube video, three minutes maximum.

  • One take. Don't edit it.
  • Camera on your face. No slides, no screen share, no reading from notes.
  • We're not looking for polish. We want to hear how you think and how you speak.

Start the video by saying the word CLARITY, so we know you read this far.

Then do this. You've started with us as a Client Concierge.

A Clarico Client Concierge handles the ATO and business administration side — explaining ATO letters and what they mean, lodging ASIC forms, preparing documents, chasing signatures, and sorting out problems with the ATO on the client's behalf. You're not the accountant. Administration is yours; tax advice isn't. If a client asks what they should do about their structure or their tax position, that goes to the accountant.

This email arrives from an existing client:

"Hi — got a letter from the ATO about PAYG instalments, $4,200 due 28 October. I don't really understand what this is, I thought I'd already paid my tax for the year? Bit stressed about it. What do I need to do? Thanks"

Use any AI tool you like to help you draft your reply.

In the video, tell us:

  1. Which AI tool you used, and what you asked it
  2. What it gave you back
  3. What it got wrong or missed
  4. What you changed yourself, and why

Then submit: your YouTube link, a shareable link to your AI conversation (ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini all support this) or the transcript, and your CV.

We reply to everyone who gets past the video stage.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer with strong hands-on Salesforce experience to join our growing team on a 4-month remote contract.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and functionality of Salesforce-based solutions throughout the software development lifecycle. You will work closely with developers, Salesforce teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to drive both manual and automated testing efforts and ensure that Salesforce implementations meet business and technical requirements.

Salesforce experience is a must-have for this role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the Salesforce development lifecycle.
  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test cases and test scenarios for Salesforce applications and solutions.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across Salesforce environments.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites for Salesforce-based applications.
  • Validate Salesforce configurations, customizations, integrations, workflows, and business processes against functional and technical requirements.
  • Review business and technical requirements to ensure consistency, completeness, and testability.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify Salesforce-related defects through to resolution.
  • Test integrations between Salesforce and external systems and validate data flow and system behavior.
  • Perform regression testing following Salesforce releases, configuration changes, and new feature implementations.
  • Conduct post-release and post-implementation testing to ensure product stability and quality.
  • Work closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, product owners, and business stakeholders to identify and resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, test strategies, and automation coverage.
  • Suggest product and functionality improvements based on usability, quality, and customer experience standards.
  • Support UAT activities and ensure business requirements are properly validated before release.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Software Quality Assurance/Quality Control, with at least 2 years in a Senior or Lead QA role.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing Salesforce applications and solutions is a MUST.
  • Proven experience with Salesforce testing, including functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce functionality, configurations, customizations, and integrations from a QA/testing perspective.
  • Proven expertise in both manual and automated testing, including hands-on experience with automation frameworks.
  • Experience designing and executing detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and regression suites for complex software systems.
  • Experience testing integrations between Salesforce and external applications or systems.
  • Strong track record of identifying, isolating, and documenting critical bugs and edge cases, with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Experience leading and mentoring QA teams and managing quality processes in Agile or hybrid development environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear business impact.
  • Proficiency with bug tracking and test management tools.
  • Experience working with CI/CD environments and understanding of software release processes is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
As the Director of Operations at Client Accelerators, you will be responsible for building, managing, and continuously improving the operating system of our company.

Our goal is to scale Client Accelerators to $20M in Annual Recurring Revenue and $5M in EBITDA, without requiring our CEO to remain involved in the day-to-day operations of the business.

Your job is to make that possible.

You'll work directly with our CEO to translate the company's vision and strategic priorities into measurable goals, operating systems, departmental accountability, and consistent execution.

You will oversee the operational health and performance of our non-media-buying departments, including Client Success, Creative Production, Revenue Operations, and Finance.

You won't personally execute every task within these departments.

Instead, you'll build the systems, scorecards, leadership cadences, and accountability structures that allow department leaders to consistently deliver results.

You'll be responsible for ensuring the company has accurate financial forecasting, clear operational visibility, efficient resource allocation, strong people systems, and the ability to identify and resolve problems before they impact the business.

You'll need to be equally comfortable discussing net operating income, margin performance, client retention, employee performance, hiring, automation, and organizational design.

Most importantly, you will be accountable for making sure the business grows profitably without sacrificing client outcomes or team performance.

Our CEO should be able to ask you how any department is performing, where the company is headed financially, or what operational risks exist — and you should know the answer.

Not because you just pulled together a report.

  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams.   • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • This role requires up to 25% travel

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Has strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Has experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

$98,685—$127,710 CAD

This opportunity resides with All-Domain Operations (ADO), a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All-Domain Operations comprises multi-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

This is an UNPAID internship through the DoD SkillBridge Program for transitioning active-duty US military personnel. DoD SkillBridge Internships are available to help transitioning active-duty military personnel gain real-world experience in the work force sometime during their final 180 days of active-duty service. The intern will actively train on meaningful projects and work closely with a mentor and with senior company leadership. HII Mission Technologies (HII-MT) Internship programs are focused on placing transitioning military into internships that require KSAs, Education & Military Training similar to their current or previous military jobs; positions that could easily transition over to a full-time regular and permanent job with HII-MT.

Skill Bridge intern will train as an All Domain Operations (ADO) Program Manager within the HII Mission Technologies, reporting to a designated Mission Technologies Program Manager, with the primary goal of learning program management principles, technologies, and core operational functions, as well as the roles and responsibilities of program/project management within a civilian contracting firm. A secondary goal is to achieve a cross-organizational understanding of how industry works. The intern will be assigned special projects as needed.

Desired End State (3-4 month target)

  • At the end of four months, the intern will be able to describe core functions of program management, have a basic knowledge of software technologies, government contracting procedures, managing program operations to ensure production schedules are met, system resources are utilized efficiently and effectively, and proper relationships are established between customers
  • The intern will gain a functional understanding of schedule, performance, and risk identification / mitigation on initiatives including but not limited to systems, tools, equipment, software, facilities and other activities
  • The intern will be oriented to profit and loss of a large complex program
  • The intern will be trained on all phases of programs from inception through completion.
  • The intern will support a program contained at one primary geographic location however covering remote locations and multiple business functions and employees directly assigned to program
  • The intern will be trained on processes to track cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs
  • HII Mission Technologies will benefit from the military and experiential background of the SkillBridge intern and considers the SkillBridge internship an overall positive experience.

Assumptions/Restrictions

  • SkillBridge interns are not authorized to represent HII to DoD or Government customers while participating in the DoD SkillBridge Program Internship. Interns can participate and train behind the scenes as long as they are not interacting with customers.
  • If candidate is selected and approved, SkillBridge Intern can be present to work with one of the Business Development or Capture teams located at one of the primary HII Office locations nationwide.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Training Location: Remote

Training Plan

Phase 1 - Basics

  • Week 1: In processing, Introductions/office familiarization
  • Week 2: Intro to Program Management, Operations, Annual Operating Plans, and business development
  • Week 3: Intro to primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance
  • Week 4: Intro to program milestones and monitoring adherence to master plans and schedules, identify program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications
  • Week 5: Intro to work of employees including management level assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas

Phase 2 – Program Management

  • Week 6: Project Management Institute resources, research, and PMBOK training for PMP certification exam
  • Week 7: Review of HII Mission Technologies portfolio - C5 intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C5ISR), and cyber; secure enterprise IT engineering and operations; military training and simulation; logistics management and integrated product support; and fleet maintenance, modernization, repair and sustainment.
  • Week 8: Coordinate resolutions to production-related problems
  • Week 9: Managing required manpower support levels throughout the period of performance of the task order

Phase 3 – Federal Contracting

  • Week 10: HII Mission Technologies existing FEDSIM, IAC MAC contract vehicles, available ceilings for additional revenue generation, and how DoD customers use these pathways to pay for services and products
  • Week 11: How Operations interacts and supports Growth elements – Business Development, Capture Management, and Proposals
  • Week 12: Standardization practices across various business groups, process options to suit specific needs, and preventing project failures
  • Week 13: Review of previous 12 weeks and conclusion of internship

Additional Goals

  • Networking and introductions to senior leadership withing the All Domain Operations (ADO) Business Group

Minimum Qualifications

Active-Duty Military ONLY within final 180 days of active-duty service. Applications accepted within final 12 months of active-duty service. Education and Experience dependent on Program of Instruction.

  • Transitioning US military service member with program/project experience and technical background
  • Commitment to learning HII standards and skills in Program and Project Management

Preferred Requirements

  • 10-15+ years of Program Management experience
  • PMP/PMI certification
  • DAWIA Level 3 certification

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements will vary and is dependent on the Program of Instruction.

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division
Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. jobs.description:
About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated in a Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an undisclosed antibody candidate, both currently in preclinical development. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit  and follow the Company on LinkedIn.  

Role Overview

We are seekinga highly motivated and experienced Senior Clinical Scientist to support clinical development programs in nephrology, with a focus on rare or immune-mediated kidney diseases. This individual will play a key role in translating clinical strategy into high-quality execution of late-stage phase clinical trials. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing biotechnology company where individual contributions have significant impact. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, demonstrates strong scientific and operational expertise, and takes ownership of key deliverables.This newly created position will report to the Executive Medical Director of Clinical Development. The role is fully remote and will require periodic travel for investigator meetings, study team meetings, conferences, and other business activities.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Development and Study Execution

  • Serve as the Clinical Scientist for one or more Phase 2 and/or Phase 3 clinical studies.
  • Contribute to study design, protocol development, and protocol amendments.
  • Develop and review study-related documents including:
  • Protocols
  • Investigator's Brochures
  • Informed Consent Forms
  • Clinical study reports
  • Study manuals and training materials
  • Safety management plans
  • Provide scientific oversight throughout study conduct to ensure protocol compliance and data quality.
  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations to support study start-up, enrollment, trial execution, and close-out activities.
  • Participate in investigator meetings, site training, and scientific discussions with investigators and key opinion leaders.

Data Review and Interpretation

  • Lead ongoing data review and medical monitoring activities in collaboration with Medical Monitors.
  • Identify clinical trends, protocol deviations, safety signals, and data quality issues.
  • Collaborate with Data Management and Biostatistics to develop:
  • Data review plans
  • Edit check specifications
  • Endpoint derivation and analysis plans
  • Participate in database lock, data cleaning, and analysis activities.
  • Contribute to interpretation of study results and development of key messages.

Regulatory and Documentation Support

  • Support preparation of regulatory submissions and agency interactions.
  • Assist in development of briefing documents and responses to regulatory questions.
  • Ensure study conduct aligns with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, and company standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work effectively across Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Regulatory, Safety, Medical Affairs, and Medical Writing.
  • Drive timelines, track deliverables, and proactively identify and mitigate risks.
  • Support governance meetings and preparation of study review materials.

Scientific Communication

  • Contribute to abstracts, presentations, manuscripts, and scientific publications.
  • Participate in advisory boards, investigator meetings, and key external scientific interactions.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving scientific, clinical, and competitive landscapes.

Qualifications

Required

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, nursing, pharmacy, public health, or related discipline (PharmD, PhD, MS, MPH, or equivalent).
  • Minimum 5–8 years of clinical research experience in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry.
  • Experience supporting Phase 2 and/or Phase 3 clinical trials.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, clinical data review, and drug development.
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and global regulatory requirements.
  • Experience reviewing clinical data and collaborating with biostatistics and data management teams.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in nephrology, immunology, inflammation, autoimmune diseases, or rare diseases.
  • Experience with global multicenter clinical trials.
  • Prior involvement in regulatory submissions and health authority interactions.
  • Experience contributing to scientific publications and conference presentations.
  • Experience working in a small or emerging biotechnology company.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong scientific and analytical thinking
  • Attention to detail with a focus on data quality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Collaborative and team-oriented mindset
  • Ability to influence across functions without direct authority
  • Comfortably operating in a highly dynamic, entrepreneurial environment
  • Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach

Position Location

This is a remote role; periodic travel to team and company events is required.

The anticipated salary range for candidates for this role is $175,000 - $190,000. The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but not limited to, relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography.

Contractor, Senior Digital Content & Social Lead

📍 Remote (U.S.-based) | 💼 Part-time | 💰 $100-$125 hourly rate

November 2026 - February 2027, with possibility of extension

WHO WE ARE

At Courier Newsroom, we empower individuals and communities through local reporting that helps people understand and affect the issues impacting their lives. We believe that by investing in the work of local journalists across the country we can positively impact civic participation and build a healthier democracy from the ground up. Through original reporting and human-focused storytelling, we highlight the issues and forces that shape our lives while calling attention to the impacts of policy-making and political action at the local level. We are a rapidly growing team with new ideas on how to change the landscape of this world.

This independent consulting engagement will support Keep Her Wild, a brand focused on wild horse preservation, humane treatment of equines and animals, public lands stewardship, and women's empowerment.

COURIER Newsroom is committed to working with a diverse community of collaborators that values diverse perspectives and lived experiences. We strongly encourage women, people of color, individuals with disabilities, LGBTQ+ consultants and freelancers, and those from all backgrounds to apply. We strive to break down barriers and ensure every collaborator feels seen, heard, and supported.

SCOPE OF WORK

We are seeking a versatile, highly autonomous independent Digital Content + Social Consultant to deliver the end-to-end execution of the digital presence for Keep Her Wild. This engagement combines short-form video production, graphic design, social media publishing, and editorial copywriting.

Consultant will operate independently as both a creative strategist and a full-stack executor, conceptualizing ideas and directly producing the final published assets. The engagement covers visual storytelling, short-form video (Reels/TikToks), high-performing social graphics, brand-aligned copywriting, and channel publishing strategy. Consultant will determine the methods, tools, schedule, and location used to perform the services.

DELIVERABLES

Short-Form Video & Multimedia Production

  • Reel & TikTok Creation: Conceptualize, edit, and optimize engaging short-form video assets using tools of Consultant’s choosing (ie: CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro)
  • Video Pacing & Audio Design: Craft strong 1-second visual hooks, write text-on-screen overlay hierarchy, and select/mix trending audio or voiceovers designed for cold-audience algorithm discovery.
  • Archival & Curated Media: Source, curate, and edit archival video footage, historical imagery, and stock or rights free media into cohesive narrative reels.

Graphic Design & Brand Systems Execution

  • Social & Digital Graphics: Design multi-slide carousels, static graphics, digital action guides, story templates, and promotional assets using tools of Consultant’s choosing (ie: Figma, or Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator/ Photoshop).
  • Visual Consistency: Apply the brand’s visual identity system across all deliverables, ensuring consistent typography, color application, and grid layouts.

Social Publishing & Channel Strategy

  • Daily Publishing & Strategy: Deliver the social content calendar and daily publishing across Instagram, TikTok, and emerging channels.
  • Analytics & Performance Tracking: Monitor platform metrics (reach, profile-to-follow conversions, saves, shares, and link clicks) and deliver monthly performance reports with recommendation to refine content hooks, post formats, and distribution strategies.

Copywriting & Editorial Voice

  • Social Copy & Hooks: Draft punchy, high-converting social captions, short-form video text overlays, and call-to-action messaging.
  • Brand Voice Application: Translate complex environmental policy, public lands issues, and equine welfare narratives into warm, direct, conversational, and "un-stuffy" prose.

ENGAGEMENT TERMS

  • Engagement Structure: Services will be performed under a consulting agreement and statement of work, compensated on a monthly basis upon receipt of Consultant’s invoice. Consultant will not receive a salary, wages, or employee benefits.
  • Independence: Consultant sets their own working hours and location and supplies their own equipment, software, and workspace.
  • Non-Exclusivity: Consultant is free to provide services to other clients during the engagement.
  • Taxes & Insurance: Consultant is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and business expenses.

CONSULTANT QUALIFICATIONS

  • Senior Hybrid Skillset (7+ Years Experience): Demonstrated track record spanning short-form video production, graphic design, social publishing, and editorial copywriting for a mission-driven brand, media outlet, or agency.
  • Full-Stack Execution & Independence: Proven ability to work autonomously by managing a project from initial concept and scripting to final video editing, graphic layout, and social posting without relying on a support team.
  • Video Editing & Content Software Mastery: Hands-on fluency with short-form video tools (CapCut, Canva Video, Premiere Pro) and visual design software (Figma, Canva, Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop).
  • Platform Native Expertise: Deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms, trending formats, interactive features, and content performance levers.
  • Copywriting Versatility: Superior short-form copywriting skills capable of switching effortlessly between quick-hook social captions and informative policy explainers.
  • Alignment with Core Mission: Deep resonance with wild horse preservation, humane treatment of equines and animals, public lands stewardship, and women's empowerment.

Rate: $100-$125 hourly rate (approx 20-25 hours per week)

Timeline: November - February with option to extend.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Please submit a resume, a short cover letter (no more than one page), and a link to your creative portfolio or case studies showing examples of narrative video direction, visual brand assets, social media accounts, collaborative campaigns, or community initiatives.

jobs.excerpt: To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions.
jobs.description:
To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions. We appreciate your understanding as we focus our hiring efforts in these specific regions. And, we encourage all qualified candidates from these states to apply, as we look forward to learning more about your unique skills and experience!

Job Overview:

Our Account Solutions Department is currently looking for a full-time Account Resolution Specialist. This position performs all duties related to protecting and preserving credit union assets and relationships by establishing payment plans, collecting loan payments, recovering collateral, and recommending accounts for charge off.

Where You Will Work:

Remote role open to candidates residing in Washington (WA) or Oregon (OR). (Branches)

Pay Range:

The target hourly pay range for this position is $20.56 - $23.37. The full hourly pay range is $18.69 - $28.04.

  • Compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer of employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manages a high volume of outbound and incoming member calls regarding delinquent and overdrawn accounts. Makes payment arrangements within policy and procedure guidelines.
  • Contacts members with past due accounts, loans, and Visa's via phone, email and mail to discuss outstanding balances and payments, sets up repayment schedules, and obtain payment from members.
  • Utilizes knowledge of Bankruptcy, collateral protection insurance (CPI), credit reporting, GAP, mechanical breakdown insurance (MBI), debt protection, repossessions, account/loan maintenance, deceased member accounts, straw loans, and automated clearing house (ACH) setup to work with members effectively.
  • Completes complex tasks associated with the collection and closure of delinquent accounts, reviews and prepares negative shares report for charge-off. Follows-up on recovery and continued collection efforts of charged off accounts by phone and mail. Reviews and unlocks dormant accounts as needed.
  • Manages a queue of delinquent accounts and makes recommendations of accounts for repossession or for charge off.
  • Prepares files for recovery of collateral and submits files to management for voluntary or involuntary repossession approval.
  • Provides guidance to teammates and branch staff as needed. Assists with training new department staff.
  • Waives fees on accounts within authorization level.
  • Reviews internal processes and provides recommendations for improvements to increase efficiencies within the department to better serve members and the credit union.
  • All other duties as assigned.

When You'll Be Working:

Monday - Friday: 9:00am - 6:00pm and rotating Saturdays: 9:30am - 2:00pm. Full-time 40 Hours a week.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum one (1) year experience in customer service or collection experience required.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Knowledge of federal, state and local laws, statutes, regulations codes and standards related to the area of responsibility.
  • Knowledge of functional relationship between branches and the loan department.
  • Knowledge of legal proceedings applicable to collection, repossession, foreclosure, liens, and bankruptcy.
  • Knowledge of the Symitar and Temenos systems are preferred.
  • Actively learn by understanding the implications of new and existing information for current and future problem solving and decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with area Vice Presidents, Directors, Branch Managers, and employees.
  • Work with computer-based collection-tracking system.
  • Analyze and evaluate situations that affect the loan assets of the credit union.
  • Work extended hours as required or requested by management to complete assigned projects, maintain appropriate staffing levels to provide service levels for member facing jobs or to ensure safety requirements are met.

Total Rewards:

This position is eligible for Full-Time Regular benefits. Employees and their eligible family members have access to a wide array of employee benefits, such as medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverage.

  • Includes an option for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to be paid at a 100% by company for the employee only coverage.
  • We also offer Health Care FSA (HCFSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions, and Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA).
  • Employees also have access to Life and AD&D insurance.
  • Employees are able to enroll in our 401k plan.
  • Full-Time Regular employees accrue 8 hours of vacation and 8 hours of sick leave, on a monthly basis.
  • Full-Time Regular hired employees also receive 11 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 1 floating holiday, 16 hours of self-care time, and 16 hours of volunteer time.

All benefits except 401k start the first of the month following date of hire. Employees become eligible to contribute to 401k on the first of the month following 60 days of employment.

jobs.title: Director, National Accounts (USA - Remote, US)
jobs.excerpt: Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life.
jobs.description:
Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.

Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.

Bausch + Lomb is seeking a highly strategic and results-driven Director, National Accounts to accelerate our efforts in building, managing, and expanding relationships with key National Account partners in the contact lens space. This sales leadership role will be instrumental in shaping Bausch + Lomb’s Vision Care business through innovative account strategies, enterprise-level negotiations, and executional excellence across channels (Private Equity, Retail, Doctor Alliance Groups). The Director position will report to the Senior Director of National Accounts.

The Director will be a player/coach, leading and mentoring a small team of account managers, and together, will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Professional Affairs, Customer Service, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to create integrated customer business plans that drive revenue, market share, and profitability. This individual will ensure alignment with corporate objectives, while driving to achieve ambitious growth goals.

Requirements:

Day to day responsibilities include:

  • Coach, develop, deploy and lead account managers; providing consistent communication and performance feedback.
  • Develop and own long-term strategic account plans for top-tier National Accounts partners to maximize revenue, profitability, and market share.
  • Lead contract negotiations, category management strategies, and joint business planning with executive stakeholders.
  • Launch and scale new products through account-specific commercialization strategies that ensure rapid adoption and growth.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Professional Affairs, and Sales Operations to design and implement customized programs (e.g., co-op marketing, growth programs, fit sets, e-commerce activations).
  • Ensure seamless alignment and execution by providing guidance and direction to field sales team on account initiatives.
  • Act as an advisor to the Senior Director of National Accounts by providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead account-level P&L oversight including revenue, trade spend, and profitability management.
  • Establish and monitor key performance metrics, leveraging analytics and insights to inform decision-making and optimize ROI.
  • Drive disciplined forecasting, consumption planning, and resource allocation.
  • Serve as the point of contact for senior leadership with critical customers, fostering high-impact relationships that drive collaboration and growth.
  • Champion customer-centric approaches, ensuring business solutions meet both customer needs and organizational objectives.
  • Represent Bausch + Lomb at industry forums, conferences, and key account summits.
  • Help to create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation within the National Accounts team.
  • Partner with HR and Sales Leadership to assess talent needs, succession planning, and future capability building.

Qualifications:

We are seeking a candidate with:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive sales/commercial leadership experience, including at least 5 years in National/Strategic Accounts or Key Account leadership within healthcare, medical device, pharma, or consumer health.
  • Demonstrated comprehensive knowledge of vision care/optometry business channels, provider landscape, sales and marketing structures, brand strategies and competitive products.
  • Proven success managing account-level P&Ls with full revenue and profitability responsibility.
  • Strong experience in contract negotiation, trade strategy, category management, and joint business planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence internal and external stakeholders and proven sound business judgment and financial acumen.
  • Thorough understanding of sales and marketing, business trends and consumer dynamics
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate, prioritize and handle multiple priorities and projects simultaneously with keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent leadership and team interaction skills to allow for maximum influence on key stakeholders as well as strengthening culture.
  • Demonstrated analytical, collaborative, and consultative abilities.
  • Domestic Travel required, ability to travel overnight up to 30%.
  • High digital fluency, including CRM, analytics tools, MS Office, and sales databases.
  • Valid driver’s license in state where territory is located, along with clean driving record.

This position may be available in the following location(s): US - Remote

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

For U.S. locations that require disclosure of compensation, the starting pay for this role is between $175,000.00 and $200,000.00. The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors.

U.S. based employees may be eligible for short-term and/or long-term incentives. They may also be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision insurance, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, a tuition reimbursement program (select degrees), company holidays, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S. based employees are also eligible to receive sick time, floating holidays and paid vacation.

To learn more please read Bausch + Lomb's Job Offer Fraud Statement.
