jobs.title: Head of Service Line, Sales-as-a-Service (Remote, Any Location, CO)
jobs.excerpt: The Head of Sales Practice Service Line is Foundever's domain expert in outsourced sales operations — inside sales, outbound prospecting, lead qualification, pipeline development, upsell and cross-sell programs, and retention sales.
jobs.description:
The Head of Sales Practice Service Line is Foundever's domain expert in outsourced sales operations — inside sales, outbound prospecting, lead qualification, pipeline development, upsell and cross-sell programs, and retention sales. This role builds the Sales Practice into a packaged, go-to-market-ready service line with defined vertical plays, proven proof points, and the commercial content needed to grow within the existing account base and win new logos.

The role exists to convert Foundever's sales delivery track record into a market-recognized practice — building the service design, vertical playbooks, GTM content, and commercial engine that establish revenue conversion at scale as Foundever's competitive moat in the sales BPO market.

The global sales outsourcing market is on track to nearly double from $28.65B in 2022 to $57.46B by 2030 at a 9.4% CAGR, and the lead generation market alone is projected to reach $295B by 2027. The shift is structural: buyers no longer view outsourced sales as a cheap-labor substitute, but as a way to deploy AI-assisted, datadriven, outcome-priced revenue generation at a speed and scale internal teams cannot match. Foundever already runs high-value sales programs across travel, hospitality, and other verticals. This role takes that capability to market deliberately.

Job Responsibilities

Domain Expertise & Market Intelligence

  • Serve as Foundever's primary subject matter expert in outsourced sales operations — B2C and B2B inside sales, outbound prospecting and SDR programs, inbound qualification, upsell and cross-sell, retention and save programs, and appointment setting
  • Stay current on sales technology evolution: AI-assisted agent support, real-time conversation intelligence platforms, predictive dialing, AI-powered lead scoring and intent-data platforms, CRM integration, and agentic outbound tools
  • Track the shift from FTE-based to outcome-based pricing in sales BPO — including revenue-share, costper-qualified-lead, cost-per-appointment, and cost-per-close models — and develop Foundever's pricing framework options accordingly
  • Monitor regulatory requirements relevant to outbound sales: TCPA, FCC Click-to-Cancel rule, state telemarketing registration requirements, Do Not Call compliance, and financial services sales suitability standards (FINRA, FCA Product Governance for regulated sales)
  • Track competitor sales BPO positioning across major full-service outsourcers and specialist sales providers — understanding their vertical focus, pricing models, technology differentiation, and proof point library

Practice Development & Service Design

  • Build Foundever's Sales Practice service catalogue: outbound prospecting and SDR programs, inbound sales qualification, upsell and cross-sell programs, retention and churn recovery, appointment setting, and full-cycle B2B sales support
  • Develop vertical-specific value propositions and GTM playbooks for Foundever's highest-opportunity sales verticals: travel & hospitality, telecom, financial services (insurance sales, card acquisition, deposit growth), retail, SaaS, and utilities
  • Design the AI-augmented sales operating model — integrating real-time conversation intelligence, AIpowered objection handling, predictive next-best action guidance, and AI-assisted coaching into the Foundever delivery model
  • Build the outcome-based pricing toolkit — defining the commercial structures, risk-sharing frameworks, and success measurement models that allow Foundever to compete on revenue outcomes, not just seat cost
  • Define the compliance framework for regulated sales verticals — particularly financial services, insurance, and healthcare — including suitability standards, disclosure requirements, call recording obligations, and QA scoring that weights compliance performance

Go-to-Market & Commercial Enablement

  • Build and own the practice GTM toolkit: vertical messaging, solution briefs, competitive battle cards, RFP/proposal content, pricing frameworks, and reference architecture decks — all ready to deploy by Sales and Account Management
  • Enable Foundever's Sales and AM teams to identify, qualify, and position Sales Practice opportunities within their accounts; deliver regular enablement sessions and maintain updated training content for the field
  • Serve as the practice SME on strategic pursuits and RFPs — owning the technical and operational narrative, articulating proof points, and co-designing solutions with the Solutions team
  • Drive upsell and cross-sell into the existing Foundever account base by identifying clients with latent demand in the practice area and developing targeted expansion plays
  • Participate actively in client meetings, executive briefings, and new logo pursuit conversations — serving as the credible subject matter voice that builds buyer confidence in Foundever's domain expertise

-

Service Design & Delivery Standards

  • Codify Foundever's delivery capability in the practice area into structured, repeatable service offerings — with documented workflows, SLA frameworks, agent competency profiles, and QA rubrics
  • Partner with Delivery leadership to design and maintain practice-specific operating standards that meet the compliance and quality expectations of regulated or high-scrutiny buyers
  • Develop and maintain the practice talent model: skill profiles, hiring criteria, training curriculum, certification paths, and productivity benchmarks for onshore and offshore teams
  • Drive continuous improvement — tracking performance data across active client programs, identifying workflow gaps, and implementing changes that measurably improve client outcomes
  • Create reusable case study documentation following client program delivery — translating operational results into external proof points ready for analyst submissions, RFPs, and sales collateral

Analyst Engagement & Thought Leadership

  • Lead Foundever's analyst engagement for the practice area — preparing and submitting briefings to leading industry analyst firms; managing the cadence and quality of submissions to build recognition over time
  • Develop and publish thought leadership content: white papers, regulatory briefings, webinar presentations, and byline articles that establish Foundever's credibility externally in the practice domain
  • Represent Foundever at relevant industry events, vertical conferences, and compliance forums — building the external profile and network that generates both credibility and commercial opportunity
  • Maintain active intelligence on the competitive landscape — tracking competitor service models,technology investments, pricing dynamics, and analyst assessments relevant to the practice

Team & culture

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a small team of practice specialists and SMEs as the service line scales; build a culture of domain expertise, continuous learning, and delivery excellence
  • Mentor delivery leaders and junior team members on practice standards, regulatory expectations, workflow design, and professional development within the domain
  • Champion Foundever's commitment to compliance, quality, and ethical service delivery — particularly in regulated or sensitive service environments

Skills and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in outsourced sales operations, inside sales leadership, or sales BPO — with direct responsibility for revenue performance, conversion metrics, and team productivity
  • Deep working knowledge of sales technology platforms: CRM, conversation intelligence, predictive dialers, AI-assisted selling tools, intent-data platforms, and outbound automation platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to build and GTM-enable a sales service practice — creating solution briefs, vertical playbooks, pricing frameworks, and RFP content — ideally in a BPO or managed services context
  • Familiarity with regulated sales environments — financial services, insurance, telecom — and the compliance requirements that govern outbound and inbound sales in those verticals
  • Strong commercial instincts and credibility with sales and revenue operations buyers: VP Sales, CRO, VP Customer Success, Head of Inside Sales
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to synthesize complex operational and commercial topics into clear executive narratives
  • Experience in customer experience (CX), BPO, digital services, or multi-country matrix organizations
  • Track record of successful analyst engagement with leading industry analyst firms and published thought leadership
  • Vertical depth in one or more of: travel & hospitality, telecommunications, financial services, retail, SaaS
  • Experience designing and deploying outcome-based commercial structures (revenue share, cost-perqualified-lead, cost-per-close)
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices and the integration of GenAI and agentic tools into sales workflows

About Us

Foundever™ is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we are the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world's leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology, and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 67822Title:National Field Development Specialist - Foot and Ankle & TraumaSalary Range:Salary Minimum:$131,500Salary Maximum: $240,000

****This position is remote, with travel primarily to the West US****

Arthrex, Inc. is a global medical device company and a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics. Arthrex is actively searching for a National Field Development Specialist to work closely with Medical Education, sales and product management to develop a sales strategy in the training program. The successful candidate will influence key stakeholders on learning and development strategies.

The position is remote to be based in the West US and does require frequent travel. Join our talented team at a global medical device company focused on Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™.

Main Objective:

Aids in the development and implementation of training programs for agency and corporate staff that are based outside of headquarters. Establishes objectives for, and creates, develops, and administers, in whole or in part, a training program including sales techniques and skills, product and product applications information, group referencing, and role playing. Develops and provides materials and developmental support to sales regions for trainings, presentations at conferences or sales meetings. Will work closely with Medical Education, corporate sales management, product management, and/or marketing team to develop a sales strategy and then incorporates this strategy into the training programs. The candidate will support the field in surgical cases to drive adoption, optimize outcomes, and generate sustained revenue growth. This will cover but is not limited to: Ring Fix, Hindfoot Nail, minimally invasive surgeries.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Works with Corporate National and Regional Sales Managers, and corporate and agency leadership to identify training needs/opportunities and to implement tactics to support business needs. Develops systematic integration of feedback in formulating strategic plans for Sales Training.
  • Works closely with members of the National Sales Team to ensure the appropriate creation and execution of learning and development content (ECI templates, AXIS implementation, etc.), programs and platforms to support the company’s marketing and business plans.
  • Works in close collaboration with Director and Sr. Manager, Global Foot & Ankle and Trauma, to identify critical sales competencies and develop short, medium and long term plans to develop teams in those areas.
  • Responsible for identifying new and emerging learning trends, executing against short and long-term strategies, and developing platforms to support learning and development initiatives.
  • Responsible for identifying, developing, and fostering business relationships with key outside parties that will support the business plans and growth objectives of the business.
  • Effectively executes and facilitates results through the development of strong partnerships with counterparts with a particular emphasis on Sales, National Accounts, Product Management, Marketing and Medical Education.
  • Works with Meetings team to organize training venues, logistics, transport, accommodation as required to achieve efficient training attendance and delivery.
  • Stays abreast of trends within Training and Development. Adapt new approaches as appropriate. Accountable for ensuring the maximization of sales force competency and performance via statistical models tied to sales results.
  • Travel up to 70% field and Arthrex, Inc.

Education and Experience:

jobs.description:
The Head of Sales Practice Service Line is Foundever's domain expert in outsourced sales operations — inside sales, outbound prospecting, lead qualification, pipeline development, upsell and cross-sell programs, and retention sales. This role builds the Sales Practice into a packaged, go-to-market-ready service line with defined vertical plays, proven proof points, and the commercial content needed to grow within the existing account base and win new logos.

The role exists to convert Foundever's sales delivery track record into a market-recognized practice — building the service design, vertical playbooks, GTM content, and commercial engine that establish revenue conversion at scale as Foundever's competitive moat in the sales BPO market.

The global sales outsourcing market is on track to nearly double from $28.65B in 2022 to $57.46B by 2030 at a 9.4% CAGR, and the lead generation market alone is projected to reach $295B by 2027. The shift is structural: buyers no longer view outsourced sales as a cheap-labor substitute, but as a way to deploy AI-assisted, datadriven, outcome-priced revenue generation at a speed and scale internal teams cannot match. Foundever already runs high-value sales programs across travel, hospitality, and other verticals. This role takes that capability to market deliberately.

Job Responsibilities

Domain Expertise & Market Intelligence

  • Serve as Foundever's primary subject matter expert in outsourced sales operations — B2C and B2B inside sales, outbound prospecting and SDR programs, inbound qualification, upsell and cross-sell, retention and save programs, and appointment setting
  • Stay current on sales technology evolution: AI-assisted agent support, real-time conversation intelligence platforms, predictive dialing, AI-powered lead scoring and intent-data platforms, CRM integration, and agentic outbound tools
  • Track the shift from FTE-based to outcome-based pricing in sales BPO — including revenue-share, costper-qualified-lead, cost-per-appointment, and cost-per-close models — and develop Foundever's pricing framework options accordingly
  • Monitor regulatory requirements relevant to outbound sales: TCPA, FCC Click-to-Cancel rule, state telemarketing registration requirements, Do Not Call compliance, and financial services sales suitability standards (FINRA, FCA Product Governance for regulated sales)
  • Track competitor sales BPO positioning across major full-service outsourcers and specialist sales providers — understanding their vertical focus, pricing models, technology differentiation, and proof point library

Practice Development & Service Design

  • Build Foundever's Sales Practice service catalogue: outbound prospecting and SDR programs, inbound sales qualification, upsell and cross-sell programs, retention and churn recovery, appointment setting, and full-cycle B2B sales support
  • Develop vertical-specific value propositions and GTM playbooks for Foundever's highest-opportunity sales verticals: travel & hospitality, telecom, financial services (insurance sales, card acquisition, deposit growth), retail, SaaS, and utilities
  • Design the AI-augmented sales operating model — integrating real-time conversation intelligence, AIpowered objection handling, predictive next-best action guidance, and AI-assisted coaching into the Foundever delivery model
  • Build the outcome-based pricing toolkit — defining the commercial structures, risk-sharing frameworks, and success measurement models that allow Foundever to compete on revenue outcomes, not just seat cost
  • Define the compliance framework for regulated sales verticals — particularly financial services, insurance, and healthcare — including suitability standards, disclosure requirements, call recording obligations, and QA scoring that weights compliance performance

Go-to-Market & Commercial Enablement

  • Build and own the practice GTM toolkit: vertical messaging, solution briefs, competitive battle cards, RFP/proposal content, pricing frameworks, and reference architecture decks — all ready to deploy by Sales and Account Management
  • Enable Foundever's Sales and AM teams to identify, qualify, and position Sales Practice opportunities within their accounts; deliver regular enablement sessions and maintain updated training content for the field
  • Serve as the practice SME on strategic pursuits and RFPs — owning the technical and operational narrative, articulating proof points, and co-designing solutions with the Solutions team
  • Drive upsell and cross-sell into the existing Foundever account base by identifying clients with latent demand in the practice area and developing targeted expansion plays
  • Participate actively in client meetings, executive briefings, and new logo pursuit conversations — serving as the credible subject matter voice that builds buyer confidence in Foundever's domain expertise

-

Service Design & Delivery Standards

  • Codify Foundever's delivery capability in the practice area into structured, repeatable service offerings — with documented workflows, SLA frameworks, agent competency profiles, and QA rubrics
  • Partner with Delivery leadership to design and maintain practice-specific operating standards that meet the compliance and quality expectations of regulated or high-scrutiny buyers
  • Develop and maintain the practice talent model: skill profiles, hiring criteria, training curriculum, certification paths, and productivity benchmarks for onshore and offshore teams
  • Drive continuous improvement — tracking performance data across active client programs, identifying workflow gaps, and implementing changes that measurably improve client outcomes
  • Create reusable case study documentation following client program delivery — translating operational results into external proof points ready for analyst submissions, RFPs, and sales collateral

Analyst Engagement & Thought Leadership

  • Lead Foundever's analyst engagement for the practice area — preparing and submitting briefings to leading industry analyst firms; managing the cadence and quality of submissions to build recognition over time
  • Develop and publish thought leadership content: white papers, regulatory briefings, webinar presentations, and byline articles that establish Foundever's credibility externally in the practice domain
  • Represent Foundever at relevant industry events, vertical conferences, and compliance forums — building the external profile and network that generates both credibility and commercial opportunity
  • Maintain active intelligence on the competitive landscape — tracking competitor service models,technology investments, pricing dynamics, and analyst assessments relevant to the practice

Team & culture

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a small team of practice specialists and SMEs as the service line scales; build a culture of domain expertise, continuous learning, and delivery excellence
  • Mentor delivery leaders and junior team members on practice standards, regulatory expectations, workflow design, and professional development within the domain
  • Champion Foundever's commitment to compliance, quality, and ethical service delivery — particularly in regulated or sensitive service environments

Skills and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in outsourced sales operations, inside sales leadership, or sales BPO — with direct responsibility for revenue performance, conversion metrics, and team productivity
  • Deep working knowledge of sales technology platforms: CRM, conversation intelligence, predictive dialers, AI-assisted selling tools, intent-data platforms, and outbound automation platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to build and GTM-enable a sales service practice — creating solution briefs, vertical playbooks, pricing frameworks, and RFP content — ideally in a BPO or managed services context
  • Familiarity with regulated sales environments — financial services, insurance, telecom — and the compliance requirements that govern outbound and inbound sales in those verticals
  • Strong commercial instincts and credibility with sales and revenue operations buyers: VP Sales, CRO, VP Customer Success, Head of Inside Sales
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to synthesize complex operational and commercial topics into clear executive narratives
  • Experience in customer experience (CX), BPO, digital services, or multi-country matrix organizations
  • Track record of successful analyst engagement with leading industry analyst firms and published thought leadership
  • Vertical depth in one or more of: travel & hospitality, telecommunications, financial services, retail, SaaS
  • Experience designing and deploying outcome-based commercial structures (revenue share, cost-perqualified-lead, cost-per-close)
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices and the integration of GenAI and agentic tools into sales workflows

About Us

Foundever™ is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we are the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world's leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology, and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.

What if AI could research antitrust law as precisely as a competition lawyer? Right now, it can't. We're building the tools to change that — and we need lawyers on the journey.

jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture is helping enterprises reinvent their organizations and businesses with human-centered AI solutions and services to drive breakthrough innovation and lasting competitive advantage. With more than 45,000 AI and data professionals across the company, our AI & Data practice brings together cutting-edge AI technologies, deep industry experience, strategic investment, exceptional interdisciplinary talent, and a powerful ecosystem of partners to help clients scale AI with speed and confidence.


You Are

A front-end engineer passionate about creating human-centered, intuitive, visually compelling, and production-ready user experiences for advanced Agentic AI products and solutions.

You will build and evolve our Agentic AI Studio, a cloud-based platform that enables users to create, customize, deploy, and manage AI agents through intuitive, no-code experiences. You will also develop Agentic AI-as-a-Service solutions, translating advanced AI capabilities into practical, engaging experiences that address real-world business needs.


Your work spans four key areas:

  • End-User Experience: Create intuitive conversational, graphical, and multimodal interfaces that enable users to interact with, understand, supervise, and collaborate effectively with AI agents.
  • AI Creator Experience: Build no-code, AI-powered interfaces that enable creators to automatically generate, customize, test, deploy, and manage AI agents, including visual workflow builders and interactive configuration tools.
  • Stakeholder Experience: Develop interactive dashboards and information visualizations that help business and technical stakeholders explore insights, monitor AI performance, and track business outcomes.
  • Developer Experience: Develop interactive development environment for developers to build and test custom agent skills and extend agent logic (e.g., pre-built task intelligence).
  • Client Solution Experience: Design, customize, and integrate front-end applications for Agentic AI-as-a-Service solutions, enabling clients to rapidly adopt AI capabilities within their existing applications, systems, and workflows.

You excel at turning complex AI capabilities, data, and workflows into simple, compelling, and trustworthy experiences, making advanced Agentic AI accessible to both technical and nontechnical users.


You will collaborate closely with product designers, AI researchers, AI engineers, client teams, and business stakeholders, combining hands-on engineering with rapid prototyping, product innovation, technical demonstrations, and production delivery.


Depending on experience and seniority, you may also provide technical leadership in front-end architecture, design systems, visualization frameworks, reusable components, and engineering best practices.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and develop intuitive graphical user interfaces (GUIs) for conversational, visual, and multimodal interactions with AI agents.
  • Develop interfaces for human-AI collaboration, including feedback, clarification, approvals, supervision, intervention, and escalation.
  • Create experiences that help users understand AI-generated insights, recommendations, decisions, and actions.
  • Create AI-assisted agent development experiences, including automatically generated workflows, conversational configuration, and iterative refinement.
  • Develop visual testing, debugging, simulation, and monitoring interfaces to help creators evaluate and improve agent behavior.
  • Design and develop interactive dashboards and information visualizations that communicate agent performance, operational status, and business impact.
  • Build interfaces that enable users to explore AI-generated insights, identify trends, investigate issues, and support informed decisions.
  • Create customizable dashboards tailored to business leaders, AI creators, operational teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Design and develop client-facing Agentic AI applications and experiences that address specific business challenges and workflows.
  • Integrate front-end applications with APIs, backend services, LLMs, AI agents, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop and maintain reusable UI components, visualization libraries, and design systems.
  • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers, AI researchers, product teams, and engineers to prototype, evaluate, and refine innovative AI experiences.
  • Contribute to code reviews, testing, documentation, continuous integration, and production releases.

Submitting a development portfolio of past front-end work is strongly encouraged and highly recommended.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


Here's what you need

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as a front-end, full-stack, or software engineer building and supporting production software applications.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience applying computer science fundamentals, including software architecture, system design, and programming.
  • Minimum of 2 year of experience developing modern web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience designing and implementing graphical user interfaces, interactive web applications, or data visualization interfaces.
  • Minimum of 2 year of experience building and deploying applications in cloud environments.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus points if you have

  • Extensive experience in one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C++, Clojure
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, and modern front-end development practices.
  • Experience creating intuitive, visually compelling, responsive, and production-ready graphical user interfaces
  • Familiarity with UI frameworks and design systems such as Material UI, Ant Design, and Tailwind CSS
  • Experience translating UX/UI designs from Figma into production-ready applications.
  • Understanding of human-centered design, usability, accessibility, and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) principles.
  • Hands-on experience developing interactive dashboards, data visualizations, exploratory analytics interfaces, or complex information displays.
  • Proficiency with one or more visualization libraries, including D3.js, Recharts, Plotly.js, Apache ECharts, Chart.js, or Highcharts.
  • Experience building interactive graph, network, or workflow visualizations using React Flow, Cytoscape.js, or similar tools.
  • Ability to translate complex data, relationships, and AI-generated insights into clear, actionable, and engaging visual experiences.
  • Experience developing applications powered by Generative AI, LLM APIs, AI agents, or agentic AI systems.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, with a passion for emerging technologies, rapid innovation, and delivering tangible business outcomes.
  • Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Information Visualization, or a related field is preferred.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills
  • A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact

Compensation & Rewards:

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 104,000 - EUR 124,800. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

The Enterprise Sales Account Executive achieves assigned sales quotas and contributes to the overall sales strategies within a major geographic area. This full cycle sales role involves developing a pipeline of opportunities throughout the assigned territory, identifying, and managing opportunities, and closing deals, all while working closely with and through Value Added Resellers (VARs) as part of Sectigo’s channel-driven sales strategy. 

This is a full-time and remote position, with the ideal candidate based in Germany and focusing on the German market. The ideal candidate must be fluent in both English and German and is able to travel more than 50% of the time based on business needs.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  • Capture new accounts while retaining and growing business in existing accounts.  
  • Develop sales strategies, territory plans, and pipelines.  
  • Lead negotiations, coordinate complex decision-making processes, and overcome objections to close deals.  
  • Meet or exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue goals.  
  • Create and update a dynamic territory plan highlighting regional and vertical targets, marketing efforts, and channel partner strategies.  
  • Build and maintain relationships with channel partners, including providing sales training, account mapping, and collaborative selling opportunities.  
  • Assume full responsibility for accurate sales forecasting by demonstrating in-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact to procurement.  
  • Prepare and deliver formal proposals and presentations to stakeholders, including C-level executives.  
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of Sectigo products and stay up to date with industry trends and technical developments.  
  • Regularly update CRM systems with accurate sales data and account statuses.  
  • Work closely with other sales executives, engineers, product managers, and leadership to drive revenue growth. 
  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent work experience is strongly recommended.  

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in quota carrying enterprise sales with a proven track record of exceeding quotas is required.  
  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience selling cybersecurity solutions is strongly recommended.  
  • Demonstrated success working with channel partners (Value Added Resellers) including building partnerships and leveraging co-selling strategies is a must.
  • Former experience working in a Channel Account Managers role is accepted.
  • Proficiency in English and German at a business conversational level is required.
  • Familiarity with sales engagement tools like Salesforce, Clari, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo for tracking and managing sales activities.  
  • Experience with formal sales training (e.g., solution selling, territory planning, communication skills). 

Ability and Availability to Travel:

  • Must be able to travel more than 50% of the time to the assigned regions and/or territories. 

Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:

  • Highly motivated "hunter" mentality with exceptional prospecting skills.  
  • Strong relationship-building skills, particularly with channel partners and C-level executives.  
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills (written and verbal).  
  • Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable in dynamic, process-building environments.  
  • High energy, driven, and goal-oriented with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Willingness to travel more than 50% within the territory or region as needed.

Senior Professional Services, Engagement Manager

An overview of this role

As a Senior Professional Services Engagement Manager, you will play a critical role in driving GitLab’s growth in the region by structuring services engagements that create true partnership and shared success with our customers. You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives. In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab.

Some examples of our projects

  • Designing and structuring outcome-based professional services engagements that align GitLab capabilities to customers needs
  • Partnering with account executives, solutions architects, and delivery leaders to turn complex DevSecOps transformations into clear, actionable implementation roadmaps and statements of work

What you'll do

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, and technical leaders
  • Conduct discovery sessions with with prospects and Systems Integrators to understand current-state capabilities, requirements and desired business outcomes
  • Design outcome-oriented services proposals that align GitLab capabilities with customer success metrics and objectives
  • Structure engagements and commercial proposals to clear outcomes maintaining flexibility for staff augmentation and packaged offerings when needed
  • Develop custom-scoped SOWs and staffing plans for complex implementations, engaging with technical architects and delivery leadership to ensure deliverability
  • Articulate GitLab's services value proposition, catalog offerings, and implementation methodologies in the context of customer requirements
  • Gain agreement on scope and price while guiding customers through commercial terms, procurement processes, and contracting structures
  • Manage project- and account-level escalations, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining customer confidence
  • Position consulting, training, success tiers, and additional solutions proactively to ensure successful outcomes and long-term customer retention
  • Facilitate solutioning sessions including implementation roadmapping, enterprise strategy discussions, and executive-level requirements gathering
  • Drive measurable outcomes by structuring services that support customer success metrics, accurately forecasting services bookings, and tracking key performance indicators related to bookings, margin, and attachment to strategic opportunities.
  • Own the engagement lifecycle from initial discovery and pre-sales solutioning through scoping, SOW development, staffing alignment, and transition to delivery, ensuring engagements are deliverable, clearly defined, and outcome-oriented.
  • Influence cross-functional teams by articulating GitLab’s professional services value proposition in the context of federal requirements and compliance frameworks, and by feeding customer insights back into sales, delivery, and practice management.
  • Partner with regional sales and engagement leadership to prioritize and manage services opportunities that support critical deals and strategic initiatives, providing clear recommendations on risk management, negotiation strategies, and commercial structures.
  • Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes.

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated progressive experience structuring, scoping, and selling professional services engagements in the region
  • Proven success operating in a pre-sales context, conducting discovery, designing outcome-oriented proposals, and developing custom statements of work (SOWs) and staffing plans for large, complex implementation projects.
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps practices, and cloud transformation initiatives, with the ability to connect technical solutions to mission objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills with executive presence, able to build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, contracting stakeholders, and senior technical leaders.
  • Highly developed facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to guide customers through acquisition processes, commercial structures, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, solutions architecture, delivery, and operations teams to align on deal strategy, staffing, and successful execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote setting, managing multiple complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals.

The Professional Services Engagement Management team at GitLab is dedicated to designing and structuring services engagements that set our customers up for successful, long-term adoption of our DevSecOps platform. We build and manage strategic relationships with customers to understand their goals, surface their services needs, and translate complex transformation initiatives into clear, outcome-oriented engagement plans. Composed of experienced services, consulting, and delivery professionals distributed across multiple regions, we operate asynchronously to support field teams, shape implementation strategies, and guide customers through their services journey. We focus on creating scalable engagement models, fostering open communication with internal stakeholders, and adapting our services offerings to the evolving needs of a rapidly maturing organization and its customers. For more on how our team works, see the Professional Services Engagement Management handbook page.

jobs.title: Point of Care Growth and Partnerships Associate
jobs.excerpt: Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for a Growth and Partnerships Associate to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

What You'll Do

In this role, you'll join our point of care Sales Team in support of Flatiron's strategic expansion of OncoEMR sales. You'll own smaller community oncology deals end-to-end, support larger and more complex opportunities alongside the Director of Sales, and help build the sales infrastructure and partnership pipeline that fuels Flatiron's continued growth. In addition, you'll:

  • Independently own net-new OncoEMR sales opportunities for smaller community oncology practices, managing the full cycle from initial discovery through contract execution
  • Conduct discovery calls, coordinate product demos, and collaborate cross-functionally with Solution Design, Implementation, and Interfaces teams to support a smooth path to close
  • Support the Director of Sales in advancing larger, more complex community oncology and multi-specialty/urology opportunities, including prospect research, multi-stakeholder demo coordination, and follow-up communications
  • Drive top-of-funnel pipeline growth by identifying and engaging new OncoEMR prospects, and by triaging inbound interest submissions
  • Stay informed on community oncology and urology market trends and competitive landscape
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date opportunity and pipeline data in Salesforce, including deal plans, stage guidance, and next steps, to support monthly sales reporting
  • Partner with the Director of Sales and BizOps to build and continuously improve the HC Sales Playbook, capturing messaging, objection handling, and learnings from active deals
  • Serve as a first point of contact for inbound partner inquiries to the Flatiron Vendor Network (FVN), assessing fit and routing qualified vendors through the appropriate next steps
  • Lead introductory discovery calls with prospective FVN partners, evaluate fit against program criteria, and provide clear recommendations on next steps
  • Help develop and maintain internal FVN process documentation, intake materials, and vendor tracking resources

This is a highly cross-functional role, requiring close collaboration with Solution Design, Implementation, Interfaces, Marketing, and BizOps teams. Ultimately, this role is designed to sustain momentum in Community Oncology and FVN partnerships, while building the capacity to pursue new market opportunities in new OncoEMR market sales.

Who You Are

You're a motivated, resourceful self-starter who thrives on progressing deals and partnerships from first conversation to close. You bring strong organizational instincts, high personability, and a collaborative mindset to everything you do, and you're energized by the opportunity to help build a growing sales function at Flatiron. In addition:

  • You have 1-4 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, consulting, or a related client-facing role
  • You have a B.A. or B.S. or the equivalent relevant industry experience
  • You have prior experience in healthcare, health tech, or a related industry, and you're motivated by the opportunity to apply that experience to Flatiron's mission of improving cancer care
  • You have hands-on experience using Salesforce (or a comparable CRM) to manage pipeline, track opportunities, and maintain accurate deal data
  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and proactively drives deals and partnerships forward with minimal oversight
  • You have strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple deals, prospects, and priorities simultaneously without letting details fall through the cracks
  • You have high emotional intelligence and personability, with the ability to quickly build rapport and trust with prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders alike
  • You have a strategic, market-savvy approach to identifying opportunities and understanding what drives value for prospective customers and partners. You are able to identify key decision-makers and develop sales strategies, not just manage transactions.
  • You are a natural cross-collaborator, comfortable working closely with Solution Design, Implementation, Interfaces, Marketing, Legal, and BizOps to move deals and initiatives forward
  • You are goal-oriented and motivated by measurable outcomes, with a track record of progressing toward (or exceeding) targets
  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and are excited to help shape and scale sales infrastructure (playbooks, process, tooling) as Flatiron expands into new markets
  • You are passionate about our mission to improve healthcare through technology and to improve cancer treatment and accelerate research

Extra credit

  • You have prior experience working in or selling into the community oncology or similar ambulatory care centers
  • You have familiarity with EHR (Electronic Health Record) systems, ideally OncoEMR or a comparable oncology-specific platform
  • You have prior experience supporting or managing vendor/partner relationships in a healthcare technology ecosystem

Where You’ll Work

This role can be based remotely or in our NYC office. Wherever you're based, you'll need to be willing to travel at least 20% of the time, including regular office visits if you're not NYC-local, to support in-person prospect meetings, partner discovery, and team collaboration. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals
  • Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice
  • Mental well-being tools and services
  • Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave
  • Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy
  • Travel support for safe healthcare services

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Software II para atuar na evolução do SDK iOS responsável pela captura segura de sinais de dispositivos e sensores, garantindo a integridade das informações coletadas para soluções de autenticação, biometria e prevenção a fraudes.

Esta pessoa será responsável por desenvolver mecanismos avançados de proteção contra comprometimento de dispositivos, atuando em conjunto com times de Arquitetura, Segurança e Engenharia para garantir alta confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade do SDK.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir SDKs iOS utilizando Swift e Objective-C.
  • Implementar mecanismos de detecção de jailbreak, emulação e manipulação de runtime.
  • Projetar e implementar controles de segurança para proteção de canal e integridade de dispositivos.
  • Integrar sensores nativos, como câmera e biometria, em fluxos seguros de captura e validação.
  • Implementar soluções de criptografia aplicada e proteção de dados em trânsito e repouso.
  • Garantir compatibilidade, estabilidade e performance das bibliotecas distribuídas para clientes.
  • Atuar na publicação, versionamento e monitoramento dos SDKs móveis.
  • Apoiar investigações técnicas relacionadas a ameaças, vulnerabilidades e vetores de fraude em dispositivos móveis.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definição de arquitetura e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento iOS utilizando Swift e/ou Objective-C.
  • Conhecimento em APIs de segurança da Apple, como Secure Enclave, DeviceCheck e Keychain.
  • Experiência com detecção de jailbreak, root detection e proteção contra manipulação de aplicações.
  • Conhecimento em criptografia aplicada, certificação digital e comunicação segura.
  • Experiência com integração de sensores móveis (câmera, biometria e dispositivos nativos).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de SDKs e distribuição de bibliotecas para iOS.
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD, versionamento e monitoramento de aplicações mobile.
  • Vivência com boas práticas de segurança ofensiva e defensiva em aplicações móveis.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Mobile Security, Anti-Fraud ou Identity & Access Management.
  • Conhecimento em engenharia reversa e técnicas de instrumentação mobile.
  • Experiência com frameworks de observabilidade e monitoramento.
  • Atuação anterior em produtos de autenticação biométrica ou validação de identidade digital.

Formação

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação, Desenvolvimento Mobile ou Arquitetura de Software será considerada um diferencial.

Competências comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Forte senso de ownership e qualidade técnica.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa em ambientes multidisciplinares.
  • Mentalidade de segurança e prevenção de riscos.

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE

The Partner Engagement Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and optimizing performance of suppliers within a particular set of languages. Performance includes, but is not limited to, on-time delivery, adherence to all client and project specific requirements, and defect-free deliverables. This Team is responsible for understanding customer capacity requirements as communicated by the Program Squads and liaising with Talent Procurement to ensure such capacity requirements can be met. As part of ensuring capacity, the Partner Engagement Team will monitor supplier utilization and advise supplier selection to the Program Squads accordingly.

MAIN DUTIES

  • Through engagement with Program Squad, make data-driven decisions regarding the most suitable suppliers for standard service offerings. Suitability may be based on quality, OTD, market / language strategy, capacity needs, content specialty, or client specific requirements.

  • Lead communication and onboarding of suppliers to new client programs, ensuring availability and suitability for such work.

  • Maintain supplier skilling as it pertains to clients / Pantheon (proprietary) programs.

  • Monitor utilization to ensure supplier usage is in alignment with strategies as defined by Program Operations, Partner Success, and Language Operations. Engage with Program Squads should adjustment in resource usage be necessary.

  • Communicate with and support Talent Procurement in the creation of new recruitment campaigns to identify and onboard new suppliers to Welocalize.

  • Ensure regular quality measuring of suppliers in alignment with Welocalize LQA strategy.

  • Monitor and flag suppliers performing beneath defined Welocalize thresholds. Supplier performance is inclusive of OTD, time-to-accept task, language quality, adherence to instructions, etc.

  • Initiate Quality Improvement Plan (QIP), RCAs or CAPAs, as needed. If QIP is deemed unsuccessful, inform Talent Procurement.

  • For existing service offerings, liaise with Program Squad to understand customer capacity requirements and take appropriate actions to ensure such requirements are consistently met.

    • Working knowledge of architecture and security methods such as well-architected frameworks, threat modeling, shared responsibility, Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, and secure-by-design principles.
    • Ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing requirements, drive decisions, and maintain delivery momentum across multiple stakeholder groups.
    • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation including reference architectures, diagrams, standards, decision records, and implementation guidance.

Technical Depth:

    Deep expertise in at least three of the following areas, with working knowledge of the others:
  • Cloud architecture: Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud; landing zones; hybrid connectivity; resiliency; disaster recovery; and cloud operating models.
  • Identity and access: Entra ID and cloud-native IAM; federation; Conditional Access; privileged access; just-in-time administration; workload identities; and secrets management.

Preferred Experience:

We Are:

We are a global collective of reinventors applying the New every day to improve the way the world works and lives. You Are:

You own the full process transformation design cycle for HR — from assessing how market forces, regulatory shifts, and technology changes are reshaping the function, through specifying the future-state process, to defining how people will adopt new ways of working. You’re the domain authority on your team: clients and colleagues come to you because of what you know about how HR actually works. You combine business expertise, technical literacy, and AI-enabled process design to drive transformation.


You are designing at the intersection of human, agent, and process as part of HR Reinvention transformation work. When you design a future-state HR process, you naturally consider how AI agent experiences should be shaped to serve both the business outcome and the people working alongside those agents. You also advise clients on how to create and capture value from AI and data — translating complex data into actionable insights and tying AI initiatives to measurable business outcomes.


Role Overview

For CHROs and Chief People Officers looking to deliver concrete business outcomes, HR Reinvention shifts the performance frontier of HR on two dimensions: supporting growth and productivity in the business, and transforming how the HR function operates. Drawing on proven platforms, deep technology ecosystems, and integrated services, we redesign HR to be faster, smarter, and built for a workforce that blends human capability with AI. The result is an HR function that spends less time on process and more time delivering superior business outcomes and innovating in employee experience.


As an Industry & Process Advisor Manager in HR Reinvention, you will help our clients pivot and lead them to reimagine the HR function. Your experience in the field makes you a leader that people look to for advice, while your people and storytelling skills mean you have no problem helping clients understand their choices.


The Work

As a Manager in HR Reinvention, you will lead future-state process and AI integration design for clients, embedding AI into both client deliverables and your team’s ways of working. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Lead future-state HR process specification, AI integration design, operating model changes, and adoption planning for assigned HR functional areas

  • Minimum 1 year of experience integrating AI and automating HR business process design

  • An HR professional who understands that helping companies redefine how work gets done — through AI strategy, intelligent automation, and process reinvention — is vital to business success. This role requires someone with the skills, the know-how, and the tools to help clients understand what the future of HR will look like and to make the change a reality
  • Understands AI strategy, ecosystem choices, and how AI can transform HR business processes; proven track record using AI-enabled industry benchmarking analyses and change-impact assessments

About Ting Labs

Ting Labs is the company behind Ting, an electrical fire prevention sensor active in more than 1.3 million homes across North America. A single Ting sensor takes 30 million measurements per second; across the fleet, the result is one of the largest continuous, high-resolution datasets ever assembled on the residential electrical grid.

Ting's sensor fleet provides real-time visibility into hidden electrical fire hazards across more than a million homes. These insights enable our Ting Fire Safety Team to identify hazards early and help prevent devastating electrical fires before they start.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to scale Ting’s consumer product and services — owning strategy, roadmap, customer support and insights, GTM, and the web and mobile apps themselves.

This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing. It will partner very closely with marketing to deliver an evolving customer experience, with the goal of growing the Ting installed base through both existing and new channels.

What You'll Own

  • The consumer. Be the in-house expert on consumers' needs - what prompted them to request or buy the product, how they use it, and what new problems it can solve for them. Run discovery, build durable feedback loops, and translate insight into the product roadmap.
  • Internal tools. Evolve the tools used by our Fire Safety Team to increase FST effectiveness and throughput resolving customer’s fire hazards.
  • The experience. Elevate the existing web and mobile experiences and support new flows and customer experiences.
  • Product vision and strategy. Set the North Star direction for the Ting Sensor and Services and the strategy to realize the vision in concert with company leadership.
  • Roadmap definition and delivery. Define and ship the roadmap to make progress towards the vision. Partner with design, engineering, marketing and operations to shape the scope of each release. Measure consumer and business impact of product changes after they’re made.
  • Expand distribution channels. Lead product development in support of new distribution channels in concert with Marketing and Sales. These include D2C, new channel partners, and international expansion.
  • Go-to-market. Partner with marketing on positioning, messaging, pricing and packaging. Ensure a smooth experience regardless of acquisition channel
  • Scalable product operations. Elevate the internal roadmapping, prioritization, and release-planning practices for this product line.
  • AI-native operating. Use modern AI tools fluently across research, prototyping, writing, and analysis — at the pace PMs are now expected to work.

What We're Looking For

Consumer product experience

  • 4+ years of consumer / mobile app product management experience.
  • 2+ years distributing products via D2C channels, experience with subscription-based products, knowledge of churn models and LTV calculations.
  • Strong understanding of how consumers interact with device / software combinations such as wearables, smart home technology and telemetry. Knowledge of how to extract qualitative and quantitative consumer insights to inform the product strategy and roadmap.
  • Experience with internal tools used to support the consumer experience is preferred.

Business acumen

  • Excellent communication, presentation skills, and executive presence.
  • Comfortable leading both product and business conversations with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Track record of translating ambiguous consumer needs into repeatable product requirements that serve multiple buyers.
  • Strong instinct for pricing, packaging, and what makes a D2C product commercially viable.

Operating style

  • 2+ years in a growth-stage startup environment — you’re at home with ambiguity, pace, and the swings of building something new.
  • AI-native operator. You can name the specific AI tools and workflows you use day-to-day and explain how they’ve changed what you produce and how fast.
  • A natural bridge between engineers and business stakeholders. Plays well with others in conditions of pressure and uncertainty.
  • Process-minded in a builder’s way: lightweight processes that scale with the team, not for their own sake.

Why Join Us?

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of a groundbreaking technology that is creating a new category while helping to protect families, homes, and communities from the devastating impacts of electrical fires. We are a passionate team, dedicated to revolutionizing fire prevention to make the world a safer place. Our pace and growth trajectory offer exceptional opportunities for professional development, and we offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits. If you want to take ownership, shape strategy, and drive meaningful change, you’ll love Ting Labs.

jobs.excerpt: We're building something ambitious at Fly. io: a new public cloud, running on our own hardware all over the world, built to make it easy to run apps close to users wherever they are.
jobs.description:
We're building something ambitious at Fly.io: a new public cloud, running on our own hardware all over the world, built to make it easy to run apps close to users wherever they are.

We've built something people want. Historically, we've been all self-serve growth - developers can find us, sign up, and build things on their own. But that's only one side of the equation! We also need to be able to go out and spread the word to companies who haven't heard about us and would do well on Fly.io.

One type of company we're particularly interested in talking to are those who want to run AI workloads close to their users on our GPUs. These companies care about security (which we're great at). Maybe they're building in regulated industries (like Finance and Healthcare) and are extra cautious about making sure their stuff isn't used as training data. (We would never.) These companies want to ship their AI apps fast and they have FOMO because their teams are stuck.

That's where you come in. We don't have a "sales org" at Fly.io yet, but we need someone to focus on sales to these kinds of companies. You'll find them, get warm intros to the right people, build a relationship, and help them see why Fly.io is the right platform for what they're building. And—this is super important—you'll do it in a way that's beneficial for everyone involved. We care about building cool shit and bringing it to the people who need it, not being mercenary sales monsters. We want you to get us in early at small companies that'll grow just as much as we want you to land big customers.

This role is right for you if:

  • You're proactive and you like experimenting. You’ll try lots of different ways to find customers who fit this use case and start conversations with them.
  • You know how to run a not-gross sales process. Any outside folks who interact with you are going to walk away thinking highly of Fly.io, whether or not they become a customer.
  • You might be a developer, you might not! Either way, you know enough about AI and what Fly.io does to be dangerous (i.e., have a conversation about how the two go together).
  • You're a persuasive problem-solver. You can build trust quickly and get deals that create value for Fly.io and our customers across the finish line.

You'll know you're succeeding in your job if:

  • It's easier for companies shipping AI apps to find Fly.io and understand why we're a great fit for what they're building (i.e., revenue from these customers increases).
  • You're building a deeper understanding of what our AI-focused customers need and are helping to shape our GPU offerings.

More Details

This is an mid career level, fully-remote, full-time salaried position. It is not commission-based because we don't have a sales org yet; that might change in the future. You can live anywhere in the US; your work hours and holidays observed are up to you. In order to optimize for pay equity, Fly.io doesn't negotiate salaries. We have standardized salaries for each employee level. The salary is $134k or $190k USD, dependent on level. We offer competitive equity grants with a long exercise window. US employees get health care, everyone gets flexible vacation time (with a minimum), hardware/phone allowances, the standard stuff.

Our hiring process may be a little different from what you’re used to. We respect career experience but we aren’t hypnotized by it, and we’re thrilled at the prospect of discovering new talent. So instead of resumes and interviews, we’re going to show you the kind of work we’re doing and then see if you enjoy actually doing it, with “work-sample challenges”. Unlike a lot of places that assign “take-home problems”, our challenges are the backbone of our whole process; they’re not pre-screeners for an interview gauntlet. (We’re happy to talk, though!)

If you're interested, mail . You can tell us a bit about yourself, if you like. Please include a fun GIF so we know you're not a bot.

  • Oversee compliance and support EPC and Asset Management teams with NERC and applicable utility standards and review/validate interconnection-related engineering deliverables
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify and mitigate transmission and interconnection risks throughout the project lifecycle
  • Provide electrical engineering expertise across all phases of projects, including design and engineering review (30/60/90/IFC)

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency in power system modeling using PSSE, PSLF, TARA and demonstrated ability to independently perform studies and interpret results

  • Self-starter with a desire to succeed and a focus on creating value

  • Integrity and accountability

Education & Experience:
