jobs.description:
Job Type:  Full-time | Location: Remote TX | Department:  Procurement | Reporting to: Procurement Manager| Work Location Type:  #remote


IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.

The Vendor Onboarding & Risk Specialist owns the end-to-end vendor onboarding process, ensuring that new and existing suppliers are qualified, documented, and approved in line with company policy before work is awarded or purchase orders are issued.

This role is responsible for coordinating vendor prequalification, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), insurance and safety verification, financial and sanctions screening, and vendor master activation. The Specialist maintains the vendor risk register, monitors compliance status through the life of the supplier relationship, and ensures onboarding records are complete, current, and audit-ready.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.


Responsibilities

Vendor Onboarding Coordination
  • Own the intake, coordination, tracking, and closeout of new vendor and vendor change requests from initial request through approval and system activation.
  • Determine the required level of due diligence based on spend, scope, site access, criticality, and commercial or safety risk, and confirm required reviewers and approvers.
  • Issue and collect vendor onboarding packages, including registration forms, banking and tax details, insurance certificates, safety documentation, and compliance attestations.
  • Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders on outstanding items and escalate delayed or blocked onboardings to the Procurement Manager.
  • Coordinate vendor master setup and changes with Finance and Procurement once all approvals and documentation are complete.
  • NDAs & Onboarding Agreements
  • Coordinate the issuance, tracking, negotiation support, and execution of NDAs and other onboarding agreements using approved templates and Legal guidance.
  • Maintain the NDA register, including counterparties, effective and expiry dates, scope, and status, and ensure executed copies are filed and retrievable.
  • Confirm that an executed NDA is in place before confidential information is shared with prospective or existing suppliers.
  • Flag non-standard terms or vendor redlines to Legal and track resolution through signature.
  • Prequalification, Insurance & Safety Compliance
  • Administer the vendor prequalification process, including collection and review of safety programs, incident statistics, certifications, licences, and WorkSafeBC or equivalent clearance letters.
  • Verify certificates of insurance against company requirements (coverage types, limits, additional insured, and expiry dates) and track renewals.
  • Coordinate HSE review and approval of contractors requiring site access, and maintain the approved contractor list.
  • Monitor expiring documents and prequalification status, and notify vendors and internal stakeholders ahead of lapses.
Vendor Risk Assessment & Screening
  • Perform sanctions, adverse media, corporate registry, and financial health screening on new and high-risk vendors and document the results.
  • Coordinate IT / Cybersecurity, privacy, and data-handling assessments for vendors that will access company systems or data.
  • Maintain the vendor risk register, including risk ratings, mitigation actions, owners, and review dates.
  • Support periodic re-assessment of critical, high-spend, and high-risk vendors and recommend changes to approval status.
Registers, Records & Reporting
  • Maintain vendor onboarding, NDA, prequalification, insurance, and risk registers in SharePoint and the ERP / procurement system. Ensure vendor files are complete, consistently named, version controlled, and retained in accordance with internal policy and audit expectations.
  • Provide regular reporting on onboarding pipeline status, cycle times, compliance exceptions, expiring documents, and open risk actions.
  • Support internal and external audits by retrieving vendor due diligence evidence and approval records when required.
Process Improvement & Stakeholder Support
  • Act as the central point of contact for internal requestors and vendors on onboarding requirements, timelines, and status.
  • Develop and refine onboarding forms, checklists, templates, vendor guides, and process documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate onboarding and compliance workflows.
  • Support vendor performance reviews and offboarding of inactive or non-compliant vendors.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience in vendor onboarding, supplier compliance, procurement, contracts administration, risk, or audit support.
  • ·Experience coordinating due diligence, prequalification, or approval workflows involving multiple internal stakeholders and external parties.
  • Working knowledge of NDAs, certificates of insurance, and contractor safety prequalification requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated ability to manage registers, deadlines, renewals, and a high volume of open requests.
  • High attention to detail and comfort reviewing legal, financial, and compliance documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, and standard business systems.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to follow up professionally with vendors and escalate issues when required.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive commercial, legal, and supplier information appropriately.
  • Preferred:
  • Experience in construction, engineering, energy, utilities, mining, data centre, or industrial operating environments.
  • Familiarity with third-party risk management frameworks, sanctions screening tools, or supplier compliance platforms (e.g., ISNetworld, Avetta, ComplyWorks).
  • Understanding of contractor safety management requirements, including WorkSafeBC or equivalent provincial regulations.
  • Working knowledge of ERP or procure-to-pay systems (SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Coupa, or similar).
  • Post-secondary education in business, supply chain, law, or risk management, or progress toward a relevant designation, would be an asset.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success. Our Canada package includes:

  • Voluntary life and critical illness coverage available
  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual health care platform
Financial Well-Being

Time Off & Flexibility

  • Internet: Wired connection, at least 20 Mbps.

Key Performance Indicators

Mail Outs: 40% Weight

  • Definition: Mail-outs measure the number of mail-outs completed by the paralegals.
  • Formula: Number of Mail Outs/Number of Mailout Target
  • Target: Meet or exceed weekly/monthly goals
  • Analysis: This KPI assesses the efficiency and effectiveness of paralegals in processing and completing mailouts.

Error Rate%: 10% Weight

  • Definition: Error Rate% measures the percentage of errors or mistakes made by the paralegals in their work.
  • Formula: (Number of Rejections / Total Number of Mailouts) * 100
  • Target: <10%
  • Analysis: This KPI evaluates the accuracy and quality of work performed by paralegals, aiming to minimize errors and improve overall performance.

QA: 10% Weight

  • Definition: QA (Quality Assurance) measures the number of QA reviews conducted on the work of paralegals and the associated feedback provided.
  • Formula: Number of QA Line items met/Overall Form
  • Target: >88%
  • Analysis: This KPI evaluates the quality of work produced by paralegals through the QA review process.

Task Aging Bucket: 40% Weight

  • Definition: Task Aging Bucket measures the percentage of tasks assigned to paralegals that fall into specific aging categories (e.g., 10-30 days).
  • Formula: (Number of Tasks in Specific Aging Bucket / Total Number of Tasks) * 100
  • Target: >90% 1-30 Days+
  • Analysis: This KPI tracks the aging of paralegal-assigned tasks and ensures timely completion and efficient task management.

Work Environment

  • Full-Time Contractor
  • Remote
  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture with a fast-paced startup dynamic.

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary Rate: DOE per hour; 40 hours per week.
  • Benefits:
    • Paid Time Off
    • Mental Health Days
    • Office Holidays

Application Process

You may apply to our career page:


Physical Demands

This position primarily involves sedentary work, requiring the ability to sit for extended periods while using a computer, phone, and other office equipment. Must handle typing and data entry tasks efficiently.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Alonso & Alonso attorneys at law is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive organization. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, age, or any other protected characteristic.

Non‑Attorney Role Disclosure & Limitations of Duties

This position is not an attorney role. The individual hired for this position is not licensed to practice law and may not provide legal advice or legal representation under any circumstances.


The employee must strictly adhere to the following limitations and escalate matters to a licensed attorney when appropriate.

Non‑Attorney Staff MAY:

  • Provide administrative and clerical support.
  • Communicate factual case status updates as directed by an attorney.
  • Collect documents and information from clients.
  • Assist in drafting forms and documents under attorney supervision.
  • Relay attorney-approved information to clients.
  • Schedule appointments and manage case files.
  • Provide government filing instructions that are procedural in nature (e.g., where to mail documents, required supporting documents as directed by an attorney).

Non‑Attorney Staff MAY NOT:

Under no circumstances may non‑attorney staff:

  • Provide legal advice or legal opinions.
  • Interpret immigration laws, regulations, or policies for clients.
  • Advise a client on which immigration benefit, strategy, or form to pursue.
  • Advise whether a client qualifies for any immigration benefit.
  • Assess eligibility, admissibility, or risk.
  • Recommend legal strategies or outcomes.
  • Advise on consequences of criminal history, prior immigration violations, or prior denials.
  • Sign legal filings on behalf of the firm unless specifically authorized for ministerial purposes.
  • Represent clients before USCIS, EOIR, DHS, DOL, or any court.
  • Communicate legal analysis to clients.
  • Negotiate with government agencies on legal matters.
  • Answer legal questions, even if the staff member believes they know the answer.
  • Translate or explain legal advice independently of an attorney.

Mandatory Escalation to Attorney

The employee must immediately escalate the matter to a licensed attorney if:

  • A client asks any legal question.
  • A client asks whether they “qualify” or “should apply.”
  • A client asks about risks, timelines with legal implications, or likelihood of success.
  • A case involves criminal history, prior removal, unlawful presence, fraud/misrepresentation, prior denials, or complex facts.
  • A client requests interpretation of a Request for Evidence (RFE), Notice of Intent to Deny (NOID), or other government notice.
  • A client expresses confusion about legal advice previously given.
  • Any situation arises where the staff member is unsure whether the response would constitute legal advice.

When in doubt, escalate to an attorney.


Compliance Statement

  • Unauthorized practice of law (UPL) is strictly prohibited. Violation of these limitations may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.
  • All non‑attorney staff are required to acknowledge in writing that they understand and agree to comply with these restrictions as a condition of employment.

Disclaimer

By applying to this position, you agree that our company utilizes a live monitoring system for work activities. This system is in place to ensure productivity, security, and compliance with company policies. Your application indicates your consent to be monitored during your working hours.

About the Role

The Coding Specialist is responsible for independently reviewing, analyzing, and resolving all assigned front-end scrubs and denied claims to ensure accurate and timely claim payment. This position focuses on identifying and correcting coding-related issues prior to claim submission, resubmitting corrected claims or appealing denied claims, applying established coding guidelines, payer requirements, and organizational policies. The Coding Specialist works closely with revenue cycle partners to prevent claim rejections, support clean claim rates, and promote efficient reimbursement processes. This role requires strong attention to detail, foundational coding knowledge, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

A Day in the Life

  • Averages 10 front-end holds/denials per hour
  • Reviews coding and resubmits corrected claims to insurance
  • Creates appeal letters/forms with medical documentation
  • Maintains a minimum of 92% coding accuracy.
  • Assigns ICD-10-CM and CPT codes with appropriate modifiers for services provided in the professional fee environment.
  • Reviews medical records and all applicable documentation to determine appropriate codes for documented services and diagnoses.
  • Ensures all diagnosis codes meet local and national medical necessity guidelines.
  • Utilizes internal coding resources, payer guidelines, and other reference materials to ensure accurate and compliant coding for all assigned services.
  • Follows all HIPAA regulations and upholds the highest standards of privacy and confidentiality.
  • Maintains current knowledge of laws, regulations, payer policies, and industry guidance impacting compliant coding practices.
  • Independently reviews and resolves all assigned front-end claim holds.
  • Actively participates in department meetings, one-on-one meetings, and mentorship meetings with the assigned Coding Team Lead.
  • Escalates identified client trends to the assigned Coding Manager.
  • Escalates all coding-related questions to the assigned Coding manager for guidance and clarification.
  • Maintains and completes all CEU requirements.
  • Performs other duties or tasks as assigned

What You Need

  • Must hold a current AAPC or AHIMA Coding Certification for a minimum of 3 years.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of professional coding experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, and state and federal Medicare reimbursement guidelines.
  • Prior experience in reviewing front end coding errors before submitting to insurance
  • Prior experience in reviewing and correcting coding from insurance denials.
  • Prior experience in submitting corrected claims and appeals.
  • Prior experience with insurance guidelines and EOBs.
  • Familiarity with proper English grammar, usage, and professional documentation standards.
  • Ability to research and analyze data, draw logical conclusions, and resolve coding or documentation issues.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply policies, procedures, laws, and regulations.
  • Ability to accurately read and interpret medical documentation, clinical terminology, and documented procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in coding and claim resolution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports, clarify documentation needs, and maintain collaborative working relationships with physicians and staff.
  • Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding protected health information.
  • Prior experience working in a medical billing environment with strict adherence to HIPAA compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

Here’s What We Offer

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.

jobs.title: SEO & GEO Manager
jobs.excerpt: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities—our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.
jobs.description:
Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities—our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by responsible, human-centered AI. Our purpose is to unlock potential across these communities, envisioning a world where doing the right thing is intuitive and informed.
At Seer, we see AI as a catalyst for innovation, collaboration, and creativity. Regardless of your division or discipline, leveraging AI is a core part of how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes for our clients. Our AI Council drives company-wide integration by focusing on education, purposeful implementation, and continuous learning — ensuring that AI is embedded in how we think, operate, and grow.
If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday—keep reading.
Seer is a remote-first agency and a Certified B-Corp, with team members across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office in Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who can work continental US-based hours.
The Role:

You, the Senior SEO & GEO Account Manager of our dreams, are a strategic consultant and will spend your days creating digital marketing strategies that tie into clients' overall marketing plans and business goals. At Seer, AI is embedded in how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes and search is evolving beyond traditional rankings into AI Overviews, generative results, and LLM-powered discovery experiences.

In this role, you are the day-to-day strategic lead on your accounts, deep in the data, driving the project plan, and running the client relationship at the operational level. A Channel Lead may sit above your accounts to handle executive stakeholder relationships and portfolio-level decisions, but you are the engine. Your instinct for what to do next and your ability to communicate it clearly to clients and associates is what makes accounts move

You will be passionately engaged with this evolving search landscape and understand how to position brands for visibility across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-driven interfaces. You don't just optimize for rankings, you think about discoverability, content visibility within AI-generated results, and how search behavior is shifting.

You're intellectually curious, systems-minded, and not afraid to test emerging tools, design AI-driven workflows, or challenge conventional SEO thinking.

Role Highlights

  • You have experience managing a portfolio of 4–6 active client accounts simultaneously, keeping deliverables on track across multiple industries and stakeholder contexts without losing the thread on any of them.
  • You will lead organic strategy for a portfolio of clients, building annual and quarterly roadmaps that account for both traditional SEO performance and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) visibility across AI-driven search environments.
  • You will serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for clients, running weekly status calls, managing the project plan, fielding questions, and keeping strategy on track. While a Channel Lead may own the executive relationship on larger accounts, you are the operational lead your client relies on
  • On any given week, you might respond to a dozen client-related messages, prep a QBR, onboard a new stakeholder, and triage an unexpected client ask, all while keeping deliverables on track. You are comfortable context-switching quickly and know when a fast response is more valuable than a perfect one.
  • Conduct in-depth content gap analyses, competitive research, keyword strategy, and SERP landscape analysis including evaluating how client content surfaces within traditional Search, AI-generated results and other generative search experiences.
  • Translate performance data from GA4, Adobe, and Search Console into clear, actionable insights, connecting ranking shifts, traffic trends, SERP feature changes, and generative visibility signals back to client goals.
  • Strengthen technical foundations such as site architecture, internal linking, and structured data to improve crawlability, entity clarity, and overall discoverability across both traditional search engines and generative platforms.
  • Work closely with 1-2 associates per account, directing their work, reviewing deliverables, and developing their skills. This is not formal people management — their team lead owns that — but you are the day-to-day mentor and quality check. Strong account managers can explain not just what to fix but why.
  • Leverage tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and automation platforms (Zapier, APIs) to accelerate research, synthesize insights, and support scalable SEO and GEO workflows.
  • Test, refine, and document AI-driven workflows and GEO experiments that enhance strategic thinking, surface new opportunities, and shape Seer's evolving approach to modern organic visibility.

Essential Skills

  • You have proven experience building and driving SEO strategy across multiple industries, with the ability to evolve strategy as search shifts toward AI-generated summaries and generative search interfaces.
  • Enterprise-level clients are your comfort zone, you've navigated complex stakeholder structures, long deal cycles, and high expectations before, and you know how to deliver at that level.
  • You have a strong technical SEO foundation, including site architecture, structured data, indexing diagnostics, and performance analysis with an understanding of how these elements influence both traditional rankings and generative visibility.
  • You are able to tie SEO and GEO performance to business outcomes and confidently communicate strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • You are comfortable working in Wrike as your daily operating system, managing blueprints, tracking deliverable burn, setting task dependencies, and keeping accounts moving within the interface. On accounts without a dedicated PM (roughly a quarter of your book), you own the project management layer.
  • You are comfortable working with AI and LLM tools beyond surface-level usage, using them to analyze data, pressure-test ideas, support research, and improve workflows.
  • You have strong analytical fluency across platforms such as GA4, Adobe, Search Console, and leading SEO tools, with curiosity around emerging GEO measurement indicators such as AI Overview presence, generative citations, and SERP volatility.
  • You are a critical thinker who evaluates AI-generated insights and GEO opportunities through real business context rather than relying solely on automation.

90 Day Goals

  • By Day 30, you will have completed division training and begun to support at least 1 client
  • By Day 60,you will have onboarded to at least 3 client accounts and are taking over strategy for them
  • By Day 90, you will have ownership of your accounts and be delivering independently

This might not be the right role for you if

jobs.excerpt: Job Requisition ID # 26WD101768Position OverviewAutodesk is building industry foundation models for the future of design and make.
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101768

Position Overview

Autodesk is building industry foundation models for the future of design and make. This role helps define how we measure progress, understand our capability relative to the market, and connect that work to business priorities.


You will set priorities for Autodesk's AI benchmarking program, which measures how our capabilities perform on the work that matters most in real world design and manufacturing, against frontier models, competitor technology, and industry baselines. You will interpret those results and turn them into guidance for research, product, and investment decisions. You will work with AI benchmarking engineers, researchers, and business leadership, with visibility up to C-suite.


Benchmarking is a key input to business decision making at Autodesk. Demand for this work is high and growing, internally and externally. Your job is to make sure the investment in benchmarking gives leaders a clear view of capability, competitive position, and where to focus next.


The person who succeeds here needs to be comfortable working across technical, customer, and business questions. You do not need to build or run the evaluations yourself. You do need enough technical fluency to challenge what is being measured, enough direct work with industry product managers to know where customer value is actually being delivered and whether a measured improvement is one customers recognize, and the judgment to turn both into a clear point of view for leaders making investment decisions.


This is an individual contributor role with a path to people management.


Responsibilities

Capability

  • Own and keep current how we prioritize what gets benchmarked, weighing workflow value, strategic importance, and competitive relevance
  • Map benchmark priorities to Industry Cloud problem areas and judge what level of evidence each question requires
  • Define the comparison set evaluated against those priorities, covering Autodesk and external alternatives
  • Collaborate on evolution of relevant human metrics and comparisons
  • Turn benchmark results into clear read-outs on Autodesk capability relative to frontier models, competitor technology, and industry baselines, including for the C-suite
  • Evolve the channels and cadence through which we report capability and competitive position
  • Keep capability questions moving to answers on a timeline that matches the decisions they support, including work that depends on teams you do not manage
  • Partner closely with the technical benchmarking team, which owns task curation and evaluation, to shape what gets measured next

Value

  • Own the translation from capability to business value
  • Evolve how we measure ROI for our models
  • Take a capability improvement and connect it to the workflow it changes, the customers it affects, and the revenue or cost implications
  • Own the customer and industry validation standard we use to evaluate new business bets
  • Work with industry product teams to ground what we measure in the workflows their customers run, and to confirm that a measured improvement is one customers recognize and value
  • Reconcile benchmark evidence with customer evidence when the two disagree, and determine which should carry the decision

Competitive

  • Turn comparative results into a clear view of how Autodesk capabilities are evolving relative to the market, and set the priorities competitive research works against
  • Translate meaningful differences in capability into research questions and investment recommendations with AI Research and AI Economics, informing scenario planning and build versus partner decisions

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years across strategy consulting, corporate or business strategy, technical product management, AI strategy, applied research, competitive intelligence, or related roles
  • Evaluation fluency. You can interrogate an evaluation result, challenge the metric, and determine whether a benchmark supports the conclusion being drawn from it
  • Business translation. You can take a change in capability and work through what it means for a workflow, a customer, a competitor, and ultimately a business decision
  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable taking an ambiguous question, breaking it into the right components, working with incomplete evidence, and developing a defensible point of view
  • Movement between technical and business contexts. You can work credibly with researchers and engineers, then translate the relevant implications for executives without losing the substance
  • Momentum. You bring a working rhythm that others can plan around, and you help shorten the distance between a question being raised and an answer being available
  • Track record of influencing research, product, or investment priorities without direct authority
  • Strong analytical judgment and clear, concise executive communication
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in strategy consulting, product strategy, or another role requiring structured analysis of complex technical or market questions
  • Experience using technical evidence, including benchmarks or evaluations, to inform product, research, or investment decisions
  • Experience with competitive intelligence, scenario planning, or technology landscape analysis
  • Familiarity with AI model evaluation or benchmarking. Direct hands-on experience is highly valuable but not required
  • Experience with unit economics, adoption modeling, or ROI analysis
  • Familiarity with Autodesk industries
  • Experience leading or mentoring analysts

Learn More / Plus d'information


About Autodesk / À propos d’Autodesk


Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!


Bienvenue chez Autodesk ! Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l’être.


Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde.


En tant qu’Autodeskien, vous pouvez accomplir un travail significatif qui contribue à bâtir un monde meilleur, conçu et réalisé pour tous. Prêt à façonner le monde et votre avenir ? Rejoignez-nous !

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Senior PACS Implementation Engineer leads the build, integration, migration, and technical onboarding of customer environments onto the InSight PACS platform, acting as the technical expert for healthcare system commissioning and interoperability across NHS trusts, private healthcare providers, and third-party suppliers.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Senior PACS Implementation Engineer leads the build, integration, migration, and technical onboarding of customer environments onto the InSight PACS platform, acting as the technical expert for healthcare system commissioning and interoperability across NHS trusts, private healthcare providers, and third-party suppliers. The role is primarily hands-on and technical, with the successful candidate also coordinating the implementation team's day-to-day technical delivery and providing mentoring to less experienced engineers. Team leadership is a meaningful part of the role but remains secondary to its core focus on technical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end technical delivery of PACS build, integration, and migration projects, acting as the subject matter expert for DICOM, HL7, and healthcare interoperability standards across customer and partner environments.
  • Design and troubleshoot integrations between PACS, RIS, EPR, VNA, and third-party clinical systems, translating customer workflows into effective, operationally sound technical solutions.
  • Plan and execute imaging data migrations, including querying and troubleshooting the underlying databases, to ensure data quality and minimal disruption to clinical services.
  • Lead day-to-day coordination of the implementation team's workload across build, integration, and migration activities, providing direct technical leadership, mentoring, and escalation support to engineers.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Client Experience teams to improve integration capabilities, maintain technical documentation, and support pre-sales and tender activities.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience implementing, integrating, or migrating PACS, RIS, VNA, or other healthcare imaging solutions.
  • Strong working knowledge of DICOM services (C-Store, C-Find, C-Move, Modality Worklist) and practical experience with HL7 messaging in healthcare integration contexts.
  • Strong SQL and database skills, including the ability to query, interrogate, and troubleshoot databases underpinning PACS and integration platforms.
  • Direct experience with PACS build, configuration, and system commissioning within a regulated healthcare environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring engineers within a technical delivery team.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience working with NHS organisations, including familiarity with NHS procurement processes and digital/information governance requirements.
  • Knowledge of cloud-hosted healthcare applications and services.
  • Experience with imaging archive consolidation or VNA migration programmes.
  • Exposure to contributing to architectural standards or reference architectures (on-premises, hybrid, or cloud-based).
  • Relevant project delivery, implementation, or healthcare IT certifications.

Travel Requirements - minimal, occasional visits to Basingstoke office for training & collaboration days

Zero Carbon Systems (ZCS) is a clean energy and direct air capture company on a mission to accelerate the transition to a zero carbon future. Position Overview

Zero Carbon Systems seeks a Process Modeling Engineer to bridge theoretical modeling, process design, and plant operations, leveraging our internal process and equipment models to develop a highly rigorous techno-economic analysis (TEA) that our leadership team will use to finalize operating points for the ZCS demo and production facilities. Using existing heat and mass balances and capital estimates, this engineer will optimize the process across scenarios such as weather, location, and plant configuration, improve process design through research and design review, and sharpen capital estimates through direct vendor feedback and informed equipment selection. The ideal candidate will have strong TEA experience for highly integrated industrial processes, hands-on process engineering experience in an industrial setting, and the ability to communicate complex numerical results clearly to leadership, investors, and external reviewers. This full-time position can be based in Brighton, Colorado or performed remotely, and reports to the Process Modeling Lead.

Responsibilities Include:

    • Use and develop internal process modeling tools to guide the selection of operating points for the ZCS demo and production facilities based on operating cost, capital cost, and energy efficiency
    • Continuously update and refine ZCS process models based on design improvements, operational data, and material advances, including running and optimizing our Aspen Custom Modeler (ACM) model
    • Translate Aspen process models into an Excel output that generates the system equipment list, equipment sizing (max/min/nominal), stream list, pipe sizing, power demand, and stream tables, and automate it using VBA or similar tools to rapidly populate vendor-ready equipment specification sheets and run self-consistency checks
    • Work with appropriate personnel to translate model outputs into Aspen Capital Cost Estimator (ACCE) and related cost estimation tools, and diligently compare internal capital estimates against those generated by external design firms
    • Use ACCE estimates and vendor quotes to specify equipment and area basis costs, sizing basis, and scaling exponents for the larger system TEA model, and develop shortcut models to support quick process review and analysis
    • Partner with internal drafters and designers to keep Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) aligned with the latest process model, and communicate model, process, and equipment updates to our external engineering design firm
    • Ensure all design and equipment updates are integrated into the demo facility design and build, and provide insight from experience and vendor interactions on equipment selection and relative pricing to drive down capital cost and increase process efficiency
    • Identify opportunities to reduce system energy, CapEx, and OpEx through fundamental process design optimization and rigorous TEA, working with domain leads in materials, site operations, and mechanical engineering to scope projects that test those opportunities and translate findings back into the model
    • Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and project management to integrate process models and cost data into larger project workflows, identify critical impact variables and data quality gaps, and support Life Cycle Analysis and environmental impact assessments
    • Present model findings, cost estimates, and process updates to senior leadership, investors, and other stakeholders

Requirements Include:

    • Degree in chemical engineering or a related field; graduate degree preferred
    • 7+ years of experience post undergraduate degree (BS + 7 years, MS + 5 years, or PhD + 2 years)
    • Prior TEA experience for highly integrated industrial processes
    • Prior hands-on process engineering experience in an industrial setting or chemical manufacturing plant
    • Knowledge of methods for representing and modeling heat and mass transfer in porous materials
    • Proficiency with Excel, VBA, Python, JMP, or similar tools to maximize the functional utility of model outputs
    • Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills, with excellent communication, reporting, and presentation skills
    • Preferred: process operations and/or design exposure, with demonstrated experience reading and generating PFDs, P&IDs, equipment lists, and instrument lists
    • Preferred: experience with detailed design and equipment selection or procurement
    • Preferred: experience working with cross-functional teams, scoping new R&D or engineering projects, and working at a startup moving from R&D to testing and scale-up
    • Preferred: experience communicating complex numerical results to a non-technical audience

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for an Associate Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team.

The job in two bullet points:
  • Own a portfolio of existing customers and take direct accountability for minimizing churn within that book, alongside driving renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Ensure coverage completeness by confirming every customer site and location, including newly added ones, is properly covered by their license.

You will love this job if...

  • You have 1-2 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn.
  • You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way.
  • You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results in this role.

Senior Technical Product Manager, AI & Data Solutions

  • Location: Remote, U.S.
  • Type: Full-Time

Let’s talk about you!

You’re a hands-on product manager who can take a customer’s messy data problem and turn it into a useful solution quickly.

You’re comfortable working directly with customers, including executive stakeholders, and moving from conversation to working software in short cycles.

You like building as much as planning. You can query data, work with APIs, configure workflows, create prototypes, and test your own work. You also know when a solution needs deeper architecture, security review, or production support from Engineering.

If this is resonating, keep reading. You may have just found the right opportunity.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager, AI & Data Solutions to help turn complex customer needs into practical, working solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, data, AI, and product development. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their business problem, identify the right data and approach, and quickly build or prototype a solution that proves value. When that work has the potential to become a scalable product capability, you’ll translate what you’ve learned into clear requirements for Engineering and the broader Product team.

What you’ll do

  • Meet directly with customers to understand the business problem, identify the data required, and define a practical first release.
  • Build and refine prototypes, reports, workflows, and lightweight integrations using SQL, APIs, low-code tools, and AI-assisted development.
  • Own the details that make a solution usable, including data mapping, output quality, edge cases, acceptance testing, and customer feedback.
  • Test and validate your own work before it reaches the customer.
  • Translate successful customer-specific solutions into clear requirements for reusable product capabilities.
  • Present solutions, recommendations, and tradeoffs directly to customer leaders.
  • Clearly communicate what works today, what requires additional development, and what can realistically be delivered next.
  • Partner with Engineering when solutions require deeper architecture, security review, production support, or long-term scalability.
  • Keep projects moving even when requirements are incomplete, identifying technical risks early and bringing a proposed path forward.

What you’ve accomplished

  • Experience managing, building, or delivering B2B SaaS products involving complex customer data.
  • Strong SQL skills and practical experience working with APIs, data integrations, and data quality.
  • Regular hands-on use of AI coding or development tools to build, prototype, and test working solutions.
  • Enough technical depth to investigate issues independently and collaborate effectively with software engineers.
  • Experience turning loosely defined customer needs into practical solutions and clear product requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and executive customers.
  • A track record of shipping useful work quickly, even when the initial request or requirements were incomplete.
  • Strong judgment around when to prototype quickly and when a solution requires more durable engineering, security, or architecture.

What success looks like

  • Customers see useful, working solutions in weeks, not months.
  • Data quality, edge cases, and usability issues are identified before launch.
  • Customer feedback is incorporated quickly and thoughtfully.
  • Successful prototypes translate into clear, well-tested product requirements.
  • Engineering receives strong context and clean handoffs when custom work needs to become a scalable product capability.
  • Customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of what can be delivered, when, and why.

jobs.description:
Analyst, Data

OPPORTUNITY

Nationally recognized nonprofit venture philanthropy seeks to hire an analyst to provide strategic and operational capacity across teams to lead grantmaking.

ORGANIZATION

NewSchools is a venture philanthropy that builds a better education system by connecting people, resources, and ideas. We bridge the gap between those with capital and those with the courage to put that capital to work on the frontlines of K-12 education. We envision an education system that keeps its promise to all students. That’s why we invest in the ideas and energy of education leaders and entrepreneurs who are advancing innovative solutions that expand the definition of what works. There’s a better way to advance education through philanthropy—one that is more equitable, more collaborative, and more courageous–and we’re proving it every day.

RESPONSIBILITIES

We seek to hire a Data Analyst to own data stewardship, quality and analytics within the Operations function and assigned to a designated investment team. Reporting to Jessica Henry, Senior Director of Operations, with a dotted line to your assigned investment team (a program team responsible for identifying, funding and supporting education ventures). You will own execution within the data framework and standards designed centrally, while serving as the analytics partner your investment team turns to for reliable data and strategic insight. NewSchools is a fully remote organization, and you may live anywhere in the United States. This role requires up to 10% travel for in-person team meetings, retreats, and conferences.

In this role, you will:

Own the data and metrics that demonstrate impact for a designated investment team (30%)

  • In partnership with the Data Manager, investment team leads, and the Research & Learning team, translate learning agendas into documented metric definitions, data structures, and processes and translate these into clear stakeholder communications
  • In partnership with the Data Manager, develop and maintain processes that ensure the investment team collects cohesive quantitative and qualitative data specific to key metrics of success — logic model, learning agenda, and funder-facing impact
  • Partner with the Research & Learning team to elevate metrics that support the broader research strategy
  • Identify where business questions can't be answered with existing data or tools; develop well-reasoned recommendations for warehouse additions, public data infrastructure, self-service tool improvements, and research agenda priorities
  • Maintain active working knowledge of NewSchools' full data stack — warehouse, BI tools, and public data infrastructure — to credibly advise the investment team(s) and inform infrastructure decisions

Ensure the data feeding into our systems is accurate, complete, and trustworthy from the point of intake (30%)

  • Project manage annual data collection cycles; partner with the Data Manager and investment team leads on clean rostering, survey development, and administration
  • Manage all data intake for the designated investment team(s) — applications, diligence, grantee surveys, internally generated data — including validation processes that catch errors at the source
  • Partner with the data engineer and fellow analysts to validate and clean incoming data and execute automated quality control checkpoints
  • Review and update databases within the designated investment team's scope, ensuring accuracy and integrity across all data sources
  • Apply and reinforce best practices for capturing data updates regularly and accurately within the investment team
  • Spot and report data anomalies from the stakeholder lens — quality issues automated back-end processing may miss — investigate root cause, report to relevant teammates, and manage stakeholder communications when a resolution isn't immediately possible

Turn data into the insights and recommendations that shape investment decisions (30%)

  • Own the analytics relationship for your designated investment team(s), developing deep knowledge of its goals, workflows, and data needs to serve as a trusted, actively sought-out resource
  • Lead ad hoc analyses to support data-driven decision-making and synthesize findings into written investment recommendations
  • Own and respond to data reporting and analysis requests supporting grant and funder reporting
  • Manage and execute ad hoc analysis and rapid prototyping using SQL, BI tools, and AI-assisted analytics to answer business questions
  • Collaborate with Research & Learning and investment teams on custom queries and datasets supporting the learning agenda, team strategy, Board requests, and funder reporting and prospecting
  • Develop planning tools, analysis frameworks, and visualizations that drive insight generation and identify portfolio bright spots, accounting for historical, contextual, and comparative data and perspectives

Help colleagues across NewSchools find, trust, and use data themselves (10%)

  • Serve as the go-to resource for data questions across the organization, helping non-technical colleagues navigate systems and dashboards
  • Support implementation and adoption of self-service analytics tools across the assigned investment team(s), including onboarding, coaching, and ongoing support
  • Support ad hoc data needs across the organization

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in roles working with complex data sets and owning end-to-end data processes (collection, auditing, analysis, meaning-making)
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with cloud data warehouse platforms (BigQuery preferred)
  • Experience with BI/analytics tools (Omni Analytics preferred) and building self-service artifacts and reporting for non-technical users
  • Experience with data validation, quality control processes, and data cleaning
  • Project management experience, particularly running recurring data collection cycles that involve coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Comfort using AI-assisted analytics tools for ad hoc analysis and rapid prototyping
  • Knowledge of the K-12 education sector with experience working with teacher, leader, and edtech data -or- Knowledge of the K-12 education sector with experience working with charter and district school and student data strongly preferred
  • Travel up to 10% for in-person team meetings, retreats and conferences

EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

  • Building and maintaining knowledge management structures that make portfolio data and findings reusable across teams
  • Supporting progress monitoring and research partnerships, including what gets collected and how data quality is protected
  • Translating analysis into clear insights and recommendations for various stakeholders and audiences
  • Implementing continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency
  • Planning, prioritizing and managing multiple workstreams

YOUR WAYS OF WORKING

  • Ground decisions, priorities, and actions in NewSchools’ mission and commitment to equity
  • Communicate clearly and proactively, share information before being asked, and raise questions and concerns directly
  • Adapt how you communicate to the audience, make a clear case for your recommendations, and give and receive feedback directly
  • Collaborate across teams, build relationships, and share ideas and insights
  • Set clear priorities, manage competing demands, and keep systems that make prioritization possible
  • Proactively name when an approach isn’t working and propose what to do instead, including reworking or stopping your own workstreams
  • Operate comfortably with imperfect or incomplete data, using sound judgment to deliver useful analysis despite gaps or inconsistencies
  • Apply sound judgment about when to make independent decisions and when to involve someone else
  • Maintain an active view of the field and market through regular scanning of research, data and public sources, and use it to surface patterns and gaps the team should examine

COMPENSATION

A competitive compensation package including base salary, performance bonus, and employer-funded benefits is available. The starting salary range is $83,000 to $104,000 with the potential for an annual bonus of up to 5%. Final salary will be determined based on experience level and qualifications.

Applications submitted by November 6th will receive priority review. We encourage interested candidates to apply early, as the position may close once we’ve received a strong pool of applicants.

NewSchools Venture Fund has a strong commitment to diversity. Candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Please note, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

jobs.description:
Buscamos a pessoa que será referência técnica em engenharia de software AI-native na Bemobi: quem define como os times especificam, delegam a agentes de IA e verificam o que é entregue, sem abrir mão dos fundamentos de arquitetura, qualidade e segurança.

Essa posição responde pelos padrões de desenvolvimento assistido por agentes — specs, contexto, guardrails, verificação e harness compartilhado — e pela confiabilidade do que vai para produção. Atua em desenvolvimento e operação, e mede sucesso por resultado para o negócio e para o usuário, não por volume de código gerado.

#BeABemober 💙🚀

  • Especificação e contexto: definir o padrão de specs verificáveis — pré e pós-condições, invariantes, Given/When/Then — e manter o contexto que os agentes usam (, , skills e restrições).
  • Decomposição e orquestração: quebrar problemas complexos em unidades que um agente executa e um humano consegue verificar, coordenando vários agentes, worktrees isoladas e passagens de bastão.
  • Política de delegação: definir com os times o que se delega à IA (o que é fácil de verificar, de baixo risco ou repetitivo) e o que fica com as pessoas (design, decisões de produto e contexto organizacional).
  • Verificação: estabelecer a estratégia de testes, evals, mutation testing e benchmarks, e levar a revisão de código para o foco em intenção e risco, que escala com o volume gerado por agentes.
  • Guardrails determinísticos: garantir CI rigoroso, proteção de branch, CODEOWNERS, lotes pequenos e rollback fácil como base de confiança no sistema.
  • Segurança desde o início: desenhar agentes com identidade própria, menor privilégio, sandbox e defesa em profundidade, em conjunto com Segurança da Informação.
  • Harness como produto: evoluir o setup compartilhado de engenharia — instruções, ferramentas, hooks e skills — incorporando o que se aprende com cada falha.
  • Operação e confiabilidade: definir níveis de autonomia dos agentes em produção (L0 a L3), com autorização progressiva, dry-run e mecanismo de parada imediata; tratar cada agente como serviço, com SLOs, observabilidade e plano de contingência.
  • IA na operação: aplicar IA onde ela agrega — playbooks, detecção de anomalia, RCA, rascunho de postmortem e handoff de incidente — sem substituir automação clássica que já resolve.
  • Formação do time: mentorar ativamente, em especial juniores e plenos, e manter trilhas de fundamentos com prática deliberada sem IA, combatendo a atrofia de habilidades.
  • Comunicação com o negócio: traduzir limites, riscos e ganhos da IA para liderança e áreas de negócio, sustentando decisões técnicas com dados.

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software, com atuação como referência técnica (Staff, Principal ou Tech Lead) em sistemas de produção de alta escala.
  • Fundamentos fortes: arquitetura, estruturas de dados, invariantes e fronteiras de segurança — a base para identificar código gerado "quase certo".
  • Uso intensivo e comprovado de agentes de IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento, com domínio de context engineering e spec-driven development.
  • Prática em TDD, testes automatizados e evals, e capacidade de desenhar estratégias de verificação para código gerado por IA.
  • Vivência com CI/CD, controle de versão, proteção de branch e entrega em lotes pequenos.
  • Vivência em operação de sistemas: observabilidade, SLOs, resposta a incidentes e postmortems.
  • Segurança aplicada: menor privilégio, isolamento e gestão de identidades e segredos.
  • Julgamento e desconfiança calibrada: saber quando parar e conferir, sem rejeitar a IA nem confiar cegamente nela.
  • Pensamento sistêmico e de risco, com foco em resultado para o negócio e para o usuário.
  • Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, liderança e negócio, e disposição real para mentorar.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com orquestração de múltiplos agentes e com harness compartilhado entre times.
  • Vivência em SRE ou platform engineering, incluindo governança de agentes em produção e avaliações contínuas (inclusive LLM-as-a-Judge).
  • Experiência com mutation testing, benchmarks de performance ou testes de resiliência.
  • Projetos publicados construídos com agentes, com atenção a segurança e resistência a ataques.
  • Experiência em pagamentos, fintech, telecom ou outros ambientes de alto volume transacional.
  • Histórico de formação de engenheiros e de criação de trilhas técnicas.

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.

In this role, you will lead day-to-day operations, harmonize international plans, manage key broker relationships, and serve as an empathetic contact for our global workforce.

Key Responsibilities

1. International Benefits Administration & Operations

  • Administer end-to-end healthcare, life/disability insurance, retirement schemes (pensions), leave, and voluntary benefits across EMEA and APAC.

  • Continuously evaluate workflows to streamline global benefit administration, drive consistency, and leverage HR automation.

  • Partner closely with Payroll on benefit deductions, benefit reporting, and invoice reconciliation.

  • Partner with global and local benefit brokers, insurers, and platform providers to deliver high-touch service and strong SLA performance.

  • Manage the full lifecycle of international renewals, plan enhancements, and vendor implementations.

  • Benchmark local market practices alongside our broker partners to ensure packages remain competitive, cost-effective, and culturally resonant.

  • Serve as the trusted, frontline contact for employee benefit inquiries, delivering timely, clear, and empathetic support.

  • Manage multi-country leave administration (parental, medical, statutory, and discretionary leave programs) and workplace accommodation requests.

  • Create vibrant, self-service communications and educational resources that empower employees to maximize their benefits.

  • Contribute to global mental health and holistic wellbeing strategies across regions.

4. Compliance, Governance & Data Management

  • Monitor regional statutory updates, mandatory benefit regulations, local pension rules (including auto-Enrolment), and leave requirements across EMEA and APAC.

  • Maintain data privacy standards (GDPR and regional laws) across all vendor tools and benefit platforms.

  • Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Legal, Payroll, Finance, and Procurement to uphold strong governance and support local consultation needs.

Global Benefits & Compliance Expertise

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in international employee benefits, global leave administration, and retirement/pension scheme management, with deep regional expertise across EMEA and APAC markets.

  • Strong end-to-end knowledge of global renewal cycles, international broker management, vendor implementation, and expanding benefit programs into new country markets.

  • Deep familiarity with statutory vs. supplementary coverages, regional pension frameworks (including auto-enrolment/governance), and local workplace accommodation practices.

HR Tech, Data & AI Innovation

  • Tech-savvy operator with hands-on experience using HRIS platforms and global benefit enrollment portals.

  • Forward-thinking approach to technology, with demonstrated comfort leveraging HR tech, automation tools, and AI to streamline operational workflows, enhance reporting, and elevate employee support.

jobs.excerpt: THE COMPANYPAX is a leading global cannabis brand on a mission to enhance people’s lives, delivering well-being through pure products, unique experiences, and an unparalleled passion for the plant.
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

PAX is a leading global cannabis brand on a mission to enhance people’s lives, delivering well-being through pure products, unique experiences, and an unparalleled passion for the plant. For more than a decade, PAX has provided products that are simple, enjoyable, and trusted by millions. PAX has been recognized for its brand, culture and products by The New York Times’ Wirecutter, TIME, Fast Company, GQ, Gear Patrol, mg Magazine, High Times, and many more. PAX is committed to making a positive impact through PEACE BY PAX, its purpose-driven platform supporting social reform, safe access and sustainability.

We are incredibly excited about the progress of the movement, the tremendous growth of the industry, and inspired every day by our opportunity to help change lives through cannabis. Our culture is focused on putting people at the center of everything we do, making an impact together, and having fun along the way. Our team has an unparalleled passion for the plant and has helped build business at the forefront of consumer experience and well-being, including Apple, Google, Uber, Fitbit, Constellation, Honest Company, Beauty Counter, Eaze, Curaleaf, Wyld and more. PAX has raised over $430MM in capital from leading consumer and technology investors and is available for sale in some capacity in more than 40 countries around the world.

Location: Remote – U.S., with ~30% national and occasional international travel
Department: Marketing
Status: Full-time, Exempt
Reports to: VP, Marketing

SUMMARY

PAX is seeking a Director of Retail Marketing to transform how our brand shows up and performs at retail across U.S. cannabis dispensaries and global wholesale channels. This leader will define our retail marketing strategy, build a distinctive and scalable visual merchandising experience, and develop shopper marketing programs that drive awareness, conversion, and repeat purchase. Equal parts creative and commercial, the ideal candidate brings deep expertise in physical retail, a strong understanding of shopper behavior, and a proven ability to translate brand strategy into measurable sales growth. They'll lead a team and collaborate closely with Sales, Creative, Product Marketing, and external partners to bring a more cohesive, effective PAX retail experience to life.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Retail Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and lead PAX's retail marketing strategy across U.S. dispensaries and global wholesale channels, aligning brand priorities, product launches, distribution growth, and revenue objectives.
  • Establish channel and retailer segmentation strategies, defining differentiated levels of merchandising, marketing investment, and activation based on commercial opportunity and performance.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to develop programs that accelerate sell-through, improve productivity per door, strengthen retail relationships, and drive profitable growth.
  • Own retail marketing planning, budgets, resource allocation, and performance measurement, ensuring investments deliver measurable commercial returns.

Visual Merchandising & Retail Experience

  • Lead PAX's visual merchandising strategy, creating a distinctive, premium, and consistent brand experience across dispensaries, smoke shops, and specialty retail environments.
  • Develop scalable merchandising systems, including fixtures, displays, product glorifiers, signage, POS materials, and planograms tailored to different channels, store formats, and retailer tiers.
  • Partner with Creative, Product Marketing, and external agencies to translate brand strategy and product innovation into compelling physical retail experiences that drive shopper engagement and conversion.
  • Oversee merchandising development, production, deployment, and optimization, balancing creative excellence with cost efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact.

Shopper Marketing & Retail Activation

  • Develop and oversee national retail promotional strategies spanning seasonal campaigns, product launches, evergreen offers, and strategic account programs.
  • Establish promotional frameworks and guardrails in partnership with Sales and Finance, balancing incremental sales growth, profitability, and brand positioning.
  • Lead retail education and advocacy strategies, including product training, sales enablement, budtender engagement, and retailer-facing content that strengthens product knowledge and recommendation.
  • Direct field marketing, brand ambassador, and retail activation programs, ensuring consistent execution, strategic deployment, and measurable results.
  • Partner with eCommerce, CRM, and Brand Marketing to develop retail-driven consumer engagement and retention initiatives that encourage trial, repeat purchase, and loyalty.

Leadership, Insights & Operational Excellence

  • Lead and develop the retail marketing team and external partners, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and execution standards.
  • Build a retail marketing performance framework measuring merchandising penetration, promotional effectiveness, retail execution, sell-through, and return on investment.
  • Leverage sales data, shopper insights, field feedback, and competitive intelligence to continuously optimize programs and investment decisions.
  • Establish scalable processes and cross-functional workflows that enable consistent execution across markets while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in retail, shopper, trade, or channel marketing, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • Deep expertise in visual merchandising and physical retail brand development, with hands-on experience creating fixtures, displays, POS materials, and scalable merchandising systems.
  • Proven success developing shopper marketing, promotional, and retail activation programs that drive measurable sales growth and return on investment.
  • Experience building retail education, advocacy, and sales enablement programs that influence shopper conversion and retail associate recommendations.
  • Background in premium consumer brands with third-party retail distribution, ideally within consumer electronics, beauty, beverage, lifestyle, CPG, or cannabis.
  • Exceptional creative judgment, with the ability to translate brand strategy into compelling and commercially effective retail experiences.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, evaluating promotional effectiveness, and optimizing marketing investments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, agencies, and complex cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, multi-market environments.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30%, with occasional international travel.

PAX LABS PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, equity & bi-annual performance reviews
  • Fully funded comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401K plan
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Monthly wellness reimbursement
  • Cell Phone reimbursement
  • Employee Purchase Program for discounted PAX devices
  • Weekly catered lunch, endless snacks and beverages
  • Dog Friendly HQ in the Mission District of San Francisco
  • Employee Assistance Program including access to online legal support

COMPENSATION

In addition to the benefits above, this role has a proposed base salary range of $160,000-200,000 per year, plus equity, subject to internal compensation review. The final salary offer will be determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, depth of experience, geographic location, and relevant education/training.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PAX VALUES

Put Consumers First - We are here to enhance their lives. We put their needs first in everything we do. We work together to deliver unique solutions for their benefit.

Build a Community - We are active and beneficial builders of a global community. We collaborate together to support sustainability, well-being and social equity efforts—both internally and externally—to establish cannabis as a force for good.

Innovate with Passion - We are passionate about enhancing the cannabis experience by making it positive, accessible and intuitive. We set the standards, innovate for consumers and find the yes as a team.

Be the Solution and Collaborate - We work as a team to achieve winning outcomes, knowing we each individually are the solution, but can only succeed together.

Lead with Humility and Transparency - We stay open and humble in everything we do. We value learning from each other, and cultivate transparency in our culture and products.

Manager, Budget and Reporting

OPPORTUNITY

Nationally recognized nonprofit venture philanthropy seeks to hire a manager to lead financial planning and analysis, budgeting, financial reporting, and investment due diligence across the organization.

ORGANIZATION

NewSchools is a venture philanthropy that builds a better education system by connecting people, resources, and ideas. We bridge the gap between those with capital and those with the courage to put that capital to work on the frontlines of K-12 education. We envision an education system that keeps its promise to all students. That’s why we invest in the ideas and energy of education leaders and entrepreneurs who are advancing innovative solutions that expand the definition of what works. There’s a better way to advance education through philanthropy—one that is more equitable, more collaborative, and more courageous–and we’re proving it every day.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Finance team seeks a Manager, Budget and Reporting to lead the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of NewSchools’ organization-wide budgeting, financial reporting, procurement, and financial due diligence on investments. Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will serve as the primary budget and reporting partner to investment team leaders, the Development team, and senior leadership. This role is remote anywhere in the U.S. Travel of up to 10% is required for in-person team meetings, retreats, and conferences.

In this role, you will:

Lead Annual Budgeting, Forecasting, and Financial Planning

  • Lead the annual organization-wide budget development process, preparing templates and training, gathering input from teams, and making recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Maintain and update rolling cash flow forecasts, financial models, and scenario analyses to support strategic decision-making.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly budget vs. actual variance analysis, and lead quarterly budget review sessions with budget owners.
  • Serve as an advisor to budget owners, translating budget data into insights and providing recommendations that inform resourcing and programmatic decisions.
  • Support the Development team with financial reporting packages and build models to integrate new funding proposals into the organizational budget.
  • Continuously improve the budgeting and reporting cycle by streamlining and standardizing workflows, and by reducing manual, spreadsheet-based processes through modernized and automated financial reporting tools.

Drive Finance Strategy, Reporting and Governance Support

  • Partner with the Director of Finance to translate organizational strategy into multi-year financial plans and evaluate trade-offs across portfolio, capacity, and funding scenarios.
  • Provide strategic insight and partner on organizational and team priorities.
  • Synthesize trends across budget, cash, and portfolio data to surface risks and opportunities early and recommend actions to leadership.
  • Contribute to long-term financial sustainability planning, including reserves, liquidity, and capital deployment strategy.
  • Prepare and analyze financial reports and presentations in preparation for quarterly Finance Committee meetings, highlighting key trends, risks, and decisions to support effective governance.
  • Monitor liquidity needs and cash positions across accounts in alignment with organizational requirements, proactively flagging emerging risks and recommending adjustments.
  • Regularly assess finance processes, controls, and tools; recommend and implement improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

Manage Investment Diligence, Capital Tools, and Procurement and Payment Operations

  • Conduct full financial due diligence for loan applications and strategic capital tools, and refine diligence frameworks as new capital instruments and risk considerations emerge.
  • Maintain organization-wide financial diligence training, support, and templates for grant investments.
  • Oversee contracts and procurement processes, including reviewing initial contract submissions, preparing financial approvals in contract workflows, and managing purchase orders in Intacct.
  • Conduct finance reviews of grant agreements, set up vendor contracts in Salesforce, and support accounts payable and grant payments.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, or financial management
  • Strong proficiency in financial modeling, Excel/Google Sheets, and financial systems (e.g., Sage Intacct, Salesforce, )
  • Experience utilizing data visualization tools to translate complex financial data into compelling, accessible narratives for non-financial stakeholders
  • Experience performing financial due diligence (analyzing financial statements, identifying financial risks) on grants, investments, or loans preferred
  • Understanding of nonprofit accounting (GAAP) and familiarity with 501(c)(3) compliance preferred
  • Travel up to 10% for in-person team meetings, retreats and conferences

EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

  • Ability to influence without authority and communicate technical financial concepts clearly to non-financial stakeholders
  • Designing and maintaining systems and routines that capture, organize and share learning
  • Owning multiple workstreams from inception through completion with attention to detail and strong organization
  • Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders to achieve ambitious goals
  • Creating processes and leading conversations that keep work moving across teams
  • Leading reflection and improvement cycles for workstreams, using data and documented learning to inform decisions and improve team effectiveness

COMPENSATION

A competitive compensation package including base salary, performance bonus, and complete benefits is available. The starting salary range for this position is $110,000 to $140,000 with the potential for an annual bonus of up to 5%. Final salary will be determined based on experience level and qualification

Applications submitted by November 6th will receive priority review. We encourage interested candidates to apply early, as the position may close once we’ve received a strong pool of applicants.

NewSchools Venture Fund has a strong commitment to diversity. Candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Please note, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
