jobs.description:
Our client is a global leader in fleet management technology and services, helping organizations plan, transition, operate, and optimize zero-emission vehicle fleets. Founded in Australia in 2016, our client supports more than 200 fleets across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region, serving transit agencies, government organizations, utilities, logistics providers, and other operators of complex, mission-critical fleets.

Our client’s integrated portfolio combines advanced software, technical advisory services, and ongoing EV Managed Services (EVMS) to support customers throughout the fleet electrification transition. Their technology solutions, including their Asset, their Plan, and their Manage, leverage advanced modeling, digital twin technology, artificial intelligence, and real-time operational data to help customers make informed investment decisions, plan fleet and charging infrastructure deployments, manage energy and charging operations, and improve fleet reliability and performance.

The Global Advisory and EVMS teams complement the technology platforms by providing specialized expertise in fleet electrification strategy, infrastructure planning, implementation support, operational performance assessments, proactive asset monitoring, energy optimization, and continuous improvement. By combining technology with expert-led services, our client helps customers translate complex operational data into actionable insights, reduce costs and risk, maximize asset utilization, and optimize reliable fleet operations.

The Director of EVMS Delivery, APAC, is responsible for the successful delivery and growth of our client's EV Managed Services business across the region. The role combines the structured problem-solving and customer leadership of an experienced consultant with the commercial and technical fluency of a solutions engineer. It owns regional delivery quality, customer outcomes, team performance, and the continued development of an EVMS offering that complements our client's existing advisory and consulting services.

Working closely with the Global Head of EVMS across APAC Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, this role translates complex customer needs into practical managed-service solutions. It leads discovery, solution shaping, scope definition, implementation planning, and executive communication, ensuring that commitments are commercially sound, technically credible, and deliverable in real fleet environments.

The role provides direct leadership and oversight of the APAC EVMS delivery team, establishing clear governance, delivery methods, service rhythms, resource plans, and performance expectations. It reports directly to the Global Head of EVMS but collaborates with colleagues in other regions and contributes APAC insight to company-wide practices.

Success in this role will strengthen customer trust, improve service performance and delivery predictability, build a high-performing regional team, and support sustainable revenue growth by making our client the partner customers rely on to turn fleet electrification strategy into dependable operational outcomes.

How This Role Embodies Our Client’s Core Values

🌿 Eco Active – This role is deeply rooted in sustainability, driving decarbonization initiatives and helping companies transition toward greener, more efficient fleet solutions. The person in this role must lead by example, advocating for climate-positive innovation and ensuring our solutions actively reduce environmental impact.

💡 Clear & Transparent – Transparency is key in this position. This leader must clearly articulate strategic roadmaps, provide inputs for product development, and market insights to both internal teams and external stakeholders. A commitment to honest communication and data-driven decision-making will ensure trust and alignment.

🚀 Transformative – This is not just about adapting to change—it's about leading it. This role must envision the future of sustainable transport, transforming our existing offerings into cutting-edge, industry-defining solutions that provide long-term value to clients.

🤝 Empathy for Customers and Each Other – Understanding client needs is at the heart of this role. The leader must deeply engage with fleet operators, business leaders, and internal teams to co-create impactful solutions that truly address the challenges of sustainable mobility. Internally, this role must foster collaboration and trust, ensuring our teams are supported in executing high-impact work.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Growth & Development Leadership

  • Shape the one- and three-year direction of EV Managed Services in APAC with the Global Head of EVMS, aligning regional priorities with our client's broader business strategy and customer value proposition.
  • Develop the regional service portfolio, delivery model, and market positioning using customer insight, operational data, and a clear view of APAC fleet-electrification customer needs.
  • Lead cross-functional regional work with Sales, Advisory, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to refine offerings that combine software, consulting expertise, and accountable operational support.
  • Identify practical opportunities for regional expansion while ensuring that scope, capacity, delivery risk, and commercial assumptions remain realistic.

Thought Leadership & Industry Influence

  • Serve as a credible APAC industry expert in fleet decarbonization, electric-fleet operations, charging, energy, and the transition from planning into day-to-day service delivery.
  • Represent our client at customer forums, conferences, panels, and partner events, communicating complex issues clearly to executive, operational, and technical audiences.
  • Develop decision-ready presentations, practical insights, and thought-leadership content that strengthen customer understanding and our client's position in the APAC market.

APAC EVMS Delivery & Project Management Oversight

  • Own the performance of the APAC EVMS PMO from sales handover and mobilization to project delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and maintain clear regional governance, service rhythms, delivery methods, decision rights, escalation paths, performance reporting, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with the Global Head of EVMS to actively manage local resourcing with global demand balancing utilization, dependencies, service performance, and delivery risk, intervening early when customer outcomes or commitments are at risk.

Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with APAC Sales and account managers during qualification and discovery, bringing consulting depth, industry expertise, and a credible delivery perspective to customer conversations.
  • Translate customer needs into integrated EVMS solutions with clear outcomes, service models, scope, assumptions, dependencies, governance, resourcing, and measures of success.
  • Contribute to proposals, presentations, demonstrations, procurement responses, partnerships, and commercial discussions, while identifying responsible upsell and cross-sell opportunities that increase customer value.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop the APAC EVMS delivery team, setting clear expectations for customer leadership, technical quality, consulting discipline, commercial awareness, and personal ownership.
  • Collaborate with the Global Head of EVMS to increase regional delivery capability by leveraging AI to increase team capacity and throughput without proportionate headcount growth.
  • Establish a resource plan to recruit and onboard team members as required and develop reusable methods, tools, and knowledge-sharing routines.
  • Create an inclusive culture of excellence, initiative, collaboration, and accountability in which issues are surfaced early and people are supported to deliver their best work.

Requirements

  • 5-7 years of experience in management consulting, professional services, or complex solution delivery, including leadership of customer-facing teams and multi-workstream engagements, preferably in mobility, energy or fleet management.
  • Strong background in strategic planning, particularly in sustainability, decarbonisation, or future mobility trends.
  • Proven experience in management consulting, solutions engineering, pre-sales, tender leadership, and business development, with the ability to shape technical and operational solutions alongside Sales.
  • Deep industry knowledge across electric mobility, fleets, transport, charging, electricity markets, or adjacent infrastructure experience, with the credibility to advise senior customer stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of data science, machine learning, and emerging technologies in transport analytics is a plus.
  • Strong delivery and commercial management experience, including scope, governance, contracts, service performance, risk, resourcing, utilisation, and engagement economics.
  • A demonstrated record of leading, coaching, recruiting, and retaining high-performing multidisciplinary teams through growth and change.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive presentations, workshops, proposal development, public speaking, and the ability to make complex topics clear.

Key Competencies

  1. Consulting & Strategic Thinking – Frames ambiguous problems, develops evidence-based recommendations, and converts strategy into practical regional priorities and operating decisions.
  2. Solution Leadership – Translates customer needs into credible, commercially sound EVMS solutions that integrate software, advisory expertise, delivery methods, and measurable outcomes.
  3. Stakeholder Engagement – Builds trust and drives decisions with customer executives, fleet operators, technical teams, partners, and internal leaders through clear communication and strong facilitation.
  4. Innovation & Problem-Solving – Ability to anticipate future challenges and develop innovative solutions to market needs.
  5. APAC Delivery Oversight – Structures and manages a regional portfolio with effective governance, service performance, resource planning, risk management, and commercial discipline.
  6. Thought Leadership – Ability to represent the company at conferences, contributes useful industry insight, and strengthens our client's credibility in APAC fleet electrification and managed services.
  7. Leadership & Influence – Experience in mentoring, coaching, and guiding teams at various levels.
  8. Resourcing & Recruitment – Anticipates team capability and capacity needs, recruits strong talent, and creates repeatable methods that enable the APAC team to scale sustainably.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, USA

Come Join Our Passionate Team! At Barracuda, we make the world a safer place. We believe every business deserves access to cloud-enabled, enterprise-grade security solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use. We protect email, networks, data and applications with innovative solutions that grow and adapt with our customers’ journey. More than 220,000 organizations worldwide trust Barracuda to protect them — in ways they may not even know they are at risk — so they can focus on taking their business to the next level.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equal employment opportunity and equitable compensation regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.

Envision yourself at Barracuda

Barracuda is looking for a highly technical security professional to join our team with a primary focus on identifying emerging threats, understanding evolving adversarial tradecraft, and translating that knowledge into actionable detection and defensive capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of threat intelligence, detection engineering, offensive security, and adversary emulation. You will research emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, intrusion techniques, and attacker behaviors to understand how modern threats are evolving and how those threats can be detected across Barracuda’s security ecosystem.

You will help answer a critical question for our customers and our organization:
“If an attacker used this technique against us today, would we actually detect it?”

You will investigate how real-world adversaries operate, identify gaps in our ability to detect their behavior, and help develop the telemetry, analytics, detections, and defensive capabilities needed to identify and disrupt them.As a secondary responsibility, you will simulate adversary behavior to validate detection capabilities and expose gaps in defensive coverage. You will safely reproduce attacker TTPs, conduct controlled attack simulations, and measure whether security controls and detections perform as expected.

You will collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Security Operations (XDR), Incident Response, and Product teams to continuously improve Barracuda’s ability to detect and respond to evolving threats.

Being a team player, strong communicator, and forward-thinking security practitioner is essential for success in this role. You will be a technical leader within the team, helping mentor others and advance Barracuda’s capabilities in threat-informed detection and adversary validation.

What You’ll Be Working On

Emerging Threat & Adversarial Tradecraft Research

  • Research emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, and adversary campaigns.
  • Analyze evolving attacker TTPs and identify new techniques that may impact Barracuda and its customers.
  • Track changes in adversary tradecraft and translate findings into actionable defensive requirements.
  • Investigate how novel attack techniques can be detected through available telemetry, security controls, and product capabilities.
  • Identify gaps in existing detection coverage and recommend improvements to close those gaps.
  • Analyze real-world attacks and incidents to identify new detection opportunities and defensive lessons.
  • Develop technical assessments of new threats, including attack paths, required telemetry, observable behaviors, and detection opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Threat Intelligence and security teams to operationalize emerging threat intelligence.

Detection Development & Validation

  • Develop and improve detection strategies for emerging and known adversary behaviors.
  • Translate attacker TTPs into detection logic, analytics, behavioral indicators, and detection requirements.
  • Evaluate whether existing detections can reliably identify real-world adversary behavior.
  • Identify detection blind spots and determine what additional telemetry or analytics are required to close them.
  • Validate detection effectiveness through controlled testing and adversary simulation.
  • Measure detection coverage against relevant threat actor behaviors and attack techniques.
  • Partner with detection engineering and security operations teams to continuously improve detection quality and reduce missed threats.
  • Develop automation and tooling to improve the speed, scale, and repeatability of detection validation.

Adversary Simulation & Attack Validation

  • Conduct controlled adversary simulations based on real-world threat intelligence and emerging attacker tradecraft.
  • Reproduce relevant attacker behaviors and TTPs to validate defensive capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable attack simulations and offensive security tooling.
  • Conduct Attack & Defend and Purple Team exercises to determine whether security controls can detect and respond to realistic attack scenarios.
  • Test new and existing detections against adversary behaviors and identify missed TTPs.
  • Research and safely demonstrate novel attack techniques and exploitation paths in controlled environments.
  • Translate offensive findings into actionable improvements for detection, monitoring, prevention, and response capabilities.
  • Maintain appropriate cloud-based laboratories and testing environments for adversary simulation and security research.

Cross-Functional Security Research

  • Collaborate with Incident Response teams to understand real-world attack activity and incorporate lessons learned into detection and validation programs.
  • Partner with Security Operations to improve detection fidelity and operational response.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify opportunities to improve security visibility and defensive capabilities.
  • Support the development of security research, threat reports, technical assessments, and internal briefings.
  • Communicate complex technical findings, attack paths, detection gaps, and recommended mitigations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Work collaboratively and independently on unique or special assignments that require specialized security knowledge and experience.
  • Mentor other security professionals and contribute to the team’s technical growth and capabilities.

What You Bring to the Role

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, threat research, detection engineering, threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of modern attacker tradecraft and the ability to analyze how real-world adversaries operate.
  • Demonstrated experience researching vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, or emerging attack techniques.
  • Experience translating adversary behaviors and TTPs into detection opportunities or defensive requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with adversary emulation, red teaming, penetration testing, or attack simulation.
  • Experience developing or validating detections using SIEM, EDR, XDR, network, cloud, identity, or other security telemetry.
  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how to map adversary behavior to observable activity and defensive coverage.
  • Ability to analyze complex attack chains and determine where meaningful detection and prevention opportunities exist.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with Windows, Unix, and Linux operating systems.
  • Understanding of network protocols and enterprise security architecture.
  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.
  • Ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques and quickly develop a working technical understanding.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical attack behavior and security risk clearly.

Highly Valued Experience

  • Experience building adversary emulation tooling or automated attack simulations.
  • Experience developing detection analytics, correlation rules, behavioral detections, or detection-as-code.
  • Experience with EDR/XDR, SIEM, cloud security, identity security, or network detection technologies.
  • Experience analyzing public vulnerability disclosures and determining practical exploitability and detection opportunities.
  • Experience conducting Purple Team or Attack & Defend exercises.
  • Experience measuring detection coverage and identifying missed adversary TTPs.
  • Experience with threat hunting and hypothesis-driven investigations.
  • Experience researching novel exploitation techniques or emerging attacker tradecraft.
  • Experience contributing to open-source security research, vulnerability research, or offensive security tooling.
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSCE, GXPN, GCIA, GCIH, CEH, or equivalent practical experience.

Success in This Role
Success in this role means Barracuda is increasingly able tosee attackers sooner and understand new threats before they become widespread incidents.

You will help the organization:

  • Identify emerging threats and adversarial techniques before they become operationally significant.
  • Convert threat intelligence into meaningful detection opportunities.
  • Discover detection blind spots before attackers exploit them.
  • Continuously validate that detections work against realistic adversary behavior.
  • Improve visibility into customer-relevant attack paths and TTPs.
  • Increase measurable detection coverage against relevant threats.
  • Strengthen the feedback loop between threat intelligence, offensive security, detection engineering, security operations, incident response, and product teams.

The goal is not simply to simulate attacks.The goal is to understand how attackers are evolving, determine how we can detect them, and then prove that our defenses actually work.

What you’ll get from us

A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda.

- High-quality health benefits

- Retirement Plan with employer match

- Career-growth opportunities

- Volunteer opportunities

jobs.description:
About Us

At Verisian, we build deep tech and AI solutions that enable groundbreaking medical therapies to enter the market faster and safely. New medicines and devices are judged using all available evidence in the proper context and backed by automated analyses that validate and make data and results transparent to companies and regulators alike. Regulators will make the right decisions on novel therapies faster and with greater confidence, protecting patients from harm and making breakthrough treatments available as soon as is possible and safe.

In times of increasing trial numbers and complexity, we are building technical innovation to remove crucial bottlenecks for pharmaceutical and medical device companies, as well as public health authorities, directly affecting clinical trial planning, analyses, validation, submission, and market approval.

By joining us, you will commit yourself to building software and AI tools that directly contribute to increasing the rate at which medical innovation improves human health and wellbeing.

Disclaimer:

We welcome candidates of diverse experience levels, and meeting every requirement is not mandatory. Research indicates that underrepresented groups tend to apply only if they meet all qualifications. If you're enthusiastic about the role, please apply and let our recruiters evaluate your application.

Culture

At Verisian, our mission is to build the future infrastructure of medical innovation. To help us succeed, we're creating a unique employee culture. We always put the mission first. We're fanatically customer obsessed, crafting world-class products that customers love with every interaction. We take extreme ownership and accountability of our work, seeing whatever we do through to completion. We communicate candidly and directly with each other, even when it's uncomfortable. We're innately curious, open to alternative perspectives and invest passionately in our own continuous growth.

Role Description

As a Programming Language Engineer, you will join our world-class engineering team in building the Verisian Platform. You will work on an application that exposes our clinical trial insights to data managers, statistical programmers, statisticians, medical experts/writers, and regulatory authorities.

The Verisian Platform brings value to a set of highly regulated processes crucial for medical progress and innovation. Your work will support the Planner, Builder, Explorer, Validator, Submitter, and related supporting modules. These core modules of the platform target the planning, exploration/onboarding, building, validation, submission, and review of clinical trials and their results. They enable data managers, statistical programmers, statisticians, medical writers, and regulators to deliver their work faster, at higher quality, lower cost, and in greater confidence.

Our pipelines analyze clinical trial documentation, code, logs, data, and results to build a knowledge graph through code traceability. We harness the resulting dataset, column-level and logic lineage to turn clinical trials into Information Infrastructure that can be used by experts and consumed by AI to revolutionize how therapies are evaluated and enter the market. We capture complex processes in fully- and semi-automated workflows that place experts in control and AI automation at their fingertips. We build visualizations to provide our customers with a maximum of insight as fast as possible.

Our application stack is based on Next.js and deployed via Docker/Kubernetes in the cloud. The data analysis pipelines run in Argo Workflows. We analyze code based on Antlr4 and Java. AI agents are developed in Python. Git is where our code lives, and Github Actions is how it gets out into the world.

You will develop parsers and compilers for programming languages (SAS, R, and Python) used by statistical programmers and data scientists to analyze clinical trials. You will then transform the code, data, specifications, and statistical results into complex graphs and related data structures. They will be used by our platform to expose our game-changing functionality to users and consumed by our AI agents to automate the planning, analysis, validation, and submission of clinical trials

You will be expected to lead the analysis, design, building and testing of components of the code analytics and backend stack. As part of our core team, you will join us in designing, prioritising, building and testing new functionality, troubleshooting customer issues, finding root causes, and deploying required fixes to ensure maximal user impact and performance.

Requirements

  • Experience with and strong interest in programming languages, parsing algorithms, interpreters, and compilers
  • Extensive experience in Java or Typescript and at least one other programming language

Description

At Ledgebrook, we are building an Excess & Surplus (E&S) lines insurance company that combines deep underwriting and pricing expertise with a modern technology platform fit for the future of insurance — truly a best-of-both-worlds approach. Our speed and service underpin every decision we make, and our rapidly growing team is a testament to our value proposition resonating with the market.

You bring the passion, leadership, and entrepreneurial spirit, and we’ll provide the opportunity to unleash the very best of your talents and skills. Apply now to advance your career at Ledgebrook.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale multiple engineering teams responsible for the technology powering Ledgebrook’s underwriting, policy, rating, data, and operational systems.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical judgment, organizational leadership, and business acumen. You are someone who can develop Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, shape technology strategy and architecture, create operating discipline across teams, and ensure engineering investments translate into meaningful business outcomes.

You will be accountable not only for what engineering delivers, but also for building the organization, systems, processes, and leadership capability that allow teams to execute predictably and scale as Ledgebrook grows.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Data, Infrastructure, Security, Finance, Operations, and business leaders to translate company priorities into technology roadmaps and execution plans while maintaining the reliability, scalability, security, and long-term health of our technology platform.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and senior individual contributors across multiple engineering teams.
  • Own organizational health across your engineering domain, including staffing, structure, technical delivery, capacity, performance, team engagement, retention, and succession planning.
  • Partner with Product and business leaders to translate company strategy and priorities into technology roadmaps, investment decisions and executable delivery plans.
  • Drive execution across multiple teams, ensuring initiatives have clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, success measures, and accountability.
  • Own the technology strategy and long-term health of systems and services within your domain, including architecture integrations, scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost.
  • Partner with Principal Engineers, Architects, Engineering Managers, and Technical Leads to establish technical direction, architecture standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs, evaluate trade-offs, identify systemic risks, and guide significant technology and architecture decisions.
  • Balance product delivery with platform investment, technical debt reduction, reliability, security, compliance, and modernization.
  • Establish strong data-driven engineering operating practices across development, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident management, documentation, release management, and production support.
  • Provide leadership during critical incidents, ensuring effective escalation, communication, resolution, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on preventative improvements.
  • Lead quarterly and annual technology planning, including roadmap prioritization, capacity planning, organizational design, and headcount projections.
  • Maintain productive relationships with strategic technology vendors and external partners, including involvement in evaluations, renewals, integrations, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, AI, automation, and modern engineering practices to create meaningful business or operational advantage.
  • Represent Engineering in leadership discussions, planning forums, operating reviews, and cross-functional initiatives.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building and scaling a company from the ground up.

As a Director, you are comfortable operating at multiple levels. You can discuss architecture with senior engineers, coach an Engineering Manager through an organizational challenge, work with Product on roadmap trade-offs, and explain technology investments and risks clearly to business and executive leaders.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Leadership Through Others: You understand that your impact as a Director comes from building strong leaders, teams, systems, and organizational capability rather than personally owning every decision.
  • Business Acumen: You connect engineering decisions to business outcomes and understand how technology investments affect customers, operations, cost, growth, and risk.
  • Technical Judgment: You can operate comfortably in architectural and technical discussions, ask the right questions, understand trade-offs, and provide direction without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and actively seek ways to improve yourself, your leaders, and the organization.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can make thoughtful decisions quickly and balance long-term technology health with the realities of a fast-moving business.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you focus on solving the problem, understanding the root cause, and improving the system rather than assigning blame.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, direct feedback, and early communication of risks and trade-offs.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build strong connections across teams, functions, and remote locations.
  • Organizational Thinking: You look beyond individual teams and identify patterns, bottlenecks, and opportunities that improve the broader engineering organization.

Requirements

Must haves

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams and managers.
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including experience managing Engineering Managers or leading multiple engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated success building, scaling, and developing high-performing engineering organizations.
  • Strong technical background in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud platforms, data-integrated applications, and production systems.
  • Experience leading architecture and technology strategy across multiple services, systems, or product areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy and product priorities into technology roadmaps and executable engineering plans.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, business stakeholders, and senior leadership on ambiguous and complex business problems.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD, testing, observability, reliability, incident management, and operational excellence.
  • Experience designing and delivering scalable, production-grade systems in cloud environments, preferably AWS.
  • Proven experience managing cross-team dependencies, complex initiatives, and competing priorities in a high-growth environment.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, mentor, and develop Engineering Managers, senior engineers, and technical leaders.
  • Experience with workforce planning, organizational design, capacity planning, and headcount prioritization.
  • Strong communication, with the ability to explain complex technical issues, risks, investments, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for technology outcomes from strategy and architecture through delivery and production operations.

Nice to haves

  • Prior startup or scale-up experience in a high-growth, high-velocity environment.
  • Experience scaling engineering organizations through significant company growth.
  • Experience with insurance, fintech, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience with underwriting, rating, policy administration, claims, financial, or insurance data systems.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and platforms using AWS, Terraform, Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or Jenkins.
  • Exposure to AI/ML systems, generative AI, LLM-driven workflows, and intelligent automation.
  • Experience developing engineering operating models, career frameworks, technical governance, or organizational maturity practices.
  • Experience managing cloud, vendor, infrastructure, and technology investment costs.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, security, compliance, or other regulated technology environments.

The Tech Stack for this role:

  • Languages: Python, TypeScript
  • Frontend: React
  • Backend: Python, Node.js, FastAPI and related frameworks
  • Data Stack: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kinesis
  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • DevOps: GitHub Actions, Docker, CI/CD automation
  • Tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Jellyfish, Slack
  • Emerging Technologies: AI/ML, LLM-enabled workflows, intelligent automation

Benefits

US & Canada Benefits

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity ownership
  • 100% employer-paid health insurance
  • 100% remote work, flexible hours
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Work with an ambitious, smart, fun team to transform a $1T global industry
  • Significant ownership, autonomy, and opportunity to shape the engineering organization
  • Direct influence on technology strategy and company growth

jobs.excerpt: Shape the Future with TribalScaleTribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world.
jobs.description:
Shape the Future with TribalScale

TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges.
Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action.

Our Digital Expertise

  • Transformation Experts: We transform traditional business models into agile, AI-powered ecosystems.
  • Strategic Visionaries: We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution.
  • Product Virtuosos: We orchestrate the creation of world-class digital solutions.
  • Code Optimizers: We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems.

Our Technological Toolkit

  • Mobile & Web Development: (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js)
  • Voice-Activated Platforms: (Amazon Alexa, Google Home)
  • Connected Ecosystems: (Cars and Homes)
  • Streaming Platforms: (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS)

The TribalScale Professional

You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Transformation Engineer to join our growing team at TribalScale. In this role, you will be embedded with a client organization of approximately 500 employees, serving as a hands-on AI platform builder, technical leader, and educator over an extended engagement.

You will help establish and continuously improve the organization’s AI knowledge foundation—its “company brain”—while building production-ready agentic systems, advancing Claude Code practices, and enabling teams across the business to adopt AI workflows. Success means not only shipping working systems, but also making them secure, maintainable, useful, and widely adopted.

This is a hands-on engineering and organizational transformation role for someone who can move quickly from ambiguity to production, partner across functions, and own outcomes over time.

What You’ll Do

AI Knowledge Systems & Agentic Memory

  • Design, build, and maintain an LLM-powered company knowledge base (“company brain” or LLM wiki) that captures institutional knowledge and makes it usable by employees and agents.
  • Architect agentic memory and context strategies: define what agents remember, how knowledge is retrieved and refreshed, and how access permissions are enforced.
  • Develop practical retrieval, indexing, knowledge-quality, and lifecycle processes that keep information accurate, relevant, and secure.

Production Agentic Engineering & Claude Code

  • Design, build, deploy, and operate agentic applications and production harnesses, including evaluations, observability, guardrails, testing, human oversight, and ongoing iteration.
  • Serve as the organization’s Claude Code expert: establish conventions for CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP integrations, and repeatable team workflows.
  • Build reusable developer tooling, integrations, APIs, and automation that improve engineering productivity and software delivery.
  • Deploy and maintain solutions on AWS, applying IAM permissions, security controls, monitoring, reliability practices, and cost management.

Organization-Wide Enablement & Adoption

  • Design and deliver a structured training program for an approximately 500-person organization, covering agentic memory, harnesses, Claude Code, and practical AI workflows for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Run workshops, hands-on demonstrations, office hours, and tailored onboarding; create documentation and reusable learning materials.
  • Develop internal AI champions and support managers and teams as they embed new practices into day-to-day work.
  • Define and monitor adoption and impact measures, such as active usage, workflow uptake, proficiency, productivity, and feedback; improve the program based on results.

Long-Term Transformation & Delivery

    • Partner with stakeholders across engineering, IT, security, and business functions to prioritize use cases and align technical work with organizational needs.
    • Own solutions from discovery and rapid prototyping through production deployment, maintenance, and iterative improvement.
    • Establish practical AI governance covering data access, privacy, security, reliability, and responsible use across hundreds of users.
    • Balance speed, quality, maintainability, and change management while helping the organization build sustainable internal capabilities.

What You Bring

  • Strong hands-on software or AI engineering experience, with proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable languages, and experience delivering production systems.
  • Demonstrable experience building LLM knowledge management or retrieval systems, such as RAG, LLM wikis, enterprise search, or related context-engineering solutions.
  • Practical expertise designing agentic memory, retrieval strategies, context management, and permission-aware knowledge access.
  • Deep, demonstrable Claude Code expertise, with specific examples of workflows, skills, subagents, MCP integrations, or harnesses you have personally built.
  • Proven ownership of production agent harnesses, including evaluations, observability, guardrails, debugging, maintenance, and continuous improvement—not just familiarity with the concepts.
  • Strong AWS experience, including relevant services such as Lambda, Bedrock, IAM, S3, and vector search or OpenSearch, with attention to security, scalability, and cost.
  • Experience working within an organization undergoing significant technology or AI transformation, including the human side of adoption and change management.
  • Proven ability to teach: experience running workshops, building training curricula, or onboarding teams to new tools, and explaining technical ideas to non-engineers.
  • Ability to partner across technical and business teams, independently own initiatives, and deliver practical solutions in fast-paced environments.
We recognize that strong candidates may not meet every qualification listed. If this role excites you and your experience is adjacent to what we have described, we encourage you to apply.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading AI adoption or platform transformation in a mid-sized organization, particularly one with approximately 200–2,000 employees.
  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or other agent orchestration and evaluation frameworks.
  • Claude Certified Architect certification or other relevant AI engineering credentials.
  • Experience building internal communities of practice, champion networks, or measurable enterprise enablement programs.
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, infrastructure as code, and operating secure AI systems at organizational scale.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client’s operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge.

As you grow in the role, you will:
  • Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans.
  • Deliver AI-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations.
  • Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible.
  • Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models.
  • Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly.
  • Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements.
  • Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production.

Why TribalScale

  • Work on high-impact challenges across industries and technology domains.
  • Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations.
  • Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions.
  • Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning.
  • Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale’s evolving technical practices.
  • Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged.

Why Choose TribalScale

At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI-driven innovation.

We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation.

Diversity: Our Collective Strength

TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able-bodiedness, or gender identity.

We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. Your unique perspective is the key to our collective innovation.

Should you require any accommodations, we implore you to inform us. Our commitment to inclusivity knows no bounds, and we stand ready to adapt our processes to ensure your comfort and success.

Join us, and help build the future of sports nutrition!

About the role

RAW Nutrition is looking for an Inventory Manager to oversee inventory accuracy, control, costing, planning, and reporting across the organization. This role will ensure inventory records accurately reflect physical inventory, investigate and resolve discrepancies, analyze inventory and costing variances, manage cycle count programs, and partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Finance, and Accounting teams to maintain strong inventory controls. This role is remote, open to United States residents with preference towards those in the Central and Eastern timezones.

What you'll do

  • Own inventory accuracy across warehouses, 3PLs, and internal inventory locations.
  • Monitor inventory balances and investigate discrepancies between ERP records, warehouse systems, and physical inventory.
  • Develop, manage, and execute cycle count and physical inventory programs.
  • Research inventory variances and identify the root cause of discrepancies.
  • Coordinate inventory adjustments and ensure appropriate documentation and approval.
  • Reconcile inventory movements including receipts, transfers, fulfillments, returns, assemblies, adjustments, and write-offs.
  • Partner with warehouse and 3PL teams to resolve receiving, shipping, and inventory discrepancies.
  • Monitor aged, damaged, expired, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
  • Assist in developing disposition plans for obsolete or non-sellable inventory.
  • Review negative inventory, inventory shortages, duplicate transactions, and unusual inventory activity.
  • Maintain accurate SKU, item, location, and inventory-related master data.
  • Ensure inventory transactions are processed accurately and timely within the ERP system.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of inventory management, inventory control, or inventory accounting experience, ideally in CPG, food & beverage, or another physical-goods environment
  • Experience working with 3PLs and/or co-packers/co-manufacturers, including managing the inevitable data and communication gaps
  • Comfort with lot tracking, expiration dates, and FIFO/FEFO practices
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with an ERP system (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Fishbowl, Cin7, SAP, or similar)
  • A demonstrated ability to build or improve a process, not just follow one — startups need people who create the playbook
  • Sharp analytical skills and comfort digging into root causes rather than just patching symptoms
  • Strong cross-functional communication — you'll be translating inventory issues for warehouse staff, finance leaders, and executives alike
  • High attention to detail paired with the ability to prioritize when everything feels urgent

Nice-To-Haves

  • Experience with a company going through rapid SKU or channel expansion (e.g., adding retail after DTC, or vice versa)
  • Familiarity with retailer EDI/chargebacks as they relate to inventory and fulfillment discrepancies
  • Experience supporting an audit or funding due diligence process
  • Exposure to demand planning or S&OP processes

Our Leadership Principles

  • Speed without sacrificing quality.
  • Data beats opinions.
  • Ownership beats excuses.
  • Testing beats assumptions.
  • Accountability is non-negotiable.
  • Every problem has an owner.
  • We are builders, not caretakers.
  • We hire adults who don't need to be managed.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation: The base compensation range for this position is $75,000-$90,000; final salary offer based on experience and skillset.
  • Insurance & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans.
  • Retirement Savings: Plan for your future with a 401(k) savings plan featuring a company match.
  • Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need with a flex PTO plan, sick time, and paid holidays.
  • Extra Perks: Monthly stipend to spend on our products and gear, access to the RAW Athletic Clubs in Port St. Lucie and Stuart, FL, and discounts on our family of brands.

jobs.excerpt: About Fello:Fello is a profitable, hyper-growth, VC-backed B2B SaaS company building the agentic real estate platform of the future.
jobs.description:
About Fello:

Fello is a profitable, hyper-growth, VC-backed B2B SaaS company building the agentic real estate platform of the future.

Our platform combines data intelligence, marketing automation, and conversational AI to help real estate teams engage smarter and scale faster. At the center of it is Felix, our AI teammate, which takes real work off a team's plate — running follow-up across calls, texts, and emails today, with more of the team's day-to-day work coming next.

We're not another tool in the stack. We're the system that powers it — learning, adapting, and executing in real time so teams can focus on growth, not guesswork.

If you're excited about building an AI product that's changing how an entire industry works, you'll fit right in.

About You:

You're the person who makes an implementation feel effortless — even when five things are moving at once. You've spent 3+ years owning onboarding, implementation, or solutions delivery at a SaaS company, and you've built a reputation for finishing what you start: outcomes, not just closed tickets. You're comfortable on camera with busy operators who can spot a script from a mile away, and you know how to build trust fast by explaining technical things in plain English. You're curious about AI, ideally have hands-on experience with LLM-based or agentic products, and you're genuinely energized by coaching people through change rather than just configuring a tool for them. Real estate knowledge — how a team, a brokerage, and a listing actually work — is a must, and it's what will let you hit the ground running.

You Will:

  • Lead every onboarding and implementation call for your portfolio of accounts — you own the room, the plan, and the outcome, with Solution Engineers looped in when the work calls for it
  • Drive The Clock : Drive your accounts through a proof chain against real clocks: Time to Go Live (target: 30 days from contract), Time to 10DLC submission, Time to First Handoff, and Time to New Lead setup / First Appointment / First Listing
  • Own the Managed Phase : Stay with each account through the Managed phase — well past go-live — until leads are flowing, handoffs are happening, and appointments are booking like clockwork. Graduate accounts to Impacting only when the ROI is provable and durable, not just when the calendar says it's time
  • SE Orchestration : Direct deployment, configuration, and integration work through the Solution Engineering team, staying accountable for quality and timeline even though you're not doing all the technical lift yourself
  • Making the Playbook Better : Feed your field notes back into the playbook — every friction point you hit becomes an improvement for the next implementation

You Have:

  • Proven expertise in customer-facing implementation : 3+ years of customer-facing implementation experience in onboarding, Implementation Delivery Lead , Onboarding Specialist, or Solutions roles at a SaaS company
  • Presence on camera with operators. Our customers are real estate team leaders and their agents, busy small-business operators who can spot a script a mile away. You build trust fast and explain technical things in plain English.
  • Fluency in AI to be credible. You've worked with LLM-based or agentic products, or you've gone deep enough on modern AI tools to explain what the agent did and why. You'll be trained on Felix; curiosity and comfort with AI are the entry bar.
  • Organized under volume. Multiple accounts, multiple clocks, dependencies on SEs and carriers and customers. You run a tight board and nothing slips silently.
  • Ownership-mindset. When something blocks your account, you chase it down. “Waiting on someone else” is a status, not an excuse.
  • The Coach flair. You are ready to jump on a call with the real estate teams, understand how they operate today and coach them on best practices, strategy and influence operational changes to derive more value from Fello.
  • Real estate knowledge. Knowing how a team, a brokerage, and a listing actually work will shorten your ramp.

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO and paid holidays to recharge and relax.
  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive team environment that values innovation and collaboration.
  • Equity Options: Opportunity to own a part of Fello and share in our success.
  • Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative products that leverage AI and advanced technologies.

About the role

Enterprise companies with $100 million to $2 billion or more in revenue are where we have the most room to grow, and you'll turn that opportunity into new customers. As Business Development Director, you'll lead new business in this band: you'll own a territory, protect and grow a book of named customers, win new logos, and turn inbound and partner-sourced pipeline into revenue. You'll report to our VP, Sales, work with a Junior AE, a Presales Engineer, an Inside Sales SDR, and our Partnerships team, and spend much of your time with prospects and customers. You'll do well here if an empty territory energizes you, you measure yourself on logos won rather than accounts inherited, and you're a resourceful, direct, consultative seller who's comfortable working independently in a small team at a company that's changing how it sells.

What you'll do

  • Own a territory of enterprise accounts across your region and the full sales cycle, from first conversation to close. Requests from these accounts come straight to you, and Inside Sales passes you inbound leads once they're qualified.
  • Identify, prospect, and close new logos in the enterprise band, running a disciplined outbound motion through Apollo for new contacts and HubSpot sequences for known contacts and nurture.
  • Sell our platform offerings alongside our existing services, and sell the outcome, not the word count.
  • Work with your Junior AE on pre- and post-sales support, your Presales Engineer on demos and technical scoping, and the Inside Sales SDR on inbound qualification and appointment setting.
  • Work with our Partnerships team and technology partners on co-selling and referral opportunities in your territory.
  • Keep HubSpot accurate: create opportunities after qualified meetings, maintain your pipeline and forecast, and share feedback that helps improve lead quality and our ideal customer profile.
  • Bring market insight back to the business, including what competitors are doing, where buyers are moving, and what's resonating.

What you'll bring

  • Typically 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise B2B sales, including new-logo selling, with a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in the localization or language services industry
  • Current or recent experience selling and carrying quota on language technology software, SaaS, or AI-driven translation, beyond per-project services statements of work (SOWs)
  • Experience owning the full commercial motion, from outbound prospecting and multi-threaded outreach to pipeline management and forecasting, beyond closing warm leads or waiting for marketing to fill the funnel
  • Working knowledge of TMS and language technology platforms such as Phrase, Lokalise, Smartling, XTM, and memoQ, and how AI-driven translation workflows are changing what buyers expect

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience of a services-to-platform or services-to-SaaS transition at a previous employer, including the change management that comes with it
  • Experience selling to technology, software, and similar enterprise companies in your territory
  • Experience structuring multi-year enterprise deals, such as subscription, bundled, or outcome-based commercial models
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot and Apollo, or the ability to pick them up quickly

If you have some of these, great. If you don't, we'd still like to hear from you.

Who we are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

• Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.

• Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.

• Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.

• Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.

• Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Founder
jobs.excerpt: Location: US or Canada Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor **A note before you read further**The world is changing fast, and so is this role.
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor

**A note before you read further**

The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

About Human Agency

We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff to serve as a force multiplier to our founder, Brendan Lind. You'll be the engine that translates the founder's vision and initiatives into executable plans, builds the systems that allow our leadership team to operate at their highest level, and ensures nothing critical falls through the cracks as we scale rapidly.

Rather than being hired for a predetermined set of tasks, you will be brought on to solve complex, evolving challenges. Success in this role requires self-direction, proactive value creation, and the ability to thrive without constant oversight. Over the coming year, your responsibilities will be tailored to both organizational needs and your individual strengths, potentially including:

  • Leading AI transformation projects with clients
  • Managing CEOs at client organizations
  • Driving sales initiatives at Human Agency
  • Partnering with Recruiting to help us find and close top-tier talent
  • Managing client project delivery
  • Driving value through data and analytics for clients
  • Leading go-to-market initiatives for clients

You'll own special projects, drive organizational initiatives from concept to completion, and build the infrastructure (GTM motions, resource allocation, operational rhythms) that allows Human Agency to grow while maximizing our greatest strength – our people. If you thrive on turning ambitious ideas into reality and building the scaffolding that makes a fast-growing startup actually work, this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Execution & Founder Partnership

  • Partner with the founder to translate priorities, initiatives, and strategic vision into sequenced plans with clear owners, timelines, and success metrics
  • Own end-to-end execution of founder-level special projects and organizational initiatives, from scoping and planning through delivery and measurement
  • Maintain focus and accountability across the founder's portfolio of priorities; proactively identify conflicts, dependencies, and risks before they become problems
  • Prepare high-quality executive materials (strategy briefs, decision memos, board materials, organizational roadmaps) that drive alignment and enable confident decision-making
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the founder, pressure-testing ideas, surfacing options and trade-offs, and ensuring initiatives align with company strategy and capacity

Internal Systems & Operations

  • Build and continuously improve the internal operating systems that allow Human Agency to scale: hiring infrastructure, resource allocation processes, team capacity planning, and cross-functional coordination mechanisms
  • Design and implement hiring systems that support our 25-30+ person growth target in 2026 without overwhelming the existing team, including interview frameworks, candidate evaluation rubrics, and onboarding processes
  • Own resource allocation and capacity planning across the organization, ensuring the right people are working on the right priorities at the right time, and that no one is stretched unsustainably thin
  • Establish organizational rhythms that create alignment without bureaucracy: leadership meeting cadences, decision-making frameworks, communication protocols, and reporting structures
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies; design and implement solutions that increase organizational velocity while maintaining quality

Cross-Functional Leadership & Coordination

  • Orchestrate complex, cross-functional initiatives that require coordination across leadership and multiple teams
  • Serve as a neutral coordinator and problem-solver when initiatives span multiple departments or require difficult trade-offs between competing priorities
  • Represent the founder's office in key internal discussions, ensuring the founder's priorities and perspective are understood even when they can't be in every meeting
  • Build strong working relationships across the organization; earn trust as someone who gets things done without ego and acts in the company's best interest

Communications & Organizational Transparency

  • Ensure crisp internal communication on company strategy, priorities, and decisions—translating founder-level thinking into clear, actionable guidance for the broader team
  • Prepare the founder for key meetings, presentations, and decisions; provide relevant context, background materials, and recommended talking points
  • Maintain visibility on organizational health metrics and key initiatives; proactively surface issues and opportunities to leadership

Who You Are

Experience & Skills

  • 5-7+ years in high-performing environments such as Chief of Staff roles, strategic operations, management consulting, venture capital/private equity, business development, or startup leadership positions
  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Before you do almost anything manually, you've already asked yourself whether AI can do it better. You're constantly tinkering, building small tools, automating your own workflows, and sharing what you find.
  • Demonstrated success in taking ambiguous, complex initiatives and driving them to completion, you're the person who makes hard things happen
  • Strong systems thinking and process design capability, you don't just execute tasks, you build the infrastructure that makes future execution easier and more scalable
  • Exceptional project management and coordination skills across multiple concurrent work-streams with competing priorities and timelines
  • High proficiency with modern collaboration tools (Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack) and intermediate to advanced comfort with AI-powered productivity tools
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable briefs for different audiences
  • Bonus: Experience in high-growth startups, venture studios, or AI/tech companies; background in talent operations or organizational design; proven success driving business development in B2B environments; exposure to board-level strategy and operations

Mindset & Traits

  • Mission-driven operator with deep commitment to Human Agency's values and vision
  • Systems builder, not just task executor, you think about sustainable processes, not one-off solutions
  • High agency and bias for action, you see what needs to happen and make it happen without waiting for permission
  • Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently
  • Ego-free collaborator who earns trust through delivery, not title or authority
  • Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, comfortable moving between strategic thinking and tactical execution
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, you thrive when there's no playbook and create clarity from complexity

Considerations

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus
  • Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible business operations
  • Travel: Occasional (10–25%) for company offsites, key events, and leadership meetings
  • Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs and strong preference for overlap with EST business hours

Equal Opportunity Commitment

Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

Brookfield Real Estate Group is one ofBrookfield’s primary operating groups. Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

BGRE is seeking an experienced property operations professional to oversee and enhance property operations across its North American Logistics portfolio. The Senior Vice President, Head of Property Operations will serve as the primary liaison between BGRE Asset Management teams and third-party property-management providers, ensuring consistent execution, operational accountability, high-quality tenant service, and efficient property-level financial and administrative processes.

The role will establish operating standards, monitor property-manager performance, coordinate property accounting and technology initiatives, and support acquisition onboarding and asset dispositions. The objective is a scalable operating infrastructure that enables Asset Management professionals to focus on leasing, asset strategy, capital allocation, and investment performance.

Role & Responsibilities:

Third-Party Property Management Oversight

  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for CBRE and other third-party property-management providers.
  • Establish and monitor performance standards, reporting requirements, service expectations, and accountability.
  • Conduct regular reviews of property-manager staffing, service delivery, financial processes, and unresolved issues.
  • Oversee compliance with management agreements, operating procedures, and delegated authorities; escalate and resolve issues with regional Asset Management teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service quality, standardize vendor practices, and reduce operating expenses.

Property Accounting and Financial Operations

  • Partner with BGRE Finance, FP&A, and property managers to improve property-level financial reporting accuracy, timeliness, and consistency.
  • Coordinate accounts payable, accounts receivable, tenant billing, expense recoveries, reconciliations, and monthly close workflows.
  • Establish responsibilities and escalation procedures for accounting exceptions while Finance retains accounting-policy, control, and reporting ownership.
  • Support property budgeting, operating-expense reviews, variance analysis, and corrective action on recurring inefficiencies.

Operational Standards and Best Practices

  • Develop consistent procedures for preventative maintenance, inspections, service contracts, vendor oversight, and tenant responsiveness.
  • Coordinate property-level risk management, emergency preparedness, life safety, environmental compliance, and business continuity.
  • Work with regional Asset Management on deferred maintenance, operational risks, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Share best practices across regions while accommodating market-specific and asset-specific requirements.

Acquisition Onboarding and Disposition Support

  • Coordinate operating transitions for acquisitions, including property management, vendor contracts, tenant information, accounting data, and records.
  • Maintain standardized transition checklists, clear ownership, and coordination with Asset Management, Finance, Legal, and Technology.
  • Support disposition readiness through documentation, contract review, operating reconciliations, and resolution of outstanding property matters.
  • Reduce operational disruption, accounting discrepancies, and avoidable post-closing obligations.

Technology, Data, and Process Improvement

  • Coordinate with BGRE Technology and Finance on Yardi, VTS, and related property-management platforms.
  • Improve consistency of operating data, reporting, documentation, access controls, and record retention.
  • Identify automation and Al opportunities in lease administration, document management, reporting, and operational review.
  • Develop practical dashboards and performance indicators for property-management providers.

Tenant Service and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Monitor tenant-service standards and help resolve significant service issues and operational disputes.
  • Coordinate with Legal and Risk Management on insurance, claims, incidents, and compliance.

  • Align property operations with regional asset business plans while preserving regional Asset Management decision rights.
  • Provide regular updates to Asset Management leadership on provider performance, risks, and unresolved issues.

Your Qualifications:

  • 20+ years of commercial real estate experience, including substantial property operations or property-management responsibility.
  • Experience with geographically diversified portfolios; industrial and logistics experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing third-party property managers and driving accountability.
  • Strong knowledge of property accounting, budgeting, tenant billing, expense recoveries, and financial reporting.
  • Familiarity with Yardi or comparable systems and experience with acquisitions, transitions, and process improvement.
  • Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and cross-functional leadership skills; relevant bachelor's degree preferred.

Measures of Success:

  • More accurate and timely property-level financial reporting and fewer recurring accounting exceptions.
  • Measurable improvement in third-party property-manager performance and tenant service.
  • Consistent, efficient acquisition onboarding and disposition transitions.
  • Standardized operating procedures, stronger systems adoption, and lower administrative burden on Asset Management.
  • Scalable property operations that support continued portfolio growth.

Your Career @ BGRE:

At BGRE, your career progression is important to us. As a successful employee, you will have the opportunity to grow within your team, department, and across the Brookfield organization. Our leadership teams are dedicated to the accomplishments of their employees. We also invest time into training and developing our people.

End your job search and find your career today, at BGRE.

Why BGRE?

We imagine, create, and operate on a foundation of values to build a better world, together. BGRE strives to create spaces where going to work never feels routine. As a BGRE employee, you will enjoy many benefits such as 401K matching, tuition reimbursement, summer Fridays, paid maternity leave and more. There is also a generous employee referral program because we want our existing team members to help us build a more diverse workplace through their networks.


Compensation & Benefits:

Salary Type: Exempt

Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly

Medical & Pharmacy Coverage: Yes, under Brookfield Medical Plan Dental Coverage: Yes, under Brookfield Medical Plan

Vision Coverage: Yes, under Brookfield Medical Plan Retirement: 401(k)

Insurance: Employer-paid life & short/long term disability

Our compensation structure is comprised of a base salary and a short-term incentive program (cash bonus). Cash compensation tends to vary based on geography to account for local market conditions and is set to be market competitive. Compensation decisions are based on a number of factors including relative experience, overall years of experience, industry experience, education and designations.


Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. We do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit and business needs, without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.
