jobs.description:
Please review the job details below.

At Lanteris Space, our next generation spacecraft range from Earth observation to interplanetary missions, including the Lunar Gateway Power and Propulsion Element (PPE).


We are looking for a Sr. Avionics/Command and Data Handling (CDH) Subsystem Engineer to join our growing team in San Jose CA. This position may also be performed remotely within the U.S. This position provides an opportunity to develop avionics architectures for various mission types, including low earth orbit constellation designs. An ideal candidate would have knowledge of existing Avionics hardware and background design platforms to accommodate this hardware. The role will support our programs and other CDH engineers for the integration of onboard computer systems, onboard data storage, and required interfaces to have components communicate and function together to provide command and data handling capabilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development subsystem designs, and perform requirements definition and flowdown. This may also involve performing trade studies and analyses to evaluate and optimize total system performance to meet customer operation requirements
  • Develop interface specifications, CONOPS definition, and other design documents related to Avionics subsystems such as (Electrical Power Systems, Flight Computing, Command and Data Handling, etc )
  • Create telemetry budgets & provide inputs for avionics subsystem sizing
  • Collaborate with Flight Software, Database, Harness and other engineers, providing command and data handling expertise to other subsystems as needed. Here, you will also create command, telemetry, and sequence records, as well as input for other associated records
  • Perform verification and validation of the designed system, which will include resolving technical such as those experienced during FSW testing, and Satellite and develop solutions with cross-functional teams to assure mission success
  • Develop and test mission operational products and procedures

Minimum Requirements:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, mathematics, computer science or a related field
  • 5 years of electrical system command and data handling architecture or relevant experience in electrical / avionics engineering for space applications, or an adjacent technical industry

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Familiarity with the space environment and its effect on satellite systems
  • Experience in analysis, design, and implementation of hardware systems, including high-speed digital circuit design and embedded processing and control
  • Knowledge of electronics design and electrical communication standards, such as RS-422/485, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire/Ethernet, CAN, SPI, I2C
  • Software development experience to solve problems, implement process improvements, or support automation (e.g. Python, C++, Java, Matlab,VBA, etc.)
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and team/project leadership skills

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Regional Sales Lead, Midwest

As Regional Sales Lead for Quince’s Midwest territory, you will drive $8-figure growth while building and coaching a high-performing team of 5-12 Account Executives. This is a rare “player-coach” role: you’ll spend your time architecting regional strategy at 30,000 feet while rolling up your sleeves to help close complex enterprise deals. You’ll combine tactical enterprise grit with the leadership intuition necessary to build a world-class sales culture—all while operating in a fast-paced, startup environment where the bar is high and ownership is expected from day one.

Your region spans 14 Midwest states: IA, IL, IN, KS, MI, MN, MO, ND, NE, NM, OK, SD, TX, and WI.

Responsibilities

  • Coach and mentor a team of 5-12 Account Executives, focusing on professional development, tactical closing skills, and performance accountability
  • Lead recruitment and onboarding for the Midwest region, owning full team integration through 30/60/90-day benchmarks
  • Run high-energy weekly standups, 1:1s, and regional offsites; set the pace and standard for excellence
  • Own the regional revenue target by identifying high-value enterprise opportunities and driving net-new pipeline through proactive engagement
  • Join key client meetings and industry events to provide executive presence, navigate complex procurement cycles, and help close deals
  • Maintain “source of truth” integrity in HubSpot; oversee pipeline hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and real-time reporting dashboards
  • Develop, manage, and grow your own book of business alongside your team’s growth
  • Be the ultimate subject matter expert on Quince’s B2B model, product assortment, and customization capabilities for both clients and your team
  • Constantly iterate on sales playbooks, tech stacks, and team infrastructure to remove friction and accelerate the sales cycle
  • Proactively identify opportunities for regional expansion and creative positioning within the segment

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of enterprise sales experience with a proven track record of consistently hitting $5M+ annual quotas
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading high-performing sales teams
  • Power-user of CRMs (HubSpot preferred) with ability to maintain pipeline integrity and leverage data for strategy
  • Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced startup environments while maintaining rigor and accountability
  • Excellent proactive, solution-oriented problem-solving skills and flexibility
  • Strong verbal and written communication with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across levels
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace

Preferred:

  • Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up
  • Background in corporate gifting, promotional products, or apparel sales (ASI, PPAI)
  • Familiarity with AI tools for prospecting, research, and outreach
  • Track record of successful talent development and AE promotion from within

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$230,000—$275,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your pharmaceutical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand regulatory requirements, scientific documentation, manufacturing processes, and quality standards?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking pharmaceutical regulatory, quality, manufacturing, compliance, and technical development professionals who can apply their industry expertise, scientific judgment, and regulatory knowledge to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional pharmaceutical position. You won't be manufacturing products, preparing submissions, or managing quality systems. Instead, you'll assess complex scientific and regulatory content, identify technical inaccuracies, evaluate reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated pharmaceutical and biotechnology content.

You'll analyze scientific, regulatory, manufacturing, and compliance-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in industry standards, regulatory frameworks, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. CMC Regulatory Affairs
Professionals experienced in Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) regulatory activities, regulatory submissions, lifecycle management, and global regulatory requirements.

2. Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance
Experts in quality systems, GMP compliance, deviation management, CAPA processes, quality oversight, and pharmaceutical quality operations.

3. CMC Science / Technical Development
Professionals involved in product development, formulation science, process development, scale-up activities, technology transfer, and product lifecycle support.

4. Regulatory CMC Submission Writing
Specialists experienced in CTD/eCTD authoring, Module 3 documentation, regulatory submissions, and technical regulatory writing.

5. Quality Control / Analytical Development
Experts in analytical testing, method validation, laboratory operations, data review, and analytical regulatory compliance.

6. GMP Compliance / Validation
Professionals with expertise in validation programs, qualification activities, GMP systems, and inspection readiness.

7. Regulatory Compliance Auditing
Experienced auditors who conduct internal, supplier, and compliance audits while evaluating quality systems and regulatory requirements.

8. Pharmaceutical Manufacturing / MSAT
Manufacturing and Manufacturing Science & Technology professionals experienced in process monitoring, troubleshooting, technology transfer, and operational excellence.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way
Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your pharmaceutical or biotechnology career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy
Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely
Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project needs and availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology
Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while applying your existing scientific and regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required
We're looking for professionals who can recognize accurate scientific reasoning, identify errors, and communicate expert assessments with clarity.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

Pharmaceutical Subject Matter Experts: $20-$50 USD/hour

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, and assignment complexity.

Project Details

    • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
    • Work Arrangement: Remote
    • Primary Location: United States preferred
    • Additional Markets: Professionals outside the United States may be considered if they possess substantial U.S. pharmaceutical industry experience
    • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
    • Project Type: Pharmaceutical AI content evaluation
    • Project Duration: Based on project requirements and assignment availability
    • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises prior to project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Pharmaceutical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced pharmaceutical or biotechnology professional who enjoys analyzing complex scientific information, applying regulatory and technical expertise, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals who bring more than familiarity with industry processes. You should be comfortable reviewing technical information, exercising independent judgment, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of four years of relevant professional experience in the regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, or a related discipline.
  • Strong expertise in at least one pharmaceutical specialty listed above.
  • Working knowledge of FDA requirements, GMP regulations, and relevant ICH guidelines, including applicable portions of ICH Q7-Q12.
  • Ability to critically evaluate scientific, technical, and regulatory information.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Confidence reviewing complex information and explaining technical conclusions.
  • Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and online research tools.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
  • Must understand and be comfortable with a task-based freelance engagement model.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • PharmD, PhD, or advanced scientific credentials.
  • Experience preparing or reviewing regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, ANDA, MAA, or equivalent).
  • Experience with FDA-regulated manufacturing, quality, compliance, validation, or development environments.
  • Experience performing quality reviews, regulatory audits, or scientific content evaluations.
  • Experience with technical writing, structured reviews, or compliance assessments.
  • Familiarity with AI model evaluation, prompt review, rubric development, or data annotation.
  • Previous involvement in scientific, regulatory, quality, or technical content assessment activities.

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

GTM Associate

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Be a client’s first touchpoint with Vega - this means being a credible counterpart to senior people at multi-billion dollar managers

  • Work directly with the Head of Strategy and Growth and the CEO to find angles and drive deals forward from start to close

  • Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation: targeting, outbound, qualification, and building the systems around this motion

  • Help build the commercial playbook as you go: taking an operational and systematic lens to turn learnings into a discipline that the team can follow

  • Support the broader growth surface: events, partnerships, content, and marketing

What we look for:

  • 2+ years in investor relations / finance, MBB, or a commercial/operational role at a fast-paced startup

  • Experience in private markets, particularly around investor relations workflows, is a strong plus

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, as well as analytical instincts

  • Genuine tolerance for repetition and rejection - this is some of the highest impact work you can do for the company, but it’s also high volume and requires scrappiness

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills when interfacing with clients who have a very high standard for output and attention to detail

  • Creativity and a bias to action, particularly when supporting with broader growth/marketing topics

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

About the Team

The primary focus of this role is to lead DoorDash’s efforts to maintain optimal work environments that foster positive relationships and two-way communication between employees and leadership. Reporting to the Senior Manager, People Advocacy, the role will help serve as a critical resource to a wide variety of cross-functional teams who support DoorDash’s New Verticals and Customer Service teams.

About the Role

As the Manager, People Advocacy, you will partner with a team responsible for identifying and addressing issues impacting the employee experience of our customer-facing teammates. You will also partner closely with business leaders, Employment Legal, HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, and other functions within the People Team to address identified opportunities.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, develop and execute both the strategic and tactical components of DoorDash’s employee advocacy strategy.
  • Work with partners across the organization to drive positive employee relations.
  • Develop, deploy and leverage communication channels to obtain employee feedback and implement action plans focused on addressing identified opportunities.
  • Create and implement training focused on improving overall people leadership skills.
  • Monitor Employee Relations trends, local and federal law changes, and rulings that have potential impact to DoorDash.
  • Inform leadership and people teams about the potential impacts on employee experience resulting from new initiatives, policies, and programs.

  • Case and Project Management

We are leaders – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

jobs.description:
Join the world's largest HVAC company, named by Forbes as one of America's Best-In-State Employers 2025!

This role is a high-impact executive role responsible for leading the end-to-end supply chain organization. This leader will design and execute global strategies across materials management, demand and supply planning, inventory optimization, and logistics. A primary mandate of this role is to champion and mature the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP / S&OP) process, driving cross-functional alignment between Sales, Operations, Finance, and Product Management to support business growth and customer fulfillment goals.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic SIOP Leadership

  • Own and mature the enterprise SIOP framework to effectively balance market demand with manufacturing and supplier capacity.
  • Lead monthly SIOP executive review cadences, driving alignment on a single consensus demand, supply, and inventory plan utilized for financial forecasting.
  • Perform scenario planning and rough-cut capacity analysis to support demand shifts, new product introductions (NPI), and product lifecycle transitions.

Materials Management & Production Planning

  • Oversee global material planning and execution processes to ensure uninterrupted supply and optimized material flow across all manufacturing facilities.
  • Govern Material Requirements Planning (MRP) system discipline, data integrity, and parameters (e.g., lead times, MOQs, and lot sizes).
  • Strengthen production control and scheduling mechanisms to optimize shop-floor resource utilization.

Supply Chain Strategy & Inventory Optimization

  • Drive working capital performance by establishing strict Days of On-Hand (DOH) targets and reducing Excess & Obsolete (E&O) inventory.
  • Identify, mitigate, and resolve long-range supply chain risks, including labor, equipment, tariff exposure, and material constraints.
  • Design dashboards and KPI scorecards to track forecast accuracy, supplier execution, on-time delivery (OTD), and total supply chain costs.

Inventory Control & Optimization

  • Drive working capital performance by establishing strict Days of On-Hand (DOH) targets, striking a precise balance between peak-season readiness and off-season reduction.
  • Implement robust inventory tracking mechanisms, including multi-site cycle counting and warehouse management systems (WMS) to maximize accuracy.
  • Minimize Excess & Obsolete (E&O) inventory through rigorous management of phase-out components, engineering change notices (ECNs), and legacy replacement parts.

Team Leadership & Supplier Partnerships

  • Provide executive-level guidance and mentorship to a global team of supply planners, materials managers, and analyst professionals.
  • Cultivate strategic relationships with tier-1 vendors, holding partners accountable to contractual commitments and delivery metrics.
  • Foster continuous process improvements utilizing Lean Six-Sigma methodologies to eliminate operational waste and enhance scalability.

Role Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field is required; an MBA or advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global supply chain planning, materials management, and SIOP within a manufacturing environment.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementing or scaling enterprise-wide SIOP / S&OP processes across matrixed organizations.

Technical Skills & Certifications

  • Deep proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced planning tools (e.g., SAP/IBP, Anaplan).
  • Expert-level knowledge of MRP architecture, demand analytics, and lean supply chain principles.
  • Professional certifications such as APICS CSCP, CPIM, or a Six Sigma Green/Black Belt are highly desirable.

Leadership Competencies

  • Exceptional cross-functional influence with the ability to build consensus between high-level sales, finance, and manufacturing stakeholders.
  • Strong financial acumen with a clear history of tying physical material movements to P&L outcomes and working capital metrics.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20%–30% to corporate sites and supplier locations as needed.

HVAC Logistics & Distribution Network

  • Optimize outbound distribution strategies for finished goods, managing complex logistics networks servicing commercial distributors, residential contractors, and job sites.
  • Manage inbound freight operations, mitigating risks associated with long-lead international components and bulky, heavy-gauge raw materials.
  • Cultivate strategic relationships with third-party logistics (3PL) providers and freight forwarders to optimize total landed cost and transportation efficiency.

HVAC Industry Competency

  • Deep understanding of HVAC supply chain dynamics, including regional seasonality, weather-correlation modeling, and distributor channel behaviors.
  • Familiarity with HVAC regulatory frameworks, including EPA refrigerant regulations, DOE energy efficiency mandates, and UL safety standards.
  • Technical comprehension of HVAC bill of materials (BOMs), commodity pricing indexation (copper/steel), and international sourcing constraints.

Systems & Analytics Expertise

  • Advanced proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and dedicated SIOP/Advanced Planning tools (e.g., SAP/IBP, Kinaxis).
  • Expertise in material optimization frameworks, including Safety Stock calculations, Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), and ABC/XYZ analysis.
  • Strong command of logistics metrics, such as On-Time In-Full (OTIF), freight-as-a-percent-of-sales, and warehouse utilization rates.

To succeed here, you’ll collaborate with others and work as one team, across various teams includingsolar and energy storage development, financing, engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) and operations, maintenance and asset management. Are you open to diverse perspectives and prepared to work seamlessly across disciplines to reach our collective goals?

Perform at Peak. We’re seeking team members who bring authentic energy and passion to every task. How can you use your natural strengths, genuine optimism and intelligence to make your greatest contributions to Origis?

Inspire & Grow. The Origis team is comprised of knowledgeable, passionate solar and energy storage experts who bring deep expertise and solution-driven thinking to clients. A successful Origis team member encourages others and sets a high bar for growth. We have a culture of continuous improvement because each team member takes the role of both learner and mentor.

Be Resilient. The spirit in which we tackle the energy challenges and objectives of our clients means we consistently stretch for the extra mile. We all take initiative and remain adaptable, overcoming obstacles by prioritizing respect.

The ideal candidate will be part of the EPC Team focused on the successful transition of projects from the early-stage development to EPC contract execution. Additionally, the individual will lead all early stage estimating, cost forecasting and scheduling.

The position of Director or Senior Director of Pre-Construction is a regular, full-time position, and is eligible for our generous employee benefits package, including employer paid health insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions, and other great benefits.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hire, mentor, manage and support Pre-construction Managers and Scheduling Managers

  • Identifies and communicates potential high-risk items to the Management team and develops action plans to address them
  • Communicates overall EPC strategy/approach in close coordination with Contracts team to facilitate the EPC RFP process and selection
  • Drives the EPC negotiations to timely execution while aligning with cost, schedule, and commercial targets of the project
  • Leads kickoff meetings to transition projects to the Project Management and Construction teams
  • Supports project financing process
  • Coordinates with Project Controls to evaluate active construction project costs and risks to incorporate into current and future project estimates and forecasts

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience (Director), OR, 10+ years experience (Senior Director) in project planning, scheduling, forecasting and estimation, and pre construction development
  • Utility scale solar and BESS project experience required

Key Attributes for Success

  • Ability to work independently on multiple tasks with minimal supervision

  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to perform in a high-growth, fast-paced, collaborative work environment

  • Ability to work with all levels of management

  • Proven ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines
  • Versatility, flexibility and willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm

Job Type: Permanent
Work Model: Remote

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

  • Have many careers in one Firm.
  • Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
  • Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Summary

As part of the Strategic Initiatives team, this position supports the development, execution, and reporting of key cybersecurity priorities for the DTTL CISO and for the Global CISO. The individual will support Initiative Leaders to provide data-driven insights, assess cybersecurity threats and opportunities, and help drive strategic outcomes across a complex, global organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with Initiative Leaders to develop strategic security exposure analysis outputs for actionable recommendations including executive-level, data-driven leadership content.
  • Support the planning, execution, and tracking of current and future strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and objectives.
  • Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, threats, opportunities, and actionable insights for leadership decision-making.
  • Develop reports, visuals, and presentations that effectively communicate strategic priorities, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams to facilitate the successful delivery of key cyber initiatives.
  • Support targeted projects and cross-functional efforts as directed to advance strategic goals and drive measurable results.

About the team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, a Technology-related field, Cybersecurity, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of two years of experience in Information Technology and/or Cybersecurity, with a focus on strategic planning, program delivery, governance, or business enablement.
  • Proven experience working within a complex, global organization and driving initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large volumes of data and translate findings into actionable insights for executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating effectively across global, cross-functional teams with diverse expertise and perspectives.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Ability to assist in translating complex technical concepts, risks, and challenges into clear, business-focused messaging for senior leaders and executives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Broad experience assisting with delivering technology initiatives, with a preference for candidates who have experience in cybersecurity threats/risk/remediations in addition to technical solutioning.
  • Experience in strategic development, planning, governance, and/or solution design
  • Working knowledge of industry-standard security frameworks and controls, including ISO 27001, NIST, and SOC 2.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or similar cybersecurity and risk management credentials are preferred.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $69,000 - $114,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You shape how we make impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

We encourage you to connect with us at if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).

When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. Account Executive — LATAM New Logo + Key Accounts
Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina — remote, with hours that overlap North American business hours
Team: Aquiva Sales
Type: Full-time
English: C1 — fluent English and Spanish, both used daily

About the role

We are looking for a seller who can open an account cold and run a boardroom QBR with the same ease.
Aquiva is a Salesforce consulting and engineering firm that also delivers across hybrid cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and pragmatic AI. What sets us apart is honest, unbiased guidance: we tell customers what they actually need, not what is easiest to sell. We want someone who sells the same way, on both sides of the desk.
This is a blended role, split roughly in half. One half is pure hunting: opening new logos across LATAM against our Ideal Customer Profile. The other half is key account management for existing customers, mostly in North America with some in EMEA, where you own the relationship, grow it, and renew it. The EMEA accounts will stretch into your morning.

What you'll do — New logo acquisition in LATAM (about half the role)

  • End-to-end ownership. Prospecting, discovery, solutioning, proposal, and close for new logos across the region.
  • Targeted outbound. Build an account list against our ICP and work it with discipline across email, phone, LinkedIn, and your own network, in Spanish and English. This is not a volume game.
  • Consultative selling. Sell across Salesforce, hybrid cloud, and pragmatic AI, leading with the customer's problem rather than a product, and position the right engagement model for each one (Scale, Flex, Outcome, Surge, Sustain).
  • Partnering. Work with Vendor Account Executives on joint opportunities, and with Solution Architects and pre-sales on discovery, solution design, and proposals.
  • Hard qualification. Qualify early and walk away from poor-fit deals instead of forcing them.
  • Account landing. Carry each new LATAM account through its first year before transition or expansion.

What you'll do — Account management in North America and EMEA (the other half)

  • Relationship ownership. Be the primary commercial owner for a portfolio of existing accounts.
  • Expansion. Find and close new business inside those accounts, cross-selling and upselling across Salesforce, cloud, and AI.
  • Retention. Protect and grow net revenue retention. Spot churn risk early and coordinate the response with delivery.
  • Account planning. Build account maps, stakeholder plans, and written account and sales plans for each priority account.
  • QBRs. Lead quarterly business reviews that tie delivery to the customer's outcomes and surface the next opportunity.
  • Renewals. Own them end to end: forecast, negotiate, and close on time at a healthy margin.
  • Forecast discipline. Keep pipeline, forecasts, and account activity current and accurate in Salesforce, and stay aligned with delivery leads across the account lifecycle.

Must-have

  • 5+ years carrying a quota in technology services, consulting, or enterprise software, with real experience in both new-logo acquisition and account management or renewals.
  • Proven new-logo success in LATAM, plus account management of North American customers in large commercial and enterprise accounts.
  • Proven success selling Salesforce solutions or selling into the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Experience selling across at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and the ability to hold a credible conversation across all three.
  • Consultative selling skill: turning a business problem into a solution and an ROI case for executive stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience running QBRs, account planning, and renewal negotiations.
  • Comfort selling to technical buyers: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Salesforce platform owners.
  • Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken. Based in or able to work from Buenos Aires, with hours that reliably overlap North American business hours.

Nice to have

  • Account management experience with EMEA customers
  • Portuguese for the Brazilian market
  • Experience at a Salesforce SI, ISV, or PDO, or selling alongside Salesforce account teams
  • Foundational certifications across Salesforce, AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • A structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Challenger
  • Vertical depth in Financial Services, High Tech, Travel and Hospitality, or Healthcare and Life Sciences
  • Fluency using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, and build proposals faster

Benefits

  • Co-working spaces and offices for collaboration
  • Team activities
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Healthcare
  • Paid sick leaves, parental leaves, and volunteer days

jobs.description:
About the role

Our largest enterprise clients need their content to flow from code repositories and CMS platforms into our platform and back, and to work when it gets there. As Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you'll make that happen in a dual role that combines pre-sales engineering and solutions architecture. You won't just suggest a solution; you'll design it, build the proof of concept, and show clients how it delivers outcomes that help them grow globally. You'll be the primary technical architect for our largest enterprise accounts and the technical partner to the Strategic Account Managers and Business Development Directors in your region, working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering, and reporting to our VP, Sales. You'll do well here if you're as comfortable in a terminal as you are in a client presentation.

What you'll do

  • Act as the technical authority in the sales cycle for the Strategic Accounts and Business Development teams, presenting confidently to senior client leaders and enterprise IT teams, and lead product demos of our platform.
  • Lead requirements workshops with enterprise clients to define integration points, data models, and orchestration patterns, and produce technical blueprints and data-flow diagrams that balance security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Design, implement, and improve end-to-end workflows that connect translation management systems (TMS) and Acclaro technology with client content management systems (CMS), document management systems (DMS), and other core enterprise platforms, and advise on API architecture, webhooks, and secure middleware development.
  • Build proofs of concept that validate proposed solutions and win client buy-in.
  • Deploy our content intelligence workflows, combining our platform, large language models, and human-in-the-loop feedback cycles, to deliver measurable outcomes and faster turnaround for clients.
  • Turn complex content intelligence architectures into simple, compelling business value for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to follow current trends and develop solutions for customer needs, and with Delivery and Operations to confirm technical viability, align Sales expectations with what we can deliver, and make sure handover and execution go smoothly.
  • Keep improving our processes by automating manual QA gates and removing technical bottlenecks in the content lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • typically 7+ years of progressive experience in localization engineering, pre-sales engineering, or solutions architecture at a large language service provider (LSP), language technology vendor, or global tech company, or equivalent experience
  • excellent communication across functions, with the ability to align Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering teams, linguists, and project managers
  • confidence handling complex enterprise procurement and IT security discussions
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including turning complex manual processes into simple, automated ones
  • a clear understanding of content intelligence, where the question is moving from "did we deliver it?" to "did it work?", and the ability to design and sell solutions for that shift

Nice to have

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of at least two enterprise TMS platforms, such as Phrase, Lokalise, Trados Enterprise, Smartling, XTM, or memoQ
  • Hands-on experience designing or scoping translation workflows that combine machine translation, large language models, and human-in-the-loop review
  • Development skills: at least one scripting language (such as Python, JavaScript, or Ruby) for automation, Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines, and regular expressions (regex) and XPath for advanced text extraction
  • Expert knowledge of localization standards, including XLIFF, TMX, TBX, and SRX
  • An understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA
  • If you have some of these, great. If you don't, we'd still like to hear from you.

Who we are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

  • Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.
  • Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.
  • Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.
  • Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.
  • Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Software Engineer 1 (New Grad)

College Board – Technology

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position

 

About Technology at College Board

We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.

About the Team

The Core Assessment Platform is a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving shared platform capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions at scale. The work spans a range of assessment contexts, from routine evaluation to more complex, high-stakes environments, where accuracy, consistency, and trust are essential. Teams collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and operations to build reliable capabilities that can be reused and adapted over time. What makes this group special is its focus on continuous learning, experimentation, and steady improvement, with success driven by thoughtful collaboration, iteration, and careful decision-making in environments where reliability and quality matter.

 

About the Opportunity  

In this role, you’ll contribute to production systems used at significant scale while learning how large, secure platforms are designed, built, and evolved responsibly. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to ship code, test ideas, and improve shared capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions. The focus is on learning by doing, while gaining exposure to real-world engineering challenges while building a strong foundation in modern development practices. This role emphasizes growth, feedback, and continuous learning. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment thoughtfully, and develop an understanding of system, not just features, while contributing meaningful work in an environment where reliability and quality matter.

 

In this role, you will:

Design & Implementation (65%)

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of high-quality software using modern technologies, focusing on building component-based, cost-effective, scalable, and secure solutions. You’ll learn and apply established design patterns to support integration with other services and applications, promote code reuse, and improve collaboration across teams.
  • Contribute to the development of application logic and responsive user interfaces using ReactJS, JavaScript (ES2015+), TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Assist in building, maintaining, and scaling, cost-effective serverless solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Follow and uphold engineering standards in collaboration with product owners, architects, and stakeholders, in support of our systems and services.
  • Learn to understand new product capabilities and decompose the implementation into specific functional changes for verification.
  • Apply and continue to develop skills best practices in Agile development, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps to deliver reliable, high-quality software.

Team Operations & Analysis (20%)

  • Participate in Agile SCRUM ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Grooming, Daily SCRUM, Demo) and contribute to team commitments.
  • Review requirements and provide input, asking questions and learning how design decisions are made.
  • Participate in peer reviews of code, designs, and other software engineering artifacts, giving and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Practice continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) by implementing, testing, and delivering code in line with the team’s DevOps model.
  • Actively develop skills needed to work effectively in a poly-skilled Agile team, including collaboration, communication, and continuous learning.

Software Solutioning & Support (15%)

  • Develop an understanding of the customer’s business processes and operational needs, learning how systems are used in real-world contexts.
  • Work closely with Solutions Architects, Senior/Lead Engineers and Data Leads to evaluate requests, help assess level-of-effort and contribute to sprint planning activities.
  • Participate in peer code and design reviews.
  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving application issues, including access, communications, and feature behavior, with support from the team.

About you, you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 0-3 years of production-level software development experience or exposure using the College Board technology stack, including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, and AWS.
  • Hands-on experience developing, debugging, and supporting web-based software applications in professional environments.
  • Proficiency in reviewing and improving code structure and architecture for testability, maintainability, scalability, and security.
  • Experience participating in software design discussions for new features and bug fixes.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, ask the right questions, and develop effective solutions.
  • Clear communicator with practical decision-making skills and a strong belief in clean code, meaningful comments, and thorough documentation.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

  • Maintain the Deal Desk playbook: fallback positions, clause library, approval matrix, and the reasons deals get stuck

  • Track record of coordinating multi-party approvals across Sales, Finance and Legal on tight timelines

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 117,600 - EUR 141,120. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law.
