jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada Health is looking for an experienced product marketing leader to help us win in GLP-1 and cardiometabolic health. This role supports our new program development marketing, including GLP-1 solutions, with an emphasis on differentiated positioning, commercial execution, and bringing new offerings to market. This is a hands-on player-coach role with one direct report. Your primary focus will be leading strategy and personally delivering high-impact work, complemented by focused coaching and development of a product marketer.

You will be a strategic partner to commercial, product, and clinical leadership, translating buyer needs, competitive dynamics, and field insights into a clear, compelling reason to choose Omada. You will own product messaging, go-to-market strategy, and support sales enablement, helping our teams connect the right offering and value story to each buyer’s priorities. Your highest priorities will be buyer and offer clarity through developing positioning and value stories by segment and asset development with a fast market-to-field feedback loop that increases selling effectiveness.

At the center of this role is a continuous feedback loop between the field and our value story. You will work closely with sales, consultant relations, and other channel and customer-facing teams to understand what resonates and why we win or lose. You will turn those insights into stronger messaging, more effective sales tools, and recommendations that inform product and commercial strategy, then bring those improvements back to the field and assess what works.

About you:

  • Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including 5+ years in healthcare and life sciences. Experience in virtual care, digital health, health plans, PBMs, or pharma is preferred.
  • Commercial judgment: A track record of shaping product marketing strategies that help sales teams compete and win in complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. You understand how employers, health plans, PBMs, and benefits consultants evaluate clinical and economic value.
  • Product marketing craft: Demonstrated strength in buyer research, competitive intelligence, positioning, messaging, go-to-market planning, product launches, and sales enablement.
  • Strategic and hands-on execution: You can set a clear direction and personally build the presentation, business case narrative, competitive response, or launch messaging needed to move the work forward. You've done this on a lean team, delivering field-ready work in weeks, not quarters.
  • Field partnership: Experience working directly with sales and customer-facing teams to turn deal-level feedback into actionable insights, stronger value stories, and repeatable approaches to selling.
  • Compelling storytelling: The ability to translate complex clinical, product, and economic information into clear, credible content tailored to different buyers and stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional leadership: The ability to influence decisions, facilitate productive feedback, and align teams across commercial, product, clinical, and marketing without relying on formal authority.
  • People development: Experience directly managing and developing marketing talent, with a willingness to balance coaching one direct report with substantial individual contribution.
  • Measurement: Experience defining KPIs and using qualitative and quantitative feedback to assess buyer understanding, field readiness, competitive conversion, and adoption, rather than simply counting materials produced.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Your impact:

You will help turn Omada’s GLP-1 and cardiometabolic strategy into a differentiated commercial story that drives selling effectiveness. Success means buyers understand our value, the field is equipped to win the right opportunities, and eligible members receive a clear, consistent explanation of the care available to them.

Market sensing that drives action:

  • Run a regular win/loss forum that incorporates competitive feedback.
  • Facilitate a fast feedback loop across Sales, Consultant Relations, channel teams, Product Marketing, and Strategy. Translate signals into clear recommendations about what has changed and what we should do differently, not simply market updates.
  • Partner with Product and Clinical to translate programs and analysis into messaging implications.
  • Close the loop by bringing updated messaging and tools back to the field, pilot in select deals, and using the results to guide further improvements.

Buyer segmentation and differentiated positioning:

  • Set annual product marketing priorities for how Omada wins in GLP-1 and cardiometabolic health: who we target, which problems we solve, and why buyers should choose us over alternatives.
  • Work through a broader B2B and Brand Marketing organization to drive awareness of your program segments and strategy
  • Develop distinct value stories for employers covering GLP-1s and those not covering them, and for buyers prioritizing cost management versus population health. Support segment adaptation for consultant and payers.
  • Maintain one coherent Omada portfolio narrative, with differentiated reasons to buy across audiences, offerings, and channels.
  • Partner with Clinical and Thought Leadership to translate evidence into relevant proof points and identify evidence gaps that matter to purchasing decisions.

Offer clarity and the buyer business case:

  • Turn capabilities into understandable, purchasable offers that clearly explain what is included, who qualifies, how access works, who pays, and what value is supported by evidence.
  • Co-develop packaging and pricing recommendations, comparison and business-case tools, and guarantee messaging with Product, Finance, Strategy, and commercial partners.
  • Ensure clinical and economic claims are clear and credible, explicitly distinguishing observed results from modeled savings and explaining relevant assumptions and limitations.

Sales and channel effectiveness:

  • Personally build and refine the narrative, pitch decks, discovery guides, competitive responses, proof points, and support business-case tools that help the field sell effectively.
  • Partner with sales leaders on priority opportunities, tailoring the value story and addressing clinical, operational, and economic objections. Turn successful approaches into repeatable tools and practices.
  • Equip consultants, PBMs, and other channel partners with a compelling reason and a practical way to sell Omada, including channel-specific messaging, use cases, and materials that fit their selling process.
  • Partner with Customer Effectiveness on practical training, and test messaging and tools in real buyer conversations rather than treating delivery of an asset as the finish line.

Launch readiness and continuous adaptation:

  • Support commercial readiness for new GLP-1 and cardiometabolic offerings, not just announcement day, aligning the offer, messaging, evidence, training, channel materials, and member communications.
  • Lead product marketing’s launch planning and post-launch optimization, with clear cross-functional responsibilities and feedback from early selling and member experiences.
  • Keep messaging and tools current as capabilities, evidence, and market conditions change.

Lead as a player-coach:

  • Manage and develop one product marketer, setting clear priorities, providing regular feedback, and supporting growth.
  • Maintain direct ownership of strategic initiatives and core deliverables, modeling strong product marketing craft and close partnership with the field.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius builds the infrastructure serious AI teams run on — GPU clusters, inference runtimes, agent development environments, data pipelines — all of it purpose-built for the most demanding AI workloads. What we are now building is the ecosystem function that ensures the best AI companies choose to build on us, integrate with us, and stay.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, Ecosystem, you will sit at the intersection of solution architecture and hands-on engineering. You assess how partner products actually work on our stack, define the reference architecture for each integration, build the working prototype that proves it, and translate what you find into product requirements that shape what Nebius ships next.

Your responsibilities will include:

Solutioning & Architecture

  • Design and prototype integrations between partner products and the Nebius platform — fast, hands-on, and technically sound
  • Define reference architectures for partner integrations — not just what works, but how it should work at scale and in production
  • Scope partner architectures against our platform — how does this product actually work on our stack, where does it snap together, where does it break
  • Build production-quality proof-of-concepts across the AI stack including agentic pipelines, RAG architectures, inference optimization patterns, and multi-model orchestration
  • Produce working proof-of-concepts that serve as the starting point for product creation — not a requirements doc, a working thing
  • Maintain a library of reference architectures and integration patterns that internal product and engineering teams can build from

Technical Partner Scoping

  • Work directly with partner engineering teams to scope, prototype, and progress integrations
  • Assess partner architectures honestly — if the integration is painful, that is signal; if it snaps together in a weekend, that is also signal; report both
  • Provide technical guidance to partners on how to maximize performance, reliability, and cost efficiency on Nebius infrastructure
  • Produce technical scoping that gives your pod partner and internal teams a clear picture of integration feasibility, depth, and complexity

Internal

  • Translate external integration findings into actionable product requirements for Nebius platform teams
  • Work with ISV partners, SI teams, and field teams to scale solution adoption and drive revenue once a solution is ready
  • Surface recurring architectural patterns and integration gaps to inform platform roadmap decisions

jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a key product area within Rithum's commerce platform. You operate largely independently, tackle open-ended and ambiguous problems, and bring cross-functional teams together around a shared vision. You are expected to have deep expertise in your domain and leverage AI-powered capabilities to rapidly shape the next generation of commerce for the world's largest retailers and brands.

Responsibilities

  • Be the owner of your product and drive the long-term vision for the world’s leading eCommerce platform, leveraging AI-first approaches to accelerate discovery, decision-making, and delivery.
  • Synthesize qualitative inputs—including client interviews, support tickets, and survey feedback—using AI tools to identify themes, opportunity areas, and prioritization inputs that inform product strategy.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to drive efficient business processes, improve team operations, and align client needs with internal objectives.
  • Own and drive roadmap prioritization for your product area, making independent decisions on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs while incorporating AI-assisted insights and data exploration.
  • Leverage AI tools to prototype and validate product concepts and workflows (e.g., user flows, wireframe descriptions, low-fidelity mocks) to de-risk ideas prior to engineering investment.

Qualifications

  • Experience driving strategy and execution for complex, integrated software ecosystems, particularly with unifying multiple platforms

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior SIEM Onboarding Engineer to lead the end-to-end onboarding of log sources and security telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel and CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM. This is an engineering-focused role responsible for designing, implementing, validating, and documenting integrations before formally transitioning them to the Security Operations Center (SOC).

Working within a highly collaborative cybersecurity team, the successful candidate will serve as a technical subject matter expert, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and work directly with customers on complex security projects.

Responsibilities

Plan, design, test, and deploy log source integrations into Microsoft Sentinel and CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM.

Act as the subject matter expert for Microsoft Sentinel and provide expertise in SIEM engineering and onboarding activities.

Design and maintain Microsoft Sentinel data collection capabilities, including data connectors, Data Collection Rules (DCRs), KQL transformations, custom tables, Azure Monitor Agent deployment, syslog/CEF forwarding, and custom log ingestion.

Design and maintain CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM onboarding capabilities, including data connectors, Falcon Log Collector deployments, HEC ingestion, routing pipelines, and custom parsers.

Build and maintain API-based integrations and automation scripts using technologies such as REST APIs, PowerShell, Python, and Bash.

Optimize data ingestion for quality, completeness, normalization, and cost efficiency.

Validate onboarded data sources, including parsing accuracy, field mapping, data health, latency, and coverage.

Develop and deliver operational handover documentation for the Security Operations Center, including onboarding checklists, data dictionaries, monitoring guidance, known limitations, and operational runbooks.

Maintain log source inventories, technical documentation, and onboarding backlogs.

Perform ad hoc firewall changes and provide recommendations related to network architecture, hardening, segmentation, log transport, and collector placement.

Contribute to the architecture, design, implementation, and integration of the Claroty OT security platform.

Partner with project managers, customers, and technical teams to deliver successful security solutions.

Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute thought leadership to the evolution of SIEM engineering practices.

Perform other related duties as required within the scope of the role.

Qualifications

Minimum five years of experience in security engineering, SIEM engineering, or enterprise log management.

Demonstrated subject matter expertise with Microsoft Sentinel, including Data Collection Rules, data connectors, Azure Monitor Agent, KQL, and ingestion-time transformations.

Strong experience onboarding and managing enterprise-scale log sources and security telemetry.

Experience with API integrations, authentication technologies, automation, and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.

Strong Windows and Linux administration experience, including logging, services, agents, system hardening, and troubleshooting.

Working knowledge of enterprise networking and firewall technologies, including rules, NAT, segmentation, and syslog/CEF transport.

Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.

Ability to work independently, solve complex technical challenges, and deliver solutions directly to customers.

Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

Experience in professional services, consulting, or managed service provider environments is considered a strong asset.

Additional Requirements

Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM is strongly preferred.

Experience with operational technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS), or the Claroty platform is considered an asset.

Experience with observability, log-routing, or data-pipeline technologies is considered an asset.

Familiarity with standards such as ASIM or Elastic Common Schema is considered an asset.

Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, AZ-500, CrowdStrike certifications, Security+, or CISSP are considered assets.

This position is fully remote within Canada.

Occasional after-hours support may be required in response to customer emergencies.

Eligibility to obtain a Government of Canada Reliability Status clearance is considered an asset.

Compensation

$115,000 to $150,000

We have 1 available position(s).

Notify Your Manager: Before applying, or immediately after, you are asked to inform your current manager of your application, in line with our Internal Transfer Guidelines Policy.

Hiring Manager Notification: The hiring manager for the new role will be made aware of your application.

1:1 Interview: A Corporate Talent Acquisition Specialist will contact you to schedule a one-on-one interview following your application.

Eligibility: Employees are generally expected to have at least 18 months of tenure with Calian, including 12 months in their current position, to be eligible for an internal transfer. For full details, consult the Corporate Talent Acquisition and Hiring Policy or contact your Talent Acquisition team.

jobs.description:
The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst position serves as a critical link between our internal business teams, external clients, and the Business Intelligence Engineering team. This highly collaborative, client-facing role translates business and client reporting requirements into accurate, actionable reports and dashboards, supporting the launch and ongoing operations of our patient services programs.

Our technology environment includes Salesforce, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, and Tableau. This position focuses on reporting requirements, data quality validation, and visualization development, partnering with BI Engineers who are responsible for data integration, transformation, and underlying infrastructure.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

Business Requirements & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions with internal stakeholders and external clients to define reporting objectives, KPIs, and data requirements.
  • Translate requirements into documented reporting specifications, including data definitions, calculation methodologies, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage requirements through the development lifecycle, including stakeholder reviews, testing, and final acceptance.

Data Quality, Validation & Analysis

  • Validate the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data in reports and dashboards, using SQL to investigate discrepancies and reconcile results across source systems and the data warehouse.
  • Develop and execute validation test cases; document discrepancies and coordinate remediation with BI Engineers and data owners.
  • Establish repeatable validation and quality assurance procedures to improve reporting reliability and reduce manual testing.

Reporting & Dashboard Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Tableau dashboards and reports that communicate operational performance, patient services program metrics, and client-specific KPIs; develop Salesforce reports and dashboards as needed.
  • Apply data visualization best practices, leveraging curated datasets and approved data models from BI Engineering.
  • Perform user acceptance testing, coordinate stakeholder approvals, support deployment, and maintain documentation of report definitions and business logic.

Collaboration, Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as primary liaison between business stakeholders, external clients, and BI Engineering; define requirements for new data elements and enhancements.
  • Support reporting governance through standardized KPI definitions, documented business rules, and consistent dashboard design, ensuring appropriate handling of protected health information (PHI).
  • Streamline recurring reporting processes, support reporting for new patient services program launches, and train stakeholders on dashboard use and self-service reporting.

Skills & Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or reporting, with demonstrated ownership of reporting deliverables.
  • Strong experience gathering and documenting business and reporting requirements with internal stakeholders and/or external clients.
  • Hands-on Tableau proficiency, including interactive dashboards, calculated fields, filters, and parameters.
  • Strong SQL proficiency, including data validation and reconciliation of reporting results.
  • Demonstrated data quality validation experience and ability to translate business needs into clear specifications, KPI definitions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to independently manage deliverables from requirements gathering through development, testing, and stakeholder acceptance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills for technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with external clients to define and deliver reporting requirements.
  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient services, or other regulated-industry reporting experience; familiarity with HIPAA and PHI handling.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM reporting and dashboards.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse; working knowledge of dbt and Fivetran.

Our Infrastructure and Database Reliability functions have grown together under one manager, and grown fast. As the team scales to support live, high-traffic events year-round, we're splitting that org into two focused disciplines so each can go deeper: Infrastructure Engineering, and Database Reliability Engineering- this role.

You'll own database infrastructure, data lifecycle and management strategy, and live-event operational readiness. You'll partner closely with the Infrastructure Manager on shared systems and help develop the database team's next generation of technical leaders — we are looking for someone focused on supporting and growing the team around them.

What You'll Do

  • Own cloud database infrastructure - AlloyDB, Redis, Kafka and others, capacity planning, and database vendor management, including commitment/CUD strategy and spend accountability.
  • Support our identity and access modernization - an inclusive, workflow-aware migration to a modern identity platform, with appropriate limits on high-risk access and a break-glass mechanism for emergencies.
  • Own data lifecycle and strategy - build a set of data services that enables data aging, archiving, and retention over a multi-year cycle.
  • Contribute to creating a database observability framework; logging, metrics, and alerting that produces clear, actionable signals instead of noise, and that doesn't depend on any one person knowing which dashboard to check.
  • Lead high-availability operations for our biggest live moments: on-call design, war-room readiness, staffing plans, and vendor escalation coordination for season kickoffs, the Super Bowl, and other peak-traffic events.
  • Own the data side of our business continuity and disaster recovery planning and execution.
  • Partner closely with the Infrastructure team on shared infrastructure surfaces, caching, messaging/queues, and the boundary between application and data infrastructure, so the seam between the two teams is invisible to the rest of engineering.
  • Maintain database security and compliance: vulnerability remediation, edge security, access controls, and support for compliance and audit processes.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts across the database portfolio, including budget ownership and negotiation.
  • Build and grow the team; identify and develop technical leads, delegate real ownership, and build a bench so critical work never depends on a single person.
  • Represent DBRE in cross-functional planning (feature launches, load testing, migrations)
  • Balance KTLO (Keeping the Lights On) work against forward-looking productivity investments; scope and prioritize a multi-quarter infra roadmap

What You Have

  • 5+ years managing database, DevOps, or SRE teams, ideally for a consumer product with real-time, high-concurrency, or seasonal/event-driven traffic patterns.
  • Deep hands-on background in cloud infrastructure (GCP strongly preferred; AWS or similar also relevant), relational and non-relational databases (AlloyDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB), and infrastructure-as-code (Crossplane, Cuelang, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).

  • Experience in a technology startup environment is a strong plus. Relevant DevOps, Cloud, or SRE certifications are a plus.

We default to no surprises. If something's at risk, we want the heads-up early, not a clean status update that turns out to be wrong.

We show up prepared. Meetings are for decisions and alignment, not for finding the agenda in real time.

Ownership means owning a problem until it's actually solved or handed off, not until you've stopped thinking about it.

Our best managers focus on enabling others rather than doing all the hands-on work themselves. We invest deliberately in growing tech leads and delegating real ownership.

We move fast without single points of failure. Anything that matters has at least two people who can carry it.

We'd rather fix the systemic problem than patch the symptom, even when the patch is faster.

jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

What success looks like:

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

  • Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
  • Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
  • Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
  • Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
  • Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
  • Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
  • Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
  • Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
  • Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
  • Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
  • See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

What you will bring:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
  • Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
  • A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
  • You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
  • You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
  • You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
  • You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
  • Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
  • You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
  • You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
  • You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.
The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.
At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Abramson Labor Group is seeking a detail-oriented Case Manager to handle an assigned California workers' compensation caseload from intake through resolution. This role audits files at every stage of the WC process, prepares complete case summaries, calculates temporary and permanent disability, evaluates QME/AME reports, and identifies cases that are ready to settle. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and proactive — someone who keeps cases moving, follows up on delays, and knows when to escalate.

Key Reposnsibilities

Case Auditing & Management

  • Manage an assigned workers' compensation caseload from intake through final resolution
  • Audit cases at every stage of the California WC process and set clear, actionable next steps
  • Prepare full case summaries and keep them current as cases develop

Disability Calculations & Medical-Legal Review

  • Calculate temporary disability (TD) and permanent disability (PD), including PD ratings and apportionment
  • Review QME/AME reports, determine whether each is favorable or unfavorable, and identify the appropriate next step

Resolution & Communication

  • Identify when a case is ready to settle and escalate it to the appropriate team
  • Work directly with defense attorneys and claims adjusters to keep cases progressing
  • Follow up on delays and escalate issues when needed

Required

  • Experience handling California workers' compensation cases (applicant side preferred)
  • Working knowledge of the California WC process from intake through resolution
  • Ability to calculate TD and PD, including PD ratings and apportionment
  • Experience reviewing and evaluating QME/AME reports
  • Strong written communication skills, including clear and complete case summaries
  • Confident communicating with defense attorneys and adjusters
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage a full caseload and meet deadlines

Preferred

  • Prior case manager, senior paralegal, or hearing representative experience at a WC law firm
  • Familiarity with EAMS and the California PD Rating Schedule
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish)

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay: Competitive hourly pay: $25.00 – $30.00
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance and retirement plans
  • Room to grow: real opportunities for professional development and career advancement
  • A supportive culture: a team built on collaboration, integrity, and excellent client service
  • Meaningful work: help injured workers get the care and support they deserve

Customer Success Manager - SMB

Own a book of [xx-xx] SMB accounts and help each one get real results from Balto.

Role

Customer Success Manager, SMB

Location

Fully remote, U.S. only

Type

Full-time

Book

60 accounts, about $1.5M

Salary

Salary Range Base is $65k - $75k, OTE of $105k

Posted

October 23, 2026

About Balto

Balto builds AI for contact centers. We help agents in the moment, score every call so leaders don’t have to, and show teams what their customers are really saying, all in one place.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Learning Stipends

About the role

Balto, a pioneering tech startup that has built a suite of AI tools for large sales and customer service teams, is seeking a talented SMB Customer Success Manager to join our team. Your mission will be to manage a portfolio of new and existing customers, making sure they have the help, resources, and insights they need to get the most out of Balto.

Our SMB team runs a scaled model. You'll own a book of customers who can reach you directly, and you'll use AI and automation to stay ahead of every account instead of relying on one-to-one outreach alone. You will be instrumental in facilitating ongoing business and fostering lasting partnerships. This is a fully remote position, offering you the flexibility to work anywhere in the U.S.

What you’ll own

  • Your book: 60 SMB accounts, about $1.5M in total book of business.
  • Renewals: the full renewal process for every account in your portfolio.
  • Growth: retention, expansion, and adoption across your book. These are the numbers you’ll be measured on.

Who we’re looking for

You’re an empathetic, organized, and driven customer success professional. You build strong relationships, learn how each customer’s business works, and connect what they need to the value Balto delivers. You’re also their advocate inside Balto, working with our teams to remove obstacles and spot opportunities to grow.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Thrive on building trust and strong customer relationships
  • Enjoy solving problems and removing obstacles for customers
  • Are proactive, organized, and comfortable managing a large portfolio of accounts
  • Get excited about using AI and automation to do more for customers, not less
  • Love connecting customer goals to measurable outcomes and ROI
  • Can balance customer advocacy with business needs like renewals and expansion
  • Want to help build out a new initiative within Balto

Key responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders
  • Lead ongoing customer communications, including check-ins, business reviews, and renewal conversations, using a mix of one-to-one conversations and automated, scaled outreach
  • Develop a clear understanding of each customer's goals, needs, and success metrics

Scaled Engagement and Automation

  • Run automated customer plays in our customer success platform for onboarding, adoption, and re-engagement, and step in personally when an account needs it
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and personalize customer emails, in-app messages and other customer engagements so every message still sounds like it came from you
  • Contribute to and help run our scaled programs, including a weekly tips email, live office hours, and a customer community
  • Spot patterns across your book and suggest new plays, content, or automations that help many customers at once

Adoption and Value Delivery

  • Support new and existing customers with resources, guidance, and best practices
  • Identify opportunities to increase product adoption and usage across customer teams
  • Help customers measure and communicate Balto's value, including ROI and performance impact
  • Partner with internal teams to ensure customers have what they need to be successful

Renewal and Expansion

  • Own the contract renewal process for your portfolio, including timelines, customer alignment, and execution
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to expand accounts through additional licenses and product add-ons
  • Propose pricing, product expansions, and terms for existing customers in partnership with internal stakeholders

Problem Solving and Risk Management

  • Proactively identify customer risks, roadblocks, and adoption challenges, using AI-driven health scores and signals to catch them early
  • De-escalate issues and coordinate solutions to keep customers on track
  • Track customer health, usage, and engagement to prevent churn and improve outcomes

What you’ll bring

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role
  • Experience managing SMB or mid-market customer relationships, ideally in a scaled or tech-touch model
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strategic and detail-oriented thinking style
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Ability to analyze customer usage data and identify trends
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) in your daily work
  • Experience building or running automated playbooks in a customer success platform such as ChurnZero, Gainsight, or similar
  • Experience with change management and adoption initiatives
  • Working knowledge of Excel and comfort with basic data analysis
  • Empathetic, customer-first mindset with a passion for delivering value

Career growth

This role offers multiple paths for growth at Balto:

  • Senior Customer Success Manager. Take on more complex relationships and lead higher-impact renewals and expansions.
  • Enterprise Customer Success Manager. Manage larger implementations and deepen your strategic partnership skills.
  • Leadership. Grow toward a Customer Success leadership track, mentoring other CSMs and driving retention and expansion.

Our hiring process

Our process includes virtual interviews and a take-home assessment. Together, they show us how you solve problems, how you communicate, and how comfortable you are with the tools and data a CSM works with every day.

Why Balto

Six values shape how we work:

  • Anchor on Success. We start every task by picturing what success looks like, then set ambitious goals to get there.
  • Love Every Customer. Every customer, whatever their size or complexity, should feel valued and supported.
  • Talk Things Out. We solve problems through open, honest conversations, without the barriers of hierarchy.
  • Always Be Growing. Everyone owns their professional development, and our culture backs them up.
  • Own the Work. We take initiative, solve problems proactively, and produce results we’re proud of.
  • Start with Gratitude. We recognize each other’s contributions, even in tough discussions.

Choosing Balto means joining a company where your work is meaningful, your growth is encouraged, and your contributions are valued. It’s go time.

How to apply

Visit balto.ai/careers, select See Open Roles, then choose Customer Success Manager - SMB.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Balto is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and have equal opportunities to succeed. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Balto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Job Title: People Operations Coordinator - Temp to FTE Opportunity, 3 month contract

Job Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.
  • Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.
  • HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.
  • Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.
  • PBP, ER & Programs Support.
    • PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.
    • Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.
    • Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.
  • Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.
  • Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.
  • Country Expertise. Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

THE TEAM:

Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Coordinators are the front door of the People organization: warm, responsive and exact, with the pride in getting it right that earns managers’ and employees’ trust. We are a global team across India, Mexico and the United States, we cover for one another, and we share what we learn so every pod gets better. We take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

THE SKILL SET:

  • 2-4 years in HR operations, shared services, or HR administration
  • Hands-on HRIS experience and a case management tool (JIRA, happy fox, service now, etc.)
  • Strong attention to detail, discretion with confidential data, and clear written communication
  • Comfort supporting business leaders and managers, and working across time zones and cultures
  • Exposure to global employment practices and multi-country HR administration is preferred
  • Experience supporting a high-growth or sales-led organization is preferred
  • Experience with process documentation, reporting, or workflow automation is preferred

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from @ email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable. The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Base Pay Range
$50,000—$70,000 USD

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101004

Position Overview

The Go-to-Market Data & Intelligence (GDI) organization empowers Autodesk teams to make better customer decisions using trusted data, analytics, and data science. The Data Science team develops Machine Learning products that help Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams determine which customers to engage, when to engage them, what actions to take, and how to measure the impact of those actions.

We are looking for a dynamic Senior Manager, GTM Data Science to join the GDI leadership team. You will lead a diverse team of data scientists and own the portfolio, execution, adoption, and measurable business impact of data science initiatives across customer intelligence domains. This role requires deep technical credibility, strong people leadership, operating discipline, and the ability to influence senior business and data leaders.

The data science team applies descriptive, predictive, and experimental methods to customer data to optimize decisions related to customer renewals, expansion, and segmentation. The data science team partners closely with GDI program management, analytics, ML engineering, and GTM teams and their operational partners to create customer intelligence experiences that are embedded in GTM workflows.

Success in this role is not measured only by the quality of models or insights delivered. You will be accountable for translating ambiguous business objectives into the right problems and products, prioritizing opportunities by expected business value, working across functions to integrate data science products into how GTM teams work, and demonstrating that those products improve decisions and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the multi-quarter Data Science roadmap for customer engagement use cases, aligned with GDI priorities and Autodesk business objectives

  • Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify and prioritize the decisions where data science can create the greatest customer and business value

  • Translate ambiguous strategic questions into clear decision frameworks, analytical problem statements, intervention strategies, success metrics, and business cases

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to executives and cross-functional leaders; challenge assumptions, make clear recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs in a way that supports timely decisions

  • Define success measures before development begins and hold the team and partners accountable for adoption and realized outcomes, including customer retention and growth, conversion, engagement effectiveness, seller and marketer productivity, and resource allocation

  • Own and actively manage a portfolio of Decision Intelligence initiatives across areas such as retention and churn, growth potential, upsell and cross-sell, segmentation, propensity and lead prioritization, license compliance, attribution, benchmarking, what-if scenarios, and next-best action

  • Lead the end-to-end lifecycle from problem formulation and data readiness through modeling, validation, deployment, workflow integration, experimentation, impact measurement, and post-launch monitoring

  • Make explicit portfolio tradeoffs, sequence work based on expected value and feasibility, and redirect or stop initiatives when evidence indicates that the opportunity is no longer compelling

  • Partner with GDI program management, analytics engineering, data engineering, product managers, and federated analytics teams to define requirements, operating dependencies, delivery plans, and adoption mechanisms

  • Establish clear operating rhythms and quality standards for the team, including roadmap reviews, technical reviews, launch readiness, outcome reviews, and escalation of material risks

  • Provide technical leadership that ensures the problem formulation matches the decision need - including when to use prediction, experimentation, causal inference, optimization, ranking, simulation, or other approaches

  • Guide the team across statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, causal methods, propensity and uplift modeling, scoring and prioritization, and related advanced analytics techniques

  • Maintain a high technical bar for data quality, leakage prevention, model evaluation and calibration, reproducibility, explainability, bias and fairness considerations, drift monitoring, and offline versus online performance

  • Ensure machine learning products connect predictions or insights to specific actions, interventions, or policies and that their incremental impact can be measured whenever practical

  • Stay current on advances in machine learning, AI, experimentation, causal inference, and decision intelligence, and apply the appropriate methods when to improve customer or business outcomes

  • Lead, recruit, retain, and develop a high-performing team of data scientists with clear roles, standards, accountability, and career expectations

  • Coach senior individual contributors and emerging leaders, developing both deep technical capability and the judgment required to operate effectively with business stakeholders

  • Conduct performance and talent reviews, provide candid and actionable feedback, identify development opportunities, and build succession and hiring plans for critical capabilities

  • Create an inclusive team environment that values rigorous technical debate, curiosity, continuous learning, cross-functional collaboration, and accountability for outcomes

  • Build organizational capability beyond individual projects by improving reusable methods, decision frameworks, operating practices, and partnerships across the broader EDA organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant hands-on applied experience

  • 3+ years of experience managing data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics teams

  • Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong technical fluency in Python or R and SQL, with the ability to engage in detailed technical design and model-review discussions

  • Demonstrated experience taking analytical or machine learning products from an ambiguous business problem through development, deployment, adoption, and measurable impact

  • Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and model evaluation techniques

  • Demonstrated ability to identify the right business problems to solve and translate business objectives into decision, measurement, and analytical frameworks

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders with data and analysis and leading cross-functional initiatives that depend on contributions from multiple disciplines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts, recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs to audiences ranging from technical practitioners to executives

  • Strong judgment, ownership, and execution: you proactively identify gaps, resolve ambiguity, make clear recommendations, and remain accountable for outcomes across organizational boundaries

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, subscription, customer lifecycle, or commercial analytics supporting Sales, Marketing, and/or Customer Success

  • Experience building or scaling decision intelligence, next-best-action, propensity, prioritization, experimentation, or other analytical products embedded in operational workflows

  • Experience with production machine learning and the operational lifecycle of models, including monitoring, retraining, and collaboration with engineering or MLOps teams

  • Experience managing a portfolio of analytical products and making prioritization decisions based on expected customer or business value

  • Experience developing senior technical talent, organizational capability, and operating mechanisms in a growing data science organization

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
The Impact of a Demand Generation Director at Coupa:
The Demand Generation Director is accountable for the integrated demand strategy and its execution across the Americas. The position owns the regional demand process end to end, including demand planning, sales play and outreach cadence design, pipeline health, and lead-to-deal conversion, and sets the foundation for how demand is generated and progressed in the Americas.

The position is the primary point of coordination between Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and Revenue Operations for demand matters in the Americas. It chairs the regional Demand Board, holds the integrated demand plan, and is accountable for the pipeline health and conversion outcomes that result. This is an individual contributor position that operates through influence across the demand ecosystem rather than through direct authority.

What You'll Do:

    Demand strategy and planning

  • Leads the regional demand process, including planning, coordination and analysis, and is accountable for the integrated demand plan for the Americas.
  • Develops integrated demand strategies that align marketing, sales and partner activity to regional pipeline and revenue objectives.
  • Sets the demand planning calendar and the inputs required from each contributing function, and holds those functions to the agreed plan.
  • Determines where demand investment is directed by segment, solution and route to market, and recommends reallocation where performance requires it.

    • Demand execution and sales plays

  • Designs tactical sales plays and outreach cadences tailored to specific target audiences and aligned to business priorities, in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Sales Enablement.
  • Accountable for the execution of the demand plan in the Americas, including sequencing, coverage of priority accounts and segments, and completion against the agreed calendar.
  • Partners with the Revenue Systems directors on the platforms and configuration that support demand motions, including prospecting and contact data, sales engagement and cadence management, and submits requirements through the established intake process.
  • Accountable for adoption and performance of the sales plays and cadences released into the region, and for revision or retirement of those that do not perform.

    • Pipeline health and conversion

  • Accountable for a healthy and predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities for the regional sales organization, measured against defined coverage and quality standards.
  • Uses data and analytics to track the performance of demand generation initiatives, and identifies the drivers of variance between plan and actual.
  • Accountable for lead-to-deal conversion improvement in the Americas, including diagnosis of conversion loss by stage, source and segment, and the remediation plan.
  • Tracks performance and progress of demand activity against pipeline health metrics, and reports status on a defined cadence.

    • Cross-functional coordination and governance

The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early-phase oncology clinical research site network. For more than two decades, START has been dedicated exclusively to oncology research, providing cancer patients with access to cutting-edge clinical trials and helping bring innovative therapies to market faster. Through our mission of "Hope Through Access", we deliver world-class research across the United States and Europe.

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Director, Regional Pharmacy Operations to provide executive leadership and strategic oversight of pharmacy services across our European network. This role is responsible for leading Investigational Drug Services (IDS), clinical pharmacy operations, and regulatory compliance while driving operational excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement across multiple countries and sites.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in investigational medicinal product (IMP) management, clinical trial pharmacy operations, sterile compounding, and regulatory compliance. As a key member of the leadership team, the Senior Director will play a critical role in shaping the future of pharmacy operations, supporting organizational growth, and ensuring the highest standards of patient safety and quality across the region.

This role requires a strategic and collaborative leader who can successfully drive alignment across geographically distributed sites, balancing operational efficiency and growth with uncompromising regulatory compliance and patient care standards. Success in this position will depend on the ability to build strong partnerships across functions and regions while fostering consistency in pharmacy operations, quality standards, performance metrics, and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for pharmacy operations across all European sites.
  • Drive consistency in pharmacy standards, SOPs, KPIs, quality systems, and compliance practices.
  • Oversee investigational medicinal product (IMP) management, including procurement, storage, distribution, accountability, and disposal.
  • Ensure compliance with EU Clinical Trial Regulation (CTR), EU GMP, GDP, GDPR, and applicable national regulatory requirements.
  • Lead quality, inspection readiness, and audit preparedness initiatives across the region.
  • Develop and mentor pharmacy leaders while fostering a high-performing, collaborative, and service-oriented culture.
  • Champion operational excellence through process improvement, innovation, and technology adoption.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, and executive leadership teams to support strategic growth objectives.
  • Establish operational metrics and data-driven decision-making frameworks to improve performance and scalability.
  • Support new site integrations, protocol activations, and organizational change initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • PharmD, MPharm, or equivalent recognized pharmacy degree.
  • Current pharmacist registration/licensure within an EU member state.
  • 10+ years of progressive pharmacy leadership experience, including investigational or clinical research pharmacy operations.
  • Proven experience leading multi-site pharmacy or healthcare operations.
  • Deep knowledge of clinical trial pharmacy services, IMP management, GCP, ICH, EU GMP, GDP, and quality management systems.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change and strategic initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, financial management, stakeholder engagement, and team development skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Preferred

  • Board Certified Oncology Pharmacist (BCOP) certification.
  • Oncology or Health-System Pharmacy residency training.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Experience supporting early-phase oncology clinical trials.
  • Experience working across multiple European countries and regulatory environments.
  • Fluency in Spanish, English and/or other European languages.

Travel Requirement: Approximately 50% travel across Europe.

Why Join START?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of pharmacy operations within one of the world's leading oncology research organizations. You will work alongside exceptional clinical and operational leaders dedicated to accelerating access to innovative cancer therapies while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and patient care.

If you are passionate about advancing oncology research, building high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence at scale, we invite you to join START and help transform cancer care across Europe.
