About the role

Our largest enterprise clients need their content to flow from code repositories and CMS platforms into our platform and back, and to work when it gets there. As Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you'll make that happen in a dual role that combines pre-sales engineering and solutions architecture. You won't just suggest a solution; you'll design it, build the proof of concept, and show clients how it delivers outcomes that help them grow globally. You'll be the primary technical architect for our largest enterprise accounts and the technical partner to the Strategic Account Managers and Business Development Directors in your region, working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering, and reporting to our VP, Sales. You'll do well here if you're as comfortable in a terminal as you are in a client presentation.

What you'll do

  • Act as the technical authority in the sales cycle for the Strategic Accounts and Business Development teams, presenting confidently to senior client leaders and enterprise IT teams, and lead product demos of our platform.
  • Lead requirements workshops with enterprise clients to define integration points, data models, and orchestration patterns, and produce technical blueprints and data-flow diagrams that balance security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Design, implement, and improve end-to-end workflows that connect translation management systems (TMS) and Acclaro technology with client content management systems (CMS), document management systems (DMS), and other core enterprise platforms, and advise on API architecture, webhooks, and secure middleware development.
  • Build proofs of concept that validate proposed solutions and win client buy-in.
  • Deploy our content intelligence workflows, combining our platform, large language models, and human-in-the-loop feedback cycles, to deliver measurable outcomes and faster turnaround for clients.
  • Turn complex content intelligence architectures into simple, compelling business value for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to follow current trends and develop solutions for customer needs, and with Delivery and Operations to confirm technical viability, align Sales expectations with what we can deliver, and make sure handover and execution go smoothly.
  • Keep improving our processes by automating manual QA gates and removing technical bottlenecks in the content lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • typically 7+ years of progressive experience in localization engineering, pre-sales engineering, or solutions architecture at a large language service provider (LSP), language technology vendor, or global tech company, or equivalent experience
  • excellent communication across functions, with the ability to align Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering teams, linguists, and project managers
  • confidence handling complex enterprise procurement and IT security discussions
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including turning complex manual processes into simple, automated ones
  • a clear understanding of content intelligence, where the question is moving from "did we deliver it?" to "did it work?", and the ability to design and sell solutions for that shift

Nice to have

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of at least two enterprise TMS platforms, such as Phrase, Lokalise, Trados Enterprise, Smartling, XTM, or memoQ
  • Hands-on experience designing or scoping translation workflows that combine machine translation, large language models, and human-in-the-loop review
  • Development skills: at least one scripting language (such as Python, JavaScript, or Ruby) for automation, Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines, and regular expressions (regex) and XPath for advanced text extraction
  • Expert knowledge of localization standards, including XLIFF, TMX, TBX, and SRX
  • An understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA
  • If you have some of these, great. If you don't, we'd still like to hear from you.

Who we are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

  • Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.
  • Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.
  • Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.
  • Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.
  • Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.excerpt: About MPLC MPLC is the legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe.
jobs.description:
About MPLC

MPLC is the legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. For over 30 years, we’ve been the trusted partner to major Hollywood studios, independent producers, and the wider creative ecosystem, ensuring content creators are paid fairly and organisations respect copyright.

About Global Technology Services

GTS is technology at MPLC, all of it. And we are honest about where we are: we are rebuilding and elevating our technology capability, from the ground up and by design. New platforms, new data foundations, new roles: this team is being built for what MPLC becomes, not what it was. You will own real outcomes early, automate the repetitive rather than absorb it, and help shape the rebuild rather than inherit someone else’s. Technology is the engine of how MPLC grows. People are the fuel. AI is the turbocharger. That is where you come in.

The Role in Two Bullet Points
  • Define and own the architecture that connects MPLC's systems, data and platforms, ensuring the technology estate scales in a structured and sustainable way.
  • Lead the design of integrations, systems of record and platform standards that create a connected, governed and future-ready technology environment.

Let's Be Honest!

  • You'll be MPLC's first dedicated architecture hire, so there won't be an established architecture function waiting for you.
  • This role is as much about influencing people and decisions as it is about technical expertise.
  • You'll need to be comfortable making recommendations and providing clear direction across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Some systems and processes have developed organically over time, so part of the role is creating clarity, consistency and structure.
  • We need someone who's practical and delivery-focused. Well-designed diagrams are helpful, but only if they lead to better outcomes.

If you need more information

We're looking for an Enterprise Architect to help shape MPLC's technology future.

Reporting to the CIO, you'll take ownership of the overall architecture of our technology estate, covering systems, data, integrations and platform design. You'll help define how our applications fit together, where critical business data should live and how information moves across the organisation.

Working closely with key business stakeholders, you'll ensure technology decisions support the wider goals of the business. You'll establish standards, guide platform selection, design integration patterns and help create a technology estate that's easier to maintain, scale and evolve.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning strategy into reality. You'll be expected to influence direction, document decisions, test ideas and work alongside the team to bring architectural designs to life.

You'll Love This Role If...
  • You have experience designing and managing architecture across multiple platforms, systems and data environments.
  • You understand how CRM, finance, data and business applications work together within an organisation.
  • You have strong knowledge of Salesforce from a platform and integration perspective.
  • You're comfortable working with APIs, integrations and modern approaches to connectivity.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems and bringing structure to environments that have evolved over time.
  • You can balance technical best practice with practical business needs.
  • You like taking ownership, making evidence-based decisions and seeing your ideas delivered.

Benefits

• Salary band: £85,000-£120,000 depending on experience.
• Remote Working with occasional travel.
• 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
• Private medical insurance (AXA), including dental, optical and 24/7 GP access.
• Life assurance at 3x base salary (Legal & General).
• Salary sacrifice pension with Aviva, 4% employer contribution.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), MUI, JavaScript
  • Testing: Jest, ESLint, Prettier, Storybook, Playwright, K6
  • Backend: Node.js, AWS (ECS, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito, SQS, EventBridge)

What would make you a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Computer Science/Engineering degree or equivalent
  • Strong Node.js experience and demonstrated ability to ship production backend services
  • Experience building React-based frontends that consume RESTful APIs
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and clear understanding of separation of concerns in service design
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar)

  • Comfortable working on a 100% remote team and able to operate independently within an agile group

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience building or operating payments systems — payment orchestration, tokenization, acquirer integrations (Worldpay, Stripe, Adyen, Finix, Basis Theory), or PCI-compliant environments
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures (SQS, EventBridge, Kafka)

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We at Innovaccer are looking for a Head of Payer Marketing to own marketing for our payer-facing portfolio — Galaxy (Payer Risk & Quality, Payer Utilization Management) in full, plus the Payer Interoperability swimlane within Gravity — end to end, the way a General Manager owns a business: strategy, story, pipeline, and reputation, not just a set of campaigns.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We at Innovaccer are looking for a Head of Payer Marketing to own marketing for our payer-facing portfolio — Galaxy (Payer Risk & Quality, Payer Utilization Management) in full, plus the Payer Interoperability swimlane within Gravity — end to end, the way a General Manager owns a business: strategy, story, pipeline, and reputation, not just a set of campaigns.

Strategy, flight plan, execution, and messaging all sit with one person in this role — a combination that is rare at this level. Most marketing leadership roles own execution against someone else’s plan, or own messaging without the mandate to act on it. This role owns the whole payer-facing arc, from go-to-market strategy through to how Innovaccer is positioned with payer buyers. You are not the person running campaigns day to day — you set the plan and the standard, and a team you build and lead executes to it.

A Day in the Life

  • Set the payer go-to-market strategy across Galaxy and Payer Interoperability: target payer segments (health plans, MCOs, government programs), competitive positioning, and priority use cases, informed by Product roadmap, Sales signal, and payer market research.
  • Define the annual and quarterly flight plan for the payer portfolio and own the marketing budget behind it, deciding what the portfolio will and will not pursue.
  • Ensure a continuous flow of payer-specific research grounds the strategy — payer buyer interviews, win/loss analysis, regulatory and reimbursement shifts, competitive scans — and convert that research into decisions, not decks.
  • Own the pipeline generation number for the payer portfolio directly. Identify the portfolio’s Big Bets — the largest, most strategic payer deals — and build a dedicated plan around each: account-based engagement, executive touchpoints, and reference activation.
  • Own payer-facing messaging and positioning directly, backed by real payer domain fluency (risk adjustment, utilization management, quality/Stars, interoperability mandates) — you write and set the narrative yourself.
  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the Galaxy Product leader (Michelle) and Sales leadership — sit in Product’s planning cadence, own payer product launches end-to-end from a marketing standpoint, and equip Sales with what they need to win payer deals.
  • Coordinate with Gravity’s and Flow’s Heads of Marketing on payer-adjacent messaging — Gravity’s Payer Interoperability swimlane sits under this role directly, and Flow’s PA/Coding/Denials work touches payers operationally even though it stays under Flow’s Head of Marketing.
  • Represent the payer portfolio externally — payer conferences, health plan briefings, industry events, analyst calls, media, and LinkedIn — building a reputation as a payer-market voice, not only an internal operator.
  • Lead the payer portfolio’s swimlane owners and the associates running flight-plan execution. Delegate the operational engine with clear ownership, set goals aligned to the flight plan, and grow the team under you.

What You Need

  • 10+ years of experience in category or product marketing, with direct experience marketing to health plans, MCOs, or government payer programs — not provider-only healthcare technology experience.
  • Strong understanding of payer operations and economics: risk adjustment, utilization management, quality/Stars ratings, government program administration (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid), and the regulatory and reimbursement trends shaping payer technology decisions.
  • A proven track record of setting go-to-market strategy and being accountable for the pipeline and revenue outcome it produces — not just executing a plan set by someone else.
  • Direct experience writing and owning payer-facing messaging and positioning yourself, with the payer domain fluency to make an independent, defensible call on it.
  • Experience as a primary marketing partner to Product and Sales leadership selling into payers — sitting in planning cadences and roadmap conversations, not being briefed after decisions are made.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead a team, delegate operational execution, and be judged on outcomes rather than personal output.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to represent the payer portfolio externally to payer-market analysts, media, and industry audiences.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

Here’s What We Offer

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
  • Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
  • Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. Innovaccer Inc. participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility of all newly hired employees based out of the U.S. and employed by Innovaccer Inc.

Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure DevOps

Location:Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) with proven hands-on expertise in Azure cloud services, Azure DevOps, Azure EXternal Entra ID, Azure networking, Redis, and .NET application integration. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in designing, implementing, automating, and maintaining secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. Candidates with Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) and Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions (AZ-305) certifications are required, demonstrating expertise in Azure networking, infrastructure architecture, and enterprise cloud solution design.

This is a critical role that bridges infrastructure, DevOps, and application engineering, ensuring high availability, security, and scalability of modern cloud-native applications in a startup-driven, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Azure DevOps & CI/CD

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for .NET and other application stacks.
  • Implement end-to-end DevOps practices including automated build, test, deployment, release, and rollback.
  • Integrate code scanning and security analysis tools (e.g., SonarCloud, GitHub Advanced Security, or Azure DevOps Security Scanning extensions) into CI/CD pipelines to enforce secure coding practices and detect vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle.
  • Manage Git repositories and branching strategies; enforce quality gates and automated testing.
  • Integrate pipeline workflows with Azure Key Vault, App Configuration, and Application Insights.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Use Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep to define and deploy Azure infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes, monitoring, and deployment using PowerShell, YAML, or Azure CLI.
  • Build reusable scripts and templates to standardize infrastructure provisioning.

Azure Platform Engineering

  • Work with core Azure services: App Services, Azure Functions, API Management, Cosmos DB, Redis Cache, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and more.
  • Implement, configure, and manage Azure API Management (APIM) to expose, secure, throttle, and monitor APIs; implement policies for transformation, caching, and authentication; and integrate APIM with backend .NET services and Azure B2C for secure identity management.
  • Manage and configure Azure Active Directory B2C, including custom policies, identity providers, and integration with .NET apps.
  • Configure and monitor Azure Redis Cache for low-latency, high-performance data access in distributed applications.

.NET Application Integration

  • Write and maintain .NET (C#) code that interfaces with Azure services such as Azure Storage, Event Grid, Redis Cache, Service Bus, and Azure AD B2C.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to ensure cloud-ready, scalable design patterns.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of .NET applications deployed to Azure.

Security, Monitoring & Governance

  • Implement role-based access control (RBAC), managed identities, and secure DevOps practices.
  • Work with the security team to audit infrastructure and implement compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, ISO, SOC).
  • Configure and use monitoring tools like Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Network Watcher.

Required Qualifications

Certification:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert AZ 400 (Required)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate - AZ 700 (Required)
  • Microsoft Certifified: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions AZ 305 (Required)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / Developer Associate AZ 104 (Optional)
  • Microsoft Certified : Develop AI apps and agents on Azure AI 103 (Optional)

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Azure cloud infrastructure and DevOps engineering
  • 3+ years of experience with .NET development and deployment in cloud environments
  • 2+ years of working with Azure AD B2C, including user flows, policies, and app registrations
  • 2+ years of experience integrating and optimizing Azure Redis Cache

Technical Skills:

  • Deep expertise in Azure DevOps tools (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts)
  • Proficient in .NET Core / C# with hands-on coding and debugging experience
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using ARM, Bicep, or Terraform
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, load balancers, DNS, NSGs, VNets
  • Familiarity with container technologies (Docker, AKS is a plus)

DevOps Tools & Languages:

  • PowerShell, Bash, Azure CLI, YAML
  • Git, GitHub/GitLab, Azure Repos
  • Monitoring & logging: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, ELK (optional)

Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, Agile environment with minimal supervision
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and containerized .NET apps
  • Experience with OAuth2.0 / OpenID Connect, especially in context of B2C
  • Familiarity with mobile app backends hosted on Azure
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and secure DevOps practices
  • Familiarity with Azure Front Door and Application Gateway
  • Working knowledge of other cloud platforms such as AWS and Google Cloud (GCP), and ability to compare or integrate services across multi-cloud environments

What We Offer

  • 100% remote work flexibility
  • Opportunity to work in a cloud-first, modern tech environment
  • Exposure to cutting-edge cloud architecture and enterprise-grade security practices
  • A collaborative, startup-oriented engineering culture

Application Instructions

Please submit any relevant Azure certifications. If you have a GitHub or code samples demonstrating Azure DevOps and .NET integration, include them in your application.

Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're growing our world-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a visionary Principal Full Stack Engineer to join our Core Platform Team

Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a high-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch.

We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today.

We’re looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are “all in” on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results.

Why Steer?

  • True Ownership: You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high-velocity teams.
  • Hyper-Growth & Vision: We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space
  • Freedom to Innovate: You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product.
  • AI-First & Agentic Culture: We are refactoring our teams to be agentic-first. We prioritize high-level problem-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Strategy & Ownership: Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools.
  • Architectural Vision: Lead the design of reusable full-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance.
  • Adaptive Development: Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless.
  • Customer-Centric Engineering: Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve.
  • Code Excellence: Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization.
  • Modern DevOps & Agentic Infrastructure: Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI-integrated, agentic-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows.

What You Have

Must Have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience building complex, web-based SaaS products.
  • The “All-In” Mindset: A deep commitment to Steer’s mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast-paced environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development.
  • AI in Production: Proven experience deploying AI-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production-grade infrastructure.
  • AI-Driven CI/CD: Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration).
  • Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with our current stack: .NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early-stage startup environment.
  • Experience building or integrating with Claude marketplace plugins (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screen — 30 min with Lead Recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 60 min with the Head of Engineering & Product
  3. Technical Interview — 60 min with a Principal Engineer
  4. Collaborative Interview — 30 min with Lead Product Manager

What We Offer

  • Equity Options: Own a piece of the company's success.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance.
  • Flexible PTO: With a 15-day minimum.
  • FSA, HSA, and 401k options.
  • Learning Stipend & WFH Equipment: Everything you need for a world-class home office.
  • Innovative Culture: A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic-first environment.

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together

Our Meaningful Mission
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity:We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. Our remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, highly diligent financial leader to serve as the US FP&A Lead. In this critical dual-impact role, you will take immediate ownership of our US financial operations, regulatory finance function, and core FP&A processes while acting as a key strategic partner to leadership and cross-functional teams.
You will bridge high-rigor financial governance, regulatory compliance, and strategic cost-center analysis to drive business performance and optimize financial outcomes in a high-growth environment. Operating as a primary accountable financial officer, you will manage state-level regulatory reporting across key US jurisdictions (including New York, New Jersey, Florida, and California), liaise with state regulators, and lead preparations for multi-state licensing examinations. Concurrently, you will serve as a proactive advisor—translating complex data into actionable insights, delivering accurate forecasts, and influencing key stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and commercial success.
Key Responsibilities
  • Strategic FP&A & Commercial Planning:Lead US budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and strategic financial planning to support rapid growth, guide commercial decision-making, and uncover opportunities that drive top-line growth and profitability.
  • Business Performance & Budget Management:Challenge the business on performance tracking versus budget targets, ensure strict adherence to financial targets, and manage cost-center reporting across teams.
  • Financial Analysis & Strategic Advisory:Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze financial data and key business metrics, track trends, identify areas of concern, and proactively generate actionable insights to improve cost efficiency and overall performance.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Executive Reporting:Serve as a strategic advisor to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, aligning their goals with broader company objectives while enhancing financial reporting through clear, compelling storytelling.
  • Regulatory Finance & Compliance:Own state-level regulatory compliance across key jurisdictions, including NMLS MSB Call Reports, Tangible Net Worth (TNW) monitoring, permissible investment tracking, and surety bond management.
  • Audit, Financial Reporting & SOX Control:Own audited US financial statements, financial reporting, and the internal controls environment maintained with SOX-level rigor.
  • Regulator & External Examiner Engagement:Serve as the key executive liaison to state regulators and external auditors, leading multi-state licensing examinations (MSE) and regulatory financial audits.
  • Leadership, Process Improvement & Scaling:Establish and scale the US finance function and continuously implement process improvements to streamline reporting, boost forecasting accuracy, and drive sound decision-making.

What you bring to the table
  • Core Credentials & Background: Active US Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential, or fully qualified accountant certification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA).
  • Progressive Finance Leadership: 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 3–5+ years in regulated financial services (e.g., money transmission, payments, fintech, or banking) along with strong experience as a Finance Business Partner or managing cost-center budgets.
  • Regulatory Finance Ownership: Hands-on experience with state-level regulatory requirements, including NMLS filings, MSB call reports, Tangible Net Worth (TNW) monitoring, permissible investments, and surety bonds.
  • Financial Controls & Reporting Rigor:Direct experience owning audited US financial statements, managing external audit relationships, and maintaining internal controls with SOX-level rigor.
  • Regulatory Approval Readiness:Ability to be approved quickly as an NMLS control person / executive officer, requiring an established US background suitable for standard FBI fingerprinting, credit, and background checks.
  • Financial Analytics & Strategic Decision-Making:Strong ability to analyze complex financial data, track business trends, and craft detailed reports and compelling narratives that inform strategic decision-making.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Collaboration: Proactive team player who collaborates seamlessly across departments with a demonstrated track record of influencing key stakeholders and driving alignment with company goals.
  • Execution & Adaptability:Proven capability to perform effectively in high-pressure, fast-paced environments while maintaining an uncompromised focus on accuracy, quality, and tight deadlines.

Bonus Points
  • Audit / Advisory Background:Big 4 audit or transaction advisory experience.
  • Exam Experience:Prior experience leading or managing multi-state licensing examinations (MSE).
  • FP&A Depth:Deep strategic FP&A and financial modeling background prior to broad financial management.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team
If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Langate is an award-winning provider of web development services in 3 main categories: business, healthcare, and education. We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineering Lead who combines software architecture, team leadership, and practical AI engineering. This is a role for someone who can quickly understand a complex existing system, define where it should go next, and lead a team to get there, while keeping the live product stable for its users.

About the project 

The product is a SaaS platform for the U.S. healthcare insurance domain. It helps customers read, collect, and process large volumes of insurance-related data and connects to multiple data sources in different ways. It is a multi-tier system with data warehouse, middleware, and front-end layers, built on the .NET stack (ASP.NET MVC and Web API, message queuing, Windows services, and a set of microservices) with MS SQL. The product is live and in active use, and the company is now preparing its next stage: modernizing the platform and bringing an AI-driven approach to architecture and development so that new functionality reaches users faster. Which parts move to a new architecture, which new services are built with an AI-driven approach, and what stays as it is are exactly the decisions this role will help shape.

What success looks like: in your first two months you get to know the system and the team, shape the first version of the target architecture together with our Engineering Manager, and present a small proof of concept. By month three, the goal is an agreed plan, development running at a steady pace, and first practical results on one to three new modules or features. By month six, the new team is delivering new functionality on the agreed architecture.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Software / Application or Solution Architect, combined with a Team Lead role

  • Strong .NET / C# background across ASP.NET Framework and ASP.NET Core, including migration from .NET Framework to modern .NET

  • Hands-on front-end experience with Angular and React: the current front end is built on Angular, and React is a likely direction for new modules given its strong support in AI-driven and agentic development

  • Practical experience designing and running solutions on Azure Cloud: Web Apps, Azure Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault, networking (VNets, private endpoints), Cosmos DB and Application Insights

  • Hands-on experience modernizing brownfield or legacy systems: auditing an existing system, defining a target architecture, writing specifications, and planning a phased migration

  • Mature architecture practice: documenting decisions as ADRs, defining and measuring non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, availability, security, observability), and explaining trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders

  • Around 1+ year of practical AI Engineering (AI SDLC / Agentic Engineering) experience: spec-driven development, agentic coding tools, context engineering, AI-assisted review and testing, and readiness to write code yourself, not only to lead

  • Strong quality engineering mindset: test strategy, automated testing and CI/CD quality gates, especially for AI-generated code

  • Experience teaching and coaching engineers in AI-driven development through workshops, pairing and hands-on examples, and turning individual practices into team standards

  • Experience across several projects and different architectures, not just one system

  • Experience managing an engineering team and introducing AI-driven approaches into delivery

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the healthcare or insurance domain (HIPAA, working with sensitive data)

  • Experience in a product company or a startup, or your own side project or business

  • Experience building AI capabilities into products (LLM integration, RAG, evaluations)

  • Ability to move fast with lean processes and a clear focus on business results

Responsibilities:

  • Go through knowledge transfer and build a deep understanding of the existing product, its architecture and integrations

  • Define and agree on non-functional requirements with the Engineering Manager and the business, and use them as the basis for architecture decisions

  • Definethetargetarchitectureand a phasedmodernizationstrategy: whattorewrite, whattokeep (includingintegrations) andwhattomoveintoseparateservices

  • Record key decisions as ADRs, turn them into clear architecture artifacts and specifications, and validate them together with the Engineering Manager

  • Build a proofofconcept, thenleadtheimplementationofnewmodulesandfeatureswhilestayinghands-oninthecode

  • Act as Team Lead: own the team’s technical delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and pairing

  • Teach the team AI-SDLC and Agentic Engineering through regular workshops and work on real tasks, and maintain a shared team playbook (specs, agent instructions, review checklists)

  • Assessthecurrentteam, formthenewcoreteam,andbuildtrustandeffectivecollaborationwithinit

Description

About Coralogix

Coralogix is a full-stack observability and security platform built for modern engineering teams that need real-time visibility at scale.

Our platform brings together logs, metrics, traces, security events, infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and user experience in one place. With a no-index architecture and in-stream analytics, Coralogix helps customers reduce cost, retain more data, and troubleshoot faster without compromising scale or performance.

We are looking for technical sellers who can help customers understand the value of a different approach and prove it in real-world environments.

﻿The Role

We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our East Coast pre-sales team, focused on LATAM customers and involving frequent travel across the region.

This is a senior, hands-on technical sales role. You will partner with Account Executives to run technical discovery, lead product evaluations, design solutions, and help customers validate Coralogix in their own environments.

During evaluations, you will be expected to do more than present the platform. You will act as the technical owner, helping customers deploy, configure, integrate, troubleshoot, and validate Coralogix across their environments. You need to be credible with engineers, confident with executives, and capable of moving between architecture, code, configuration, and business value.

This role is for someone who can earn trust in technical conversations, build strong relationships with LATAM customers, and help drive deals to a strong technical close. Frequent travel across LATAM is an important part of the role.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for sales opportunities in partnership with Account Executives.
  • Lead discovery across customer architecture, telemetry sources, operational pain, business drivers, and success criteria.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations that connect Coralogix to real customer use cases.
  • Manage technical evaluations and POCs from scope through validation.
  • Support hands-on deployment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting during evaluations.
  • Work with customers across logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes, cloud environments, applications, and security use cases.
  • Explain Coralogix’s architecture, differentiation, and value clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify technical risks, remove blockers, and guide customers toward a successful technical decision.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to represent field feedback and improve how we win.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering .
  • Native level Spanish and fluent English are required. Portuguese or additional languages - strong advantage.
  • ﻿Experience leading technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept processes.
  • Willingness to travel frequently across LATAM.
  • Strong hands-on technical ability across deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration work.
  • strong understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, APM, dashboards, alerting, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Ability to speak credibly with engineers, DevOps, SRE, platform, and security teams.
  • Confidence engaging executives and translating technical value into business impact.
  • Practical experience with cloud-native environments, distributed systems, containers, and modern infrastructure.
  • Coding or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or similar.
  • Strong communication, ownership, follow-through, and commercial judgment.

Technical Experience

Relevant experience may include:

  • Kubernetes and containerized environments
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Prometheus
  • Docker
  • APM and distributed tracing
  • Log analytics and telemetry pipelines
  • SIEM or security monitoring
  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • RUM
  • Terraform, Helm, or deployment automation
  • CI/CD workflows
  • Application instrumentation and debugging

What Success Looks Like

The best Solutions Engineers at Coralogix are not just strong presenters. They are technical owners.

They can uncover pain, define success, build a validation plan, and prove value in the customer’s environment. They are hands-on enough to earn credibility with practitioners and commercially aware enough to help move opportunities forward.

They know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and when to escalate.

Why Join Coralogix

Observability is changing fast. Data volumes are growing, budgets are under pressure, and teams are rethinking the platforms they rely on.

Coralogix gives customers a different path: real-time analytics, open standards, strong security and observability use cases, and an architecture designed for scale.

As a Solutions Engineer, you will play a central role in strategic evaluations, competitive opportunities, and the technical decisions that help customers choose Coralogix.

﻿Compensation and Benefits

The on-target earnings range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, education, and work location.

Our total rewards package includes healthcare, dental, mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid sick time, and paid time off.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Cultural Fit

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart.

Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it - banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user. James Goodfellow, working at Smiths Industries, uncovered the insight that you needed something you have (a card) and something you know (a PIN). Because someone told him they could only remember 4 digits instead of his proposed 6, today over 3 million ATMs use a card+4 digit PIN over 60 years later.

Like the ATM, Mercury is building technology that pushes forward financial interfaces for the long term. Command is Mercury's LLM-powered financial assistant, launched to all customers in June 2026. It lets users understand their finances and take action in plain language, from asking about cash flow to sending payments, issuing cards, and managing invoices. With the product now in customers' hands, the work is to evolve it, extend its capabilities, and find new ways to leverage LLMs to give Mercury customers a more powerful banking* experience.
